title: 001 Pokemon Rosso
description: Acchiappali tutti! Il tuo viaggio per diventare il migliore Allenatore di Pokémon di tutti i tempi ha finalmente inizio! Ma non sarà facile: nel bellissimo e vastissimo mondo dei Pokémon ne esistono ben 150 specie diverse. Dopo che avrai incontrato Clefairy, Pikachu e tanti altri, lo spirito del gioco ti prenderà e... vorrai acchiapparli tutti! Cattura i Pokémon, allenali e forma delle squadre imbattibili. Sviluppa la tua strategia Pokémon e supera brillantemente tutte le sfide e le lotte contro gli altri Allenatori fino ad arrivare al vertice della Lega Pokémon! Ti aspetta un'entusiasmante avventura: riuscirai a diventare il più grande campione di Pokémon mai esistito?

title: 002 Pokemon Blu
description: Acchiappali tutti! Il tuo viaggio per diventare il migliore Allenatore di Pokémon di tutti i tempi ha finalmente inizio! Ma non sarà facile: nel bellissimo e vastissimo mondo dei Pokémon ne esistono ben 150 specie diverse. Dopo che avrai incontrato Clefairy, Pikachu e tanti altri, lo spirito del gioco ti prenderà e... vorrai acchiapparli tutti! Cattura i Pokémon, allenali e forma delle squadre imbattibili. Sviluppa la tua strategia Pokémon e supera brillantemente tutte le sfide e le lotte contro gli altri Allenatori fino ad arrivare al vertice della Lega Pokémon! Ti aspetta un'entu- siasmante avventura: riuscirai a diventare il più grande campione di Pokémon mai esistito?

title: 003 Pokemon Giallo
description: Una nuova sfida ti attende! Dopo le avventure di Pokémon Versione Blu e Rossa, ecco a te un nuovo entusiasmante viaggio! Mettiti in cammino, stavolta seguito come un'ombra dal tuo fedele amico Pikachu e ascolta i suoi divertenti commenti! Preparati ad incontrare Jessie e James di Team Rocket e sconfiggi gli otto Capopalestra per diventare il Miglior Allenatore di Pokémon! Scambia i Pokémon con i tuoi amici e acchiappali tutti! Riuscirai a trovare il minigioco nascosto nella Versione Gialla?

title: 004 Pokemon Oro
description: Acchiappali tutti: sono ancora di più! Nuovi Pokémon da catturare, allenare e sfidate ti attendono in un mondo completamente nuovo, dove le ore e i giorni della settimana scorrono davvero! Inoltre, in quest'avventura troverai il PokéGear, un nuovo strumento che contiene la mappa, la radio, il telefono e un orologio da regolare all'inizio del gioco.

title: 005 Pokemon Argento
description: Acchiappali tutti: sono ancora di più! Nuovi Pokémon da catturare, allenare e sfidate ti attendono in un mondo completamente nuovo, dove le ore e i giorni della settimana scorrono davvero! Inoltre, in quest'avventura troverai il PokéGear, un nuovo strumento che contiene la mappa, la radio, il telefono e un orologio da regolare all'inizio del gioco.

title: 006 Pokemon Cristallo
description: Il nuovo capitolo della serie di Oro e Argento! Ritorna al mondo di Johto! Leggi le nuove descrizioni del Pokédex, guarda come sono cambiate le animazioni della lotta e scopri un nuovo modo di catturare Suicune!

title: 007: The World Is Not Enough
alternate_titles: 007 James Bond The World Is Not Enough | 007 The World Is Not Enough
description:
Enter the sophisticated world of high-tech espionage as Her Majesty's greatest spy... James Bond. Experience all the intense action, spycraft, and state-of-the-art gadgetry synonymous with Bond. Work with helpful allies such as Dr. Christmas Jones and M to stop the treacherous villain Renard. Your mission: Save the world. Are you up to it? Of course you are. You're Bond. James Bond.

• Bond's Best Missions! Battle through 8 dangerous levels based on the hit movie.
• 14 Q-Lab Gadgets and Weapons! Bond's P2K, Night-Vision Glasses, Taser and many new surprises.
• New Power-Ups! 10 different power-ups, including access cards, grenade launcher ammunition, and health.

title: 10 Pin Bowling
description: 10-PIN BOWLING brings you all the fun of bowling in miniature form on your Game Boy Color. Play by yourself or with a friend in 10 frames of simple straight-up bowling action. Challenge your friend to see who's better or challenge your own scores to see if you can beat them. Aim carefully and apply the right amount of strength and you'll be racking up strikes in no time. This cartridge also uses the Rumble technology so you can feel every strike and spare in the alley. 10-PIN BOWLING features everything but the stinky shoe rentals. Will you rule the lane, or will you just be another gutter ball?

FLY INTO THE FACE OF DANGER!

It's 1942. Get ready to climb aboard, strap in tight, and take to the skies in this timeless vertical scrolling shooter. Dodge enemy fire, execute loops, and pick up a myriad of bonus power-ups.

• Earn your wings in one of history's most treasured arcade classics.
• Features 32 action-packed, daring levels.

title: 2003 Pocket Monster Carbuncle
alternate_titles: Pokémon Sapphire Version | Pocket Monster Ruby | Pocket Monster Saphire
description:
2003 Pocket Monster Carbuncle is a Pokémon-based strategy RPG for the Game Boy Color.

The main character is initially Pichu, but evolves into Pikachu and then Raichu, although its sprite on the map screen is always Pikachu. As you progress through the game you recruit other Pokémon to your cause to a total of 20, four of each type. Those types are celerity, balance, strength, super power and defense, which roughly correspond to electric/flying, water/grass, fighting/fire, psychic/normal, rock/ground types in the original games, each type being strong against the next one.

Your team travels around the world map fighting battles in areas loosely based on those from the first two generations of Pokemon games. Some battles are required to progress, others give you an item which is required to progress elsewhere, others are completely optional but may give you a new team member or evolution badge. Towns also have a "palaestra" in which you can fight as many times as you like (standard battles can only be played once) in order to level up your Pokemon.

title: 204863-A P.T. Silent Hills Demake
description: P.T./Silent Hills is quite possibly the most anticipated, controversial, and discussed games ever made. Like many others, I was heartbroken to hear that the game was cancelled, and that Hideo Kojima had left Konami. This is an homage to that great playable teaser in the style of the GameBoy Color.

title: 2T & 1L
alternate_titles: 2t & 1l
description:
Visiting a new friend you play a game of two truths and a lie.

Look for clues

For hints talk to the furry friend.

title: 3-D Ultra Pinball: Thrillride
description: All the bells, whistles, and sirens of the pinball games of yesteryear come to the portable system with 3D ULTRA PINBALL: Thrill Ride. This colorful title takes all the fast action of pinball and combines it with features that only a videogame can provide. The full-sized table features multiple screens of action, with all of the staples of pinball intact. Bumpers, ramps, stoppers, and flippers litter the table, along with a variety of special bonus chutes that will take you to one of several special pinball challenges. 3D ULTRA PINBALL is highlighted by brightly colored graphics, with excellent detail on the board and its various parts. The game also features realistic ball physics and gameplay elements, so don’t bump too hard or you’ll get a "TILT"! 3D ULTRA PINBALL: Thrill Ride will test your skills and push your reflexes to their limits.

title: 32 in 1
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: 3D Pocket Pool
description: 3D Pocket Pool is a pool game, developed by Aardvark Software and published by Virgin Interactive, which was released in Europe in 2001.

title: 3D Quasars
description: The Proxima war was a long time in the winning and fighting was never more intense than in its closing years. Federation members were forced back to their home planets, and the emphasis shifted from space to surface warfare.  With nuclear photons the enemy have blasted a way through the Quasar defense system. As captain of a Taranula C1 patrol ship, you must attack the enemy craft and defend the Planet.

title: 40 Winks
description: 40 Winks is a platform game where players act as siblings Ruff and Tumble. As the two are about to go to bed, their mother tells a story about the Winks and the HoodWinks. The Winks protect humans from nightmares and provide them good dreams. Meanwhile, NiteKap, who resides in a house on a hill, is having trouble sleeping due to the Winks in his dreams, and instructs Threadbear to kidnap all of them.[8] The captured Winks turn into nightmare-bringing HoodWinks, and only 40 Winks are left, so its up to the playable protagonists to save them and stop NiteKap's plan.

title: 414 South
alternate_titles: 414 South (shareware)
description: The story of the game follows three brothers who have set out on an adventure. Their journey takes an exciting turn when they discover a meteorite impact and decide to investigate. While playing the game, you can solve puzzles and explore the New Zealand bush. Collect native shells, bugs and more to unlock bonus scenes. Avoid crabs, play mini-games, and meet the local wildlife. Drink milo, and throw chips to seagulls. Summit a mountain, abseil into glowworm caves, get lost in a swamp, and swim at the beach.

title: 720 Degrees
description: Hop on and hang ten as you crash around corners, swerve on sidewalks, and leap over the locals at Skate City, a skateboarder's fantasy world where virtually every surface is skateable. Flip and twist around the street fighters, Frisbee throwers, hard bodies and killer bees that jam city streets. Polish your skills and take your act to the skate parks where you'll vie for medals and cash in downhill, jump, ramp, and slalom competition. Shoot the tubes, "catch air" as you fly off ramps - master all of the moves including the dangerous 720. You'll need every edge as you try to become champion of the skating world!

title: A Clockmaker's Tale
description: A Clockmaker's Tale is an original short story game about a clock maker being tasked with fixing the Grand City clock tower. Since it broke, mysterious things have happened, and you must discover the secrets behind the clocks in order to save the world.

title: A Dark Winter Wander
description:
This is a short Christmas game for Game boy. It's about Embla and how she tries to handle the holidays and her strained relationship with her family. She's drawn into a twilight world of spirits where she undertakes a mysterious year walk, where she might get perspective on things or not.

It's up to you.

title: A Friend in Need
description:
"A Friend In Need" is a 5 min story-driven thriller made for the Gameboy where every choice you make, matters! 

Play a character down on their luck, who is paid a visit by a long lost friend with a secret. When shadowy forces show up, who will you trust? The choices you make will determine not only your friend's fate, but yours.

title: A Grave Encounter
description:
Humans have never been in the town, and some consider them to just be a rumor. But one day, something changes... Do you have what it takes to protect the town?  

This game features a turn-based system of dodging mechanics to avoid damage and to talk your way out of conflict.  Explore Ripple Town as you meet all sorts of curious characters, beat difficult bosses, and make peace with impending threats. Can you uncover the mystery behind the strange appearance of these humans?

title: A Husk At Dusk
description: A Husk At Dusk invites you to step into Stanley the Scarecrow's magical corn maze. You'll be met with puzzles and challenges along the way in this autumn themed adventure. For those who complete Stan's maze there is a ... great reward waiting.

title: Aardvark
description:
Control the Aardvark’s tongue and clean the ant eggs up. Beware super ants and caterpillars which can reduce the egg counter. As the sun goes down, the game is over. The further you get in the game, the faster the day goes, but your mission is not impossible.

The game has 14 levels and 5 maze combinations.

title: Abyss Story - Chapter 1
description:
The Nexus calls again, for you.  Explore the mansion and find hidden surreal worlds with a vast variety of themes. Some spooky, some relaxing. maybe even both!

Battle monsters or make some friends if you'd like but the biggest question here is... where are you?  What exactly is the nexus... Only one way to find out so play this little rpg now!

title: ACE-2876
description:
The world's first look into the DreamScapes universe.

The Year is 2876, The Universal Union has fallen into disarray after the Failure of the New American federation’s Unification war and their subsequent defeat by the Universal union.

You play as Ace, INTL S.I agent who was wrongfully imprisoned, you’ve recently been released and recruited by Captain Vask to Help eliminate and invading Alien force.

title: Action Man: Search For Base X
description:
Alex "Action Man" Mann makes a stop over onto the Game Boy Color where once again he must stop the world from falling into the clutches of the evil Dr. X. The player takes control of Action Man as they travel through seven different levels ranging for jungles to the Arctic, battling an army of robots with a variety of weapons and battle suits in search of Base X and stop Dr. X from launching a terrifying new weapon that could very well bring an end to the world.

The gameplay is a standard side-scrolling action platformer where the player advances throughout the level, destroying enemies and avoiding pit falls. Along the way they can pick up more powerful guns as well as a bow and arrow and even different suits that can help them on their quest. Additionally, players can find these weapons and suits by taking different paths throughout the levels.

title: AF+ER
alternate_titles: AF+ER (World) (GB Compatible) (Aftermarket) (Unl)
genre:
AF+ER is the story of a child finding himself in a dreamworld, on that is a perfect reflection of the real one, but with a grim secret. And somehow these two worlds become almost seamlessly intertwined.


AF+ER is really about taking your time, exploring, and realizing choices you make may have rippling effects. In the dreamworld, you can search every nook of every house, and learn every NPCs darkest secrets, or merely get a voyeuristic insight into their life and motivation.

ESRB Rating: Not Rated

title: Agency
description:
The mayor of a quaint little town has tasked your character with restoring its power. But is there more to this quest than meets the eye? The answers you seek are well protected––you’ll need to fully immerse yourself in the game to solve its mystery.

The decisions you make along the way can lead to 14 possible endings. Where will your search take you?

Explore! If it looks like you can interact with it, you probably can.

Mingle! Everyone in town has plenty to say. 

Get a clue! If you've pressed the Hint button and still aren't sure what to do next, ask around––someone in town might be able to help. Checking your inventory might jog your memory, as well.

title: Airaki!
description: Airaki! is a small tile-matching puzzle game for the Nintendo GameBoy and GameBoy Color. The matched tiles allow to take part in a one-on-one battle against 8 ennemies with increasing difficulty: attack, guard against attacks, heal, or... get drunk.

title: AirForce Delta
description: Ever been screaming along at Mach 2 and ordered to drop 6,000 pounds of bombs on a target no bigger than a Yugo? Or get that feeling of multiple bogeys closing in on your tail for a lock-on to blow you out of the sky? You've been contracted by a mercenary group to fuel-up, strap-in and snuff out the enemy. And to sweeten the pot in this "The more you take out, the more you take home" deal, you can upgrade your ride, choosing from over 30 different aircraft to get the job done. You in? Then get ready to grab some serious air!

title: AJXI: Cosmic Climb
description:
In AJXI: Cosmic Climb, Stef and Tia must save earth from the alien bots with the help of the Air Jordan 11 Low shoes!

Platform from the city streets up to the stars to reach the alien ship and stop their botting schemes. Use your basketball to bop the bots along the way; be careful not to fall back! Can you find and collect all JUMPMAN collectible letters as you go? You're in for a treat if you do!

title: Akira DMG
description: A Remake of Akira (Famicom) exclusively for Gameboy Color featuring some new content. Hours of heart pumping visual novel action!

title: Akumanor Gaiden DX
description:
Orochi terrorises the land! You are Sakura, youkai hunter, and you vow to protect your village and destroy Orochi, who inhabits the most vile of castles, The Akumanor!

Jump, whip, throw shuriken, and vanquish youkai in this exciting adventure inspired by Japanese horror! Now in Colour!

title: Alcatraz Harry
description: A unique blend of arcade strategy and adventure where the player must escape from the prison camp. In order to do so he must steal secret files and escape equipment, then negotiate a mine field, avoid the patrolling guards, use the escape tunnels, cut the wire fence, and reach the car which you can steal to help you get to the escape compound where you can deposit the equipment you have accumulated and finally escape via the hole in the fence. Avoid the obvious and think carefully before you decide where to make your move.

title: Alentejo: The Tinto & The Ugly
description:
It’s time to return to the historical 19th-century Iberian Peninsula!

Welcome back to the nostalgic Old Alentejo. In this historical 19th-century European western, help Gildo, Dolores, and Pepe in their quest to fight Baron Tinto and his oppressive laws. To do so, you’ll need to cross the historic border, explore new locations, discover more items, allies, and… new enemies! The Tinto has never meant so much to so many people in so many ways!

title: Alentejo: Tinto's Law
description:
A Gundown Satiric Western, set in the 19th Century Iberian Penisula!

Trains, outlaws, kegs, contraband. Welcome to 19th-century Alentejo, a land where the scorching sun and mysteries are ever-present. Meet Gildo and help him assemble his gang to stand against Baron Tinto's tyrannical rule. Travel across various locations, explore caves and mines, cross the border into Spain, and challenge Tinto and his oppressive lawmaking.

title: Alfred's Adventure
description: Alfred's Adventure is an Action game, developed by Mobius Entertainment and published by SCi, which was released in Europe in 2000.

title: Aliens: Thanatos Encounter
description: Prepare for horror and fright beyond your wildest nightmares, as you step into the world of ALIENS: Thanatos Encounter. The terrifying creatures made famous by the popular ALIENS movies come to Game Boy Color in a totally new adventure. You play as one of five space marines who are sent to explore an abandoned freighter. Naturally, the situation is far worse than your squad expected the ship is completely infested with thousands of vicious aliens. In this single-player shooter, you'll make your way through the various sections of the ship in 12 missions. Discover the solution to the mystery of the aliens' reappearance through the cinematic cutscenes you'll see throughout the game. You can use a variety of alien-busting weapons like machine guns and flame-throwers to fend off the incoming horde and, if all else fails, turn tail and run as fast as you can! Battle a wide variety of different breeds of aliens, including some all-new hybrids.

title: All Humans Must Die!
alternate_titles: All Humans Must Die
description:
Welcome, earthling!

Are you ready for a little attack on humanity? Then get into the U.F.O. and kill as many people as possible in 60 seconds. But don´t get hit! We had to divert all shield power into the disruptor. Now we destroy these annoying little creatures with just one shot. But we are helplessly at the mercy of their unruly shots.

title: All Star Tennis 2000
description: This is a cartoon style tennis challenge that requires all your skill! Pick a character and journey through the game's tournament mode, or simply try your hand in free mode. Choose from different court surfaces and different match setup options. Offering games for one to four players, All Star Tennis is a great way to enjoy the action on centre court.

title: All-Star Baseball 2000
description: Using real licensed teams and players from the 1999 season, ALL-STAR BASEBALL 2000 challenges you to take your favorite MLB team to a World Series victory. ALL-STAR BASEBALL 2000 offers a wide variety of gameplay options. If you think you have what it takes to play through a full season of MLB action, try the Season mode. If you like to cut to the chase, go straight to the Playoffs. Practice up your swing in the Batting Practice mode, and then prove your skills in the Home Run Derby! When you're ready, take to the field with the greats of the sport in an All-Star Game. Choose between manual and automatic fielding. Need to hold off on your pennant race until another day? No problem! Save your team's progress using the handy password function.

title: All-Star Baseball 2001
description: Are you ready to be an All-Star? In Acclaim's ALL-STAR BASEBALL 2001, that's just what you'll have to be to hang in the dugout with the pros. This single-player game for the PSX brings all of your favorite MLB teams to the small screen with a wide variety of gameplay options. Choose your favorite team and go through a full Season or cut right to the Playoffs to prove you are the best. Take it to a new level by playing an All-Star Game, where the top players from the MLB come to show off their stuff. For this version there's an improved batting system, as well as updated rosters, better computer AI, and enhanced graphics. Make sure to practice with the improved batting interface, because the ever-popular Home Run Derby also makes its return. ALL-STAR BASEBALL 2001...catch it!

title: Alleyway DX
alternate_titles: Alleyway DX (v1.0) (MojoDodo) | Alleyway (World) (Alleyway DX) (v1.0) (MojoDodo) | Alleyway (World) (Alleyway DX) (v1.1) (MojoDodo) | Alleyway DX (v1.1) (MojoDodo)
description:
A big overhaul of Alleyway for the Gameboy by adding colors, fixes and improvements.

New in this version:
Change between blueish or white background with select button on title screen
Fixed a bug that froze the game when running on MGBA core in Retroarch

This hack includes:
All Levels have custom colors
Select starting stage with a/b buttons on title screen
Scores can now show 5 digits, and max score is now 65535
High score saving
Mario head for lives looks nicer
Fixed bug from original game where if you die as a small paddle on the far right, your next paddle started stuck in the wall
Still plays ok on DMG
Demo takes twice as long before it starts, so there is more time to select start level

title: Alone in the Dark: The New Nightmare
description: From the moment Edward Carnby and Aline Cedrac set foot on Shadow Island, they are confronted by mysterious, evil creatures intent on thwarting their progress to recover 3 ancient tablets believed to hold the secret key to some incredible menacing phenomenon. Fears threaten from every corner. The slightest shadow could be hiding deep secrets, or concealing worse nightmares...

title: Amazing Penguin DX
alternate_titles: Amazing Penguin DX (v1.0) (marc_max)
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: An Autumn With You
alternate_titles: An Autumn With You (World)(Aftermarket)(Unl)
description:
Your parents, your Nana and you have just moved to a remote location out in the country. Help them settle in and explore the wilderness around your Nana's house! It's said that there are spirits in this forest.

Controls:
A button - Interact
Select (on title screen) - Load Game

title: Angel - The Unbeknownst Event
description: This game is an hybrid of Visual Novel with turn based boss battles.  It tells the story of a young man without hope for the future. But something happened around him that challenged all his beliefs.  Now he must face an ordeal bigger than his life, and uncover the mystery with the help of newfound friends.

title: Animal Breeder 3
alternate_titles: あにまるぶり～だ～3
description: The third work in the "Aniburi" series. The main character is one who lives in "Animaru World". There are more than 300 kinds of animals inhabiting various places such as forests and ponds. The goal is to improve various abilities and win the tournament held during 12 types of games. The tournament includes foot races, swimming, dancing, climbing trees, karaoke, loud voices, beauty, academic ability, etc. Of course, it is possible to marry a pet even in the third work. Moreover, the child has inherited the bloodline.

title: Animal Breeder 4
alternate_titles: あにまるぶり～だ～ 4
description: The 4th animal breeding simulation game series! This time, we will introduce a story to generate an event and liven up the game. The theme is feuds and friendships with rivals, and scenarios with animals. Compete with five rivals in the world of the animal world "Animani" to succeed to the next throne, and raise existing and fictitious animals born in this world with the aim of becoming a "Queen of Breeders". We will complete the "Nima ni Daizukan". There are some animals that you can get only in the scenario event!

title: Animastar GB
alternate_titles: アニマスター
description: In the cyber space called "ANIMA @ NET", the race to manipulate data life forms called "mania" is booming. The main character aims to be the "animaster" who wins the anima race. The anima race progresses against the team that adopts the relay method, using the cards that can be obtained every turn and the special skills of the anima, while jamming rivals and powering up the ability of your anima. , Aim for the goal first. You must GET a rare anima to become an animastar. There are 6 types of terrain that form the course, and there are more than 150 types of anima! Defeat powerful rivals while increasing anima data!

title: Animorphs
description: ANIMORPHS is a single-player RPG based on the popular children's book series and television show. You assume the role of the Animorphs, a group of kids with the ability to transform into any animal they touch. As an Animorph, you must use these unique abilities to stop an invasion of your planet by a group of aliens known as Yeerks. You'll change into a large variety of animals including an elephant, a fish, a bird, a mouse, and many more as you fight for the survival of your planet. Explore four large areas in search of microprocessor chips that control the Yeerk ship. Make sure no one sees you using your special powers, though, or you'll be the government's newest guinea pig! Keep an eye out for the Yeerks as well, as they are more than willing to put an end to your quest. Fortunately, you can battle back with the power of the beasts. Save your progress with the password save function to continue the search another day.

title: Annihilator
description:
In the future, no one has rights to their own body. The weak and sick are swallowed up into an unmerciful machine driven by corporate profit. Even after death, the body is reused for products, services, and war.

You are Shinryu, an ex-marine and activist, fighting against this system. One such corporation, CRUSH, has become a formidable foe They manufacture enhanced soldiers from the living, and dead and they have caught up to you. Taking your family, your life, and your body.

But they couldn’t take your desire. Desire for revenge.

title: Antz
description: Based on the hit movie from DreamWorks, ANTZ for the Game Boy Color is a wild platform adventure that spans 19 levels. Playing as both Z and Princess Bala in this single-player adventure from Infogrames, you'll advance through side-scrolling scenes taken straight from the movie. Beautifully-detailed graphics capture the essence of the jaw-dropping movie visuals in each of the levels, and varied mission goals keep the gameplay fresh throughout. Use pick-axes to dispatch your foes, but look out for common ant disasters like the dreaded magnifying glass. Even a simple shoe can prove to be a major problem when you are ant-sized! Can you defeat the evil General Mandible and save your colony? Save your progress with a handy password feature when you're finished playing for the day. ANTZ is giant-sized fun for everyone!

title: Antz Racing
description: Who'd have thought that racing's biggest stars could be so small? Join all of your favorite insects from DreamWorks' 1998 animated classic, ANTZ, in this kart-racing take on the film. Play as favorite characters from ANTZ, such as Cutter, Azteca, Weaver, Bala, and Z. Each character will be rated in different performance areas, allowing for a number of various racing strategies and styles. Exactly what sort of vehicles to such tiny beings ride? You'll hop into the driver's seat in modes of transportation like a sardine can, a nutshell, and a leaf in this creative classic. The 10 unique tracks will be the stage for all of the heated competition, and each of the game's five environments is lifted straight from the film. Packed with awesome power-ups and wicked shortcuts, ANTZ RACING is the perfect addition to your Game Boy Color library whether you're a fan of the movie or you're just looking for a fun kart race.

title: Antz World Sportz
description: Antz World Sportz is a racing game, developed by M4 Limited and published by LSP, which was released in Europe in 2001.

title: Apartment 307
description: Apartment 307 is a Metroidvania about parasitic aliens hoping to infiltrate human society and failing miserably, although their failure isn't all good news for us...

title: Aqualife
alternate_titles: アクアライフ
description: Choose your favorite tropical fish, aquatic plants, decorations, etc. in the aquarium, and keep the tropical fish in the Game Boy. Feed it, replace it with water to clean it, and grow it like a real tropical fish. There are more than 20 types of tropical fish in all. Some tropical fish cannot be kept in reality. It is compatible with pocket printers, and it is also possible to retrieve tropical fish data. There are two modes, a "scenario mode" in which the number of tropical fish that can be bred increases as you clear the three scenarios, and a "free mode" in which you can freely breed those fish. You can also exchange fish and eggs with your friends using the communication cable.

title: Arena 3000
description:
In the year 3000 the gaming grids are dominated by the human/machine hybrids known as Cyborgs. As the newest achievement of the cybernetic sciences, your final testing demands that you battle, and defeat, the most dangerous robotics in the universe. Deadly enemies converge on you as you frantically fire your arm pistol. As you clear each arena, your opponents move faster, take more hit, and mutate into additional nightmarish creations.

This is a homebrew game, run on Gameboy Color. Original version: Keith Woods (using the pseudonum "Rita Jay") - Microdeal - Commodore 16/Plus4, 1985. Created with GB-Studio 2.0.0 beta5!

Author: Rajcsányi László (WLS).

title: Arena 3000 ZX
alternate_titles: Arena 3000
description: In the year 3000 the gaming grids are dominated by the human/machine hybrids known as Cyborgs. As the newest achievement of the cybernetic sciences, your final testing demands that you battle, and defeat, the most dangerous robotics in the universe. Deadly enemies converge on you as you frantically fire your arm pistol. As you clear each arena, your opponents move faster, take more hit, and mutate into additional nightmarish creations.

title: Arilland - A Beautiful Painful World
description:
What if it wasn't just the world we know?

What if there was another reality similar to ours, but pervaded by a mysterious energy that allows the use of magic?

Come and discover Arilland and save it from the pain that has plagued it for centuries.

Steps into the shoes of Luke and his friends and embarks on an adventure in a way full of dangerous creatures to face in turn-based combat.

Finds the four sacred weapons and saves Arilland by restoring balance to the Arill.

title: Arle no Bouken: Mahou no Jewel
alternate_titles: アルルの冒険 まほうのジュエル | Arle's Adventure Magical Jewel
description: Arles' weapons this time are the "Monstaa" who became cards. Call Monstaa from the cards you get and win the card battle with the enemies who are blocking your way! If you set the jewel that you can get in the adventure on the card (jewel tuning system), Monsta will power up and evolve. Monstaa can only get the cards that the enemy has when he beats the enemy. Monsuta that you have seen or made friends with are recorded in Arles's "Monsuta Ajiten", so collect and tune all the Monsutas to make your own "Monsuta". Let's make "Monsta Ajiten"!

title: Armada F/X Racers
description: A racing game spin-off from the Dreamcast classic, Armada. This time, the characters compete on the racetrack. Dodge traps and encounter Armada bosses while driving along the courses in this unusual sci-fi racing game for the GBC.

title: Armorines: Project S.W.A.R.M.
description: Experience the thrills and action of standing alone against an entire alien invasion in ARMORINES: Project S.W.A.R.M. for Game Boy Color. You're just one Armorine against an entire race of vicious alien bugs bent on destroying all human life on Venus. Play through six overhead levels full of action and puzzles. Beware, because the enemy is intelligent and won't hesitate to use strategy to defeat you. Make use of five different weapons, including the laser, the flamethrower, and the plasma rifle to deal with the relentless assault. Work your way through a variety of levels all the way up to the Mothership, where you'll put a stop to this invasion for good! ARMORINES: Project S.W.A.R.M. features a wide variety of well-detailed enemies along with richly-colored graphics that will draw you right into the action. Use the password function to continue the fight another day!

title: Army Men
description:
Army Men is a mission-based combat game that has you guiding a green plastic commando named Sarge in warfare against a tan-colored toy army. Soldiers use bazookas, grenades, flamethrowers, mortars, automatic rifles, and land mines to trash each other. You can also drive jeeps and tanks across the varied terrain. To help you learn the controls, a boot camp option offers a series of eight training missions. 

Once you are ready, choose from two campaigns: desert and alpine. Review your objectives before each mission on the briefing screen, and prepare for battle against an onslaught of plastic troops. A mission will fail if you exceed the time limit, allow your rivals to win, or let Sarge die. The options screen lets you view current objectives, consult a strategic map, exit vehicles, and abort your mission. You can also adjust the control scheme, select a difficulty level, and toggle music.

title: Army Men 2
description: Army Men 2 is an Action game, developed by Digital Eclipse and published by 3DO, which was released in 2000.

title: Army Men: Air Combat
description: Pilot one of four toy helicopters through the treacherous terrain of your backyard, the local playground, picnic areas and nearby beaches. Engage in both air-to-air and air-to-ground combat with enemies ranging from battleships to butterflies. Utilize the unique abilities of each 'copter to battle armies of mutant insects; destroy rampaging remote control cars; blow up sand castles; and save Sarge from being melted by kids with magnifying glasses. Real combat. Plastic men.

title: Army Men: Sarge's Heroes 2
description:
Sarge and the Bravo Company Commandos managed to foil the Tan Army's first assault, but do they have what it takes this time?
General Plasto has teamed up with Brigitte Bleu, a diabolically treacherous Blue Spy, the destroy the Green Nation once and for all.
The adventure continues as Sarge and Vikki fight their way over pool tables, around a bedroom and across desktops to the final showdown against Plastro and his troops. Prepare for another gigantic battle!

title: Around Town
description:
Dart the frog is hoping to earn some money to upgrade his favorite bike. Help Dart earn that money by riding around town and taking on requests from fellow residents!

In Around Town, you will fulfill requests to earn money,  ride a bike, and chat with fellow residents. If you get lost, you can always pull out your trusty Town Map!

Also, FROGS!!

title: Arthur's Absolutely Fun Day!
description: Based on the PBS children's cartoon, ARTHUR'S ABSOLUTELY FUN DAY offers up a ton of fun for fans of the show. In this single-player game for Game Boy Color, you play as Arthur, who wants to go to the ultimate amusement park, Wonder World. There are over 15 mini-games in Arthur's neighborhood (including air hockey, shooting hoops, cooking pancakes, and a whole lot more), each with its own style of gameplay, from simple timing exercises to mild puzzle solving. You get stars for completing them and once you have enough, you will earn a free pass to Wonder World, where all the mini-games are available for you to play whenever you like. ARTHUR'S ABSOLUTELY FUN DAY is an ideal choice for a younger gamer.

title: Asterix & Obelix
description: Caesar has erected a new barricade around the village of the indomitable gauls, to keep them trapped inside. Join Asterix and Obelix and travel across the Roman Empire. Here you will enter a bullfight, participate in a rugby match, and even take part in the Olympic Games. Bring a souvenir from each country you visit, in order to prove to Caesar that the Gauls are the strongest heroes.

title: Asterix & Obelix Contre Cesar
alternate_titles: Asterix & Obelix vs Caesar
description: Relive the adventures of Asterix and Obelix. Take control of your favourite cartoon heroes of totally addictive action. Take on the ranks of leggionnaires, the formidable Roman catapults and the unforgettable finishing levels of ever increasing difficulty. Some magic potion will make you fly.

title: Astérix Sur La Trace d'Idéfix
alternate_titles: Asterix: Auf Der Suche Nach Idefix | Asterix: Search for Dogmatix
description:
If you have trouble choosing between an adventure game with a suspenseful, in-depth investigation and a game of skill made for joystick fanatics, "Asterix: search for Dogmatix" is just for you!

If you play in "adventure" mode, you set out to search for Dogmatix in six worlds and 30 levels (taking you on journeys throughout Gaul, Egypt, Rome, etc.). And the dozen or so mini-games in "instant fun" mode are sure to keep your fingers busy between two stations on the underground.

There's a catch, though: to access the whole set of mini-games, you have to win Bonus Tokens by playing in "adventure" mode. By Belenos, this is a game for the truly indomitable!

title: Asteroids
description: Your spaceship is trapped in a deadly asteroid belt. You will have to destroy the drifting asteroid boulders before they destroy your spaceship. But, watch out for enemy spacecraft. Fire your missiles to destroy the boulders and the enemy.

title: Astral Possession
description: Astral Possession is a simple arcade style platformer Gameboy Color Game. You play as a cute ghost that can possess 2 different NPC characters.  Avoid giant spiked balls and collect coins. Collect 10 coins and you get teleported to a new level. Try to beat all 9 levels.

title: Astro Chase
description:
Astro Chase - A fast-flying, fast-fighting race through space to save the planet earth from total destruction!

Blast off and blaze across a scrolling, star-studded galaxy. Seek out and explode deadly mega mines that close in as they orbit the earth. But keep an eye out for attacking enemy vessels - they'll pursue you to the far corners of space! Fire your lasers! 

Save the planet from this awful doom and there's a secret reward awaiting you!

title: Augury
description:
The king of the graveyard, sir Hamlet has been killed! As such, you, Horacio, must discover the culprit and solve this case! There are few leads, but with the help of a mysterious item, Horacio may be able to reach the truth of this murder.

The game has 2 endings, with one of them being the true ending.

title: Augury Red Code
description: You play as a female android called C-1 as you platform your way out of ALS Tech Facility. Open locked doors and eliminate monster creatures known as BUGS to pave your path to the exit with the lowest time possible.

title: Austin Powers: Oh, Behave!
description: Fans of AUSTIN POWERS will find a lot to do in AUSTIN POWERS: Oh Behave! This game turns your Game Boy Color into a mini-organizer, complete with a word processor (Austin's Pad), a calculator (the Shagulator), and a mockup web browser that contains facts about the popular movies. Looking for something a bit more game-related? Well, AUSTIN POWERS has those in spades, too! The largest of the games, "International Man in a Platform Game," is just what it sounds like. In it you play as Austin through a multitude of platform levels that feature full-color graphics inspired by the movie. Also available for your enjoyment are the "Mojo Maze," a takeoff on PAC-MAN, "Domination," a board game similar to OTHELLO, and finally "Rock or Paper or Scissors," which pits you against an Austin Powers villain in a play of the classic game. Customize the backdrop of all the fun by choosing wallpaper, screensavers, sound effects, and more. You can also link up to play some of the games with a friend or foe using either AUSTIN POWERS: Oh Behave! or AUSTIN POWERS: Welcome to My Underground Lair.

title: Austin Powers: Welcome to my Underground Lair!
description: Fans of AUSTIN POWERS will find a lot to do in AUSTIN POWERS: Welcome to My Underground Lair. This game turns your Game Boy Color into a mini-organizer, complete with a word processor (the Evil Launch Pad), a calculator (the Frickulator), and a mockup web browser that contains facts about the popular movies. Looking for something a bit more game-related? Well, AUSTIN POWERS has those in spades, too. The largest of the games, "Kin-Evil," has Dr. Evil and Mini-Me riding their scooter through a variety of stunt-packed stages. Also available for your enjoyment are the "Mojo Maze," a takeoff on PAC-MAN, "Domination," a board game similar to OTHELLO, and finally "Rock or Paper or Scissors," which pits you against an AUSTIN POWERS character in a play of the classic game. Customize the backdrop of all this fun by choosing wallpaper, screensavers, sound effects, and more. You can also link up to play some of the games with a friend or foe using either AUSTIN POWERS: Oh Behave! or AUSTIN POWERS: Welcome to My Underground Lair.

title: Auto Zone
description: While on a routine ferrying mission your scanners alert you to what seems to be signs of habitation. The source of the signals seem to be coming from the nearby dead moon. As a result of this information you are duty-bound to investigate. So having employed your XL-PROCON surface buggy your computer directs you towards the phenomena in an area called the 'Autozone'. This area has been explored before by several probes, but all have failed to report back. As a result of this, the area is regarded as dangerous. From the information orbital satellites have been able to obtain, scientists predict that somewhere in this zone there is pocket through which escape 'should' be possible. Success depends on dexterity and quick thinking...

title: Azarashi Sentai Inazuma - Dokidoki Daisakusen!
alternate_titles: あざらし戦隊イナズマ～どきどき大作戦!? | Seal Sentai Inazuma-Pounding Daisakusen !?
description: "Inazuma Seal", which was created in collaboration with Izumi Eda, the original author of the blockbuster character "Sushi Seal", and HAKUEI of the rock band "Penicillin", has been made into a game as a squadron. Get the transformation power and defeat the polar bear king in dance games and bowling games! Polar bear kings are playing shooting games and card battles. The game music is newly composed by "Penicillin" for this work. The four characters are inspired by each member of "Penicillin".

title: Azure Dreams
description:
For years the Monster Tower has beckoned to you and, today, on your fifteenth birthday, you have come of age. You can finally enter the Tower to discover what has happened to your father. Though beware, the tower changes every time you step foot into it. Do you follow in your father's footsteps or live a peaceful life in the town of Monsbaiya - it's time to choose.

- Discover demon eggs and breed them to create new viscious monsters.
- Gain fortune and fame to help your family and town grow in prosperity.
- Journey to the top of the tower with an ever- changing layout of the floors.
- Seach for more powerful monsters inside the tower with your monster tamiliars.

title: Babe and Friends
description: Puzzle fans that enjoyed the BABE movie series will find a lot to like here. BABE AND FRIENDS, a single-player puzzle game for Game Boy Color, has the little porcine hero guiding his herd through 40 levels that span such locations as the farm, the airport, and the city. In each level there is a checkered flag, to which Babe must take a herd. The sheep aren't very good at finding their own paths, so Babe has to walk them through every step of the way. Clear obstacles, set up roadblocks to make detours, and generally do what you have to in order to make a safe route for the sheep. Watch out for obstructions such as carts in the airport and rushing rivers on the farm. Detailed still-screens of all of Babe's friends appear between the levels to move the story along. A password save system is included if you need to take a break from the brain-bending action. Can Babe save the day once again?

title: Baby Felix Halloween
description: Baby Felix Halloween is a platformer developed by Bit Managers and published by Light & Shadow Productions for the Game Boy Color platform. Baby Felix Halloween was only released in European countries.

title: Back to Nature
description: In this game, the player controls a frog who must eat bugs to survive. Catching a fly increases your energy by 5 calories, but each jump results in a loss of 1 calorie . The number of jumps and flies is randomly generated with each attempt.

title: Backgammon
description: Backgammon, the world's most widely played and recognised board game just got portable. The ultimate game of chance and skill now available on Game Boy, chose from 3 modes of play including "Tournament, Free and Vs Match" and 6 difficulty levels.

title: Bad Apple
alternate_titles: Bad Apple!!
description: Bad Apple is a music track from the Touhou Project series. A mesmerizing shadow art film has been ported to many platforms, including Game boy Color.

title: Bad Batsumaru
alternate_titles: バッドばつ丸 ロボバトル | Badtz-Maru Robo Battle
description: "Badtz-Maru", who learned that the "Gorgeous Cup Robo Battle Tournament" will be held in Gorgeous Town, was burning a fight to win the championship. However, all of his friends "Panda Bar" and "Hanamaru" are aiming for victory. Badtz-Maru, who has acquired his own robot and mastered the rules of "Robo Battle", will play against his friend's robot one after another in order to strengthen the robot! Gain experience and strengthen equipment. And finally for the tournament! Can Badtz-Maru win the championship? ?? "Badtz-Maru" makes an outstanding performance in Robo Battle! The basis of the game is Sugoroku, where various events occur for each square that stops. If you defeat the Boss Robo that appears when you clear the conditions set for each map, the map will be cleared! If you win a battle against an enemy robot that interferes with your destination, you will receive experience points, weapons, and armor parts. There are normal parts, Sengoku warlords parts, animal parts, etc., and each part has different characteristics, so you can change the strength attribute of the robot by freely changing the parts. There are more than 800,000 types of parts rearrangement patterns! !!

title: Bakukyuu Renpatsu!! Super B-Daman Gekitan! Rising Valkyrie!
alternate_titles: 爆球連発!!スーパービーダマンRPG | Explosive ball barrage !! Super Bidaman RPG
description: An RPG based on the popular manga "Bakukyu Barrage! Super Bidaman" in "CoroCoro Comic". Many popular characters appearing in the original are all here! !! The battle is a "visual battle" that utilizes the GBC screen. Equipped with "hero growth system". Of course, you can exchange parts with your friends using the communication cable, so you can customize your own B-Daman.

title: Bakusou Dekotora Densetsu GB
alternate_titles: 爆走デコトラ伝説GB SPECIAL～男度胸の天下統一～ | Bakusou Dekotora Densetsu GB SPECIAL
description: Ported the popular "Bakuso Dekotra Densetsu" to GBC. The player is a new tracker who dreams of being the best tracker in Japan. While delivering luggage, we will decorate the truck by buying and stealing parts from rivals and raise the degree of attention. Defeating an opponent will increase the legendary level. The purpose of the game is to defeat many rivals and finally defeat the strongest tracker to get the title of No. 1 in Japan. Equipped with "national conquest (main mode)" that aims to conquer the whole country by fighting trackers all over the country and raising the degree of attention and legend, and "communication battle" mode in which parts are bet on each other. There is also an event to confess to a girl as she increases her friendship with the girl she met on the way.

title: Bakuten Shoot Beyblade
alternate_titles: 爆転シュート ベイブレード | Beyblade
description: The main character is a wild child, the earth, who polishes Beyblade's skills in the remote mountains. Beyblade is a new type of beigoma that battles using the various characteristics of each part by exchanging and customizing the parts divided into 5 layers. Familiar characters such as Takao, Kai, and Max will also appear, and a hot bay battle will take place. In addition to the bay battle, which shows the movement just like the real thing, the live performance of the bay braider DJ has been added, and the battle has become more realistic. As the earth grows, it becomes stronger in battle and can exert various hidden powers such as the use of special moves. If you use infrared communication, you can have a one-on-one bay battle with your friends.

title: Ballistic
alternate_titles: Puzz Loop
description: Puzzle Players Unite! Ballistic is the exciting new action puzzle game everyone's been talking about! It's simple to play and offers endless hours of fun. Your goal is to keep the balls from reaching the center gate. rotate the launcher and shoot the balls into a constantly growing sting of balls. Matching three-of-a-kind creates a "chain reaction" and makes them disappear. Combine multiple chains for even more points!

title: Balloon Fight GB
description: Take to the skies in a balloon to save your younger brother. In the little town of Pencilvania, there lived a brother and sister who loved to play with balloons. Alice and her younger brother Jim would spend countless days filling the skies with their balloons. One day, Jim filled all of his balloons and tied them together to make a beautiful balloon rainbow across the sky. But suddenly, a strong wind came and carried Jim away. As Alice, you must save your brother from peril. Float through eight different stages as you follow Jim's trail of balloons. Collect as many balloons as possible to earn bonuses. Test your piloting skills to avoid enemies, or let go of your balloons to face enemies on the ground. In "Balloon Trip" mode, compete for the highest score and move up the ranks. Take a big gulp of courage and give Alice a hand as she searches for her missing brother.

title: Balloon.gb
alternate_titles: Balloon
description:
Balloon.gb is that old lost bootleg Horror platformer for GB color.

A game you purchased sometime in the early 2000s from an import store. It was dark and gory, and clearly not approved by N|ntendo.

A short horror platformer/Walking sim, where you played as the silhouette of a boy that can change into a balloon.

Though you haven't thought about the game in years, you can remember playing it, but when you try to find it now, the Internet had no clue what you're talking about.

title: Bandits At Zero
alternate_titles: Bandits at Zero
description: Defences are low and the bitter war continues. Alone in the skies you must survive by fighting off endless attacks from the enemy. Your perilous mission is to destroy the enemy aircraft carrier based at sea. You must do this at all costs. It may take several days to find the carrier during which you will be under constant fire from all sides. A fuel plane will be sent to you each day, it will approach alone, glide up behind it carefully. If you can re-fuel completely you will gain a bonus protective shield. The fighting will be fast and furious and you will be alone against the enemy.

title: Barbie: Fashion Pack Games
description: Barbie: Fashion Pack Games is an Action game, developed by Hyperspace Cowgirls and published by Mattel, which was released in 2000.

title: Barbie: Magic Genie Adventure
description: Barbie: Magic Genie Adventure is an Action game, developed by Vicarious Visions and published by Mattel, which was released in 2000.

title: Barbie: Ocean Discovery
description: Barbie: Ocean Discovery is an Action game, developed by Realtime Associates and published by Mattel, which was released in 1999.

title: Barbie: Pet Rescue
description: Barbie: Pet Rescue is an Action game, developed by HotGen and published by Mattel, which was released in 2001.

title: Barcode Taisen Bardigun
alternate_titles: バーコード対戦バーディガンバーロイド大図鑑 | Barcode Battle Birdigan Barroid Encyclopedia
description: Collect, grow and evolve. I'll teach you how to play birdigans in a fun way! How many bodies did you collect? Introducing Barroid. Get stronger with training! Barroid enhancement plan.

title: Basketbrawl
description:
Join our ninja basketball goblin girl from the past, Himari, on a mission to save the city from a robot invasion! Resurrected five years after her death, she teams up with friends, Ikari, Tatsumi, & Kimiko in a short Metroidvania full of tight platforming, unlockables, and secrets.

Race against time in speedrunning or take your time unlocking characters & see the story unfold!

title: Bass Masters Classic
description: Now when you can't get out to the lake, you can go fishing on your Game Boy Color with Bassmasters Classic. Choose from a variety of lures and hit your favorite fishing hole. You cast the line by stopping a power meter at one of five positions more power equals more distance. After you cast the line, you must wait for a fish to strike. When it does, get ready for a fight. Once you get the fish to the boat the game is not over, as you must stick you hand into the water and grab the catch. If you can't get a hold of it within three tries, you'll be telling stories about the one that got away. All of this action takes place in Practice and Tournament modes. If you can't get to the lake, bring the lake to you with Bassmasters Classic.

title: Basterdale Farm
description:
Welcome to Basterdale Farm – a once-proud estate now fallen into ruin and up for grabs. But not for free! You’re Percy the Pig, a plucky porker with a dream: to buy the farm and bring it back to glory. There’s just one snag... it costs 45 diamonds!

Scattered across the fields, barns, and pastures lie the glittering gems you’ll need. But beware – the farm is crawling with mischievous creatures, rogue animals, and other unmentionable farmyard nasties who do not want you to succeed.

Luckily, Percy has a secret weapon: the almighty belch. With a mighty BURP, all nearby enemies are turned to dust – giving you a chance to snort your way to safety and press on in your noble quest.

Dodge danger, outwit the pests, and gobble every last gem. Collect all 45 diamonds and the farm is yours – pigsty and all!

title: Batman Beyond: Return of the Joker
description: In the future, a new Batman is called upon to fight the criminal element in the futuristic city of Gotham. BATMAN BEYOND: Return of the Joker, based on the animated movie, follows the adventures of Batman as he attempts to solve the mystery of the return of his fiercest foe. This side-scrolling one-player game takes the player through 16 levels patterned the animated series, which provides an authentic look. Progression through these levels is far from linear, allowing players to search out hidden rooms, weapons, and enemies. Batman must keep an eye out for more than just his enemies however, because the Joker has set a variety of traps all throughout the game. Use weapons like a club and Magnetic NunChaku, or just take to your foes with your fists and feet of fury! You can also utilize the unique abilities of five different Bat-suits, each granting their own special ability. It's up to you to finish off the Joker for good in BATMAN BEYOND: Return of the Joker.

title: Batman: Chaos in Gotham
description: The Batman returns on Game Boy Color with BATMAN: Total Chaos in Gotham City. Based on the popular animated BATMAN series, this single-player action game allows you to don the cowl of one of two Bat-heroes: Batman or Batgirl. Some of the Dark Knight's famous arch-villains have escaped and are causing serious trouble in Gotham, and it's up to you to put them back where they belong. Everyone from Poison Ivy to the Clown Prince of Crime the Joker himself is here to wreak havoc and keep the caped crusader busy. Grab your utility belt and assault 18 stages of varied action that take you on a tour of Gotham City. Much of the action is played from a side-scrolling perspective, but some levels have you taking out the Batmobile or the Batcycle in overhead high-speed excitement. Naturally, Batman and Batgirl are both packing their usual assortment of weapons and tools including the Batarang, the grappling hook, smoke bombs, and more.

title: BATTLE DICE WORLD
description:
BATTLE DICE WORLD is a DICE-building RPG, where BATTLERS compete against each other in the famous WORLD TOUR - assemble your DICE by collecting Attack, Heal, Guard, and Status FACES of various kinds, and roll over the competition!

But beware, some seek powerful DICE for evil and for profit!

title: Battle Star
description: Whilst on patrol over the watery planet Nuljai you encounter an alien construction ringing the planet. This construction was build by the evil Cyfrots to siphon off the precious water and transport it to its people. Your mission is to destroy the Cyfrots and blast out of sight the aliens' marauding bombs.

title: Battleship
country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Now it's your turn to sink your opponent's battleship in this Game Boy Color rendition of the classic strategic board game. Players deploy all four of their ships to different areas on a grid, and take turns firing shots at various parts of their opponent's grid. Hit each ship the required number of times, and the ship is removed from play. In a unique twist on the classic game, each ship has new weapons. For the solo player, there are 48 missions to complete with animated full-color cutscenes to inspire you to victory! The real challenge however, is taking on a human opponent via a link cable. Forget setting up the board and looking for missing pieces, this is the real way to play Battleship!

title: BattleTanx
description: 2001 A.D. - The world as you know it is no more. A deadly virus has wiped out 99% of the female population and the few surviving women are now worshipped as QueenLords. You are Griffin Spade, warrior and Battlelord in a post-apocalyptic future. With only the BattleTanx at your command, you must save mankind from extinction! Fight your way across the wasteland that was once America and rescue the QueenLords from roving gangs of mercenaries and thugs.

title: Beatmania GB
description: Clear the stage by pressing the button at the right time according to the rhythm notes that scroll in time with the music. It will be cleared if the groove level reaches the red zone at the end of the performance. In addition to 10 songs from the arcade version and PS version, a total of 20 songs, including 10 GB original songs, are included. Various mode settings such as NORMAL, EXPERT, GB-MIX, FREE, VERSUS, etc.! You can carry it around and enjoy it in your favorite mode when you want.

title: Beatmania GB 2 GatchaMix
alternate_titles: beatmania GB 2 ガチャミックス
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: BeatMania GB Gotcha Mix 2
alternate_titles: beatmania GB ガチャミックス 2
description: It consists of 25 songs and famous classic songs. There are even more ways to play the game, with a total of 4 play styles. It is also possible to increase the difficulty level. Added a cooperative "DUET" mode to 2P play. Let's get along well!

title: Beebul
description:
Do you dare descend with Beebul to the lower levels of hell. If you are to complete your quest you must collect the items found there guarded by creatures and magic, but you must have quick reactions and a cunning mind or you'll end your days there...

Move Beebul along the platforms collecting the objects whilst avoiding the monsters. When you reach the bottom of the screen you must teleport to the top again. To use the teleport, step into it and magic.

title: Behind The Door
description: A short RPG about a girl hoping to get her friend to open up to her. All she wonders is what happens to him behind that door.

title: Berks
description: The Berks have arrived! They are everywhere, protected by their ever faithful homing Drones, which cannot be destroyed (only stunned temporarily). Your mission - clean each territory (29 screens) of the mindless Berks using your expanding Terror Tank. The number of Berks left to be destroyed is indicated in the bottom of the screen. How long can you survive?

title: BeyBlade: Fighting Tournament
alternate_titles: ベイブレード ファイティングトーナメント
description: The second installment of the monthly CoroCoro Comic series "Beyblade". The previous work was an RPG in which the main character Takao aims to win the world championship, but this work is a battle-centered game in which the players themselves participate in the tournament tournament and collide. The player will become a resident of the world of GB software "Beyblade", power up Beyblade mainly in battle and remodeling, and face various rivals such as Takao and Kai in tournaments. One of the four Beyblade Registration Chapter cards is included, and the first Beyblade a player gets is determined by this card.

title: Bibi Blocksberg - Im Bann der Hexenkugel
description: Beim großen Hexentreffen geht einiges schief: Ein Blitz schlägt in die Hexenkugel ein und die Hexen trifft ein Bann. Nur Bibi Blocksberg kann mit viel Geschick den Bann der Hexenkugel aufheben. Die kleinen User erwarten sechs verschiedenartige Levels mit abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben, die Kombinationsgabe, viel Geschick und schnelle Reaktion erfordern. Ausgestattet mit allem, was die kleinen Fans von Ihrer Lieblingshexe erwarten, bietet dieser Titel lang anhaltenden Spielspaß für zu Hause und unterwegs.

title: Big2Small
description:
Big2Small is a new puzzle adventure game where you try and guide the animals to their corresponding food of choice.

Travel through forests, farmland, sewers, and more to help Elle the elephant, Gisele the goat, and Melanie the mouse find delicious food in 40 unique puzzles.  Use each animal's different abilities together to manipulate and maneuver past rivers, mouse holes, giant pipes, shrubs, mousetraps, and other obstacles.

title: Bikkuriman 2000 Charging Card GB
alternate_titles: ビックリマン2000 チャージングカードGB
description: There are more than 110 types of character stickers! Players aim to complete their dreams. Card ability, sticker perfection, character knowledge ... When the three powers are the highest, you can get the title "Head Class" of the surprise man champion. The hero repeats card battles with various opponents while walking around on the map. The rules are simple! Combine the "Angel" and "Devil" cards well to create a "role" with a high score, and combine the stickers you get with the cards to power them up! Dr. Card, Dr. Chojin will kindly explain the rules of card battle. Card battles and stickers can be exchanged using a communication cable.

title: Billy Bob's Huntin'-n-Fishin'
description: In BILLY BOB'S HUNTIN' AND FISHIN' for Game Boy Color, you play the role of a hapless guy named Billy Bob, who is trying to impress a girl. She'll ask Billy Bob to fetch her rabbits or bass, and it's up to you to help Billy Bob get them. Obviously, to get the things she wants you'll have to either go hunting or fishing. Not so fast though, because you need bullets for hunting, bait for fishing, and a license to do either of the two activities. Luckily, you can earn these items by playing a variety of mini-games. The games vary in their gameplay, but the usual assortment of speed and reflex tests are the common thread. You'll need to clear four mini-games each to go hunting and fishing. Once you've finally cleared them and gotten the items you need, you'll head out to catch your real prize. BILLY BOB'S HUNTIN' AND FISHIN' is for one player and is compatible only with Game Boy Color.

title: Biohazard Gaiden
alternate_titles: バイオハザードGAIDEN
description:
Experience a brand new chapter in Cpacom's classic horror survival series: Resident Evil. Now a desperate fight for survival takes place aboard a luxury cruise-liner overflowing with a host of deadly zombies. There is no escape. As S.T.A.R.S. operative Barry Burton, it's up to you to save Leon Kennedy, rescue a young survivor named Lucia and disable a deadly Bio-Organic Weapon. With countless traps to avoid, rooms to explore, puzzles to solve and mysteries to uncover, each lurking horror survived will take you closer to the source of the Resident Evil. Survival is your only option.

The Japanese edition comes with a manual and a survey/ registration card. The cartridge is wrapped into a small plastic bag, and placed inside the removable interior of the box. Japanese GBC games were not sealed.

UID: CGB-BIOJ-JPN

title: Bionic Commando: Elite Forces
description: You are the ultimate weapon. You are the perfect synthesis of human and machine - a Bionic Commando. Your latest mission - to rescue a fellow commando, Commando Joe - will take you deep into the heart of enemy territory. Use your Bionic Claw to grapple and swing through more than 20 levels of forest, deserts, mountains and futuristic cities Blast through dozens of unique with your Assault Rifle, Rocket Launcher and Flame Thrower as you seek to destroy the overlord Arturus, and save your homeland of Karinia from utter destruction.

title: Bionic Granny
description: She lurks outside the school gates waiting to surprise any unsuspecting kids. When the hands on the school clock reach 4 o'clock her fun begins. Despite all the efforts of teachers and lollipop ladies she sometimes manages to "Zap" the kids with her laser powered brolly! Better run for your life before she gets you too!

title: Bitterroot
description: Bitterroot is the story of the cursed Bitterroot Mansion, and the secrets it holds. You take on the role of a stranger stranded, who tries to find help but instead end us trapped in the web of the Bitterroot curse.  Use your investigational skills to find key items that may help you escape the dark powers of the mansion. Fight off its otherworldly inhabitants, and try to piece together what caused this anomaly to occur.

title: Black Bass: Lure Fishing
description: Now you can enter a summer-long fishing tournament in BLACK BASS LURE FISHING. At the beginning of the tournament, you have the lowest ranking and can only fish on one lake. But if you perform well enough and move up the ranks, your class will change and you will be able to choose which of the two lakes you want to fish on. Should you do really well and move into the top two classes, you will be given access to special techniques like Let Fish Go, 8 Magic, Power Lift, Dancing Worm, Dancing Frog, and Last Strike. Along the way, you will be able to use eight different lures to attract the big fish and your progress will be recorded using a password system. So hop in your boat and try to win the tournament in BLACK BASS LURE FISHING.

title: Black Tape
alternate_titles: BlackTape (Homebrew) (PentarouZero) (v1.0)
description: Explore the world and collect videotapes (remember those?) containing weird and nerdy things.

title: Black Tower Enigma
description:
Puzzle-Solving Game Boy Adventure about an Orc inside a Mysterious Tower looking for his Wife.

Play as Wigo, the Orc, whose wife has been kidnapped and taken up to the skies by a magic dress gifted by a mysterious Fairy.

As Wigo saw his wife going up to the skies, he went to the tallest building known on the continent: The Black Tower Enigma.

Inside the Black Tower Enigma, Wigo has to solve some riddles and challenges in order to climb up and find some clues to find his wife.

title: Blade
description: You're blade, Gothic City's baddest vampire hunter. When rival vampire clams ignite a deadly feud, you go deep to do some serous demon killing. Stalk the undead through 24 gothic locations, then waste an arsenal of intense weapons. Plan on staying up late tonight 'cause and even greater evil awaits.

title: Blaster Master: Enemy Below
alternate_titles: Meta Fight EX
description:
Jason, brave hero of yesteryear, is roused from retirement by the news that mutant lifeeorms, thought to have been long since destroyed, are once again on the move, hollowing out subterranean niches in the image of their old haunts. The decision to reactivate Sophia seems to Jason nothing more than an inevitability. Back into the cold once more...

- Eight areas to explore, to find the keys and kill the sub human bosses
- Use the tank’s suction system to drive up walls and along ceilings
- Drive Sophia or go it alone with Jason.

title: Blink's Pet Lizard
description: Help Blink feed the lizard by giving it apples. Don't let the other animals steal the apples. Make sure you feed the lizard apples that haven't gone rotten. If you don't feed it, the lizard will die!

title: Blinky's Revenge
alternate_titles: Blinky's Revenge (World) (Aftermarket) (Unl)
description:
Have you had enough of the pac-man always winning? Have you ever wanted to side with the evil one?

In this game you can now roll the dice.

With Blinky - this little red ghost - you have to catch Pac-Man in this 12-level game. You will need good observation skills and patience. Don't let the ghosts down.

title: Block Droppin'
description:
Block Droppin’ is a fast-paced puzzle game to train your brain and test your reflexes: swap blocks to match three or more blocks of the same type, and use special blocks like bombs to your advantage. Block Droppin’ takes quick wits and concentration, so make sure your block-swapping skills are up to the task!

The game comprises two playing modes, Arcade and Puzzle, each with its own unique challenges and rewards.

That's it. Go play.

title: Blue's Clues: Blue's Alphabet Book
description: Blue's Clues: Blue's Alphabet Book is a Puzzle game, developed by Vicarious Visions and published by Mattel, which was released in 2001.

title: Boarder Zone
description: BOARDER ZONE is a wild snowboarding action game for the Game Boy Color, and it packs in a ton of variety for boarding aficionados. Choose from four different boarders, each with their own unique skills and abilities, and then choose from four boards which all have different characteristics. Further adding to the customizability is the ability to pick your boarder's outfit. The variety doesn't stop there, however six different gameplay modes are available. In Race Attack mode, you must beat your fellow boarders in a race to the finish; Trick mode has you scoring points by performing tricks before the time runs out; Time Attack has you racing the clock; Challenge mode has you trying to either beat the clock or perform tricks on different courses; Slalom mode will have you beating a time limit on one of a number of unique courses; and Practice mode helps you brush up your skills for the real game. You can also use a password to save your progress through the various gameplay modes.

title: Bob et Bobette: Les Dompteurs du Temps
alternate_titles: Suske en Wiske: De Tijdtemmers
description: Bob et Bobette: Les Dompteurs du Temps is an Action game, developed by Standaard Multimedia and published by Infogrames, which was released in Europe in 2001.

title: Bob the Builder: Fix it Fun!
description: Bob the Builder: Fix it Fun! is an action game, developed by Tiertex Design Studios and published by BBC Multimedia, which was released in Europe in 2000.

title: Boing!
description:
You bounce the BUBBLE around a playfield of 36 STEPS (6 rows of 6). The BUBBLE must land on each step and turn it "on", sometimes in a particular order. The BUBBLE EATER or the PIN will pop the BUBBLE if either comes in contact with it. The BUBBLE EATER chases the BUBBLE, while the PIN descends the steps from the top row down. The PIN will pop the BUBBLE or the BUBBLE EATER if they are in its path.

Boing! was originally released in 1983 for the Atari 2600 by First Star Software. It was developed by Alex Leavens and Shirley A. Russell. All work, property, and credit belongs to them.

title: Boku no Camp Jou
alternate_titles: ぼくのキャンプ場 | My Campsite
description: Campsite management simulation game. We will clear the rough land, mow the grass, crush the rocks, cut down the trees if necessary, improve the facilities, and increase the number of visitors. Listen to the opinions of selfish campers, check what you need, and gradually prepare the equipment. Purchase land when you have saved money and aim for a larger campsite. On the way, you can get items, get stronger, and have more than 100 kinds of events. If you don't have enough money or want to rest your bones, you can exchange the money you earned from hunting and fishing with your friends via communication.

title: Bokujo Monogatari GB2
alternate_titles: 牧場物語GB2
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Bokujo Monogatari GB3
alternate_titles: 牧場物語GB3 | Harvest Moon 3
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Bomberman B-Daman Bakugaiden V: Final Mega Tune
alternate_titles: Bビーダマン爆外伝V ファイナルメガチューン
description: The previous work "Victory Hemichi" was an evolution / coalescence panel dungeon RPG, but this time it is a battle RPG. Combining pilots, armor, beadaroids, and items to create the strongest armor unit, defeat Devil Vader and win. In addition to the familiar Shirobon and Kurobon, you can also board the armor as a pilot. Armor has appeared not only in the Victory series but also in the old Bakugaiden series, and the number is over 60! In addition to defeating enemies in battle, armor can be obtained with "infrared data". If you point the remote control around you, you can receive infrared data from the remote control and get new armor and items.

title: Bomberman B-Daman Bakugaiden: The Road to Victory
alternate_titles: Bombāman Bī-Daman Bakugaiden: Bikutorī he no Michi | Bビーダマン爆外伝～ビクトリーへの道～
description: Panel dungeon role-playing game. The story is that the player controls the main character B-Daman, solves the mystery in each world from the past to the present of B-Daman, and finally challenges the dark B-Daman who attacks B-Daman. A lot of new characters are also recorded, about 250 types. There are three game modes: "story mode", "data mode", and "communication battle mode". In "Story Mode", a system that allows players to evolve and unite is installed. Some items can only be obtained in online battles.

title: Bomberman Max: Blue Champion
alternate_titles: Bomberman Max: Hikari no Yuusha
description: In Bomberman Max, your task is to jump through five zones with a dozen levels each. At the beginning of the round, you're given your quota to meet -- in some levels, you'll have to destroy all the enemies. In another, wipe out all the blocks in the land. In another, rescue the level's Charabomb. And in others, simply make your way to the target square in the set amount of time. But it won't be easy, since many enemies just don't stay still for you to walk up and plant a bomb next to them. It's all in the strategy of bomb-placement. Plus, once a level's complete, you'll have to pick the proper exit that appears. Released in two versions, Blue and Red.

title: Bomberman Max: Red Challenger
alternate_titles: Bomberman Max: Yami no Senshi
description: n Bomberman Max, your task is to jump through five zones with a dozen levels each. At the beginning of the round, you're given your quota to meet -- in some levels, you'll have to destroy all the enemies. In another, wipe out all the blocks in the land. In another, rescue the level's Charabomb. And in others, simply make your way to the target square in the set amount of time. But it won't be easy, since many enemies just don't stay still for you to walk up and plant a bomb next to them. It's all in the strategy of bomb-placement. Plus, once a level's complete, you'll have to pick the proper exit that appears. Released in two versions, Blue and Red.

title: Bomberman Max: Yami no Senshi
alternate_titles: Bomberman Max: Red Challenger
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Bomberman Quest
description: Bomberman is on his way home when the engines on his ship are stolen. As a result, he must make an emergency landing on a strange planet. However, Bomberman is not traveling alone he's got all of the monsters he has captured on his adventures with him. After a rough crash landing, the monsters escaped. You must help Bomberman recapture the monsters and find his engines in order to return home. You'll travel to four different regions of the planet collecting bombs, finding items, and getting hints for how to proceed on your adventure. Along with the main quest a Two-Player mode is also included, in which you try to trap your opponent by setting bombs; the first person to be victimized by a bomb loses.

title: Bonkers
description: A group of earthlings are trapped in the upper regions of an alien space station. They have to reach three air locks at the bottom to escape. This may sound simple, but those horrible aliens are holding a creepy creatures convention and they will all join together to make it increasingly difficult for you to help the earthlings. Watch out for the Double gangsters, a Pac-droid, Sqidge-droid, a Stomper, Baby-droid, a deadly space ship and 2  other mystery guests.

title: Booty
description: Jim the Cabin Boy must make his way below decks to collect various items of booty (automatically picked up when he walks past them) strewn around the ship. When you have collected 35 items from the Black Galleon's 14 holds, the game ends! Jim will meet an untimely death if he falls through a trap door or is bitten by a ship's rat.

title: Bop It!
alternate_titles: BopIt! GB
description: BopIt! GB is a fan game that aims to recreate the BopIt! experience on Gameboy. Using the D-Pad and A, highlight the appropriate section and trigger it.

title: Boppy Horror Show
