description: Boppy Horror Show is a short and simple adventure focused on the Boppy the Mime and her journey to get snacks for her girlfriend in the midst of a Red Ghoul apocalypse.

title: Bouken! Dondoko Shima
alternate_titles: 冒険!ドンドコ島 | Adventure! Dondoko Island
description: The boy who was distressed on a yacht arrived on the island "Dondoko Island" which is not on the map. It was a new world where various monsters and the mysterious creature "Mokopoco" built by the village of stone tool civilization lived. Develop the village of Mokopoco with monsters and lead a mysterious life that no one has ever experienced. Ask a mysterious creature called "Mokopoco" who is building a village on the island to invent a vehicle that can escape from the island. It starts with raising various monsters, giving them jobs suitable for their roles, and developing the island. Make good use of the characteristics of monsters to make them work.

title: Bounce
description: Bounce is a puzzle platform game for Game Boy Color. Control the jumping ball to the flag by overcoming various obstacles in the challenging 15 levels.

title: Bounce Emi Bounce!
description:
The first gameboy game with a gigantic ass! Hyper booty gal Emi got a delicious burrito. However, platforms rose from the ground and her burrito was taken to the skies. Now Emi has to use her butt to bounce on platforms to reach the top. There will be challenges but she'll not stop until she gets her burrito back!

(WARNING: This is a rage game so it might not be suitable for people who had a bad day)

title: Brave Saga Shinshou Astaria
alternate_titles: ブレイブサーガ 新章 アスタリア | Brave Saga New Chapter Astaria
description: Asteria is a world where people's hearts are filled with peace and civilization and nature are filled with a gentle harmony. The fertile land and the outstanding civilization overlapped each other, and people lived in peace. There was no word "fight" in Asteria, and the only "villain" who once made the land quiet was sealed, and there was no evil in this world. However, the seal was broken by a boy and a robot who were confused by the words of the demon, and the demon demon Jerkin who eats the power of justice and scatters his own evil power is resurrected! Its power instantly covered the entire Asteria with dark clouds, robbing people of justice. Can the boy and the robot who brought the "darkness of darkness" regain peace in Asteria? The GBC version of Brave Saga, which is extremely popular with anime fans and hobby fans, is a completely original story. The main characters are twin brothers and sisters. The player chooses one and goes on an adventure in Asteria. Everywhere in Asteria, there are dungeons set up by the demon Demon Jerkin. The main character is to get into the dungeon, destroy the enemy, rescue his friends, and defeat the demon demon Jerkin who led Asteria to chaos. From the sunrise works produced by Takara, the Eldran series, which has been highly requested by fans, nostalgic works, and new GBC original works, a total of 20 works and more than 150 types of mecha have appeared! You can enjoy the dream battle of "Brave vs. Brave" with your friends in online battle.

title: Brookwood Pocket Tactics
description:
Brookwood: Pocket Tactics is a new Game Boy Color strategy game developed by Jared Chansen of Werebear Games and published by Bitmap Soft. Inspired by Redwall, WarCraft, and the tactics genre, the game is set in an Islamic-inspired fantasy world inhabited by medieval animal factions. Players can command one of four groups: the Khalifa of Rodents, the Sultanate of Cats, the Eashir of Birds, or the Hashd’n of Lizards.

The story unfolds in a harsh world transformed by a volcanic eruption that brought warmth, resources, and magical crystals known as World Hearts. This prosperity eventually fractured the harmony among tribes, leading to factional conflict. When the Eashir of Birds harnessed the power of a World Heart, they disrupted the balance, prompting the Rodents and Cats to ally and exile them. Though peace has held for years, it now hangs by a thread as political tensions resurface, threatening renewed war.

title: Bub-O Escape
description: Bub-O Escape is a new 1-bit action puzzle adventure for the Gameboy Color from Limited Run Games and Gabboco Games. Help Bub-O escape using his bubble blowing power to battle his way through over 40 levels and find out who's behind it all.

title: Bubble Frog DX
description:
Bubble Frog DX is a charming 2D puzzle platformer that brings the magic of retro Game Boy Color games to Steam! Step into the role of Bubble Frog—a frog in a bubble, of course—as you explore four colorful zones, bouncing your way through 50 levels to collect 160 lost Onigiri, scattered by your friend OniGary.

Feeling daring? Test your skills in the Ink Zone—a special 10-level "Super Hard" challenge, where you'll collect all the Ink lost by Squid Face Jones to earn the final 161st Onigiri.

title: Bubble Trouble
description: The fun takes place in the bath where you, a small bubble, must increase your size enabling you to float to freedom - and onto the next level. To grow big enough you must eat other little bubbles, whilst avoiding the nail-brushes, and other bathroom accessories that are out to burst you! You grow +1 if you eating the soap, but touch anything else and you will POP! Good Luck - you'll need it!

title: Buck and the Cursed Cartridge
description: When Buck, a die-hard retro gamer, buys a mysterious cartridge labeled “DEFINITELY NOT A CURSED CARTRIDGE” from his local GameStop, things go sideways fast. The moment he pops it into his Chromatic, he’s sucked through the screen and trapped inside the game! To escape, Buck must battle through pixelated worlds, outsmart glitchy bosses, and uncover who—or what—is pulling the strings. With help from a rogue hacker, hidden cheats, and his trusty blaster, Buck’s only way out is to beat the game itself.

title: Buffy the Vampire Slayer
description: Step into the shoes of Buffy Summers, Sunnydale's hottest vampire slayer. Fight against fierce vampires using cool moves and awesome slayer weaponry. With advice from your watcher Giles, you'll destroy the most fearsome creatures of the night.

title: Bug Diver
description:
In this fast paced, addictive arcade game, as a mere bug, you have to be fast to outswim the merciless bug eating fish, whilst stealing their precious eggs found in the murkiest recesses of the ocean floor.
It takes short reflexes to guide the bug back up to the waiting speed boat so that you can collect your reward.

title: Bugjinka Surf!
description: A very short auto-scroller for the gameboy color where you dodge obstacles and gain points by riding  waves. Watch out for seagulls!

title: Bugs Bunny & Lola Bunny: Operation Carrot Patch
alternate_titles: Looney Tunes: Carrot Crazy | Bugs Bunny & Lola Bunny: Operation Carrots
description:
In Looney Tunes: Carrot Crazy you take control of either Bugs and Lola to find your carrots that have been stolen by an unknown Looney Tunes character. Bugs and Lola each have their special abilities and you will have to switch between them when necessary to proceed. You access the game's different stages through a Warner Bros. film studio that acts as your hub.

Yosemite Sam, Daffy Duck, The Tasmanian Devil, Marvin the Martian and Elmer Fudd have stolen Bugs and Lola's carrots and hid them in different sets in the nearby studio.  Bugs and Lola head through five different "sets" in order to reclaim them.

title: Bugs Bunny In Crazy Castle 3
alternate_titles: Bugs Bunny: Crazy Castle 3
description: Bugs Bunny returns to crazy puzzle or action gaming on Game boy Color. Once again you play as the legendary Bugs Bunny as he explores the mysterious Crazy Castle in search of the mother lode of carrots. The castle has all-new rooms with all-new puzzles, so prepare yourself for even more hare-brained action than the last time around. The Crazy Castle is chock-full of hazards and traps that will end your merry little jaunt in a hurry, so keep a sharp eye out. In order to test your reflexes as well as your wits, several Warner Bros. cartoon characters have returned to make Bugs's life that much more difficult! Fight off Sylvester, Daffy Duck, Yosemite Sam, Elmer Fudd, Tweety Bird, and the Tazmanian Devil with one of your weapons, or just turn tail and run as fast as you can. Naturally, the game comes complete with a password function so you can explore the floors at your leisure once you've cleared them.

title: Bugs Bunny In Crazy Castle 4
description: Bugs Bunny returns in BUGS BUNNYS CRAZY CASTLE 4 for Game Boy Color! Thinking he has found the Carrot Castle, Bugs has once again entered the Crazy Castle. You must help him escape in this single-player action or puzzle game. This time, more than 60 rooms await Bugs, and he'll have to use all of his wits and skills to escape with his "hare" intact. Once again, the Crazy Castle is loaded with traps and hazards that will cut your carrot-collecting career short so make sure you don't get reacquainted with them the hard way. As CRAZY CASTLE fans are probably used to, several Warner Bros. cartoon characters are here to keep Bugs on his toes. You'll have to fight off Daffy Duck, Yosemite Sam, Foghorn Leghorn, Pepe Le Pew, Tweety, and the Tazmanian Devil with one of a variety of weapons, or make tracks to the nearest safe spot. A password save will chart your progress so that you don't have to start from scratch each time you play.

title: Bulb
description:
Sometimes...

The world can be a dark place...

Light up your life, 

with a little help from - BULB!



"It can be tough going through life as an unplugged light bulb - When you're made of glass, you got to watch carefully where you step.. You got to learn how to make a jump, and also how to take a fall..."

Are you able to get the special power up and win the evil boss battles.. 

And save the whole neighborhood from impending doom?!

title: Burai Fighter Color
description: When humankind discovers an alien race on a distant planet, it becomes clear that the extra-terrestrial way of life threatens survival on Earth. Rather than sending out a fleet of space destroyers or loads of nuclear warheads, it is determined that Earth's best chance of wiping out these creatures is (drum roll, please) you! As Space Marauder, it is your job to avoid waves of space beings careening through the outer reaches of the galaxy. You are aiding only by a jet pack and a laser gun. Sound tough? It is. Assorted power-ups are strewn about to help you in your plight, but the best asset you'll have is your itchy trigger finger and taste for alien blood. Lots of powerful bosses wait at the end of each of the game's levels, and every stage presents new and increasingly difficult challenges for our hero. Boasting a cool soundtrack and smooth controls, there's plenty of gameplay to keep your fingers moving for hours on end.

title: Burger Burger Pocket: Hamburger Simulation
alternate_titles: バーガーバーガーポケット
description: Sugoroku opening battle game. Turn the roulette wheel to become the owner. The decisive factor in the game is whether you can stop the roulette wheel in a very advantageous square. You can also take over a rival store with a hijacking card, and depending on how you use the card, you can advance the game to your advantage. There are various items on the field, and if you make the ultimate burger with the collected ingredients and win the contest, you will get a prize. Also, up to 4 players can play.

title: Burger Kitchen
description: Burger Kitchen is a puzzle game in which you make a burger as ordered by manipulating the ingredients that fall down. Learn how to play in Story Mode and get serious in Endless mode. The kitchen is busy today!

title: Burger Paradise International
alternate_titles: バーガーパラダイス
description: A simulation game in which you create and sell your own hamburger using various ingredients and run a hamburger chain store. In eight stages, each with a different climate, you will grow your own chain store while fighting against the unique enemy "SYOGUN Burger" group chain store. There are more than 150 kinds of ingredients that appear in the game. The number of burgers that can be made depends on the combination is infinite.

title: Burger Time Deluxe - EX
description:
A hack that adds colors to the GB release!

Based on BurgerTime, the Arcade classic from 1982, BurgerTime Deluxe once again puts you in the role of chef Peter Pepper, a guy who can really build a burger. You maneuver the cook up and down ladders and left and right across floors in order to walk across various parts of giant hamburgers, such as large lettuce, big buns and massive meat patties. After you cross any section of any hamburger, it will drop one level and push any other burger part within that stack down a floor as well. The object of the game is to build all the hamburgers in each stage by dropping all the makings of each burger into completed stacks at the bottom of the screen.

As you go about your burger building business, Food Foes Mr. Pickle, Mr. Egg and Mr. Hot dog (also known as Frank N. Furter) will chase after you. You can destroy these culinary cutups by trapping them in falling burger parts or by tricking them into walking on a burger part you are in the process of dropping. To freeze the Food Foes, you can sprinkle a dash of pepper on them. You begin the game with a small pepper supply and can pick up additional pepper shakers that appear throughout the levels. You can also pick up bonus points (in the guise of cups and saucers) and extra lives.

Unlike the original BurgerTime, which had less than 10 different non-scrolling screens, BurgerTime Deluxe has seven levels with four stages in each level for a grand total of 28 screens, most of which scroll to some degree. A password feature enables you to return to the beginning of last level you played. Also, this version of the game features a two-player competitive mode (as long as you have two copies of the game, an extra Game Boy, and a link cable).

title: Buried Behind The Cabin
description: After a weekend of planning and murder, you are ready to go... But something is not right, as if something doesn't want you to leave the forest.

title: Bust-A-Move 4
description:
You'll be Forever Bursting Bubbles! Bust-A-Move-4 is bursting onto the scene with more advanced gameplay, and tons of new features. It's a challenge for the whole family!

* Bury opponents with the devastating new Chain Reactions.
* Keep the bubbles in balance with the new Pulley Mechanism.
* Rank yourself with the comprehensive Ranking System.
* Save custom puzzles to Memory Cards with Edit Mode.

title: Bust-A-Move Millennium
alternate_titles: Puzzle Bobble Millennium | パズルボブル ミレニアム
description: BUST-A-MOVE MILENNIUM EDITION on Game Boy Color brings a bevy of often-requested new features to this classic puzzler. Bubbles of different colors descend from the top of the screen in clumps. Using your blaster that fires colored bubbles of your own, you must attempt to clear the screen as best as you can. BUST-A-MOVE MILENNIUM EDITION offers five unique modes of play. In the returning Puzzle mode, you'll play through a huge number of new stages of bubble-busting action that require careful planning and fast reflexes. Challenge mode also returns to test your BUST-A-MOVE skills. In the brand new Story mode, you'll take on a series of increasingly difficult computer opponents in a battle to the finish. Also new is a mode that allows you to play as long as you can last. Of course, the biggest and best addition to BUST-A-MOVE MILENNIUM EDITION is the two-player link cable Versus mode. Now you can grab a friend and show off your BUST-A-MOVE skills! You get all of this plus enhanced graphics and other new options.

title: Bygone Choices
description: A girl in pink wakes up in a forest after hearing a mysterious voice. Now what will they do?

title: Caesars Palace II
description: Welcome to Ceasars Palace II, the premiere gambling game where you're the next high roller in the glamerous casino enviroment of the world-famous Caesars Palace. If you're feeling lucky, then you've come to the right place. Test your gambling prowess with 19 games of chance including: Craps, Blackjack, Rouulett, Slotts, Video Poker, Mini-Baccarat, Keno and Poker Challenge.

title: Cairn
description:
You are Amber, a young woman lost in a temple. Explore a vast area shared by three goddesses, and regain their power to escape safely. 

A large part of the lore and advice for the puzzles are inside the stories of every collectible, so keep an eye in the menus.

title: Cake Keeper
description:
Hedda was playing with her friend in her house garden when an evil witch transforms him into a cake. Now all the insects are attracted by his delicious aroma.

Protect your friend from being eaten by all kinds of bugs, get to the witch's house and confront her to reverse the spell and save your best friend.

Cake Keeper is a single screen view classic arcade videogame, where you will have to eliminate the insects that try to eat the cake.

title: campfire tales
description:
This game is cursed.

DO NOT PLAY!

This 8bit game is a port from a mystery source... It was originally made to be played on one of the best selling portable gaming consoles of all time!
This chromatic, casual, linear, interactive story game centers around a campfire with old friends telling... tales.

The first story is a true story about a camping trip. The second story follows a father and two children. A witch, Baba Yaga kidnaps the children! In the third story, we wake up as a rubber ball and have an adventure. The final story... WEREWOLF!

title: Cannon Fodder
description: Don't wait till you see the whites of their eyes! Don't kid yourself it will all be over by Christmas! Don't try to shut out the screams! And don't forget to wash your hands afterwards. CANNON FODDER. War has never been so much fun!

title: Card Captor Sakura: Itsumo Sakura-chan to Issho!
alternate_titles: カードキャプターさくら～いつもさくらちゃんといっしょ～ | Cardcaptor Sakura: Always with Sakura-chan
description: A real I'm adventure game where you collect Clow Cards with Sakura. With the built-in clock function, the actual time and the time in the game are linked, and the game progresses according to Sakura's life. Wake up Sakura sleeping in the morning and send her to school, and start collecting Sakura and Clow Cards that came home from school in the evening. You can play mini games while Sakura is at school. It is compatible with pocket printers, and you can print cute characters in the game that you want to keep.

title: Card Captor Sakura: Tomoeda Shougakkou Daiundoukai
alternate_titles: カードキャプターさくら ~ 友枝小学校大運動会 ~ | Cardcaptor Sakura: Tomoeda Elementary School Great Exercise
description: A collection of original mini games with an athletic meet as a motif. There are four modes: "Play alone", "Two people", "Renshu", and "Bonus". The types of mini-games are "action type" where you can enjoy big ball rolling, 100M running, obstacle racing, horse fighting, rope-drawing battle, bread-eating competition, two-legged race, and relay, which are familiar in athletic meet, and "puzzle" where you can enjoy ball putting and Kusudama. There are three types: "system" and "dance system" where you can enjoy baton dance and vaulting box. In "bonus", you can play fortune-telling and printer stickers.

title: Cardinal Island
alternate_titles: Cardinal Island (v1.1) (Vivian Video)
description:
We mixed a few survival and adventure ideas together to create Cardinal Island - a game where you play as an alien explorer who has crash landed on a deserted island... an island that is also home to mysterious dungeons to explore! Be sure to carry some food and water with you too, though!

What caused the crash? How can you escape the island? What's the deal with all the shells? These questions and more might just be answered!

title: Career Day The Video Game
description: In this game, you will slowly learn how monotonous working a repetitive job can be by playing the same minigames through many workdays!

title: Cargo
alternate_titles: Cargo (Homebrew)
description:
"An old abandoned ship contains a precious cargo, but what is it, and is it worth the risk? You can try and make your way to the main deck and claim the treasure some vanished protecting. 

Make sure you track your oxygen and ammo, as any wrong move may turn out to be fatal!

Cargo is a short adventure game for the Game Boy. Play it in browser, or download it for your favorite emulator or Analogue Pocket."

title: Carl Lewis Athletics
alternate_titles: Carl Lewis Athletics 2000
description: Carl Lewis Athletics is a sports game, developed by Planet Interactive and published by Ubisoft, which was released in 2000.

title: Carmageddon
alternate_titles: Carmageddon: Carpocalypse Now
description: CARMAGEDDON brings all the carnage of the PC and Nintendo 64 action-racing games to the Game Boy Color. You play as one of the last survivors of a horrible disaster that has turned an entire city into zombies. Now you've got to take to the streets in a deadly race with other survivors. Use your weapons and driving skills to decimate your opponents and the zombified pedestrians that walk the streets. You'll find more than 30 different tracks of mayhem in four different areas, giving you plenty of replay value. Earn enough points and you'll upgrade your road machine to something with a bit more destructive power, and there are 18 different machines available for your use. Colorful graphics represent all the vehicular mayhem with speed and style, and a password function saves your progress through the game.

title: Casper
description: Follow the adventures of the friendliest ghost around with CASPER for the Game Boy Color. Based on the hit 1995 movie, the game follows the plot of the film closely. Casper is on a mission, and he must explore Whipstaff Manor for clues and solve puzzles as he avoids the ghostly trio of Stinky, Stretch, and Fatso who are looking to put a stop to Casper's adventure. The game is played from an isometric perspective, which shows the rooms and hallways of the mansion in high color and detail. You'll have to search the rooms of this huge estate carefully for items such as keys and puzzle pieces that will help you unlock other sections. You can also learn new abilities and gain ghostly powers to further aid you in your adventure.

title: Castle of Terror
description:
One day, Carla and her family went to visit Sanabria Castle. While the instructor told the story of the castle, Carla listened and watched closely, but... she got careless and her pacifier fell, unfortunately, behind a door. "Oh no!!!" said Carla. "I have to get it!"

Then, she crossed the door, and when she finally managed to retrieve her pacifier, something she hadn't expected happened. "Poo!" The door had closed. "Nooooo"

Carla was trapped in the castle dungeons. Will she be able to get out and return to her family?

title: Castlevania Circle of the Moon
alternate_titles: Castlevania: Circle of the Moon: GBC Edition
description:
Enjoy playing Circle of the Moon on your Game Boy Color! well at least a tiny segment of it.

This is a for fun 'what-if' slice of gameplay only.

title: Castlevania Order of Shadows Golden Belmont
description:
Castlevania Order of Shadows Golden Belmont aims to re-imagine the infamous java game of the same name [minus the Golden Belmont part].

Reworked from the ground up with re-imagined story that aligns the timeline with Legends, Resurrection and the original Order script to account. 

A small fan game for the fans of the lore but did not like the java game's controls and "physics" all that much.

title: Castlevania: The Adventure DX
alternate_titles: Castlevania - The Adventure DX
description: Castlevania: The Adventure is a fan favorite Game Boy game that was included in Konami GB Collection Vol. 1. That compilation did provide a much needed color injection, however it was full of weird color choices and incorrect overlays on backgrounds resulting in a marred experience. This release intends to correct as many of those flaws as possible, increase the quality overall, and make the game a dedicated stand-alone experience.

title: Cat Jumper
description: A port of the "cat jumper" makecode arcade game.  Make the cat leap to each level and collect all the coins!

title: Catwoman
description: It might just be the purrrfect action game. As CATWOMAN, the best cat-burglar in the world, you'll move through tight spots and encounter challenging environments. Feline strength? Furtive movements? She'll have to rely on all her cat-like qualities to stay out of harm's way. An agile leap here, a lightning-fast flip there. She has all the right moves and this game has enough excitement to last a lifetime...make that NINE lifetimes!

title: Catz
alternate_titles: Catz: Your Virtual Petz Palz
description: Are you looking to adopt a pet but lack the time or space to take care of a real one? Then you may find CATZ to be of interest. Part of the small but popular virtual pet genre, CATZ lets you adopt a cat from one of three breeds: Siamese, Calico, or Persian. You can play with the pet first to decide if it's right for you. Once you've adopted the little gal or fella, it's up to you to take care of it: feed it, groom it, and play with it regularly if you want it to grow up to be a well-adjusted adult. If you mistreat your cat, your little pet will take off, never to return! Eventually, new breeds of cats and new special toys will become available for you, depending on how well you do. You can also trade toys and breeds of cats with your friends via the infrared link.

title: Centipede
description:
The classic arcade hit CENTIPEDE comes to Game Boy Color in this slightly enhanced version of the old favorite. This one- or two-player game has you firing pesticide at an oncoming centipede that is threatening the garden. As the pest weaves its way through the mushrooms dispersed throughout the screen, you'll have to use strategy as well as quickness to fight it off. The classic gameplay is replicated perfectly in this arcade port. You can play two players competitively by alternating on a single Game Boy, or grab two copies of the game and a Game Boy Link Cable to cooperate against the buggy bad guys. CENTIPEDE is enhanced for Game Boy Color, with all new brightly colored graphics that will take you back to the arcades of the '80s. Centipede is compatible with all Game Boy systems.
DMG-AC5E-USA

title: Championship Motocross 2001 Featuring Ricky Carmichael
description: CHAMPIONSHIP MOTOCROSS 2001 FEATURING RICKY CARMICHAEL brings all the thrills and action of motocross to your Game Boy Color. This single-player racer uses a special graphics technique to give the gameplay a smooth 3D look and feel. The racing action takes place from the third-person perspective. You can choose from 30 real licensed racers, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Pick your bike from 16 unique bikes and hit the dirt on more than 20 tracks that take place in a variety of scenes. The tracks feature complex turns and jumps made possible by the special graphics engine. In addition to racing, you can also try the Freestyle mode, where you can show off your trick abilities. Use a password to save your scores and your progress through the various races.

title: Chantey
description: A rhythm RPG where music powers every spell. Story-driven, chill, and packed with original songs.

title: Chase H.Q.: Secret Police
alternate_titles: Taito Memorial: Chase HQ
description: The chase is on in CHASE HQ: Secret Police for the Game Boy Color. Loosely adapted from the arcade game of the same name, CHASE HQ is a unique mix of racing and action for one or two players. In the One-Player mode, you'll lead a handpicked team of undercover cops, each with unique talents. You'll be shown what kind of vehicle the suspect is driving, and then you'll hit the streets to find him. When you finally locate the perp, you'll switch to a behind-the-vehicle view as you try to shoot or bump the criminal off the road. Once you've managed to lower their life-bar far enough, they'll pull over and you'll make the arrest. There are 10 levels of single-player action, so you'll be plenty busy as you try to collar the criminals. You can also grab a friend to play Head-to-Head using a link cable, with one person playing the cop and the other playing the bad guy.

title: Checkmate
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Chee-Chai Alien
alternate_titles: ちっちゃいエイリアン | Little alien
description: The wide universe is filled with dark matter called dark matter. Now, this dark matter has disappeared from space and is increasing on Earth. The cause is "little alien". The little aliens come to Earth in the light, but they also bring the dark matter on their bodies to Earth. Due to the little aliens who knew nothing, the earth turned black with dark matter, and the universe, which should have been black, turned white. If nothing is done, the balance of the universe will be lost and it will be difficult! Players catch tiny aliens, collect dark matter, return dark matter to space, and save space! A game in which the infrared communication unit of GBC catches small aliens in the light and collects dark matter attached to the body of the small aliens. It's actually a magnificent scale that collects dark matter and saves the universe! The vibration of "Susuharai" that picks up the dark matter attached to the body of a tiny alien may be addictive! ?? Rocket the collected dark matter back into space and regain the black universe! It's important to fly a rocket, but it's also important to play with tiny aliens. Playing with them will make the little aliens cheerful and open to you. You can also exchange and play small aliens with your friends via infrared communication. Only your GBC can save the universe!

title: Chessmaster
description: Prepare to challenge the longest running console chess series, THE CHESSMASTER. In this Game Boy version of the game, you can choose to play at any one of 16 different skill levels, ranging from beginner to expert. For those just learning to play chess, take advantage of the Teaching mode that will show you all of the best moves to make. This game has a variety of options for chess fans, as you can set up the board however you like to simulate classic chess situations and challenges. You can even make your opponent’s pieces invisible for an added challenge. If you make a wrong move, the game will allow you to take back moves and try again. If you’d rather just see the outcome, merely ask THE CHESSMASTER and he’ll finish the game to checkmate. Play alone or against a friend through the use of the Game Boy Link Cable. You can also use the password function to resume a game already in progress.

title: Chi to Ase to Namida no Koukou Yakyuu
alternate_titles: 血と汗と涙の高校野球 | High school baseball with blood, sweat and tears
description: The purpose is to select a school from 4096 schools, take office as the manager of the high school baseball club, and raise it into a permanent corps. Reconstruction aiming for a permanent corps = The conditions under which the game can proceed are (1) to leave a record of 8 or more in the district best in the 1st and 2nd years (2) to leave a record of 8 or more in the district in the 3rd to 4th years (3) Achieve the best 8 or higher in the national tournament or selection in the 5th to 6th years (4) Win the national tournament or selection in the 7th to 9th years (5) Retire in the 10th year. After the summer tournament, the third graders will retire, and in April of the following year, new students will join the club, and the conditions must be cleared. You can also set the content of individual practice and the timing of practice games.

title: Chibi Maruko-Chan: Go Chounai Minna de Game Dayo!
alternate_titles: ちびまる子ちゃん ご町内みんなでゲームだよ! | Chibi Maruko-chan It's a game for everyone in the town!
description: A board game set in the town of Shimizu that appears in Chibi Maruko-chan. The player chooses one of the six familiar characters to advance the game. Rather than aiming for the goal first, collect "memorable items" around the squares, and appraisal issued by four appraisers based on "value as memories", "monetary value", and "rareness" Compete for points. When the players stop in the same square, the "Appraisal Battle" starts! If you lose at the appraisal point, you have to give the item to the other party. There is also a square where you can enjoy 6 mini games. Not only one person but also up to four people can play by using the GBC body in turn

title: Chicken Run
description: CHICKEN RUN for Game Boy Color brings all the fun and adventure of the movie to the palm of your hand. You take the role of Ginger as you guide your fellow chickens to freedom in this one-player action or puzzle game. More than 20 levels of puzzle-solving adventure span the farmyard and the pie machine, which will keep you busy for hours. To begin, you'll have to bring a group of chickens through the farmyard, carefully avoiding or deactivating any obstacle that may alert the farmers. Then it's off to the pie machine, where mechanical mayhem awaits you if you aren't careful. Once you've brought the chickens through the pie machine, you'll be back in the farmyard with a new bunch of chickens and all new challenges ahead of you. You'll have to avoid obstacles such as dogs, cameras, spotlights, and others, as you make a break for freedom. You can push objects, shut off power, or find shortcuts to get around the many obstacles. And don't forget to keep an eye out for objects you can use to your advantage. You can also use a password to continue your chicken-saving quest another time.

title: Choro-Q Hyper Customable GB
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Choro-Q Hyper GB
alternate_titles: チョロQ ハイパーカスタマブル GB | Choro-Q Hyper-Customizable GB
description: GB version Choro-Q is an RPG-style training simulation. The goal is to solve the mysteries of the game world, adventure while fighting, destroy Dr. Mad's ambitions, and find his missing father. With Bio Choro-Q, which continues to grow in battles even after the game is over, the battles will heat up even more than in street mode. There are more than 200 types of modified parts and power-up items. In addition, there are 50 difficult courses such as circuits, mountains, rivers, and ice. Of course, since it is compatible with communication cables, you can exchange parts with friends and race.

title: Chousoku Spinner
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Chromatic Tetris
alternate_titles: Chromatic Tetris V1.1 | Tetris | Tetris (world) (Modretro Chromatic)
description:
Experience the evolution of an all-time puzzle classic with Tetris® for Chromatic, the latest addition to the iconic Tetris franchise. This game seamlessly blends modern innovations with nostalgic elements, offering both modern and retro modes for an unparalleled puzzle experience. Enjoy multiple game modes and exhilarating multiplayer action via link cable, all brought to life with revitalized, 8-bit graphics. Tetris for Chromatic is the thrilling new chapter in the beloved Tetris series, perfect for fans old and new.

Features:
Marathon, Sprint, Ultra, and Endless Game Modes, all in retro and modern settings
Stunning 8-bit graphics
Reimagined versions of the iconic Tetris theme song
Compete head-to-head in multiplayer matches via the link cable
Create and manage up to three custom player profiles

title: Chuck Norris Superkicks
description:
You are Chuck Norris, the world's greatest living Karate expert armed with a variety of kicks and punches, and in search of an ancient monastery. You must choose which path to follow. At each branch, you find obstacles and warriors you must conquer.

Win the fight and earn a higher degree belt, plus bonus time. Lose and you will lose ground and time because you've been stunned. Become a black belt and you enter the monastery, only to encounter the mystical Ninja, master of camouflage.

How far can you get on the path to ultimate victory?

title: Chunkout
description: A fun little puzzle game where try and match colors in as big section as possible to maximize points

title: Cinder Creek FireWatch
description:
You are a Fire Lookout. Due to the rising temperatures, the pace and amount of fires are now a frequent occurrence. It seems with every passing degree that it rises. A new fire sparks.

Call in the local fire brigade and let the flames be doused in water.

title: Classic Bubble Bobble
description: The addictive arcade classic comes to Game Boy Color in CLASSIC BUBBLE BOBBLE. Bob has fallen sick, and it's up to Bub to traverse a strange world to find the cure. Each of the game's 100+ levels is filled to the brim with enemies, but luckily you've got a trusty weapon at your disposal your bubble shot that you use to trap the monsters! Once trapped in their soapy prison, you can pop them just by touching the bubble. Once you clear out all the enemies in a stage, it's time to float over to the next one. Collect power-ups to increase your speed, freeze your enemies, or even shoot special bubbles that fire off dazzling electricity attacks. You'll do battle against a variety of bizarre and sometimes very large enemies as you work to cure Bob's illness. CLASSIC BUBBLE BOBBLE features new graphics, including all-new backgrounds so you're bound to have a new experience every time you play.

title: Cleaving Caliber EX
description:
CLEAVING CALIBER EX is equal parts Arkanoid and Time Crisis. Bounce the Crosshair off your Armored Transport to spot targets for your Sniper!

Will you have what it takes to get a 3 out of 3 Star Rating after taking out the Enemy Leader?

title: Climb It
description:
Climb It is a 3 screen game. You are a heroic young man who has to rescue his beautiful girlfriend who has fallen into the clutches of a giant monkey.

This monkey stays hidden from view but keeps both his eyes on his captive. Your mission is to rescue her, avoiding moving barrels, fires, climb the ladders and you have to go through moving elevators.

title: Clover Mini
description:
After Dr Deadbeat's defeat, Clover and Miller are sent to a space station to clean it of the remaining robots from Dr Deadbeat's army.

In Clover Mini, you control Clover as he's shooting through waves of robots. Try to get the best score without getting hit.

title: Cokemon Gold
description: As if you hadn't had enough of Cokemon Blue, here's Cokemon Gold! You're in the future playing as some kid... going out to do favors for this Professor, then ending up going out catching Cokemon. The mafia is back, hustling drugs! You must stop them!

title: Cold Nights
alternate_titles: Cold Nights (World) (Aftermarket) (fizzlymike)
description:
It was supposed to be an ordinary trip, but not everything went according to the plan... Your plane crashed. 

Prepare yourself, because it's going to be a COLD NIGHTS there.

title: Colin McRae Rally
description: Colin McRae Rally is a Racing game, developed by Spellbound and published by THQ, which was released in Europe in 2001.

title: Colônia
alternate_titles: Colonia
description: Based on a true story, Colônia is a survival horror game where you must face the horrors of an abandoned asylum.

title: Columns GB: Tezuka Osamu Characters
alternate_titles: コラムスGB 手塚治虫キャラクターズ
description:
Columns was to the Game Gear what Tetris was to the Game Boy. Some years after the Game Gear had ceased production, it was ported to the 'Boy. To spice things up, the game has been given several game modes, and, most notably, a licence to several popular manga characters created by Osamu Tezuka. Play as famous characters such as Astro Boy, Kimba or Black Jack.

Apart from the main Columns mode, this edition features a puzzle mode like that of the Nazo Puyo games, where you must remove a set of pre-installed pieces using a set of pre-defined dropping pieces. There is also a link-up mode for battling with friends.

The Tezuka characters play no big role in the game, being displayed in a window to the right of the playfield, changing mimics according to how the game progresses. You have six characters to choose from, and three save slots to put them in. The save slots let you keep your score for upcoming sessions.

title: Combo Fishing
alternate_titles: Combo Fishing (Homebrew)
description: Welcome to Combo Fishing (Combination Fishing)! In this game for the Gameboy, you can fish using the arrow keys. There are 16 fish to collect to complete the museum, and you can earn Frog Tokens with each catch! Your progress autosaves. Press Start to view your fish collection, or press "A" on the tacklebox! You can also view the lectern in the museum to see how many of each fish you've collected. Feel free to use your Frog Tokens in the shop for extra goodies! If it seems like you can't interact with something, you could be facing the wrong way, try pressing the direction again. The dev didn't make a unique sprite for when you're facing up, smh.

title: Command Master
alternate_titles: コマンドマスター
description: The second software for "motion sensor" that moves the GB itself to play. The ultimate experience game that realizes "technical coolness" and "fun of action" that allows you to enter more complicated commands quickly and accurately. The number of characters that the player can transform by entering a command is 80! The total number of techniques that each character can use is over 300! Furthermore, the strength changes depending on the timing of entering the transformation command. You can enjoy both collecting characters and refining techniques to create strong characters.

title: Commander Keen
description: Commander Keen is a 2001 video game published by Activision. It is part of the Commander Keen series, which was originally developed by id Software. Released for the Game Boy Color, it was developed with id Software's permission; however it did not involve any of the original Commander Keen developers. It was developed instead by David A. Palmer Productions. Tom Hall, creative director and designer of the original Commander Keen series, has stated that he does not consider the GBC game "canon by any means".

title: Commando
description: You are Super Joe, the crack combat soldier, equipped with only an M60 machine gun, you must carry out your lone crusade forcing your way into hostile territory. Your mission is to invade each of the four areas, cleaning each one of your opponents before finally destroying your objective, the enemy fortress. Watch out, because your mission will end even if you get behind the enemy!

title: Computer Engineering (for dropouts)
alternate_titles: Computer Engineering For Dropouts
description: When studying for finals, you fall asleep and need to do some quick cramming for your computer engineering exam! If ~15 minutes of logic gate-on-brain action appeals to you, then this weirdly personal game might scratch that itch. This one goes out to all the engineering dropouts out there. We tried our best.

title: Conker's Pocket Tales
description: It's Conker's birthday and someone crashed his party! The Evil Acorn has stolen all of Conker's presents and kidnapped his best chipmunk friend, Berri. Now you must take on the role of the bushy-tailed hero, pursuing your nemesis throughout 6 visually-stunning worlds to rescue Berri and save your birthday from complete disaster. Strain your brain to solve challenging puzzles, battle the Evil Acorn's horde of minions with your trusty slingshot, and even flex your muscles in sporting events as you track your foe to the final showdown!

title: Conquest
description:
Featuring The White Stripes. It's Halloween in Detroit, and suddenly Jack mysteriously disappears and the city is turned into a De Stijl representation of itself, with the Hotel Yorba rising in the distance.  Can you help Meg rescue Jack?

The game features two levels.  The first level is a De Stijl maze.  Help Meg navigate her way through the maze to the Hotel Yorba.  But be careful, avoid the moving blocks.  One wrong move and you will be transported to a new location.

The second level is a platformer that requires you to climb to the top of the Hotel Yorba.  But watch out, touch a ghost and they will possess you.  Do you have what it takes to make it to room 206?

title: Consume
description:
Consume is a simple Game Boy Color JRPG made with GB Studio.

You take the role of Scum, a criminal tasked with defeating the Demon Lord in order to gain their freedom. 

Defeat monsters to gain exp to level up and gold to spend. 

Use gold to buy potions, drugs, and a place to rest. 

There are multiple endings based on what actions you take and how much you explore.

title: Cookie
description: Charlie the Chef keeps ingredients locked in the pantry, which upsets them. When released, they escape along with pests and rubbish. Charlie must stop them with flour bombs and get them into the mixing bowl, or else they’ll be lost to the bin monster. If junk gets into the cake mix, Charlie’s task becomes harder, and he must work faster to finish baking.

title: Cookie's Bakery
alternate_titles: Cookies Bakery
description: Four days until the annual Winter Festival! It sure is a busy time in your bakery, but you will help your fellow citizens, by providing them with bite-sized calm and contemplation: delicious cookies!

title: Cool Bricks
description: Cool Bricks is a Breakout-style game, updated for the modern market. Players use the bat and ball to smash all the breakable bricks to complete each level. Cool Bricks also features a wide range of power-ups including the Ghost, Ninja and Poison. New technological tricks allow for high-colour screens and in excess of 150 levels. The game also features a durable High-Score board.

title: Cosmo Command
description:
COSMO COMMAND is a love letter to classic Game Boy shmups and a certain franchise featuring animals flying space ships. Try for the highest score while listening to banter from your teammates and take part in a story of galactic proportions!

In a distant galaxy, the peace of the cosmos is at stake! The Reptile Empire has invaded the star systems of the Mammalian Federation, and it’s up to the plucky heroes of Cosmo Command to save the day.

title: Cosmo Knight ZiON
description:
An invasion of androids from outer space has reached Earth. Zion and Eerie find themselves surrounded by these strange androids who relentlessly capture humans. Faced with this situation, Zion is forced to use his martial arts skills to fight the enemies. With the help of cosmic armor obtained from one of the invading androids, he will embark on a crusade to save Eerie and the other humans. Immerse yourself in a retro adventure that will transport you back to the golden days of handheld consoles.

Cosmo Knight Zion is a classic platform game, like those that were so popular in the 90s. It offers levels full of excitement, hidden elements, enemies to defeat, beautiful scenes that tell the story of the game, and powerful level bosses that will remind you of the challenging difficulty of yesteryear. Cosmo Knight Zion brings you the full retro experience of handheld consoles.

A RETRO-STYLE JOURNEY
Classic retro-style platform game inspired by the famous handheld consoles of the 90s. Jump, hit, collect items, and get power-ups as you advance through challenging levels and face powerful bosses. The key to success is not giving up and knowing your enemy. Will you make it through with your armor intact?

title: Cosmoctopus
description: You are the COSMOCTOPUS, stay constantly in motion, avoid anything that moves and you may reached the very end of the universe.

title: Coucou*
description: You play as a mermaid that has to seduce and lure men into the water so they can drown. Seduce them by waving at them in a flirtatious way.

title: Crazy Bikers
description: Motocross Maniacs 2 is a Racing game, developed by Konami Computer Entertainment Osaka and published by Konami, which was released in Europe in 1999.

title: Crazy Golf
description: You are about to tee off on the CRAZIEST golf course you've ever seen! Featuring ten holes, each with its own unique set of obstacles which must be either avoided or used to your advantage. The ball's path will restart if it falls into a black hole or touches the wire. Each hole has a "par", this is the number of strokes in which it is possible to sink the ball. If you're lucky you may be able to complete a hole "under par".

title: Croc
description: The lovable little crocodile from the PlayStation and Saturn games arrives on Game Boy Color in CROC. The evil Dantinis led by the wicked Baron Dante have kidnapped the peaceful Gobbos. You assume the role of Croc, a heroic young crocodile, as he sets out to save all of his little friends. Run, jump, and swim your way through four colorful areas. More than 30 stages await you in the desert, ice world, jungle, and the castle. CROC features several special levels to keep gameplay fresh: aside from the standard side-scrolling stages on foot, you'll have to swim through treacherous coves, ski down a bumpy incline, ride a railcart through an underground mineshaft, and more. Adding even more variety are some mini-games that change up the action between levels. CROC features detailed full-color graphics with superb animation, and is a single-player adventure that you won't soon forget.

title: Croc 2
description: Join Croc in an exciting new adventure as he searches for his long lost parents. But the search soon becomes a showdown as Croc's archenemy, Baron Dante, is magically resurrected by his evil Dantinis. Join Croc's journey as he explores over 40 levels within four Gobbo tribe villages, each packed with unique Gobbos, mischievous monsters, and tons of surprises!

title: Cross Hunter - Monster Hunter Version
alternate_titles: クロスハンター モンスターハンターバージョン
description: A game born from the popular reader-participation project "The Strongest RPG Plan" in "Comic BomBom". It is an orthodox RPG, and it is made with an emphasis on the basics of training, collecting, exchanging, and fighting. There are 16 types of monsters created by readers, and more than 140 monsters can be collected. The story is different for all three versions. The main character of the Monster Hunter version is Shiro. Since there are 3 versions, you can enjoy various communication variations! With a deep and three-dimensional structure, you can play as many times as you like.

title: Cross Hunter - Treasure Hunter Version
alternate_titles: クロスハンター トレジャーハンターバージョン
description: A game born from the popular reader-participation project "The Strongest RPG Plan" in "Comic BomBom". It is an orthodox RPG, and it is made with an emphasis on the basics of training, collecting, exchanging, and fighting. There are 16 types of monsters created by readers, and more than 140 monsters can be collected. The story is different for all three versions. The main character of the treasure hunter version is the rope. Aim to defeat the Demon King to save his sister. Since there are 3 versions, you can enjoy various communication variations! With a deep and three-dimensional structure, you can play as many times as you like.

title: Cross Hunter - X Hunter Version
alternate_titles: クロスハンター エックスハンターバージョン
description: A game born from the popular reader-participation project "The Strongest RPG Plan" in "Comic BomBom". It is an orthodox RPG, and it is made with an emphasis on the basics of training, collecting, exchanging, and fighting. There are 16 types of monsters created by readers, and more than 140 monsters can be collected. The story is different for all three versions. The main character of the X-Hunter version is Huga. Since there are 3 versions, you can enjoy various communication variations! With a deep and three-dimensional structure, you can play as many times as you like.

title: Cruis'n Exotica
alternate_titles: Cruis 'n Exotica
description: Race in style! Cruis'n Exotica takes you to fantastic locales in even more fantastic vehicles. Race through steamy Jurassic jungles or on the ocean floor. Midair stunts keep the action nonstop! Valuable short-cuts and nitro boosts speed up the already fast-paced action!

title: Crystal Clear
description:
Bipedal Studios has partnered with Kyuchumimo to fix the first ever Bipedal game! Originally unreleased due to a couple of game breaking bugs, Crystal Clear is a typical color-matching game in which the player doesn't control the pieces. Instead, you have to decide how the pieces will be arranged and drop them from the top of the playfield. After that, you will be no longer able to move them. 

The crystals in the game feature different colors and shapes, which allow for both GBC and DMG support. To make the game seamlessly playable, Kyuchumimo, a regular tester of Bipedal games, got rid of the bugs that prevented the game from being released when it was initially intended.

title: Crystal Depths
description: After moving in, Dash discovers a magical world beneath her basement. Now it's up to you to help her find a way out of dreamland.

title: Crystalis
description: CRYSTALIS for the Game Boy Color takes you to a post-apocalyptic world where an evil force named Dragonia threatens to take over. You must seek out the four powerful enchanted Swords of the Elements in order to defeat him. Explore a massive world, loaded with more than 70 enemies and 300 non-player characters to interact with in this action or RPG.

title: Cubix: Robots For Everyone - Race 'N Robots
description: Robots in everyday life? Believe it, folks. That's the reality of the cool cartoon series, CUBIX: Robots for Everyone. The story follows the adventures of Connor a human boy and his robot, Cubix, through Bubble Town. Attempting to repair damaged robots and ward off evil beings, the pair encounters a whole cast of wacky characters every week. The game puts its emphasis on the racing aspects of the series, sending you to Bubble Town's racing championship series. Your arch-nemesis, Dr. K, has a converted racer named Kolossal in the competition, and your goal is to earn the right to defeat it. Choose to race as any of your favorite series characters, including Hop2ix, Brutix, Don-Don, Diagnostix, and Cubix. You'll be able to customize your racers to fit your liking, using elements like Grav-grip, Zero G, and other series-based power-ups to defy gravity and reach top speeds. Full of cool options game modes, and colorful graphics, Race N Robots is not to be missed.

title: Cupid
description: Something or someone has broken the Heart, a magical relic that stitches all things together. Without it, the universe will slowly unravel and everything will fall into darkness. Play as a cute little Cupid, tasked with mending the broken Heart. Do your best to spread love and happiness to all that you meet and prevent the darkness from taking hold!

title: Cuthbert in the Cooler
description:
The object of the game is to collect the various objects on each screen and get out of the top again while avoiding the guards. You will have 5 Cuthberts to start. Each object you pick up will increase your score (100 points). You will also receive a time bonus for completing a sheet quickly (100 points for every sign). You start with 6 bombs. These can be laid, one at a time, by pressing the "A" button. Once laid, they can be detonated by pressing "A" for a second time. These will destroy the guard, but not You! You can pick it up with no harms. An extra bomb is awarded for each sheet completed, but maximum of 6 bombs you have.
The Goal: Earn 10.000 points! Good luck!

title: Cuthbert: The C16 Games
description:
This is a homebrew game collection, run on Gameboy Color. Original version: Microdeal. Commodore 16/Plus4, 1984-1985.

CUTHBERT ENTERS THE TOMBS OF DOOM

In the year of 6502 BC, I Jesmon Hys, a natyve of ye far away city of Nodlon, dyscovered ye ancient tombs of Ledromica, some three decades past, whilst on trek through ye rich pastures of Gagsellus. I entered into the tombs and from thence I spent many years exploring the myriad of chambers and gained much knowledge as to ye ways, ye promises of great unimaginable treasures an ye straynge inhabitants  of ye many colored caverns. From ye many carvings and scriptings on ye walls, I have come to know of an even greater goal. It would seem that somewhere in ye tombs were a temple, dedicated to ye worship of Rah. Anyone reaching this temple would be given a gift far greater than any treasure!! Alas, I am now but an olde man, too slow of brain and frail of body to continue my quest. My notes herewithe should help ye, my successor, in reaching a far away goal. There is much to know and many skills to master before the should enter ye great tombs. May the force be with ye.

CUTHBERT IN SPACE

Cuthbert has been sent on a looting mission. You must collect the fuel pods & return them individually to the mother ship. Once all the pods are collected you depart for another planet but sometimes your ship malfunctions and you must go for vital spares. Good luck!

CUTHBERT IN THE COOLER

The object of the game is to collect the various objects on each screen and get out of the top again while avoiding the guards. You will have 5 Cuthberts to start. Each object you pick up will increase your score (100 points). You will also receive a time bonus for completing a sheet quickly. You start with 6 bombs. These can be laid, one at a time, by pressing the "A" button. Once laid, they can be detonated by pressing "A" for a second time. These will destroy the guard, but not You! You can pick it up with no harms. An extra bomb is awarded for each sheet completed, but maximum of 6 bombs you have. Good luck!

title: CyberTiger
description: Rip up the rules book - anything goes! Create your own golfer to take on CyberTiger and the many other characters. Real-time analog swing and ball control - hit a fade or a draw, add topspin or backspin, all in mid-flight. Sandtraps and tall rough are just the beginning. Seven modes of play: Strokes, Skins, Match, Tournament, Practice, Driving Range and the all-new Battle and Club Challenge modes. More ways to get on the green - superdrives, hidden tricks, hidden courses, hidden golfers, and tons of secret skills!

title: Cyborg Kuro-chan 2: White Woods no Gyakushu
alternate_titles: サイボーグクロちゃん 2 ～ホワイトウッズの逆襲～ | Cyborg Kuro-chan 2 ~ White Woods Counterattack ~
description: The second game GB version of "Cyborg Kuro-chan" serialized in Comic BomBom. We are soliciting game proposals from readers at Comic BomBom, and the names of the adopters will appear in the ending! The number of "cropons (weapons)" is more than the previous work, more than 420 types. You can get a powerful rare cropon with Pazuward. The password is available on Comic BomBom and the homepage, so look for it now!

title: Cyborg Kuro-Chan: Devil Fukkatsu!!
alternate_titles: サイボーグクロちゃん デビル復活!! | Cyborg Kuro-chan ~ Devil Revival !! ~
description: Collect Kuro-chan weapons, commonly known as "Kuropon", and defeat the boss that appears at the end of the stage! In this game, the "destruction rate" that destroys and raises buildings is important. You can get a new cropon by destroying the object to be destroyed, or you can get the "strongest cropon" when the destruction rate of all 5 stages reaches 80%. There are 320 types of cropons in all. If you get "The Strongest Cropon", you will be able to fight your friends in online battles. If you win the match, you can take a penalty such as stealing the cropon used by the opponent or rewriting the name of the opponent's cartridge to your own name. At the beginning of the stage, there are visuals featuring characters familiar from anime, including Kuro-chan.

title: d fuzed
description:
Poor Deef, a bomb disposal robot, reluctantly finds himself on a journey to save his friends. A big bad boss has appeared, raining chaos and destruction on this once peaceful land. Deef must rescue his friends while defusing bombs and avoiding hazards, as he progresses through each area towards a final explosive confrontation.

D*Fuzed is a turn-based logic puzzle game, where just one wrong move might be your last. Defuse bombs to recharge your battery, avoid the explosions, and look out for other hazards along the way!

title: Daa! Daa! Daa! Totsuzen * Card de Battle de Uranai!?
alternate_titles: だぁ!だぁ!だぁ!とつぜん★カードでバトルで占いで | Da! Da! Da! Totsuzen ★ Fortune-telling in battle with cards
description: "Da!" Serialized in the monthly shojo manga magazine "Nakayoshi". Oh! Oh! ] Is made into a game. "Card game" is a mode to play a card game with the main characters that appear. In 1 play, the game progresses according to the original story of the game, and in 2 play, two GBCs are used to play against each other. "Fortune-telling" is the player's fortune-telling mode. There are "1 day fortune-telling" and "1 week fortune-telling", and 4 fortune-telling: general luck, love luck, study luck, and health luck. "Compatibility is fortune-telling" is a mode for fortune-telling compatibility with friends. There are two types, "Nakayoshi fortune-telling" fortune-telling compatibility and "Otasuke fortune-telling" fortune-telling friendship. "Name card" is a mode to create a simple business card for yourself or your friends. "Album" is a mode in which you can watch event graphics.

title: Daffy Duck: Fowl Play
description: DAFFY DUCK: Fowl Play brings more Looney Tunes fun and action to your Game Boy Color. In this one-player, side-scrolling action game, you'll play as Daffy Duck, who's been told by Bugs Bunny about a secret hidden treasure. Your job is to find it! Too bad Bugs and the rest of the Looney Tunes crew have decided to stop your treasure-hunting journey cold. Play through nine stages of platforming action as you look to get rich quick. There are a few puzzle elements as well that require you to push crates and use dynamite sticks to clear a path. DAFFY DUCK: Fowl Play features large, well-animated characters set on detailed backgrounds, and although it has been enhanced for Game Boy Color, this game is compatible with both Game Boy and Game Boy Color systems.

title: Daikaijyuu Monogatari: The Miracle of the Zone II
alternate_titles: 大貝獣物語 ザ・ミラクル オブ ザ・ゾーン II
description: The second GB version of the card game "MOZ", which is gaining popularity mainly among elementary school students. Appeared with a significant power-up. 119 types of cards including the blue chapter card have been added, the number of in-game tournaments has quadrupled, the in-game ranking setting system has been newly increased, and the purpose of aiming for the highest rank "Miracle Master" has been achieved. The characters have been renewed to 59 people, the map has increased by 4 places, the BGM has also been renewed, and the number of songs has increased significantly. Rare cards can be obtained by communicating data, which is a cable, with the "Poyon's Dungeon Room" that will be released in advance.

title: Daikatana
description: Daikatana is a role-playing game, developed by Will and published by Kemco, which was released in Europe in 2000.

title: Daiku no Gen San
alternate_titles: Daiku no Gen-san: Kachikachi no Tonkachi ga Kachi | 大工の源さん カチカチのトンカチがカチ | Hammerin' Harry Ticking Ticking Ticking
description: Hammerin' Harry, a familiar carpenter, has appeared as an action puzzle game. Gen-san's favorite item, "Hammer," also has three different characteristics, and its reaction changes when it hits an enemy or transforms a block. Includes various puzzle variations that can stand in the way of disturbing gimmicks. Grasp the features of many gimmicks and solve puzzles to pave the way!

title: Daisu-ki
description: Your goal is to unite the two dice in love back together. To do this, they have to be adjacent to each other and add up to 7. The dice can push each other. Each time one moves (unless it pushes another), its number goes up or turns to 1 if it was 6. The tiles with numbers only allow a die to pass if it shows that number. The spikes toggle every time a die moves, but not when you swap players. Conveyor tiles move dice in their direction.

title: Dance Dance Revolution GB
description: DDR is now available on GB. The GB version takes steps with your fingers! It has a dedicated finger controller, so it's easy to play. When you have a little time, you can easily play with the stage-based ARCADE MODE. With cable communication, you can play with your friends and compete with each other.

title: Dance Dance Revolution GB Disney Mix
alternate_titles: DDR Disney Mix
description:
Third and last console game of DanceDanceRevolution with Disney.
This is also the last game released on GameBoy.
DanceDanceRevolution GB Disney mix includes most of the songs from DanceDanceRevolution Disney's RAVE.
Just like Dancing Stage featuring Disney's RAVE and DanceDanceRevolution Disney's RAVE, there is no numerical scoring system during gameplay. Instead, a letter rank is given (starting with A), which improves or worsens throughout the song, depending on the player's performance.
One of the two GameBoy DanceDanceRevolution titles with a battery backup cartridge.
Total Songs: 16

title: Dance Dance Revolution GB2
alternate_titles: ダンスダンスレボリューションＧＢ2
description: The second DDR GB. Contains a total of 20 songs, including 3rdMIX, which is popular in arcades, and solo2000, the first home video game console. It also has a NON-STEP mode, which makes it even more interesting. A finger-only controller with a different color from the previous work is also included. Enjoy DDR anytime, anywhere!

title: Dance Dance Revolution GB3
alternate_titles: ダンスダンスレボリューションＧＢ3
description: The third in the DDR GB series! This time, we selected songs from the arcade version of DDR 4th MIX. From 3rdMIX and solo2000, it also covers songs that could not be included in the previous work. The dedicated controller has also been renewed!

title: Dancing Furby
alternate_titles: ダンシングファービー
description: A rhythm action game that lets you dance "Furby" to the flowing rhythm. The modes are "Dance mode" where Furby dances by key operation according to the music (there are 3 levels of difficulty), "Free play mode" where you can freely select Furby and songs, and you can dance with your own song with the composition function. There are 5 types of "Composer Mode", "Network Mode" where you can play powerfully with your friends, 4 types of mini games, and "Mini Game Mode" with "Furby Dictionary". In addition, depending on the score of the game, a signal can be sent from the infrared port of GB to the toy "Furby doll" owned by the player, and the toy "Furby doll" will perform various dances and talks.

title: Dangan GB2
alternate_titles: Dangan GB2 (World) (Aftermarket) (Unl)
description:
Dangan GB2 is a short simplistic boss-rush, bullet-hell, shoot 'em up released for the Game Boy Color to celebrate the console's 25th anniversary.

Features:
-six unique bosses with multiple phases
-no sprite flicker, no slowdown, no tearing
-bigger, faster and more bullets
-two playable characters
-high-score save

title: Danger Ranger
description: Danger Ranger must collect ten keys from the Chamber of Pasha, whilst warding off the Floating Urns, Radioactive Bats and Roving Eyes. Then he must face the Acid Chamber to collect all the Treasure Chest, avoiding not only the drops of acid, but shooting the three demons which guard the chamber.

title: Dango Dash [Standard Edition]
description:
Ever since an unknown calamity destroyed the world, people live on islands floating in a vast sea of clouds. In a small village on one of these islands lives a young boy called Dango, who tries to find his place in life.

Dango Dash is a platformer adventure game that combines fast-paced action with an engaging story about growing up and fighting for what you believe in. Help Dango in his quest to save his village and defeat the evil Hanami ninja clan threatening their peace.

title: Das Geheimnis der Happy Hippo-Insel
description:
The game is a relatively simple side-scrolling platformer. It stars the anthropomorphic hippopotamus Max Mutig ("Max Courageous"), who sets out on a journey to lift the secret around his home island's volcano, which has recently become active again and is causing destruction. In order to do so, he must venture through six areas, consisting of three levels each and filled with various enemies and hazards, which must be avoided or eliminated by various means, as well as fire, which can be doused by spitting water at it. Along the way, Max must also rescue numerous of his hippo friends and bring the island's five "Happy Flowers" back to life after the volcano has made them wither.

Das Geheimnis der Happy Hippo-Insel was the first video game to feature the Happy Hippo characters by Ferrero, who have appeared as figurines in the company's Kinder Surprise chocolate eggs since 1988, as well as in various other forms of media and merchandise. It was released exclusively in German-speaking regions, where the characters are very popular, and is thus only available with German on-screen text; as the game is not very text-heavy, however, it can be played without understanding the language.

title: Dashosaur DX
alternate_titles: Dashosaur DX (World) (v0.21) (Aftermarket) (GB Studio) (Sleeping Panda Games)
description:
Dashosaur DX is a short precision platformer for the Gameboy.

You play Roxy, one of the last living dashosaurus of this era. She is known for her powerful dash ability. Guide her through the valley to a safe place while a volcano suddenly awaken.

title: Data-Navi Pro Yakyuu
alternate_titles: データナビプロ野球 | Data Navi Professional Baseball
description: A simulation baseball game where you can freely edit data. Players can enjoy realistically reproduced pennant races as owners, managers, and spectators. The latest real name default data that promoted the actual results, a total of 360 players. In addition to being able to set up to the year stick, the full-scale content of the baseball stadium and stadium is all real names. Many uniform team logos are also available for the original team. Since team data can be sent and received by infrared communication, it is possible to fight with a team of friends, and it also has a trading function during pennant racing.

title: Data-Navi Pro Yakyuu 2
alternate_titles: データナビプロ野球 2 | Data Navi Professional Baseball 2
description: A simulation baseball game where you can freely edit data. Adopted the latest data at the start of the 2001 pennant race. 360 players in a professional baseball team. The stadium appears under its real name. It also supports the 140 game schedule of the Central League. Players can enjoy realistically reproduced pennant races as owners, managers, and even spectators. The number of signs that can be instructed is 11 items when attacking and 11 items when defending. You can enjoy modes such as "Penant Race Mode" to fight through the season, "All-Star Game Mode" selected for the success of the first half of the game, "Japan Series Mode" to fight with the winning team of Sepa, and "Open Battle Mode" to play anytime you like. You can exchange team data of your friends via infrared communication.

title: Date with Falco
description:
Date with Falco is a furry dating sim / walking simulator. The game is written and drawn to be appropriate for general audiences.

You (Fox McCloud) walk and talk with your boyfriend (Falco Lombardi) who's not happy about the cold weather, as you try to get him outside during the winter season in Corneria. Things have been rough in the past week for Fox and Falco, and the cold weather certainly hasn't helped, but maybe a walk in the fresh snow will cheer them up.

Explore the city, talk with your bird boyfriend, and get up to hijinx together.

title: Dave Mirra Freestyle BMX
description: The Game Boy Color gets its own BMX trick game with DAVE MIRRA FREESTYLE BMX. You'll play through eight different stages that will give you the chance to pull off some wild stunts and spectacular jumps. Each course will challenge you to complete a variety of objectives, ranging from specific stunts to collecting items. Perform each of the objectives to earn points, unlock new stages, and upgrade your bike for better tricks. The game is played from a ?-overhead perspective, which allows you a maximum view of the surrounding area. Each of the levels has a multitude of obstacles and items to perform tricks on and, with careful timing, you'll be able to create wild trick combinations off multiple objects. You can play a Tournament mode with up to three friends by passing the system after each run, and you can save your progress and high scores using the password save function.

title: David Beckham Soccer
description: From the country that lives, eats and sleeps the sport, comes David Beckham Soccer. It features: Over 200 top club and international teams using up-to-date squads and player data; fluid, motion-captured animation; awesome super-stadiums; realistic crowd atmosphere; play-by-play calls; a unique David Beckham training mode. This is the most true-to-the-game soccer experience available.

title: David O'Leary's Total Soccer 2000
alternate_titles: Barca Total 2000 | Total Soccer 2000
description:
A portable version of PC's excellent Total Soccer series. The graphics are even more simplified for the Gameboy's capabilities, but the gameplay remains the same.

It features 10 different practice modes, 3 levels of difficulty, leagues, championships and single-matches, and 2-player-link feature also.

title: Dawn Will Come
description: It's dark. How long has it been dark?  Monsters prowl everywhere, supplies are scarce. Decide your tasks, carry them out, find more survivors to help, fight back the creatures that emerge from the Night. You must survive, because surely Dawn Will Come.

title: Days Without
alternate_titles: Days Without - Elvies | Days Without - Elvies [More Endings]
description:
Find meaning in life as Job meets a friendly stranger and survives the end of the world in this short narrative.

Developer: Elvies

title: DE '22
genre: Construction and Management Simulation | Platform | Unofficial
description:
Can you jump your way through the construction zone to reclaim all of DE's bananas?

Go through all 3 levels and collect all of the Bananas for a special reward!

Note: DE '22 is a GameBoy Color exclusive. It will not work on a DMG or MGB GameBoy.

title: Dead Gorgeous
description: Take on the role of Nadia Steele as she tries to find the killer who murdered her sister in a story driven platformer with hand drawn cutscenes and a retro 8 bit gameplay experience on the original Gameboy.

title: Dead Names
description: A small sci-fi visual novel for Game Boy -- set during one winter day, in a future that hopefully never comes.

title: Dear Daniel no Sweet Adventure: Kitty-Chan o Sagashite
alternate_titles: ディアダニエルのスィートアドベンチャー ～キティちゃんをさがして～ | Hello Kitty: Dear Daniel's Sweet Adventure-Looking for Kitty-
description: Daniel's action game. In order to meet Kitty again, you have to clear the stages all over the world and get "Love Love Points". By accumulating love love points, you can use various costumes and items, and you can go to hidden stages. The more power-up items you get, the more high-scoring techniques you can get in the jump action, and the more points you get, the easier it is to earn love love points. Mini games and communication functions all depend on love love points.

title: Death Planet
description:
An evil galactic empire has constructed a moon-sized battle station, the Death Planet.

Equipped with a giant laser cannon, it has the power to destroy entire planets. The whole galaxy is under threat.

But the battle station has a weakness built-in at it’s very core, and this has come to the knowledge of the rebel alliance.

A rebel fighter squadron is on a sabotage mission to destroy the Death Planet and restore peace to the galaxy.

title: Decline
alternate_titles: Decline (v1.1) (Homebrew)
description:
In Decline, you play as an elderly police detective on the verge of retirement. Wrestling with cognitive decline, she attempts to solve the seemingly simple case. Though, things may not be as they seem as rumors spread about something called the ‘Glitch Witch’…

A story-driven horror game for Game Boy. Investigate a teacher's murder and deal with the effects of old age. The game features multiple endings based on decisions you make along the way.

title: Deep Space Freight
description:
Deep Space Freight is a homebrew game color game inspired by classic economy trading games from yesteryear. Remember Dopewars from 1997?

You start with a small loan and a  space-worthy freight truck, you must buy low, travel, and sell high, and avoid perils -- and welcome gifts along the way. Every time you travel, a new turn starts with new pricing at a new location. Randomized events can see you robbed, gifted cargo space, or experiencing a cargo fire, and more. How much can you make before your time's up?

title: Deer Hunter
description: The popular pursuit of hunting comes to the portable screen in DEER HUNTER for the Game Boy Color. You play as a hunter looking to catch a nice trophy in one of four different areas using three different weapons. Hunt deer with a shotgun, a rifle, or a bow, using slightly different tactics with each. If you want to be successful, you'll have to use real-world hunting strategies. Search for droppings or other signs of movement to find the best area to wait in. Once there, use one of an assortment of tools to help you catch your prey: mask your odor with a cover scent, use a tree stand to camouflage yourself, or lure the deer with a powerful musk, a deer call, or an antler rattle. It's up to you to decide how to catch the deer; some methods are more efficient than others, so you'll have to find the one that works best for you. Detailed graphics and digitized sound round out the experience for would-be hunters.

title: Deja Vu I & II: The Casebooks of Ace Harding
description:
Take on two thrilling mysteries in one Game Pak!

Life is never boring when you assume the role of Ace Harding, private detective. In Deja Vu I, you will scramble down the dark alleys of Chicago, searching for a cure for you amnesia and a killer who has framed you for a brutal murder. After solving the first case, you'll uncover a few loose strings that gradually unrabel into Deja Vu II. Trapped in the slimy town of Last Vegas, you find yourself dealing with a notorious mob leader who makes you an offer you can't refuse.

-Two detailed graphic adventure games in one Game Boy Color Game Pak!
-Detailed commands for interacting with anyone or anything!
-Return to the scene of the crime, or any of the other 140 locations!
-Sort out the real evidence from the red herrings and over 80 other items!
-Battery-backed save option for up to three save game files!

title: Dejiko no Mahjong Party
alternate_titles: でじこの麻雀パーティ | Di Gi Charat Mahjong Party
description: There are 6 game modes: "Winning Battle", "Free Battle", "Gamers Mode", "Beginner Guide", "Communication Battle", and "Item Mode". You can shop at Gamers with the points that won the mahjong game. Depending on the item you bought, the attribute value of the character will change, and mahjong will be advantageous.
