The voice is uttered by four people (Di Gi Charat, Buchiko, Usada, Panda), so you can enjoy it with your favorite character's voice.

title: Delia - The Traveling Witch
alternate_titles: Delia - The Traveling Witch (Homebrew v15)
description:
Delia and their Glowing Pig Bao are now in Glutinous Kingdom. After receiving a request to cure a sick child, they are wrapped in an adventure that spans the whole magical land!

Delia: The Traveling Witch is an Action Platformer with lots of talking NPC's and locations to jump around in. It has a minor Schmup section to it as well.

title: Denki Blocks!
description: The people of Puzzle Island love to play puzzle games. Their favorite is Denki Blocks! A game of skill that is played by sliding blocks around a board, joining colored blocks together to build shapes and solve puzzles.

title: Densha de Go!
alternate_titles: 電車でGO! | GO by train!
description: A train driving simulation game that stops the train at the station's stop position on Diamond Street. Stamp rally is adopted for all routes and sections as a new game system. Depending on the accuracy of the stop position, the stamp of the stop station will appear for each level. Since the stamps are stored in the backup cartridge and can be viewed freely, you can use it as a guide for achieving the station capture, and you can compete with your friends for the number of stamps you have collected. The lines that appear are the Sanin line, Keihin Tohoku line, Tokaido line, and Yamanote line, and if you collect stamps for all lines, extra lines will appear.

title: Densha de Go! 2
alternate_titles: 電車でGO! 2 | GO by train! 2
description: The second train driving game is now available at GBC. There are five driving routes: the Hokuhoku North Line, the Osaka Loop Line, the Kagoshima Main Line, and the Akita Shinkansen where you can enjoy high-speed driving. There is also a "fixed time system" that passes through the station at a fixed time. Adopted "Railway picture book mode" that collects railway photos by rank according to driving evaluation. The characteristics of each train are commented on the photos, and you can create a digital photo book by collecting the photos. These photos were taken by professional photographer Yosuke Shiozuka, and there are hundreds of them. It's compatible with game boy printers, so you can print out the photos you collect and exchange them with your friends. A full-scale train driving game that railroad fans will appreciate.

title: Depths of Europa
description:
Depths of Europa is a new Gameboy Color game in active development.

This demo is a complete, tiny adventure all its own, and takes place before the full game. Don't worry about spoiling the main game - this content is standalone!

The Gameboy Color never really got a solid exploration game in the style of Metroid, and I want to change that. Depths of Europa will be a full "metroidvania" adventure with modern features like an auto-map that fills in as you explore, a speed-running mode that disables dialog popups and other gameplay interruptions, and equipment and inventory screens for managing your loadout or reviewing clues you've picked up.

Press Start to access your Map subscreen. From there you can press Select to cycle to Equipment and Inventory screens. In gameplay, pressing Select will switch between active abilities - however you'll only have one to start the game, your gun. You may drop down through "thin" platforms by pressing Down + A (jump).

title: Desertion
description:
stranded in the middle of the desert.

sandfishing and reeling to the beat.

signal has been lost...

don't ever bother calling again.

title: Detective Conan: Legend of the Treasure of Strange Rock Island
alternate_titles: Detective Conan - Legend of the Treasure of Strange Rock Island (Japan) (En) (v0.04) (mz)
description: The second detective adventure of Conan's great success, following the "Karakuri Temple Murder Case". The next stage is an isolated island called Strange Rock Island. A mysterious incident involving a treasure awaits Conan and his friends! The basic flow of the game is to operate Conan and others to solve the mysterious incidents that occur in temples and strange rock islands in the mountains. The process of resolving the case finally evaluates the degree of detectiveness. This depends on what action (choice) the player makes. One of the pleasures is not just to solve the case, but to aim for the highest evaluation.

title: Detective Conan: The Mechanical Temple Murder Case
alternate_titles: Detective Conan - The Mechanical Temple Murder Case (Japan) (En) (v1.0) (Psyklax)
description: Conan and Ran go to an old temple in the remote mountains in search of their missing classmate's sister. Can Conan solve the incident that happens in the old temple? ?? The scenario adopted is Game Boy original. Full-scale scenarios and tricks are content that even adults can fully enjoy. Various mysteries are hidden in the game, and it is not easy to solve by Conan alone. In such a case, changing the character may lead to an incident or mystery. At the end of the game, the player's detective degree is evaluated based on the situation and actions that solved the case. If the detective rating is good, something will happen! ?? maybe. Operate Conan to solve the mysterious murder case!

title: Dewdrop Dynasty Demo Demake Demo
description: A fan demake of Firith Studios Goodgis' Dewdrop Dynasty Demo. Experience the successfully kickstarted metroidvania as if it were released back in 1998!

title: Dexter's Laboratory: Robot Rampage
alternate_titles: Elevator Action EX
description: Robots are running amok in Dexter's lab! Based on the popular cartoon series, DEXTER'S LABORATORY: Robot Rampage for the Game Boy Color puts you in the little boots of the Dexter as he tries to reclaim his lab from Mandark's invading mechanical mayhem. You'll have to ride elevators, dive down shafts, hide in shadows, and occasionally blast the robotic intruders as you hunt down your evil nemesis. There are three different outfits you can wear to make infiltrating the lab easier: wear your standard lab-coat or one of two special robo-suits, depending on what the situation calls for. You can also use Dexter's high-tech weapons to dispatch the enemy through level after level of fast and furious action.

title: Diamond Mine 2
description: You control a vacuum pipe in a mine to collect all the diamonds on each level. A robotic assistant named DIAMO powers the winch motor until his energy runs out or the level is cleared. You guide the pipe through mine shafts, avoiding enemies that will cost you a life if they touch your pipe or you. Crossing or retracing your own pipe also loses a life. You can retract the pipe using the B button and arrow keys. Each level becomes more difficult, and after level 10, enemies move randomly.

title: Dicee!
description:
Dicee! is dice puzzle game for the Game Boy and Game Boy Color. 

Roll the dice for scoring combinations to get the highest score.
Each game consists of 13 turns.
On each turn, roll the dice up to 3 times.
Use the D-pad (arrow keys) to move the cursor and select a dice or score category.
Select a dice and Press A (z) to lock or unlock a dice before a roll.
At the end of a turn, you must place a score or a zero in one of the thirteen score categories.
Press B (x) to Quick Select Roll Option during play or Back-out of Menus.
Press Start (Enter) to Pause Game.
During game play, press Start (Enter) then Select (Shift) to Quit back to Title Menu.

title: Dicky 1 Deluxe
alternate_titles: Dicky and the curios case of the missing girlfriend at orgy manor
description: Dicky and his girlfriend are invited to a orgy over at a luxurious manor, but once they arrive he lost sight of his beloved one. Luckily 3 beautiful woman are willing to help find her in return for a few favors.

title: Dicky 3
alternate_titles: The Saga of Dicky 3
description:
After the break up with his girlfriend Dicky went on a soul searching voyage that ended in the arms of a young witch at the yearly ‘Blazing bloke festival’.

Sadly the ex of the witch watched them at their most intimate moment and in anger shrunk a particular beloved body part of Dicky.

Luckily the curse can be revoked with the help of the witch and 3 of her convent sisters.

title: Die Biene Maja & Ihre Freunde
alternate_titles: Maya the Bee & Her Friends
description: A puzzle game based on the German cartoon.

title: Die Biene Maja: Auf der Klatschmohnwiese
alternate_titles: Maya the Bee: Garden Adventures
description: Maya the Bee 2 is an Action game, developed by NEON Software GmbH and published by Acclaim, which was released in Europe in 2000.

title: Die Maus
description: Maus und Elefant machen sich große Sorgen: ihre Freundin, die Ente, ist spurlos verschwunden...Wo ist sie? Hat sie ihnen nur einen Streich gespielt oder ist es ernst? Gemeinsam machen sich Maus und Elefant auf die Suche. Auf ihrem Weg müssen sie verschiedene Aufgaben bewältigen. Um die gestellten Rätsel lösen zu können, muß man auf versteckte Hinweise achten und die eingesammelten Dinge schlau einsetzen. Aber Achtung, es lauern auch einige Fallen in der abenteuerlichen Welt der Maus. Gemeinsam sind Maus und Elefant stärker, aber manche Hindernisse sind für den einen oder anderen unüberwindbar... - Maus, Elefant und Ente - die drei Stars der Fernsehserie endlich für den Color Game Boy - Der Spieler kann abwechselnd die Rolle der Maus und die des Elefanten übernehmen - Vielfältige Spielaufgaben: Fahrradpuzzle, Geheimcode knacken, Zaubermelodie erraten, Geschicklichkeitseinlagen... - Originelle Aktionsmöglichkeiten: Die Maus kann Fallschirm springen, der Elefant kann mit seinem Rüssel z.B. einen Luftballon aufblasen - Witzige Zeichentricksequenzen zwischen den Levels geben wertvolle Tips - 5 Welten mit mehr als 150 perspektivischen Szenen (isometrisch 3D) - Passwortzugang nach jedem abgeschlossenem Level möglich - Zwei Schwierigkeitsgrade wählbar

title: Die Maus: Verrueckte Olympiade
description: Die Maus: Verrückte Olympiade is a Sports game, developed by Neon Studios and published by Infogrames, released in Europe in 2001.

title: Die Original Moorhuhnjagd
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Digimon Adventure TCG
alternate_titles: Digimon Adventure TCG (Guzeinbuick)
description: That's right boyos. It's the Pokemon TCG. But with Digimon.

title: Digimon Adventure TCG Remastered
description: That's right boyos. It's the Pokemon TCG. But with Digimon.

title: Digimon Crystal
description:
Hack of Pokemon Crystal for the Game Boy Color adding Digimon into the game.

-All 251 Pokemon replaced with Digimon
-Fairy type
-Physical-Special split
-Running shoes
-Most HMs replaced with key items
-Forgettable HM moves
-Evolution parameters included in each Dex entry
-Increased difficulty and improved level scaling
-Convenient mart items
-All Digimon available in-game
-More useful item pickups

title: Dino Breeder 3: Gaia Fukkatsu
alternate_titles: ディノブリーダー ～ガイヤ復活～ 3
description: Incubate dinosaurs from eggs and let them travel on an adventure. Let's clear the waiting enemies and numerous events and create a new species by "fusion" while nurturing by feeding and sometimes treating. The number of scenarios will increase significantly, and the story will branch out. There are two types of dinosaurs that players can train, Stycola Saurus and Sordes, and six new types. The dinosaur grows in four stages. It is also possible to play against each other using a communication cable, and if you lose the game, the new species will become the opponent's thing.

title: Dino Breeder 4
alternate_titles: ディノブリーダー 4
description: Dr. Matsunaga continues to study dinosaur genes (Dinogenome). One day when the research was nearing completion, he suddenly disappeared, leaving a sample. There, Dr. Matsunaga's grandson, Dr. Matsunaga appeared, believed in the survival of the doctor, got on the time machine left by his grandfather, time slipped into the past, and set out on an adventure! The Dinoboo leader of the training series powers up with a fulfilling story and action! Not only the number of dinosaurs, but also the visual aspect, "super-futuristic DNA coalescence" in fusion, and the towering of many new systems, all of which are far beyond the previous work! The story has two screens, an action side and a bleeding side, and you will get an anesthetic bullet hitting Dino who will accompany your trip on the action side. Once you get Dino, take care of the dinosaurs and go on an adventure together. Defeat the enemies you encounter, overcome the events, obtain the items, and "DNA coalesce" with the fusion you arrived at to produce new species and complete the picture book. You can exchange new kinds of dinosaurs with your friends by installing a communication system.

title: Dinosaur'us
description: Dinosaur'us is a Role-Playing game, developed by RFX Interactive and published by Electronic Arts, which was released in Europe in 2001.

title: Dirty Feet
description:
A strange meteorite landed on earth and opened several pan-dimensional portals. You’ll need to dig your way up surrounded by many enemies. Demons, mutants, zombies and aliens await you in this brand new world of adventures. Travel through the city, jump into the underground and more…

Enemies can't kill you, but if they hit you, they'll teleport you backwards in the level, or make you temporarily disappear to block your progress.Crush your enemies, shoot them. Be ready to make your feet dirty ! The game is difficult in the spirit of the games of the Game Boy Era.

title: Disney's Tarzan
description: Overcome the jungle's most dangerous perils in this action-packed adventure. Based on the animated film, Tarzan allows you to relive Tarzan's journey through life from a headstrong youth to a courageous adult. Your innate jungle abilities will allow you to swing, climb, run, jump, and surf through 13 beautiful environments, while interacting with unique characters, riding elephants, and solving challenging puzzles. It's now up to you to master the moves of this unique jungle hero and save Tarzan's family from a ruthless hunter.

title: Disney's The Emperor's New Groove
description: What would you do if someone turned you into a llama? Based on the animated film from Disney, THE EMPEROR'S NEW GROOVE casts you in the role of a young Incan ruler named Kuzco. When the evil Yzma turns Kuzco into a llama, our hero must make his way through eight action-packed levels in order to return to his archenemy for the ultimate showdown. That will require jumping gaps, negotiating moving platforms, breaking down barriers, unlocking closed doors, and more. Of course, all of Yzma's dastardly minions will be after you, but you'll have a variety of attacks to thwart their efforts including spitting! Along your path, you'll collect red and gold coins, water jugs, and plenty of Aztec coins. There'll be lots of obstacles along the way (watch out for scorpions!), but with your wits, skills, and reflexes, you might just have a chance at defeating your enemies and returning to the life that's rightfully yours. Good luck, llama!

title: Disney's The Lion King: Simba's Mighty Adventure
description: As the young lion prince Simba, you'll grow to discover what it means to be rightful ruler of the Pride Lands. But first you'll have to outrun a wildebeest stampede, escape a wildfire and more! There's never a dull moment when you're King of the Beasts!

title: Disney's The Little Mermaid II: Pinball Frenzy
description: To coincide with the release of another Little Mermaid video, Disney has also released another Little Mermaid videogame. LITTLE MERMAID 2 PINBALL FRENY for the Game Boy Color is just what the name implies, a frenzied pinball game. There are two different boards that can be played on, each with several variations of their own. The Ariel board contains paddles that are put at varying places to throw off people too used to traditional pinball machines, and it makes them learn some new strategies. The Melody board has many different ramps and drop spots to create its own unique atmosphere. Each board contains eight mini-games that differ from simple actions to more complex objectives. The game also comes with a built-in Rumble Pak, guaranteed to deliver plenty of shaking to help make the game a more realistic experience. LITTLE MERMAID 2 PINBALL FRENZY delivers a pinball experience geared toward young players, but has enough gameplay and variation to please most any fan of the genre.

title: Disney/Pixar A Bug's Life
description: A Bug's Life is a platform game with different goals in each of 15 levels. Most of the goals deal with getting the main character, Flik, to do events that match the storyline of the movie. When the player finishes a level, that player can proceed to the next level. Each new level starts with a new short animation from the movie. If the player collects all of the bonus items in a level, that player gets a bonus movie. Bonus items include 50 pieces of grain, four letters that spell F-L-I-K (like the Tarzan N64 game) and permanently finishing off each enemy bug. To guide the player through the levels there are little floating telescopes that will show the player areas where he is supposed to go. Throughout each level are a variety of types of seeds. Some seeds are partially buried in the ground. These seeds can be transformed by Flik into a specific kind of plant that can help him solve problems within the levels. Flik can increase the number of plants he can grow by collecting colored tokens scattered throughout the levels, with a token's color determining what type of plant can be grown with it. Some levels also included Flik’s harvesting invention (hidden somewhere in the level) which can be used to collect grain and kill off enemy bugs.

title: Disney/Pixar Buzz Lightyear of Star Command
description: Only you, Buzz Lightyear, and your elite Space Ranger team can defeat the evil Emperor Zurg in his dark quest for universal domination! Blast off with power-ups like shields, rockets, homing weapons and lightning beams. Fight on jetpacks, hoverboards, jetbikes and more! Explore 12 levels in seven amazing worlds, including Planet Z.

title: Disney/Pixar Monsters, Inc.
description: Get set to have a roaring good time as you scare your way across Monstropolis. Get Boo back to her world before the CDA catches up with you. It's a hair-raising comic adventure across monstrous puzzle-laden zones

title: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 2
description: As space hero Buzz Lightyear, you've got your hands full. Your best buddy, Woody, has been kidnapped by a greedy toy collector and it's going to be an all-out race against time to save him.

title: Disney/Pixar Toy Story Racer
description: The race is on! For the first time ever, join Woody, Buzz Lightyear and the gang in a crazy, turbo-blasting remote-controlled racing competition through the action-packed world of Disney's Toy Story!

title: Disney's 102 Dalmatians: Puppies to the Rescue
alternate_titles: 102 Dalmatians: Puppies to the Rescue
description: It's puppy power to the rescue! As Oddball or Domino, it's up to you to rescue your captured puppy friends from the evil clutches of Cruella De Vil and her army of pet-napping toys!

title: Disney's Aladdin
description: Disney's Aladdin is a series of platformer video games based on the 1992 motion picture of the same name. The series consists of three drastically different games: one developed by Virgin Interactive for the Sega Mega Drive, which was ported to various other formats, another developed by Capcom for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System, which was later ported to the Game Boy Advance, and a final version developed by SIMS for the Sega Master System and Game Gear.

title: Disney's Atlantis: The Lost Empire
description: A civilization shadowed with mystery, guarded by mythical monsters, controlled by a mighty crystal that- in the wrong hands- could destroy the legendary empire. Now, with the aid of a submarine and a mysterious book, go on a journey in search of Atlantis: The Lost Empire. Along the way you will encounter huge sea-creatures, fiery volcanoes, mutiny, and even a beautiful princess. Are you ready to take on this mission?

title: Disney's Beauty and the Beast: A Board Game Adventure
description: Disney's Beauty and the Beast: A Board Game Adventure packs the personality and fun of the popular Disney characters into a wild board game filled with a variety of mini-games. Select your favorite Beauty and the Beast character and play against three opponents as you race to the finish line. Since everything depends on the roll of the dice, there is a bit of luck involved but skill enters into the mix when you land on one of the mini-game squares. When you do, you'll be whisked to one of 10 side games that will test your reflexes, memory, and skill. Up to four players can play this game by passing the system around after each turn no link cable required! If you want to try something a little different when playing by yourself, challenge the game's Story mode, where you must race the villainous Gaston to the finish of each board.

title: Disney's Donald Duck: Goin' Quackers
description: In DONALD DUCK: Goin' Quackers for the Game Boy Color you play Donald Duck, who must rescue his girlfriend Daisy from the clutches of the evil Merlock You'll set out on an adventure to rescue Daisy and send Merlock back to his own warped dimension. To do that, you'll have to run, jump, and battle your way through the levels and collect the blueprints to the dimensional transporter that are scattered around four different side-scrolling worlds. Vibrant, full-color graphics with astonishing animation make the presentation of this game top-notch, and colorful cutscenes move the story along between levels. DONALD DUCK: Goin' Quackers is only compatible with Game Boy Color systems.

title: Disney's Doug: Doug's Big Game
country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Doug makes his way to the videogame world with DOUG'S BIG GAME on Game Boy Color. You play Doug Funnie and his alter ego Quailman as you try to find your missing sweetheart, Patti Mayonnaise. You can also take on the role of your loyal pooch Porkchop, who also has own superhero alter ego: Quaildog. Solve the mystery of Patti's disappearance by searching the town of Bluffington for clues and write in your journal so you can refer to them later. Discover who is behind Patti's disappearance and her whereabouts by exploring 20 different environments from the popular TV show you're bound to bump into more than a few of the show's popular characters along the way. And don't forget to keep an eye open for power-ups that will increase Quailman's strength and powers. DOUG'S BIG GAME features detailed color graphics that bring the feel of the popular show right to the palm of your hand.

title: Disney's Pooh and Tigger's Hunny Safari
description: A.A. Milne's beloved characters come to interactive life in this wonderful expedition through the Hundred Acre Wood. In order to ensure their party will be, Pooh and Tigger are going to need some honey (known in Milne's world as "hunny"). In fact, the duo will need to find dozens of pots full of the stuff, and that will mean searching the entire forest. Much to Pooh and Tigger's collective dismay, the area is populated by dozens of insects, angry animals, and environmental dangers. In addition to searching for the hunny, you'll have to help your pals find such popular characters as Rabbit, Piglet, and Owl, as well as unlocking dozens of hidden areas and special power-ups. Three mini-games Veggy Match, River Run, and Fence Off can also be uncovered, and you can save all of your progress and resume play with a password. The game spans 18 levels and five diverse environments including The Spring Glade, The Nighttime Forest, Autumn Heights, Creepy Caves, and Winter Wood.

title: Disney's Winnie the Pooh: Adventures in the 100 Acre Wood
alternate_titles: Atsumete Asobu Kuma no Pooh-san - Mori no Takaramono | Winnie the Pooh: Adventures in the 100 Acre Wood
description: Join Winnie the Pooh and his friends as they come to the Game Boy Color in WINNIE THE POOH: Adventures in the 100 Acre Wood. You must help Pooh get to a certain place on the game board within a specified number of dice rolls. Along the way, he will encounter his friends Tigger, Piglet, Rabbit, and Eeyore, who will play along with Pooh and open mini-games for the loveable bear to store in his cupboard. The mini-games will have the player helping Pooh look for honey, exercise, fish, get unstuck from Rabbit's hole, bounce with Tigger, and catch acorns. The more you play WINNIE THE POOH: Adventures in the 100 Acre Wood, the greater the chances of finding a new path or mini-game.

title: Diva Starz: Mall Mania
description: Diva Starz: Mall Mania is an Action game, developed by Digital Illusions and published by VU Games, which was released in 2001.

title: DiveBlob
description:
DiveBlob is a fast-paced platform-survival game for the original Game Boy and Game Boy Color that was funded through Kickstarter. Boasting a smooth 60fps, you will be able to get the most out of the 7 unique unlockable characters that change the way you play.

Gameplay Features:-
* 7 unlockable playable characters with their own unique abilities
* Different platforms with hazardous effects to keep you on your toes. Do Blobs have toes?
* Randomly generated levels so that no two runs are the same
* Seeded mode to play the non-random levels. This Can be used to challenge a friend and keep the same level difficulty.
* Silky smooth movement and physics that stand out on the retro console (We can't stress this enough)
* Automatically saves to keep track of your high scores, progress, and preferred settings.
* 8 Original music tracks by Ashleigh Bridges, a talented composer popularized by their work in Old School Runescape
* Second input mode to control the character with both thumbs rather than one.

title: Doc Cosmos: The Saga Begins
alternate_titles: Doc Cosmos - The Saga Begins (World) (Aftermarket) (Unl)
description:
Doc Cosmos is on the search for a powerful alien device that is rumoured to be able to allow the user to time travel. He arrives on the alien planet to begin his quest to obtain the device but soon gets stuck in the underground complex.

Use the device to switch between timelines to change Docs control scheme and alter the scenery in order to progress through the complex and find a way out. Search for keys to open the multitude of doors blocking Docs way. With your help Doc can get out with the device and begin his adventures in time!

title: Dog Guardian and the Fallen Star
description: It is said that, a creature from the Heavens has bestowed this small town with the greatest gift.... A Guardian.

title: Dog's Muck Island
description:
"Dog's Muck Island is a short Gameboy game inspired by Link's Awakening's fetch quest. Play in your browser or on a real Gameboy or Analogue Pocket.

Includes music by
Ember#1765 / DeerTears
krümel (crumb)#0723
Tomas Danko

This game was developed in GBStudio."

title: Dogz
alternate_titles: Dogz: Your Virtual Petz Palz
description: Are you looking to adopt a pet but lack the time or space to take care of a real one? Then you may find DOGZ to be of interest. Part of the small but popular virtual pet genre, DOGZ lets you adopt a dog from one of three breeds: Chihuahua, Scottie, or mutt. You can play with the pet first to decide if it's right for you. Once you've adopted the little gal or fella, it's up to you to take care of it: feed it, groom it, and play with it regularly if you want it to grow up to be a well-adjusted adult. If you mistreat your dog, though, your little pet will take off! Eventually, new breeds of dogs and new special toys will become available for you, depending on how well you do. You can even trade toys and breeds of dogs with your friends via the infrared link.

title: Dokapon?! Millennium Quest
alternate_titles: ドカポン?! ミレニアムクエスト
description: This is the Kingdom of Dokapon (Land), the country that gave birth to many small legends. One day, the 18th King of the Kingdom of Dokapon was troubled by an incident and put up a job advertisement all over the country. "We are looking for brave human resources! With a nap for three meals, Paradise will be waiting for you! For more information, please visit Dokopon Castle ~" An adventurer's egg came to the Kingdom of Dokapon with such a job advertisement. .. "It's not such a dangerous job because it's that king," he chose for his first job as an adventurer. However, it was a dangerous job with 151 monsters waiting for you, from the crazy guy to the mukatsuku guy! .. Combat is a "rock-paper-scissors" system, so it's important to outwit the enemy. Play hot battles with your friends and steal their equipment.

title: Doki Doki Densetsu: Mahoujin Guruguru
alternate_titles: ドキドキ伝説 魔法陣グルグル | Pounding Legend Magical Team Guru Guru
description: An original story with the original motif that can be enjoyed not only by original fans but also by non-fans. Nike and Kukri's great adventure RPG that went on an adventure over the mystery of the magic circle "Guru Guru". What do they find at the end of their trip ...? The magic circles obtained during the game will level up the more you use them. If you continue to use it, it will evolve into a new magic circle. It is up to the player to decide what kind of magic circle to evolve. You can collect all 96 types of magic circles. You can also play "Cable Communication" to draw magic circles in real time and defeat invisible enemies, and "Infrared Communication Battle" to perform card battles using the obtained magic circles.

title: DokiDoki Sasete!!
alternate_titles: Doki×Dokiさせて!
description: What if I jumped into a very popular idol group as a new member ...? The aim is a dome concert one year later. As one of the members, the player deepens friendships with five boys and fosters romance with the boys he cares about, while living a dreamlike idol life. Is the ending a live success? Love with members? A cute and slightly dangerous, crushing multi-ending adventure game. With "business card exchange" using communication and "fortune-telling" function supervised by Dr. Ludohild of "Petit Birthday". The character design is "Miho Koto", which is popular only for Johnny's official manga.

title: Don't let her in
description: A short body horror story about being alone

title: Donald Duck: Goin' Quackers
alternate_titles: Donald Duck: Quack Attack
description:
Keeping Donald content is about as easy as herding cats, but everyone's favorite fusspot really goes off the deep
end when malodorous magician Merlock duck-naps Daisy. To add insult to injury, Donald's uppity cousin, Gladstone
Gander, vows to rescue Daisy. Thus begins Donald's great race to reach Daisy first and foil Merlock's nefarious
plans.

The player has four lives that can increase by finding special items. Each life gives Donald two opportunities to be touched by the enemy, the first time is touched, he becomes angry and throws berserk to the enemies, the second time, he loses a life. Donald can also unlock new outfits, which alter cutscenes and idle animations (such as Donald taking photos of the place if he is dressed like a tourist).

title: Donkey Kong 2001
alternate_titles: Donkey Kong Country | ドンキーコング2001
description: The best-selling Super NES game of all time is back! Remember blasting through levels in barrels and taking wild mine cart rides? All the jammin' jungle hi-jinks are back, along with DK's animal friends Rambi the Rhino, Squawks the Parrot, Enguarde the Swordfish and more! In addition to all the original levels, you get the chest-pounding fun of new bonus levels and 2-player games.

title: Donkey Kong 5 :The Journey of Over Time and Space
alternate_titles: Super Marrio Sunshine
description:
The fairy Sodoma, responsible for all plantlife, has been captured!  with nothing to eat, Donkey Kong sets out on a quest to rescue Sodoma.

Donkey Kong 5, also known as Super Marrio Sunshine, is a Gameboy Color Bootleg version of the first 4 worlds of Super Mario Bros. 1.  There is also a version featuring Harry Potter, with a completely different story.

title: Donkey Kong Country
description: The best-selling Super NES game of all time is back! Remember blasting through levels in barrels and taking wild mine cart rides? All the jammin' jungle hi-jinks are back, along with DK's animal friends Rambi the Rhino, Squawks the Parrot, Enguarde the Swordfish and more! In addition to all the original levels, you get the chest-pounding fun of new bonus levels and 2-player games.

title: Donkey Kong GB: Dinky Kong & Dixie Kong
alternate_titles: Donkey Kong Land III | Donkey Kong Land 3 | ドンキーコングGB・ディンキーコング＆ディクシーコング
description:
Fame-and-fortune seekers have flooded Donkey Kong Country in search of the fabled Lost World. You command Dixie Kong and Kiddy Kong through 36 Kong-sized levels of action and adventure. Use your animal friends - Squitter the spider, Squawks the parrot, Ellie the elephant, Enguarde the swordfish and Parry the parallel bird - to help you prove your adventuring skills and find the Lost World before someone else does!

In this updated version of Donkey Kong Land III, enjoy the classic adventure now in full color exclusively released in Japan.

title: Doraemon Kart 2
alternate_titles: ドラえもん カート2
description: The previous work used secret tools to win the race, but this time we will race to collect secret tools. Moreover, secret tools cannot be collected just by winning the race. The total number of secret tools is 132. There are three modes: "Scenario mode" where you race to regain secret tools from the king of karts, "VS mode" where you can play 2P with a communication cable, and "Time attack" where you compete for 3 laps with 1P. There are courses with different designs in one world, and there are 5 worlds in that world. Flat ground course, underwater course, cloud course, ice course, etc. are available.

title: Doraemon Kimi to Pet no Monogatari
alternate_titles: ドラえもん きみとペットの物語 | Doraemon Kimi to Pet Story
description: An RPG where players can adventure with Doraemon. The theme this time is friendship between players and pets! Depart with Doraemon and others on a pet hunting trip that I loved. The main character can be selected from two boys and two girls, and you can enjoy different adventures by changing the character. You can enjoy battle with "friendship attack", "brave point", and "secret tool" techniques. Equipped with a "consultation system" when you don't know what to do next during the game. It is also possible to collect characters and secret tools with trading cards. Of course, you can also exchange with friends using a communication cable.

title: Doraemon Memories: Nobi Dai no Omoi Izaru Daibouken
alternate_titles: ドラえもんメモリーズ のび太の想い出大冒険 | Doraemon Memories: Nobita's Memories Adventure
description: A horizontal scrolling action game that clears a number of tricky tricks. A surface clear type that is easy for anyone to operate and clears a number of fun gimmicks. 4 stages (+2 hidden stages) Each stage has an action area, and the characters with a total area of ​​20.5 have characteristics such as jumping power, foot speed, and HP. Many familiar "secret tools" have appeared as items, and they are used to capture the action stage. If you receive a remote control for electrical appliances at home in the infrared port of the GBC main unit that supports infrared communication, memorial shots and hidden stages that are not normally available will appear.

title: Doraemon no Quiz Boy
alternate_titles: ドラえもんのクイズボーイ | Doraemon's Quiz Boy
description: Select the type of quiz such as "up-down quiz", "time try", and "panel attack", and compete for benefits depending on the correctness of the problem. In "Communication Battle Mode", you can select your favorite character from familiar characters such as Doraemon, Nobita, Gian, and Shizuka-chan, and in "Challenge Mode", you can play against two friends. The quiz questions are based on learning questions from the first to sixth grades of elementary school, and about 4,500 questions are prepared, including sports and trivia.

title: Doraemon no Quiz Boy 2
alternate_titles: ドラえもんクイズボーイ 2 | Doraemon's Quiz Boy 2
description: "Doraemon learning software" that allows you to study while playing. Contains more than 5,000 learning quizzes that correspond to the new course of study from 2002. The range of questions is the same as the timetable for music, physical education, life sciences and elementary school students, including Kokusaisha. Furthermore, in the "genre" genre, questions about computers, English, and welfare are also given. There are four game modes: "Up Down Quiz", "Bingo Quiz", "Panel Attack Quiz", and "Time Trial". There are three difficulty levels: low, middle and upper grades. It is also possible to take advantage of the quiz by using secret tools.

title: Doraemon no Study Boy: Gakushuu Kanji Game
alternate_titles: ドラえもんのスタディーボーイ 「学習漢字ゲーム」 | Doraemon's Study Boy "Learning Kanji Game"
description: The third learning support material for Doraemon. Learning software that covers all 1006 learning kanji learned in the 6th year of elementary school. Since it is set so that students can study by designating a grade, it can be effectively used for reviewing not only the grade but also those before that. Includes a "question mode" with random questions that you won't get tired of, and a "game mode" that allows you to check what you have learned in a fun way. You can play against your friends in "Game Mode". You can search by reading, number of strokes, radicals, etc., and it also has a dictionary function that shows the stroke order, on-yomi, and kun-yomi. Let's enjoy mastering kanji in the game!

title: Doraemon no Study Boy: Kanji Yomikaki Master
alternate_titles: ドラえもんのスタディボーイ かんじよみかきマスター | Doraemon's Study Boy Kanji Yomikaki Master
description: Kanji problem software that corresponds to the new course of study notified by the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology from 2002. You can set several levels from basic to advanced according to the level of kanji. Equipped with a dictionary function, it contains kanji learned in the first and second grades of elementary school.

title: Doraemon no Study Boy: Kuku Game
alternate_titles: ドラえもんのスタディーボーイ 「九九ゲーム」 | Doraemon's Study Boy "Multiplication Table Game"
description: The second learning support material for Doraemon. A fun and fun learning software to help you learn and use multiplication tables perfectly. Includes a "problem mode" for mastering multiplication tables, a "practice mode" for learning while listening to multiplication tables, a "game mode" for checking multiplication tables in a fun way, and a "game mode" for checking multiplication tables in a fun way. You can play against your friends in "Game Mode". You can also enjoy measuring the progress of multiplication tables using the "clock". If you get lost in the middle of a problem, you can press the select button to see the hint box. Let's have fun mastering multiplication tables in the game!

title: Doraemon: Aruke Aruke Labyrinth
alternate_titles: ドラえもん あるけあるけラビリンス
description: "Navigation (navigation action game)" that guides five familiar friends to the goal while making a good path. When the game starts, the character once starts walking. The lamp demon is made of smoke, so it is full of enemy characters, clouds, and smoke that block the way. The player uses the gimmicks well to defeat the enemy and guide the character. You must finish the character within the time limit while getting items such as Dorayaki so as not to touch the thunder and enemy characters. There are 60 stages including the back mountain of the school. In addition, a post stage, a hidden stage, and a battle play original stage are available.

title: Dork's Dilemma
description: You are Dork and you have crashed your spaceship and knocked yourself out on an unknown planet. Waking up, you realize that the planets occupants, Zobwats have stripped your spaceship clean and hidden the parts in an underground kingdom. Each piece is placed in the middle of various single screens with exits on the walls and you must kill a certain amount of Zobwats to get each piece.

title: Dorotea
description:
Dorotea is a researcher specializing in the history of her hometown of Conversano, near Bari.

An important event is just a few days away. Her job involves cataloging and archiving books and artifacts dating back to the 1600s, stored in a room that hasn't been opened for decades.

But the past never stops watching her...

title: Dr. Franky and the Monster
description:
Alone in the dark haunted dungeons of his castle, Dr Franky is desperately trying to turn his monstrous creation into a human being. His task seems simple, he has to collect the flasks of life-giving chemicals which he has placed in his dungeons, away from prying eyes. However he has forgotten the power of the super-natural! 

The people he used to make his monster have returned as ghouls to haunt and kill him...

There are 9 different dungeons to be completed, each screen different from the last. To complete each dungeon, you must collect three white conical flasks and take them to Dr. Franky's monster, who stands lifeless in the top right-hand corner of the screen.

title: Dr. Garfield DX
alternate_titles: Dr Garfield DX (v2.0)
description: Three kinds of ugly, nasty viruses are on the loose. But these germs are fun to catch. Garfield throws multi-colored vitamin capsules into the bottle. You can move, shift or spin the capsules as they fall. Arrange them to align with other capsules on top of the virus. If you can get 4 or more of the same color in a row, POOF! The viruses disappear! Destroy all the viruses in the bottle and you progress to the next round, where things get even more difficult.

title: Dr. Mario DX
alternate_titles: Dr Mario DX | Doctor Mario DX | Dr. Mario DX (v2.1)
description:
This hack transforms Dr. Mario Game Boy game into a Game Boy Color game.

Enjoy the Game Boy classic now in full color with a very cool new feature: character selection!

That’s it! Dr. Luigi, Dr. Daisy and Dr. Wario join the virus battle! Choose your favorite doctor to play as, each one with their own sprite, palettes.

It also has a couple of slight QoL tweaks to the original game code.

title: Dr. Rin ni Kiitemite!
alternate_titles: Dr.リンにきいてみて!～恋のリン風水～ | Ask Dr. Rin! ~ Koi no Rin Feng Shui ~
description: Fortune-telling and feng shui can be done easily anytime, anywhere! Feng Shui of Meirin, Shikigami fortune-telling of Joban, Tarot fortune-telling of Mari, Western fortune-telling of Eddie, familiar familiarity of Tianjin, etc. In adventure mode, I always admired watching "Ciao" and anime, Dr. Entering the world of Rin and making friends with Meirin and Asuka, Dr. Listen to Rin's advice and make love come true ... A thrilling story awaits what will happen! Since it supports infrared communication and communication cable, you can immediately fortune-telling with your friends.

title: Dracula
description:
This is an interactive horror story, based on the novel of Bram Stoker. It has some action, puzzles, exploration, comedy, etc. Available in Spanish and English versions. 

It depicts soft nudity art in a gameboy color fashion.

title: Dracula: Crazy Vampire
description: Dracula: Crazy Vampire is an Action game, developed by Planet Interactive and published by DreamCatcher Interactive, which was released in 2001.

title: Dracula: Dark Reign
alternate_titles: Dracula Dark Reign | Dracula - Dark Reign
description:
Dracula: Dark Reign is a Castlevania-style video game that will take players on an immersive journey into the dark and captivating world of Bram Stoker's iconic vampire tale. Dracula: Dark Reign promises to offer a unique blend of storytelling, exploration, and action to relive Jonathan Harker's daring escape from Castle Dracula!

Set against the backdrop of the tumultuous First World War era, the game delves deep into the lore of Bram Stoker's original novel, seamlessly pushing the storyline forward while maintaining the essence of the source material.

title: Dragon Ball Z III: 2002 Fighting
alternate_titles: Dragon Ball Z 3 2002 Fighting (Unl) [Fixed] | Dragon Ball Z III - 2002 Fighting (Unl) [Fixed]

title: Dragon Ball Z: Densetsu no Chô Senshi Tachi
alternate_titles: ドラゴンボールZ 伝説の超戦士たち | Dragon Ball Z: Legendary Super Warriors
description:
Dragon Ball Z: Legendary Super Warriors (ドラゴンボールZ 伝説の超戦士たち, Doragon Bōru Zetto Densetsu no Chô Senshi Tachi) is a turn-based fighting game released for the Game Boy Color. It is played with the use of in-game cards for attacks, techniques and support items. The game's story takes place from the start of Dragon Ball Z, the Saiyan Saga, and runs until the end of the Buu Saga. The game includes two extra stories involving Future Trunks's timeline.

Once the game has been completed, the player is free to replay the story mode or battle modes the game has with the freedom to use any characters and forms they choose in any of the given battles. During the player's second playthrough, they may be able to unlock additional characters if certain criteria are met.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Legendary Super Warriors
description: Dragon Ball Z: Legendary Super Warriors is a mixture of a card game and a turn-based fighting game for the Game Boy Color. The game is played with original in-game cards for attacks, techniques and support items and initially has only two modes trade and story. Legendary Super Warriors’ story spans from the Saiyan saga to the end of the Buu Saga. Once beaten, a battle mode is unlocked, allowing players to square off with random enemies. Once the game is beaten, any character is usable in any battle, such as Frieza vs. Cell.

title: Dragon Ball Z3
alternate_titles: Qi Long Zhu Z 3 | 七龍珠Z3 | Dragon Ball - Advance Adventure
description: Dragon Ball Z3 is an unlicensed GBC port of Dragon Ball: Advanced Adventure for the GBA from Sintax Technology Co., Ltd. It was later reskinned as Sintax's "Bynasty Warriors 5".

title: Dragon Dance
alternate_titles: Pocket Color Block
description: Addictive breakout-style action meets fast and furious arcade fun. With 100 levels, challenging end bosses and multiple power-ups, Dragon Dance is the game you can't put down! Head-to-head combat with boss enemies every 10th level. Random events like earthquakes shake up the gameplay. Dragon control and length add to the complexity of each puzzle. Enjoy Vs. mode and play with friends via Game Link Cable.

title: Dragon Diving
description:
Explore the insides of a dragon!

In a far off magical forest full of talking creatures (even the bugs!) the forest is watched over by a forest-dragon. Made of similar vegetation to the forest they inhabit, this dragon is particularly well suited to being its guardian by blending in with the forest itself. Normally there is nothing they can't handle.

On this day however, the forest's protector has a problem - they have a tummy ache! Seeing as you are a bug that specializes in taking care of plants, they have reached out to you to ask for help in treating their digestive woes. Despite this being completely outside your field of expertise you go to help them.

title: Dragon Quest I & II
alternate_titles: Dragon Warrior I & II
description:
Dragon Quest (ドラゴンクエスト, Doragon Kuesuto?, titulado Dragon Warrior en América del Norte) es el videojuego original y el primero de la saga Dragon Quest. Fue desarrollado por Enix y lanzado en 1986 en Japón para MSX y Famicom (NES).
Fue uno de los primeros videojuegos de batalla por turnos en obtener un gran éxito y es considerado un pionero en el desarrollo del género. Precediendo a Final Fantasy y junto con esta otra saga RPG, Dragon Quest pasaría a ser una franquicia exitosa que se convertiría en un estándar para los videojuegos de rol.

title: Dragon Quest VIII
alternate_titles: Yong Zhe Dou E Long VIII
description:
Dragon Quest VIII (勇者鬥惡龍VIII) is a Action/Bootleg video game published by Sintax released on December 27th, 2024 for the GB Color. *the original release date is actually unknown.

It was released in a GBA shaped cartridge, but it actually runs a GBC ROM! It's also labeled as Action-RPG but it's so simple and closer to a Castlevania game.

title: Dragon Tales: Dragon Adventures
description: It's off to Dragon Land with your favorite Dragon Tales friends. Wish on Dragon Scale and get whisked away to Dragon Land. Then choose your adventure from five different fun-filled stories. While searching for Dragon Berry cupcakes, gems, and musical Notes you will travel to magical places like Puzzlewood in the Crystal Caves! So grab your Dragon Scale and let's Go!

title: Dragon Tales: Dragon Wings
description: The popular animated television series is now a magical hand-held game! You take on the role of a dragon that has yet to learn the secrets of flight in this exciting adventure. You'll attend Quetzal's School in the Sky, where you'll practice your wing flapping, hovering, treasure carrying, and breathing. Once your confidence is high and your skills honed, you'll enter the enchanted Dragon Land, where all sorts of mischief awaits you. Journey through 15 levels of difficult obstacles and dangerous terrain, meeting up with a few friendly faces straight out of the television show along your path. There are three difficulty levels to choose from, so gamers at all skill levels can get in on the action. The game is only intended for one player, but you can always complete a game and then challenge a friend to match your progress. Learning to fly has never been so fun or safe.

title: Dragon Warrior I & II
description:
Dragon Warrior I & II is a 2000 Game Boy Color video game developed by Tose and released by Enix America in the USA on September 19, 2000.

Step back into the wondrous land of Alefgard and defeat the evil DracoLord in the standard-setting Dragon Warrior I. Continue your amazing adventure and banish the foul Hargon in Dragon Warrior II. With tons of monsters to fight, treasures to find and mysteries to explore, you may never want to turn off your Game Boy Color again!

title: Dragon Warrior III
description:
Dragon Warrior III is a 2001 Game Boy Color video game developed by Tose and released by Enix America in the USA on July 17, 2001.

Your father, the brave Ortega, is dead. He set off to destroy the Demon Lord Baramos but fell in glorious battle. Unless stopped, Baramos will unleash a torrent of evil that will destroy the world. You must stop Baramos and discover the legend of Dragon Warrior! Your journey starts on Aliahan. Only you decide where it ends...

title: Dragon Warrior Monsters
alternate_titles: Dragon Quest Monsters: Terry no Wonderland | Dragon Quest Monsters: Terry's Wonderland
description:
In Dragon Warrior Monsters, enter Terry’s Wonderland, a magical place of kings, monsters and magic spells.  Make monsters your allies to fight through the dangers that lie ahead in the long quest.  Find your kidnapped sister and become the most powerful monster master in the world!

Each monster has unique special skills to use in battle.  Train and treat them well, and you’ll be victorious!  Over 40,000 different combinations - can you breed the rarest and most powerful monsters?

* Over 200 cute & cool monsters to collect, tame, and train.
* Breed your trained monsters to make more powerful monsters, each receiving special skills from their parent monsters.
* Play solo, or use the Game Link cable to link to Game Boy game systems and battle and breed with your friends’ monsters.
* A spin off of Japan’s best selling RPG game, Enix’s Dragon Quest.

title: Dragon Warrior Monsters 2: Cobi's Journey
description: When Cobi and Tara's family of monster farmers moves out to the island of GreatLog, it quickly becomes apparent that all is not well in their new homeland. The island's prince, Kameha, and his ill-willed accomplice, Warubou, quickly confront the brother-and-sister team. Now, the dastardly pair has embarked on a plot to sink the entire island, and you'll have to train an army of Dragon Warrior Monsters to help stop the evil crime. This installment casts you as the brother, Cobi challenging you to find hidden keys and prepare all of your monsters for battle. There are more than 300 battling beasts in all, which means that you'll have your work cut out for you if you hope to effectively utilize your troops. As you wander through the land, you'll encounter different monsters, which you can persuade to join your team by offering up treats. You can also trade beings with other players who own the game or have a copy of DRAGON WARRIOR MONSTERS 2: Tara's Adventure (the parallel release, which follows the story of Cobi's sister).

title: Dragon Warrior Monsters 2: Tara's Adventure
alternate_titles: Dragon Quest Monsters 2: Iru no Bouken
description: The wildly successful DRAGON WARRIOR MONSTERS returns to handheld form with parallel releases DRAGON WARRIOR MONSTERS 2: Tara's Adventure and DRAGON WARRIOR MONSTERS 2: Cobi's Journey. This installment focuses on the efforts of the sister, Tara, as she tries to end an evil plot to stop her new homeland from sinking. Prince Kameha and his ill-willed accomplice, Warubou, are responsible for the mischief, and you've got to help Tara collect and train more than 300 fighting monsters in order to reverse the deadly plan. Make your way through the countryside, collecting valuable keys and recruiting monsters to help battle evil. Each beast you encounter will need to be persuaded to help you out, which you can do by offering up various forms of foods and treats. With better graphics than most of its competition, the game even lets you trade monsters with other players who own either installment of the addicting DRAGON MONSTER WARRIORS 2 collection.

title: Dragon's Lair
alternate_titles: Dan Bluth Presents Dragon's Lair
description: Dirk the Daring is back! Control the fate of Dirk the Daring in the long-awaited return of Dragon's Lair, now for Game Boy Color. The fair princess, Daphne has been seized by the evil dragon, Singe and only Dirk the Daring can rescue her from his clutches. On your quest, you must fight your way through the castle of the dark wizard who has enchanted it with treacherous monsters, traps and other obstacles. Lead on brave adventurer!

title: Dragon's egg
description: A short turn-based RPG following a kobold mother called "Viriik" who's trying to find her stolen eggs.

title: Dragonfire
description: The king's treasures have been stolen! As the daring young prince, your goal is to recover them all. The treasures are being kept in various castles, each one guarded by a fire breathing dragon. Each level in the game has two parts; first you will need to cross the castle's drawbridge. You will have to jump and duck the dragons fireballs as well as avoid flying arrows to reach the other side! In the second part you need to collect all of the treasures on the screen and make it to the exit while avoiding the dragon who runs across the bottom of the screen. The dragons on each level have different patterns of movement and firing, and as the levels progress will become faster and trickier.

title: DRAGONSLAYER
description:
After years of peace, the king has been killed by a dragon, reigniting an ancient war. Once again, the realm calls for vengeance - for a DRAGONSLAYER!

DRAGONSLAYER is a 1-bit roguelite rpg, built in GB STUDIO for GB COMPO 2025. Embark on a challenging journey to avenge your king and slay a dragon, loot powerful artifacts, and discover secrets. Can you survive long enough to save the realm, or will you fall to one of the many foes you'll face along the way?

title: Dragonyhm
description:
Experience an epic tale set in a vivid fantasy world.

For a number of years after the age-old conflict with dragons came to a head, the people of Archend have enjoyed an era of peace.

All was well until the esteemed Yhmszindr, Kurtis, went missing, and the sealed dragons began to awaken.

​Explore, solve, and battle your way through this heroic adventure, meeting memorable characters while uncovering the rich history of the land of Archend.

Step into this world as Kris, son of the Yhmszindr, embarking on a quest to find him. Along the way, put a stop to the plot that threatens the kingdom!

title: Drake's Adventure
description: 8 years ago the followers of Dracula awakened him from his long rest .. Now 8 years after this tragic event a new hero was born! Take on the role of "Drake" and save the world from Count Dracula

title: Dream Diary
alternate_titles: Dream Diary 1 - The Six-sided Room
description:
"We were in a field at night. there were white flowers everywhere and no stars in the sky. In the distance, we could see a little room."

A door with no handle...a starless sky...a face in the ground. your mother is there but she won't turn to look at you. have you ever seen these kinds of things in your dreams?

title: Dream Shark - Part 1
description: When an escapist child’s VR mask breaks, he begins to have intense nightmares, and must learn presence from his dream characters, to face the shadowy beast he runs from. Play as Tac and explore a surreal universe full of diverse gameplay and rich story!

title: Driftwake
description: Driftwake has been drifting for a century you wake up from your cryopod after all this time. Figure out the mystery of the old ship and why you were asleep for so long.

title: Driver: You Are The Wheelman
description:
In Driver, the driving (pun intended) force of the world is crime. The main character, an ex-race car driver, takes on the role of an undercover cop. It seems your superior officer has decided to put your talents to the test. He orders you to infiltrate the local mob group, and to help bring it down from the inside. As a result, the game takes place from the perspective of a low-level gang member. The action speeds into a number of different cities, ranging from San Francisco to Miami. It is on the streets that the main part of the game will take place. 

Basically, Driver is broken into a number of mini-missions. In total, over 30 different challenges await the persistent gamer. The missions are divided between the various locales of the game. The different assignments will each require a special tactic. As an example, consider the mission in which the objective is to destroy an enemy getaway vehicle. In such a situation, the primary goal is to keep an eye on the target and ram it into submission. If the orders are to pick up a gang member within a time limit, speed and secrecy become of utmost importance. If the cops see the exchange, the badges will be on you like glue. Each situation will require a measure of thought and intelligence. 

Driver also offers a couple of extra side games. The survival mode sets the player against a horde of maniacal police officers. The crazed cops will do anything to smash you into submission. The result is a race through the city with a bunch of cops on your tail. It is a test of endurance. In the getaway mode, the idea is to flee for safety from the encroaching stiffs. The game places you in an area of the city, with a cop on your tail. Your only goal is to avoid the authorities. Be careful, though, as the cops may set up a roadblock to impede your progress.

Driver is designed with the Game Boy Color in mind. It offers a password save system to keep your data under wraps.

title: DropBlox!
description: High-speed arcade action!

title: Dropzone
description: Dropzone is an Action game, developed by Awesome Developments and published by Acclaim, which was released in Europe in 1999.

title: DT: Lords of Genomes
description: Time is the near future. A nanomachine (ultra-small robot) called "DT" was developed in secret, and governments and giant companies were conducting intelligence activities over the technology. Players will fight as DT masters who make full use of cards that express DT, units, and skill data. There are about 200 types of cards, and the battle is a full-fledged battle with 40 decks and full strategy. Understanding the story on every card and using it effectively is the key to becoming a true master. The more you read the card novel written on the card, the deeper your knowledge and mystery of DT. "When you get all the cards, you embody the final evolution of life on Earth ..."

title: Duck Hunt
alternate_titles: Duck Hunt (Homebrew)
description:
A fully adapted port of the NES classic, now on Game Boy Color.

New features include:

    New zones: Discover brand-new areas inspired by other Zapper-based games like Wild Gunman.

    Boss battles: Each zone features an original boss, created exclusively for this version. 

In addition, Duck Hunt GB is fully compatible with the original Game Boy and all of its hardware revisions.

title: Duel Fight Transformers Beast Wars: Beast Warriors' Strongest Decisive Battle
alternate_titles: Ketō Transformers Beast Wars: Beast Senshi Saikyō Ketteisen
description:
Duel Fight Transformers Beast Wars: Beast Warriors' Strongest Decisive Battle is a fighting game for the Game Boy Color system.

It features combatants from Beast Wars, Beast Wars II and Beast Wars Neo.

title: Duke Nukem
description:
Is Game Boy Color man enough to handle Duke? You'd better believe it.

The master of one-liners and undisputed king of carnage has conquered Nintendo 64, and now he's preparing to get down and dirty on Game Boy Color. The most recent Duke Nukem titles have been played using a first-person perspective, but GT Interactive broke that pattern with Zero Hour for the N64, and this platform adventure for Game Boy Color. Duke's ego must be growing out of control now that millions of gamers will actually be able to admire his pumped-up pecs while playing.

Duke Nukem delivers 16 levels of alien annihilation, with a different visual theme for each area. Duke is equipped with all new moves for his small screen debut, including a perfect backflip which leads us to believe that he may have been dating a gymnast in the off-season.

Duke Nukem is compatible only with Game Boy Color.

title: Dungeon Crystal
description: Travel the seas, corrupted by evil crystals. Transform into different spirits and animals to solve puzzles. Find hidden treasures and become stronger to defeat the wild monsters. Save the islands by destroying the beautiful but destructive crystals. And take a break while catching some fish on your own sailing ship.

title: Dungeon Savior
description: Competitive dungeon RPG maker. Invade each other's dungeon created by you or your friends, and defeat the opponent's boss waiting in the enemy dungeon before your friends capturing your own dungeon to win! There are four dungeon types: "dungeon", "tower", "castle", and "jungle". There are more than 200 types of monsters that protect and attack dungeons. There are more than 200 types of items that can be obtained by searching dungeons and defeating monsters. By connecting the communication cable, you can play against your friends and trade monsters and items.

title: DX Jinsei Game
alternate_titles: DX人生ゲーム | DX Game of life
description: That life game has become GBC and is getting more and more powerful. There are three game modes: "Waiwai mode" where you can enjoy normal life games, "Love love mode" where you can enjoy your marriage, and "Yamatani mode" where you can enjoy a turbulent life. More than 1000 events such as university entrance exams, exams, and romance create a variety of life. A total of 16 people, including familiar characters such as Angel and Akuma, as well as Captain and Fuchu Alien, will appear. My character can be created as a montage, and more than 50 million patterns are prepared. Every time you clear the main game, Life Game Island will develop steadily. You can also enjoy 10 types of mini games.

title: DX Monopoly GB
alternate_titles: DXモノポリーGB
description: As a portable Monopoly game, it has a save function, so you can enjoy it anytime. Full-scale without any unnecessary rule changes. You can enjoy various modes such as "Tournament Mode" where you win 4 tournaments against CP characters and "Free Play" where you can play freely. There are 15 characters. Each character makes a big difference in playing.

title: E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial and the Cosmic Garden
description: He might be wrinkled and a little bit slimy on the outside, but his heart is pure gold. Perhaps the most famous cinematic space alien ever to capture kids' imaginations, E.T. stars in this delightful adventure for the Game Boy Color. The title character's green thumb comes out to make its presence known in this installation of the story (remember, E.T. is an excellent gardener). Help the little guy travel to the farthest reaches of space collecting specimens of various plants for the Cosmic Garden that lives on his spaceship. Once you've collected all of the plants, the object of the game is to make sure they can stay alive in the Garden. New friends, Space Bee and Space Slug a couple of adorable additions to the saga will assist you. With addicting gameplay, excellent graphics, and classic characters, this is one game that's certainly worth phoning home about.

title: E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial: Digital Companion
description: If you have any doubt as to E.T.'s ability to help you get organized, witness the stunning efficiency with which he expressed his desperate need to make a phone call. There's no need for a separate digital organizer anymore, as you can now keep track of your life on a Game Boy Color. Everyone's favorite little alien being provides a calendar, an address book, a working clock, and even a "to-do" list that will keep young science fiction fans motivated and productive. There are even five mini-games included, several of which involves helping the titular mascot evade the authorities and collect the necessary items to construct an inter-global telephone system. One of the games challenges you to raise a "Flopgopple" pet, and all of the options are compatible with the Nintendo Game Boy Printer. Kids can even protect all of their personal data with the use of an original password. Now, that's organization.

title: E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial: Escape from Planet Earth
description: As long-time fans of the classic film know, it's not easy being a visitor on another planet. This handheld game for the GBC closely mirrors the plot of Steven Spielberg's 1982 classic science fiction masterpiece, putting you in the shoes of E.T. or his human friend, Elliot. Of course, the game's main objective is to collect the parts necessary to construct an interplanetary communicator that E.T. can use to "phone home." All the while, Earth-based authorities will try to apprehend you, so make sure you bring your wits and reflexes to the table. There are 45 quests in all, each of which presents new traps and obstacles to avoid, and the game even has three separate difficulty levels to master. With six main game areas and 10 detailed environments, E.T. THE EXTRA TERRESTRIAL: Escape from Planet Earth has unusually high replay value, wonderful graphics, and more gameplay than you can shake a stick at.

title: Earthworm Jim: Menace 2 the Galaxy
country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Earthworm Jim is back, and he's brought a ton of mayhem and destruction with him! EARTHWORM JIM: Menace 2 the Galaxy is the second Game Boy Color adventure for everyone's favorite worm-turned-superhero. Playing as Jim in this one-player action game, you must blast your way through 12 bizarre stages packed with enemies and other hazards. To aid you in your endeavor, you'll be able to pick up and use four different weapons to toast your foes. The typical wry humor present in the EARTHWORM JIM series is here as well, resulting in some crazy situations for you to jump, shoot, and fly your way through. Although EARTHWORM JIM: Menace 2 the Galaxy is compatible with all Game Boy systems, it includes a special exclusive level when played on Game Boy Color.

title: Eat This! Burger Frenzy
description: Eat This!: Burger Frenzy is a memory and level based fast food order fulfillment game for Game Boy Color. Make those orders as quickly as possible!

title: ECW Hardcore Revolution
description:
When the wrestling-license musical chairs ended last year, Acclaim must have felt like it was on the hurtin' end of a Stone Cold suplex, what with EA snagging the WCW license from THQ and an enraged THQ, its spirit meter jacked up to stratospheric levels, responding by wresting the prized WWF license from Acclaim's grasp.

All's fair in love and corporate lumberjack matches, though, so Acclaim pulled itself off the canvas and went out in search of a new franchise. The answer lay as close as the nearest TV, where Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW) holds court weekly on The Nashville Network. Sealing the deal for a long time to come, Acclaim has invested some of its many WWF and Turok bucks in the ECW.

title: Eebee's Adventure
description:
Eebee’s Adventure is an open world adventure game for the original Game Boy and Game Boy Color systems.

Play the game however you like! Go and visit your friends, help villages in need, or stop a mad creator and her evil plans. Who knows, you might even find yourself in a completely different world!  Use Eebee’s healing power to survive monsters, meet powerful elemental forces and cross dangerous environments in Eebee’s Adventure!

title: Elevator Action
country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description:
Elevator Action EX is an update to the Game Boy version of Elevator Action published by Altron in 2000. In addition to colour, players can choose between three characters: Mike, an all rounded character, Guy, a slower yet more durable character, and Sarah, a faster yet weaker character.

The game contains four stages with four buildings each. At the end of 4th building in each stage, player fights against a series of enemies appearing from the doors inside a narrow tunnel, except for stage 4, where player fights against boss in a multi-level suite. After completing the game, a password is given, which allows player to use the boss character (D.D.Fox) in the game. When playing as D.D.Fox, the final boss is Mike.

This game was redesigned and published by BAM! Entertainment as Dexter's Laboratory: Robot Rampage, which uses Dexter's Laboratory characters.

title: Elevator Action EX
description: Elevator Action EX is an update to the Game Boy version of Elevator Action published by Altron in 2000. In addition to colour, players can choose between three characters: Mike, an all rounded character, Guy, a slower yet more durable character, and Sarah, a faster yet weaker character.

title: Elie no Atelier GB
alternate_titles: エリーのアトリエGB ～ザールブルグの錬金術士～ | Erie's Atelier GB ~ Alchemist of Saarburg ~ | Atelier Elie
description: After graduating from the academy and A gaiden story that is a little different from the main story (PS version). Elfir (commonly known as Erie) and Marlone (commonly known as Marie) are alchemists in Saarburg. For some reason, such Erie and others decided to take care of the fairies in the atelier. The purpose given to Erie and others is to "grow a half-serving fairy into a full-fledged fairy in four years." There are many things that fairies have to learn, such as collecting ingredients, dodging monsters, and blending items! The character of a fairy changes in various ways depending on how it responded to the fairy and what kind of behavior the fairy did. Can Erie and his friends raise a good fairy alchemist? Events and characters are different from the Marie version.opening up a alchemy shop, Elfir Traum is requested by the fairy tribe's elder to take care of an apprentice fairy.

title: Encedalus
description:
Welcome to Enceladus,

an icy moon of saturn. Take control of an alien species and escape from a research station. How you go about it is entirely up to you and your malice...

title: Enceladus
alternate_titles: Enceladus (V3 jam)
description:
Welcome to Enceladus, an icy moon of Saturn. Take control of an alien species and escape from a research station. How you go about it is entirely up to you and your malice...

This game is made for the GBCompo2023 and can be played on actual GameBoy Color hardware.

title: Entomophobia
description:
The year is 2049.
Earth's population has gotten out of control. Within ten years there will be more people than crops available to sustain them. The world is in crisis. RenGen Corp has set up project Harvest, an outer space experimental facility designed to facilitate a way to grow crops larger and faster.  The mission was a success but during their experiments they also found a way to accelerate the growth of insects.

title: ESPN International Track & Field
alternate_titles: International Track & Field: Summer Games (EU) | Ganbare Nippon! Olympic 2000
description: ESPN INTERNATIONAL TRACK & FIELD brings all the excitement of a real athletic contest to Game Boy Color. Try to win the gold medal in 12 different events including fencing, skeet shooting, the 100-meter dash, the long jump, the javelin toss, 100-meter freestyle swimming, 110-meter hurdles, the high jump, weightlifting, the pole vault, the gymnastics vault, and table tennis. Each event requires a mix of speed, stamina, and timing to succeed it’s all about the button mashing! Can you win all the events and become the ultimate champion? Full-colored, detailed graphics bring the knuckle-busting action to life. Use the Game Boy Link Cable to hook up with a friend and challenge him or her to a two-player contest to see who can win the most medals. This game includes battery backup to save all your high scores and world records.

title: ESPN National Hockey Night
description: Exciting NHL action comes to the Game Boy Color with ESPN NATIONAL HOCKEY NIGHT. Since the game is fully licensed by the NHL, all of the teams (including the expansion Columbus Blue Jackets and Minnesota Wild) and players are here. When you want a quick puck fix, play a single game in the Exhibition mode. True hockey fanatics will want to take all of the challenges of a full Season, but if you're not interested in hockey until it's Cup time, you can skip the season and go straight to the Playoffs. If you think you are as good as anyone in the NHL, you can even put yourself into the game with the Create-a-Player mode. Now you can literally get into the game with ESPN NATIONAL HOCKEY NIGHT.

title: European Super League
description:
Sporting 16 fully licensed team and stadium endorsements, European Super League brings together the talent from many teams in Europe to create a 'European Super League Championship'.

Features:
- Entries from clubs such as AC Milan, Bayern Munich, Marseille, Liverpool, Chelsea and Paris Saint Germain
- Stadiums are modelled to real-life specifications
- Control interface when played in novice mode is limited to simple button combinations, allowing for a newcomer to play the game more easily; for the advanced gamer, the alternate mode, although more complex and demanding, will give them improved control over the game
- Authentic crowd chants

title: Evel Knievel
description: Follow in the tire tracks of America's most beloved stuntman, Evel Knievel! Experience Evel's live-on-the-edge lifestyle as you pull off death-defying feats ordinary men only dream of! With all the stunts, all the excitement, and none of the broken bones, you control the actions of the most daring man in history!

title: Expiration Date
alternate_titles: Expiration Date 1.5 | Expiration Date 1.0
description:
Better to spill a little milk than expire completely!

Have fun helping save all the food that's about to expire in the fridge in this new indie platformer for the Gameboy Color!

Music by: Isaih Martinez

Everything Else by: Howdy Riceball

title: Extreme Ghostbusters
description: In an attempt to takeover the world, the newly liberated and powerful ectoplasmic forces, led by the half-human, half-demo Count Mercharior, have kidnapped two key members of the Extreme Ghostbusters team. Without wasting a second, Eduardo and Kylie jump into the famous Ecto-1 ambulance and race off to the rescue... Play as Eduardo and Kylie as you uncover the clues to the kidnapping, confront the evil Count Mercharior and return your teammates, Roland and Garrett, to safety!

title: Extreme Sports with the Berenstain Bears
description: Get extreme with Mama, Papa, Brother, and Sister Bear in their first Game Boy Color game, EXTREME SPORTS WITH THE BERENSTAIN BEARS! In this single-player game you'll control the members of the family as they participate in an assortment of extreme sports events. Use Brother or Sister Bear in kayaking, dirt boarding, biking, and luge, or take the whole family in the river rafting and toboggan sequences. All of the events take place from an overhead perspective, which provides the best view of the playing field. In each event you can perform a wild range of tricks and stunts to gain speed and shave seconds off the clock. Can you beat the high scores and become the best bear you can be? Well-animated characters set on colorful, detailed backgrounds ensure a bright presentation.

title: F-1 World Grand Prix
description: F-1 World Grand Prix straps you into the driver's seat as you experience the high-octane rush of an actual Formula One season. Compete in the FIA Formula One World Championship with your choice of 22 drivers. You'll race through 17 of the most challenging Formula One circuits. Five game modes including: Grand Prix, Exhibition, Time Trial, Challenge and Two-Player. Realistic racing effects include real-time tire wear, skid marks and exhaust flames.

title: F-18 Thunder Strike
description: Supersonic jet dogfighting comes to the small screen in F-18 THUNDERSTRIKE for the Game Boy Color. In this one-player flight sim, you take the role of a daring pilot who's flying an elite fighter jet. Slide into an inside-the-cockpit view, battle against multiple enemies, and practice your aerial combat and evasion maneuvers to prove your air superiority. You can play in either Arcade or Simulation mode, each affording you a unique experience. Arcade mode offers looser controls that make things easier for rookie pilots, while experts will want to jump right into Simulation mode, which will challenge the ability of even the most experienced flyboy. Head into multiple missions of dogfighting action and perform aerial tricks that will break the sound barrier, but don't think that it's all fun and games. When the mission's complete, you'll have to carefully land your jet on an aircraft carrier.

title: F1 Championship Season 2000
description: F1 CHAMPIONSHIP Season 2000, featuring all the drama, action, and emotion of the 2000 season, takes the player right to the heart of the thrilling world of Formula One racing. Re-live the gladiatorial battles between Michael Schumacher and David Coulthard or tear up the record books and take an outsider to World Championship glory. In-depth behind the scenes technical support from the Orange Arrows and Benetton Formula One teams allows the game player to enter the world of Formula One racing in unprecedented detail and authenticity.

title: F1 Racing Championship
description: Strap yourself in for high-octane excitement in F1 RACING CHAMPIONSHIP for Game Boy Color.
