The goal of this game is to provide a realistic Formula 1 racing experience in every aspect: the game has the full F1 license, which gives you a choice of 11 real racing teams such as McLaren and Ferrari. Choose the vehicle that suits your racing style, then take to one of 16 real licensed tracks, each accurately modeled to reflect its real-life counterpart. You can play in multiple gameplay modes, including a quick Single Race or the more grueling Formula 1 Championship. Watch the action from several camera angles, including a behind the vehicle view and first-person perspective. The full color graphics contain large, detailed vehicles and smoothly animated tracks that help to put your right in the middle of the action. As an added bonus, try to prove your championship skills by taking on a friend with the link cable Two-Player mode. F1 RACING CHAMPIONSHIP is only compatible with Game Boy Color systems.

title: F1 World Grand Prix II
description: F1 World Grand Prix II for Game Boy Color is a Racing game, developed by ITL and published by Video System, which was released in 2000.

title: Faceball 2000 DX
description:
This is a color/enhancement hack of the technological marvel that is Faceball 2000.

FEATURES:
- HIGHER FRAMERATES - This hack takes advantage of the GBC’s extra hardware to increase the speed of gameplay.
- FULL COLOR - Multiple palettes have been utilized to add some color variety to the game.
- FIXED AUDIO - Sound channel 3 now actually gets a waveform loaded, making the music sound as intended.

title: Fairy Kitty no Kaiun Jiten
alternate_titles: フェアリーキティの開運辞典 | Fairy Kitty Good Luck Dictionary
description:
Kitty's upbringing and fortune-telling game is finally here! As the level goes up, you will be able to do various fortune-telling! Fortune-telling your own fortune and your friends' fortune!
Print out the results and carry around , You can give it to your friends! Grow it into a nice fairy kitty!

title: Fairy-chan: Donut Chaser
description: Fairy-chan feels like a chocolate doughnut. How convenient that the doughnut shop has just prepared quite fresh chocolate doughnuts. When asked how much the treat costs, the saleswoman replies that the doughnuts are on the house.  However, only on the condition that you manage to capture the doughnut (which just flew out the door)!

title: Fall from Space
description:
Jet off to the stars! Multiple worlds to explore inside your Gameboy, with side quests, unique encounters, secrets and upgrades
Combines Metroidvanian platforming action with an open world RPG
An original story to uncover with multiple endings, a karma system and choices that impact the world and it's inhabitants around you
Authentic Gameboy aesthetic, with graphics and art style built within the DMG palette constraints
Hours of gameplay, save at any time with multiple save slots, unlockables and Gameboy Printer support!

title: Fallout Rancher
description: Welcome to your new farm in the Mohave, where you grow crops and raise animals.

title: Far After
description:
Two friends awaken to see they have finally gained their magical birthright. Help these pals explore the mystical forest while fighting off monsters and earning spells. 

A hybrid platformer ARPG that allows for a unique handheld adventure! Level up, upgrade gear, find secrets, and more in this bite sized adventure.

title: Fast Eddie
description: On your mark, get ready, here comes Fast Eddie. Eddie is on a wild treasure hunt climbing up and down ladders everywhere in search of prizes. Things would sure be a lot easier for Eddie if it weren't for all those pesky little Sneakers running around. They literally keep him jumping! Look Eddie, there's a magic floating heart on the second floor and another on the third. Go get'em, Fast Eddie! Look out for that Sneaker? Ooooh my!

title: Fast Food
description:
Burgers, fries, shakes, pizzas ... Flying by at subgastronomical speeds.You and Mighty Mouth have to catch 'em if you can. The higher calories you consume the faster the food flies.

But beware the purple pickles! Catch too many and your binge is over.

title: Featherless Cake Delivery
description: Follow Loke in his job as a Cake Delivery cat and take care of a lost bird in this mini open-action platformer where no enemies are killed and no death traps are deadly.

title: Feed Eggs
description: The hottest game of the year is now playable on Gameboy!!  Feed Eggs is a fan game based on the game of the same name in "I Think You Should Leave."

title: Feed IT Souls
alternate_titles: Feed IT Souls (World) (v1.4) (Aftermarket) (Unl) | Feed IT Souls v1.4
description: You are the offspring of IT, a bio-technological monstrosity after only one thing - delicious souls! Seek out and retrieve souls to feed your master. His power is your power, and every soul retrieved will enhance your mobility as you explore your surroundings.

title: Feed The Monster
description:
In Feed The Monster we control a little alien monster called Quoru.

After passing through the earth, Quoru's saucer is shot down. Upon receiving the strong impact, an energy sphere detaches from the ship and ends up in the hands of a terrible monster.

In order to recover his energy sphere and be able to return home, Quoru will have to feed the Monster.

title: Ferret Monogatari: Watashi no Okiniiri
alternate_titles: フェレット物語：ワタシのオキニイリ | Ferret Story: My Dear Ferret
description: Ferret Monogatari is a simulation style game in which you take care of a ferret. At the start you choose one of three different colored ferrets. The colors are randomly chosen. The ferret is kept in the cage much of the time. You have to keep its water and food topped up, and clean its litter box. You can take your ferret out for walks or to play with. You can even play minigames. One is a race, one is putting together a picture and the other is dancing

title: FIFA 2000
description: Brace yourself for a soccer game that brings all of the wild fun of soccer home on your Game Boy Color! FIFA 2000 is a fully-licensed soccer game that has more than 60 teams from around the world with updated rosters appropriate to the 2000 season. You can choose to play one of five different gameplay modes. Exhibition mode is a quick game where you set the teams and the rules then hit the field. In Tournament mode, you'll square off against an assortment of other teams to see who can take home the final victory. Playoff mode has you playing the final teeth-to-the-grindstone matches where every victory counts. In League mode, you'll play through a full season that culminates in the playoffs to see who is the greatest. Finally, Indoor mode takes the game inside and changes up the rules a little bit, resulting in a fast-paced version of the original. Options available for every mode include weather settings, foul settings, wind, and more. You can also use the password to save all of your stats in League and Tournament modes.

title: Fighter on the Path of Glory
alternate_titles: Fighter on the Path of Glory (World) (En,Ja) (v1.00) (GB Compatible) (Aftermarket) (Unl)
description:
A homebrew pixel art platformer action game for the GBC.

A young man of the Oni tribe with reddish skin and horns sets out on an adventure. He is a stoic martial artist. He studies under his elder brother at a dojo in the mountains,where he hones his skills as he competes with his rivals.

There are two types of stages: boss battle stages and road stages. When you conquer 3 stages in the same level, you can advance to the next level. Use big attack against hard enemies and bosses. You can deal a lot of damage at a time.It is important not only to attack, but also to watch the enemy's attack and avoid it.

There are coins to collect in road stages. There are three coins per stage. Search all over stages to collect them!

title: Fillo - Crystal Version
description: Fillo is an emperor penguin who spends most of his time in Antarctica. Now he had a little trouble because his territory was occupied by the invaders. Help Fillo designate an area where he can spend his time with his love. In a mission through 15 levels, you must collect all the ice diamonds and trick the enemy penguins that take back the area you have already occupied. Time is also your enemy, you have a total of 20 seconds on each level to finish it. Good luck!

title: Final Fantasy Adventure DX
alternate_titles: Final Fantasy Adventure DX (korxo) (v1.0)
description:
Despite having thousands of remakes in different systems, Final Fantasy Adventure was still missing a Game Boy Color version, so here it is!

Changes in this version are:

Full colorization
New world map (the old one was basically an empty space with 4 or 5 house icons)
Some of the bugs in the original game are fixed here: after casting Heal your defense power is not reduced anymore; a moogle item can now be used to heal a moogle status.
Inspired by the great hack made by xenophile, the sprites of the main characters are displayed in the char name selection menus.

title: Final Fantasy Legend DX
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Final Fantasy Legend I DX
alternate_titles: Final Fantasy Legend I DX (v1.01) (Adam)
description:
Fully colorized, several bugs in the original game fixed.

A full colorization of the first Sa-Ga game, localized as Final Fantasy Legend.

title: Final Fantasy Legend II DX
alternate_titles: Final Fantasy Legend II DX (v1.0.0) (Adam)
description:
The Game Boy classic now in full color!

A full colorization hack of the second Sa-Ga game, localized in the west as Final Fantasy Legend II.

title: Final Fantasy Legend III DX
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Final Fantasy X - Fantasy War
alternate_titles: 太空戰士X
description: Final Fantasy X: Fantasy War is an unlicensed game for the Game Boy Color, loosely based on the Final Fantasy] series of RPGs. It was published in Taiwan by SKOB and in mainland China by Guangzhou Li Cheng Industry & Trade Co, although its developer and release year are unknown.

title: Finders Keepers
description: Magic Knight has been sent to the Castle of Spriteland by the King of Ibsisima in order to find a special present for Princess Germintrude. If Magic Knight is successful in his quest, he may have proved himself worthy of joining the famous "Polygon Table", a reference to the mythical Round Table from the legends of King Arthur.

title: Fire Ant
description: You are the last remaining soldier of an army of ants which has been destroyed by scorpions. Your sole objective is to rescue the Queen Ant who has been taken hostage. Negotiate the scorpion chambers collecting items which will help you on your journey. You need a combination of quick reactions, careful planning, and observation if you are going to survive long enough to achieve your goal.

title: Fireman
description: A fire broke out in New York City! It is your job to stop the spread of fire and protect the city from destruction. Good luck!

title: Fireman Fred
description:
Fireman Fred is the hero of the Fire Service. Every day Fred leaves home for work at the Fire Station. When the fire bells ring, fearless Fred then swings into action with his ladders in an attempt to save lives from the perils. Fireman Fred gets many different calls for help, rescuing people and animals in danger at home and work.

Fred must be very alert as there are many dangers around him - fires, balls of smoke, poisonous spiders, exploding light bulbs and bouncing balls, to name just a few.

Your job is to guide Fireman Fred up the ladders and along the floors. To make his job harder, some floors have been burnt or broken away so Fred has to jump the gaps, and any other hazards that might get in his way. You must help Fred to rescue the people and the animals, get them down the ladders safely before sending them to hospital in the waiting ambulance. When you have succeeded on one screen you will go to the next until you have cleared all 20 screens.

title: First Contact Protocol
description: A deep-space collision. A spreading contamination. A crew with conflicting goals. As you explore the ship and try to repair it, every choice you make matters. Some decisions combine in unexpected ways, leading to different outcomes.

title: Fishin' Hole
description:
Fishin' Hole is a Game ported from the Stephen King book End of Watch. 

Just sit back and catch as many fish as you can. The more you can get in your net at a time, the more points they'll be worth! Catch the elusive UFO for even more points!

This game includes 5 game modes. You can play normally, on a harder mode, a practice mode,  you can play basketball with a fish, or even as a fish

title: Five Nights at Freddy's GAMEBOY
description: Can you survive five nights at Freddy FazBear's Pizzeria with only 8 bits to spare? Five Nights at Freddy's GAMEBOY is a 1 to 1 recreation of the original FNaF,  retooling every aspect of the game for the classic Nintendo portable.

title: Fix & Foxi: Episode 1 - Lupo
description: In Fix & Foxi - Episode 1 Lupo you must help the plucky and cool Lupo on his incredible adventure to make it through the enchanted lands and out the other side alive and in one piece! You only have a certain amount of lives to make it through each level so tread wisely and jump on all the enemies to eliminate them and collect the precious coins they leave behind!

title: fix my heart
description:
Fix My Heart is a precision platformer with minimalistic graphics and a strong emphasis on speedrunning, ranked 16th out of 134 entries in the Game Boy Competition 2021.

Run through a perilous cave as you try to fix your mechanical heart. The game offers challenging levels that will push your platforming abilities to the limit, leaving no room for errors. Are you up for the challenge?

With seven unique endings to unlock, you must decide your fate and confront the cave's deadly obstacles. For those seeking an even harder experience, the Remix mode introduces five new gameplay mechanics that will put your skills to the test.

title: Fix-It Felix Jr
description: After having his stump moved by a construction company, Wreck-It Ralph seeks revenge by damaging the apartment building built on his land. The citizens of Niceland call on Fix-It Felix Jr. and his magic hammer to repair the damage Ralph is dishing out and force him off the building, the player climbing from ground level to the roof in each new level. Levels are made up of multiple screens where shattered windows must be repaired by swinging Felix's hammer, the player moving up to the next layer after all damage on the current screen has been repaired.

title: Flipper & Lopaka
description: Flipper & Lopaka is an Action game, developed by Planet Interactive and published by Ubisoft, which was released in Europe in 2001.

title: Flooder
description:
A colorful puzzle game for your favorite handheld console.
Can you flood the whole field with a single color within 25 steps?

title: Floracy
description: "Floracy" is a roleplaying game with elements of strategy and action games, in which the player breeds plantlike creatures for exciting animated combats. This demo was made public by the developer - no publisher was found for the game even after several attempts.

title: Foal's Creek
description: People are going missing in Foal‘s Creek, a small settlement deep in the late 1880’s American West. Foal’s Creek may seem like a happy, sleepy town, but there is an evil that lurks below the surface.

title: Force 21
description: PC fans craving real-time strategy action on Game Boy Color may have found their title with FORCE 21. In the year 2015, World War III has broken out. Technology has progressed to the point that air-based nuclear attacks are ineffective, so warfare will be conducted the old-fashioned way: through large-scaled attacks of armored units and infantry. In this one-player strategy or action game, you'll choose to either control the American or the Chinese military forces, each side comprised of the same eight different unit types. From the speed and power of a tactical helicopter attack to the all-out brawn of a platoon of tanks, you'll have all the warfare options you'll need to carry out your plan of attack. In order to complete the game, you'll have to battle your way through 16 different missions that take place all over the world, in such locations as barren snowfields, yawning deserts, and crowded cityscapes.

title: Formula One 2000
description: Formula One 2000 is a Racing game, developed by Tarantula Studios and published by Take-Two Interactive, which was released in 2000.

title: Fort Boyard
description: You will need courage, cunning and teamwork to beat the traps and pitfalls the Fort has in store and carry of its legendary treasure.

title: Fortune & Glory
alternate_titles: Fortune and Glory
description:
Dare you enter the ancient Gatopolis is search of buried treasure?

This is a story that is told in mouse homes around the world: once, our people lived in prosperity and freedom. Life was easy, as we were sustained by our greatest treasure.

Then, the armies of the cat folk appeared. They burned out homes to the ground and destroyed our farms. Those who did not flee became slaves, building the mighty Gatopolis, the City of Cats.

Legend has it that our treasure is still hidden somewhere in the Gatopolis, if only someone were brave enough to seek it out...

title: Fox Star Catch
description: Oh no the stars are falling! And only one can save the world! All you need to do is catch the stars. Simple enough?

title: Frantic Freddie
description: Freddie is a telephone line engineer who has to climb up and down the telegraph poles, picking up pots of gold and avoiding the dreaded Greeblies. The Greeblies take on a different form with every new screen, but one thing's for sure - they may look cute, but they show no mercy! Frantic Freddie also features wacky messages, funny interludes and silly bonuses. Frantic Freddie - a game with a sense of humor!

title: Frasier Fantasy
alternate_titles: Frasier Fantasy: The Director's Cut
description:
Experience the thrilling adventure of living an evening as Dr. Frasier Crane!
FIGHT for your antique silverware! 
SNEAK through the live-in help's bedroom!
ATTEMPT to throw the ultimate dinner party!

Frasier Fantasy is a loving tribute to the show, "Frasier," in turn-based RPG form. Filled with Easter Eggs and callbacks, this is the game for anyone wondering if Eddie ever blinked first.

title: Freeway
description:
This game is not as "simple" as it looks! Random traffic patterns inspired by the most treacherous traffic you'll ever encounter on the nation's highway. Traffic flows varies from a few slow-moving autos to frantic rush hour intensity, complete with blaring horns and roaring engines - everything except exhaust.

Test your agility, cunning and courage by helping your "daredevil chicken" across the freeway. You get a point for each crossing, but you'll need quick reflexes and great timing to make it across without getting hit and losing life.

title: Friday at Ours
description:
Loud music is blaring from your neighbors flat. Allthewhile you're dead-tired, a little introverted and most importantly: not invited. So what are you to do?

Once you've finally convinced yourself to stop by, you'll find that partying like a pro is not quite as easy as you would have imagined.

title: Frightliner Express
description:
One night, Cameron was heading home on the subway when a mysterious event occurred. Can you figure out what happened to Cameron and escape this nightmare alive?

Frightliner Express is a horror game created in GB Studio 2.0.5.

title: Frogger
description: It's tough to be a frog! Life isn't all lazy days and lily pads--it abounds with dangers. Can you help Frogger survive some perils and spring him home to safety? First hop your frogs across a busy highway. Then cross a raging river to reach the safety of home. But your frogs will have to leap away from one danger after another before they're safe. Watch out for the tricky diving turtles...jump away from the frog-eating snakes...hop from the jaws of the hungry alligators!

title: Frogger 2: Swampy's Revenge
description: It's fast and furious action from start to finish for Frogger and his new friend, Lillie Frog. Help them save the Frog Babies from Swampy the crocodile.

title: Froggy Kong
description:
A horrible frog monster is terrorizing the city, leaping from rooftops and dropping water balloons! Luckily, the police have set up a huge laser barrier, and they're going to blow the monster up with a big bomb! There's just one problem. You are the monster.

Jump between falling platforms using directional buttons and the A button and drop water balloons with the B button. Keep the bomb wet to stop it exploding! Your score increases every time you hit it. Don't touch the laser!

title: From Below Pocket
alternate_titles: From Below Pocket (World) (Aftermarket) (Unl)
description: As the Kraken climbs the walls of your fortress, repel it by hurtling blocks down at the monster. As lines are cleared, the Kraken will retreat, but only momentarily. Can you survive the night, and live to fight another day?  Compatible with all Game Boy models, and enhanced for the Super Game Boy! Featuring Two-Player simultaneous play!

title: From TV Animation - One Piece: Maboroshi no Grand Line Boukenki!
alternate_titles: From TV animation ONE PIECE 幻のグランドライン冒険記 | From TV animation ONE PIECE Phantom Grand Line Adventure
description: The second Game Boy version of "ONE PIECE" RPG! Solve the incidents that occur on the landed islands, find the "log pose" that will be the door to your next adventure, go to all the islands, and complete the nautical chart. The first order is the original route, and the second order is the original story of the game. The game system has been greatly enhanced from the previous work. "Shocking action system" where the character accidentally takes action, "Dream combo" which is a dynamic combined attack that is launched when certain conditions are met, "Adrenaline battle" where you can release powerful special moves according to the character's anger, etc. Is newly added. Communication is possible not only in online battles and character exchanges, but also in the previous work "Dream Luffy Pirates Birth!"

title: From TV animation ONE PIECE: Yume no Luffy Kaizokudan Tanjou
alternate_titles: From TV animation ONE PIECE 夢のルフィ海賊団誕生! | From TV animation ONE PIECE: The dream Luffy Pirates are born!
description: Weekly Shonen Jump, a popular anime game on TV. Select the route you want to go from the blank map, play new adventures and events, and gather crew members to join. When you clear the event, that part will be added to the map. The player moves the blank map with the crew, clears various events, defeats the enemies on the field, and aims to complete the map. By selecting the episode, you can enjoy the story as it was originally written or your own original story. Of course, you can play online battles with your friends and exchange characters. Open up the world yourself!

title: Front Row
description: You can easily enjoy detailed and realistic machine settings (engine, tires, body) like a real F1. Machine (team) can be selected from 8 types. Equipped with a full-scale world tour mode that aims to become a world champion by racing on all 16 courses around the world, including Japan, England, and Australia. In addition, a single race mode where you can choose your favorite course and enjoy the race, and a time attack mode aiming for the fastest lap are also installed. Of course, the communication function allows two people to fight hotly.

title: Fun Video Store
description: Late 80s. Your first day at one of the country’s biggest video rental chains should have been just another teenage job. But the customers are mean, a mysterious tape has appeared, and a careless wish under the stars may have doomed your best friend. What was supposed to be a joyful week behind the counter turned into the worst time of your life.

title: Funny Rat Game 2
description: Have you ever wanted to be a smelly rat?? WELL NOW YOU CAN!! IN FUNNY RAT GAME 2!! YOU WILL DIE A LOT IN THIS GAME SO IF YOU RAGE DON'T PLAY... defeat the cat. get the cheese. and get the huzz

title: Fushigi no Dungeon: Furai no Shiren GB2: Sabaku no Majou
alternate_titles: 不思議のダンジョン 風来のシレンGB 2～砂漠の魔城～ | Mysterious Dungeon Furai no Shiren GB 2 ~ Desert Magic Castle ~
description: In the blowing sandstorm, there was a figure rushing ahead while being taken by the heavy sand. One is a young man. "Shiren" is a wind-visitor wearing a cape on the way to Mitsukasa. The other is a small, one weasel, and the now rare narrative weasel "Koppa". However, the intense sandstorm obstructed my view and course, and I was finally exhausted ... The next time Siren woke up, she was trapped in a prison, with her hands tied to a sturdy chain. Even Koppa, who usually makes a lot of noise, doesn't try to open a word because he is exhausted. A girl visited there ... Shiren, who has grown into a dignified young man, develops a spectacular swashbuckler with his nostalgic friends! The stage of the adventure is a castle town full of exoticism, a vast "desert" where the mystery is, and a "magic castle" that rises in the desert. In the dungeon, "Wana" is as troublesome as a monster. If you inadvertently step on it, you may end up in an adventure crisis, so be careful! Also equipped with "Otasuke System" that allows you to resume playing from where you were defeated. It corresponds to the communication cable, and if you send the data that you have been defeated to your friend, your friend's character will come to help you. The first limited edition comes with a "Siren Rare Card", and you can get an item by entering "Magic" on the back of the card in the game!

title: G-Man
description: As a new graduate of the Space Geology College, G MAN is sent on a mission to recover samples from the heart of the Sea of Dreams. Being new to a low gravity environment, he spent a lot of his time experimenting with flying and consequently missed the Moonbus back to the Shuttle, which had set down 900 meters away earlier in the day. Has G MAN realized his predicament too late? He has only 7 minutes to reach the Shuttle before it takes off! But all is not lost - he does have his trusty short-range Jet-pac, and if he uses fuel efficiently as well as picking up more along the way, he could  get there in time... it's all down to your ability now kid...

title: G-ZERO World GP
alternate_titles: G-ZERO_World_GP_v1.0.0 | G-ZERO World GP (v1.0.0 )
description:
To win the G-Zero World Grand Prix you must finish five races in first place. You have to complete three laps in each race, with the boost being unlocked after the first lap. While boosting your machine is accelerated to maximum speed.

Your machine has limited power, which decreases when you touch the track's rail or other drivers. It is also consumed while boosting. If the power is used up, you can't continue and the race is lost.

You can heat up your machines engine by holding the A Button down before the race begins. If your timing is good your machine will perform a boost start. If you overload your engine you must wait a little before you can accelerate again.

title: Gaia Master: Duel Card Attacks
alternate_titles: ガイアマスターDUEL カードアタッカーズ
description: The world is no longer human, and there is only a phantom land floating in the sky that covers the moon and the sun. Once every 100 years, the board game "Gaia Master" of the gods, which has been repeated for a long time, hits the world in chaos. The battle for the power of the gods' root "Gaia" was fierce, with people as the pieces in the board game of the world, and the battlefield was only getting worse. In the midst of such a melee, Demon Lord Dante has revived. When I thought I was able to seal Demon Lord Dante again, a dimensional crack occurred in the battle with Demon Lord Dante, and the world of "Gaia Master" who had sealed even the gods was revived. A new battle has begun in search of unseen cards scattered in the resurrected world! The battle for the true power of "Gaia" has begun in search of unseen cards! "Gaia Master", which was well received in PS, has been added to the card battle with the element of deck editing, and has been greatly enhanced and appeared in GBC. There are more than 100 types of cards that appear. There are also many rare cards that only appear on certain stages. You can strengthen your deck with GET weapon cards. If you level up your weapon card, you can learn skills. You can also make original cards by equipping the skills you have learned! Since it is compatible with communication cables, you can exchange cards as well as play against friends. The story mode is generous and responsive enough!

title: Gakkyu Ou Yamazaki
alternate_titles: Class King Yamazaki | 学級王ヤマザキ
description: My game is out! !! Full of powerful gag. Aim, the strongest class king! That messy and powerful gag has finally arrived at the Game Boy! Let's evolve 3 unique Pooh assistants while challenging 5 action games! If you use a communication cable, you can fight with your friend Pooh! Let's fight against the familiar 6th grade 3rd group characters such as Takuya, Erica, Watanabe Army, and now for the true class king!

title: Gakuen Battle Fishers: Yoky Shiimono wa Tsure
alternate_titles: バトルフィッシャーズ ～欲しいものは釣れ～ | Battle Fishers: Catch what you want
description: A school full of mysteries specializing in fishing The name is Chojin School. A game in which players enjoy various events and stories while fighting "fishing battles" with rivals at this school. Fun and unique characters such as boys' manga and anime will appear. The "fishing grounds" in the "fishing games" so far are the sea, lakes, rivers ... However, in "Battle Fishers", various parts of the "school" become "fishing stages". Each lure to be collected has a completely different gameplay and fun operation. The fish school gauge display clearly shows the location of the fish, and you can enjoy it without feeling the stress of "fishing in a place where you cannot fish".

title: Galacard Platinum
description:
Welcome to the Platinum edition of the Planetary Galacard Tournament! In this competition, you’ll be able to play against Galacard aficionados from every corner of Planet Ack, and, above all, have fun! In case it’s your first time here or you’ve forgotten how to play, let us remind you what the rules are.

Each round in Galacard puts you against five other players. All six players start with a hand of six cards each. Every card contains a shape and a number, and your goal is to get the highest number that matches the shape of the first card in each turn. To advance to the next round, you must finish it with the exact same number of wins as the goal that you set at the start. There is also a card in the middle known as the Power Card [PC], which has an advantage over the other shapes and adds a whole new layer of strategy to the game.

New to this edition of Galacard is the shop. At the end of each round you’ll be allowed to purchase helpful items in exchange for wins. The Ackians you compete against in each round are also given names and wear different kinds of hats.

title: Galaga: Destination Earth
description: All the other space pilots have been eliminated. Somehow you survived. The Galaga enemies are on the move. Now, you must fight or doom Earth to extinction. There's no time to plan strategies. Just find your targets and come out blasting. Battle wave upon wave of alien attack craft in this dazzling edition of the arcade classic. Use special weapons, retrieve captured craft to multiply your firepower and of course, rack up big points in the Challenge Stages. This is Galaga - Strap yourself in and come out firing!

title: Gambler Densetsu Tetsuya - Shinjuku Tenun Hen
alternate_titles: 勝負師伝説 哲也 新宿天運編 | The Legend of the Gambler Tetsuya Shinjuku Tenun Hen
description: This is the story of a legendary game master who was called "Jongsei" in the mahjong world. A four-player mahjong game of the mahjong manga "Tetsuya-The Legend of the Gambler" serialized in Weekly Shonen Magazine. You can enjoy the characters and episodes of the TV anime version, as well as various Ikasama-themed games anytime, anywhere. "Scenario game mode" where you play against experts according to the story, "Free game mode" where you can freely set characters and rules, and "Communication game mode" where you can play a combination game with 2 players vs. 2 computers. , Equipped with game modes such as "Dunch's Mahjong Course Mode" that is easy and fun to remember.

title: Game & Watch Gallery 2
country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description:
Game & Watch Gallery 2 features six games based upon the Game & Watch brand of handheld games. Each game contains a 'Classic' mode, resembling the gameplay and presentation of the original Game & Watch title, and a 'Modern' mode, which contains revised graphics and additional features. For every 200 points players accrue in each game, they earn 'stars' which can be used to unlock additional features, entries in an in-game gallery displaying animations of other Game & Watch titles, and a sixth game, Ball; up to five stars can be earned in each mode and difficulty of each game, for a total of 120 stars.

Ball: The player juggles two to three balls in the air, requiring the player to catch and toss them up again, with one point earned for each successful catch. In the 'Modern' version, Bob-Ombs will also sometimes appear, which the player must avoid catching; multiple playable characters can also be unlocked.
Chef: The player moves left and right to catch food in their frying pan to toss up into the air. In the 'Modern' version, the player can rotate and turn on the spot to feed Yoshi.
Donkey Kong: The player moves left and right and jumps to avoid barrels, making their way up platforms and ladders towards Donkey Kong. In the 'Modern' version, platforms disappear and levels change for greater variation.
Helmet: The player moves left and right to avoid tools falling from the sky, making their way between two doors, with a point awarded for every journey. In the 'Modern' version, a button on the floor occasionally appears, awarding coins for bonus points if stomped upon.
Parachute: The player controls a boat, and must collect parachutists before they fall into shark-infested waters, in which case a life is lost. In the 'Modern' version, parachutists sometimes land in a cannon to be shot back into the sky.
Vermin: The player moves left and right to hit moles with a hammer as they appear out of ground. In the 'Modern' version, the player controls Yoshi, who can also move up and down, and must guard eggs from vermin that come from all sides.

title: Game & Watch Gallery 3
description:
Game & Watch Gallery 3 is a 1999 Game Boy Color video game developed by Nintendo R&D1 and Tose and released by Nintendo of America in the USA on December 6, 1999.

Flash back to the '80s with original and updated versions of five Game & Watch hand-held games!

Relive the birth of hand-held gaming in Classic Game & Watch games. Then join your favourite Nintendo characters in Modern versions featuring improved play control, graphics, colour and sound!

Egg - Catch your eggs before they hatch!
Turtle Bridge - Carry the packages across the turtles' backs!
Green House - Protect your plants from the pesky pests!
Mario Bros. - Help Mario & Luigi keep the factory flowing!
Donkey Kong, JR. - Grab the key and free DK!

-Save & Quit feature lets you stop and restart your game anytime!
-Battery-backed memory saves all your scores!
-Collect stars to access new features and open hidden classic games!

title: Game Boy Camera Gallery: Mystery Show
description:
You need to keep a razor sharp focus because it's your first assignment as a journalist covering an exhibition for the local art magazine. The only thing is-- you weren't prepared for it to take place in a haunted mansion owned by an strange raccoon! Hold on tight, because things might get a bit scary in this campy point-and-click game for the Game Boy. 

The virtual gallery features photos all taken on the Game Boy Camera by over two dozen photographers. It is a love letter to the Game Boy Camera, the community surrounding it, and the spirit of "funtography" that it continues to spark!

title: Game Boy Gallery 3
alternate_titles: Game and Watch Gallery 3 | Game & Watch Gallery 3
description:
Game and Watch Gallery 3 (Known as Game Boy Gallery 4 in Australia and Game Boy Gallery 3 in Japan) is a  1999  flash back to the '80s with original and updated versions of five Game & Watch hand-held games! Relive the birth of hand-held gaming in Classic Game & Watch games. Then join your favorite Nintendo characters in Modern versions featuring improved play control, graphics, color and sound! The Classic and Modern versions of Egg, Greenhouse, Turtle Bridge,
Mario Bros., and Donkey Kong Jr. are unlocked by default. Flagman, Judge, Lion,
Spitball Sparky, Donkey Kong II, and Fire must be unlocked by earning stars.
The hidden games only have Classic versions.

title: Game Boy Gallery 4
description: Flash back to the '80s with original and updated versions of five Game & Watch hand-held games! Relive the birth of hand-held gaming in Classic Game & Watch games. Then join your favourite Nintendo characters in Modern versions featuring improved play control, graphics, colour and sound!

title: Game Boy Wars 2
alternate_titles: ゲームボーイウォーズ 2 | GameBoy Wars 2
description: The first Hudson "Game Boy Color" compatible. The masterpiece of strategy simulation has evolved further. A total of 100 offensive and defensive maps, and the computer's thinking engine speed has increased by 30% from the previous work.

title: Game Boy Wars 3
alternate_titles: ゲームボーイウォーズ 3
description: An orthodox strategy simulation in which a magnificent strategy runs through the battlefield. The player becomes the commander of the Red Star Army or the White Moon Army and gives instructions to his army to occupy the capital of the enemy army or to annihilate the enemy's troops. The game mode is "Beginner mode" where you can learn how to play and units while playing 16 types of maps, "Campaign mode" where you can fight through all 45 types of maps according to the scenario, and you want to play from all 60 types of maps. There are three "standard modes" where you can freely select the map. It also supports "Mobile System GB", and you can "download maps" and "call mercenary units".

title: Game Konbini 21
alternate_titles: Game コンビニ 21
description: 21 kinds of games collected from various genres that can be started easily at any time and can be interrupted at any time are recorded in one. 1 All games can be enjoyed with simple operations, so it is perfect for taking a break for a short time! Anytime, anywhere, anyone! It's a game convenience store!

title: Gamer Boy Mission
description: Your Game Boy batteries have died! Your mission? To go buy some new AA batteries!

title: Games Designer Samples
description:
In 1985, the Darling brothers released a unique game creation utility for the Commodore 16 and Plus/4: Games Designer. At a time when programming knowledge was often a barrier, this tool filled a vital gap by giving young enthusiasts the chance to build their own games with little to no coding experience. It was a groundbreaking effort in bringing game development to a wider audience, especially kids who dreamed of creating their own digital worlds.

The original release included three example games, designed to showcase what could be achieved with the software: Space Desert, Creature Crawl, and Road Stunner. This collection brings those titles together once more, both as a tribute to early creativity and as a snapshot of an era when imagination was just beginning to merge with interactivity on home computers.

title: Ganbare Goemon: Hoshizorashi Dynamites Arawaru!!
alternate_titles: がんばれゴエモン〜星空士ダイナマイッツあらわる!!〜 | Good luck Goemon: Starry Skyman Dynamite Appears !! | Ganbare Goemon: Seikuushi Dynamites Arawaru!!
description: An exciting action game. Various "devices" and "boss characters" have appeared. In addition, the 3D boss battle by the giant Karakuri Robo "Impact" is also reproduced. Also equipped with a "warumono pictorial book" that allows you to file defeated enemy characters, and a fun mini-game that allows you to take on challenges using a communication cable.

title: Ganbare Goemon: Mononoke Douchuu Tobidase Nabebugyou!
alternate_titles: がんばれゴエモン〜もののけ道中 飛び出せ鍋奉行!〜 | Good luck Goemon: Go out on the way to Mononoke!
description: "Goemon Goemon" is now available as a collectible role-playing game. The feature of this time is the collection of "Mononoke". There are 146 types of unique "Mononoke" of various attributes and aristocrats. What is unique is not only the appearance but also the skill that each person has to liven up the battle scene. "Mononoke" can be made friends by using the "Fuin" command during battle, and becomes stronger by gaining battle experience with Goemon. Furthermore, it is possible to inherit special skills by fusing "Mononoke" with each other. Raised mononoke can be played against or exchanged via communication.

title: Ganbare Goemon: Tengutou no Gyakushuu
alternate_titles: がんばれゴエモン〜天狗党の逆襲〜 | Good luck Goemon: Tengu Party Strikes Back
description: The main character is Hajime, an active and adventurous fourth grader. Now, there is a Goemon boom among children, and Hajime is of course an enthusiastic Goemon fan. One day, when I went to my grandma's house in the countryside, I heard a legend about a big tree towering in the forest of the company, and out of curiosity, I went through a big hole in the trunk of the big tree. Suddenly, a dubious bandit attacks Hajime and asks Ebisu Maru to help him with a close call. Hajime was back in time in the Edo period! He heads to Oedo to meet his longing Goemon, but Goemon goes to the mountain of deception to recover the treasure stolen by a bandit called the Tengu Party. In this way, Hajime and his friends were involved in this incident ... The player is a modern elementary school student who is the main character. The hero solves the incident that happened in Oedo while traveling back and forth between Hyundai and Oedo. In Oedo, we meet friends such as Goemon and Ebisu Maru and cooperate with each other. Each character has a unique special move, and there is also a combined attack by multiple people. The theme is adventure and friendship. In a heartwarming story, the friendship between the main character and the Goemons is depicted.

title: Gang Sign
description:
Your name is Angel, and your goal is to please people.

GANG SIGN is a simple game made in GBStudio by Chris Maltby, that details a story of a woman that uses her charm and influence to get to her goals. Witness in this game how she uses what's at her disposal in order to kill a small drug-lord and take all of his money.

title: Gas Station Story
description: A surreal slice-of-life about a mysterious computer virus and its effects on the city you live in. Navigate day-to-day decisions, fall in love with your coworker, and alienate your customers by being rude in this dystopian desert ring-‘em-up — featuring graphics created with a Game Boy Camera!

title: GB Corp
description:
GB Corp. is an incremental / idle game for the Game Boy, that rewards you for playing it on several console models.
 The core gameplay is quite simple. You hire consoles from the Game Boy line (Original GB, GB Pocket, GB Color, Super Game Boy 1 or 2, Game Boy Advance), and they work for your "push-button" company. When you have earned enough money, you can hire more employees, and upgrade the ones you have so they bring back more income. Also, you must be careful of their power levels: change the batteries of your employees when they are empty!

While the concept is quite simple, this game also has a unique feature: the consoles you hire are effectively working only when you run the game on the same console model! So, to put your GBC employees to work, you need to play the game on an actual Game Boy Color (or set your emulator to "GBC mode"). If you want to make your GBP employees active instead, you'll have to unplug the cartridge and put it into a Game Boy Pocket from your collection (or change your emulator settings). The game uses a SRAM save, so the game progress is kept while switching consoles.

This "console change" is a real gameplay mechanic and not a simple gimmick. When you only have a handful of employees, changing batteries isn't a burden. But when you employ dozens of them, it costs loads of money. However, when you switch from one console model to another (say, you switch the cart from a GBC to an original GB), all the active employees get a new set of batteries for free!

title: GB Harobots
alternate_titles: GBハロボッツ
description: A nurturing RPG that develops various adventures while nurturing the robot pet "Halo" who longs for the player with the master in battles and mini games. There are more than 120 types of robots that Haro transforms into 44 titles! Equipped with a "combinize" system that can be transformed into various robots by incorporating halo into various parts. Find out the rules of combination of parts and create the strongest robot data. Even in the four mini-games, halo will be trained and strengthened. You can also play online battles and convert parts and robot data with your friends. Moreover, you can create new Robo data by shining the light beam on Robo data using the infrared function!

title: GB Run
description: A micro-sized Gameboy Color tribute to a classic arcade racer.

title: GB Stadium
description: Grand Battle Stadium / GB Stadium is an attempt on a platformer-fighter collab on some of GB Studio's game / developer pioneers, made for the GB Compo 2021

title: GBBBS95
description:
The internet has been shut down and your friend has been blamed for releasing a virus. Can you find proof to clear his name? A nostalgic cozy game inspired by memories of growing up in the 1990s.

It's 1995, a long autumn weekend has just started and you got your brand new Gameboy Modem to go online. Experience the 90's world of dial-up Bulletin Board Systems, solve a small town mystery and explore a lush world in this cozy game backed by lofi hip hop vibes and Midwestern emo inspired soundtrack. Massive original soundtrack by Beatscribe also includes a song by 90s math-rock slowcore legends C-Clamp and LoFi chill master A L E X.

title: Gekisou Sentai Dangun Racer: Onsoku Buster Dangun Dan
alternate_titles: 激走ダンガンレーサー 音速バスターDANGUN弾 | Fast-running Dungan Racer Sound Speed ​​Buster DANGUN Bullet
description: The popular "Dungan Racer" from CoroCoro Comic is now available as a game! Keeping the world view of the comic as it is, the player controls his own Dangamma Shigan and aims to become a "sound speed buster". Comic characters will appear as player companions and rivals. All real Dangan Racer machines and parts are now available in the game. Players purchase machines and parts at the shop and tune the machines according to the race in the same way as the actual car. A fierce battle is expressed on a powerful big screen! You can also use the "skills" (special moves) that appear in comics..

title: Genesis of Dreams
description:
Get ready for a new 8-bit handheld adventure! Genesis of Dreams!

When 2 friends, Alex and Max, slept on the job, Mech steals the mystical Elegems,and now its trapped in the planet Genesis!

As they try to get the Elegems back, they find out that Mech also mind-controlled the rulers of North Island, the main island of planet Genesis.

Now you must help Alex and Max to stop Mech and get the Elegems back Can you do it?

title: Gensou Maden Saiyuuki: Sabaku no Shijin
alternate_titles: ~ 砂漠の四神A ~ 幻想魔伝 最遊記 | Gensoumaden Saiyuki: The Four Gods of the Desert
description: The story after Sanzo and his group went to Tianzhu. At one point, there was a dispute over which was stronger, Red Boy or Gojo, and he decided to hold a martial arts tournament to see who was stronger. The player chooses one of the eight characters and participates in the martial arts competition. The purpose is to walk anywhere on the map, talk with the people you meet there, raise the level while fighting with youkai, and win the tournament.

title: Get Mushi Club: Minna no Konchuu Daizukan
alternate_titles: Get虫'倶楽部 みんなの昆虫大図鑑 | Get Insect Club -Everyone's Insect Encyclopedia- | Get Chuu Club: Minna no Konchuu Daizukan
description: Just like catching an actual insect, you can catch about 300 insects and make your own insect pictorial book while considering the activity time and habitat of the insects. Capture action games are played in various places such as mountains, rivers, forests and ponds according to the ecology of insects. With the vibration cartridge, you can experience collecting insects with different vibrations for each insect. You can exchange the caught insects with your friends. The modes are "scenario mode" where insects are collected through all 15 scenarios whose capture difficulty gradually changes, "insect pictorial book mode" where insects captured in scenario mode can be registered in the pictorial book, and full-scale collection methods such as sweeping and peting. We have prepared a "Mushitori Mode" where you can play mini games.

title: Gex 3: Deep Pocket Gecko
description: Even a lost island hideaway in the wet South Pacific isn't far enough away from the long arm of Rez. While GEX was whiling away the hours living on the fruits of his recent successes, the madman of the Media Dimension was working on his new hobby - secret agent-napping. Agent Xtra was now struggling for her freedom as a hostage in the lair of Rez. As a master of disguise, GEX had his work cut out for him. Another descent into bad TV movies is at hand. To the GEXCaves!

title: Gex: Enter the Gecko
description: After saving the television realm from destruction, Gex retired to Maui. Unfortunately, Rez has returned and wants to take over the television realm again. Now Gex must come out of retirement. Guide him through 26 levels, each with a number of missions to complete. Finishing a mission will earn a remote control; collect enough remotes and new stages open. In all of the levels, Gex will have to either avoid or fight enemies. Luckily, he is equipped with a tail that can whip the bad guys into shape. To further aid in the fight, Gex can eat flies that will grant him an extra life or increase the power of his attacks, among other things. Help the gecko with attitude save the television realm in GEX: Enter the Gecko.

title: Ghost In The Shell
description:
Experience the anime classic in this 8-bit Visual Novel by Multi Paint System.

Features;

-Hours of heart pumping dialogue!

-Multiple choices and exploration!

-Arcade  shooting and driving!

-5 endings to discover!

and more?

title: Ghost Town
description: Once a prosperous place to live, your town has been turned into a Ghost Town by the evil wizard Belegro with a spell. After he cast the spell, he took all the treasure and hid them in one room. Your quest is to search the town in this top view flick-screen arcade adventure using the items found and using them on other screens. There are secret items and many obstacles and dangers and if any are touched, then this loses your life and the game has to be started again.

title: Ghostly Labyrinth
description:
Ghostly Labyrinth is a randomized platformer about exploring a cave system. You play as Kishona, an amateur caver as she attempts to escape after a rockslide traps her in the dark.

But hiding in the maze of tunnels and caverns are ghosts and other obstacles. Try to find your way out before your lights run out...

title: Ghostly Labyrinth 2
description: A follow-up to the first game, Ghostly Labyrinth 2 is another cave adventure about escape and confronting your fears. Inspired by Super Metroid and Luigi's Mansion, this randomized platformer explores a cave system with it's various branches and monsters. Battle ghosts as you try to escape the depths of the cave...

title: Ghosts 'n Goblins
description:
EXPERIENCE THINGS THAT GO BUMP IN THE KNIGHT!

Command the heroic Sir Arthur, as you begin a quest to defeat the forces of evil and save your kidnapped girlfriend, Guinevere. Scores of evil enemies await you, from zombies to gargoyles, on your journey to save her. Will you survive the perils that lie in wait in the haunted countryside of Ghosts 'n Goblins?

• The all-time classic, action-adventure game now for the Game Boy Color video system.
• Seven challenging levels of haunting adventure.
• Collect money, weapons, health, and other power-ups to aid you in your quest.

title: Gift
country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description:
Unlike its big 3D brother on the PC and Playstation 2, Gift for the Game Boy Color is a top down 2D action game.

As Gift, a small cute red devil-like creature with an attitude, players must save Lolita Globo and defeat the Shadow of Black Deep Dark Night. To do so Gift must find seven treasures and seven gnomes in seven different worlds. Worlds are divided in rooms, in rooms puzzles have to be solved, and enemies fought. Finally each world is guarded by a level boss.

title: Gimmick Land - Tomato Head's Secret
description:
Gimmick Land, (called Gimmick Land: Tomato Head's Secret when including its subtitle) is an unreleased role-playing game that serves as the prototype to Tomato Adventure. The game was developed by AlphaDream and was originally going to be published by them. While the game is complete and fully playable, Nintendo asked AlphaDream to use the pre-existing concepts developed in Tomato Adventure and port the experience to the Game Boy Advance system. Because of this, the game is practically the same outside of a few minor changes.

Before the ROM was leaked online in September 2020 as a part of the "Nintendo Gigaleak", the only publicly available documentation of the prototype that existed was two screenshots. An unofficial English fan translation was released on August 3, 2022. The English fan translation is currently labeled as unfinished, but features a full translation of the main script, and most other elements that are necessary to understand in order to complete the game.

title: Gnasher
description:
Gnasher is a game based on the classic Pac-Man.

Like most other Pac-Man clones gameplay stays very close to the original tried and tested formula. The player controls a chomping yellow blob, Gnasher, and must manoeuvre Gnasher around a maze chomping on dots. When all the dots have been cleared the player progresses to the next level.

title: Go Catch 'Em
alternate_titles: Go Catch 'Em (World) (v20220225) (Aftermarket) (Health Potion Studios)
description: It's Pokemon Go as a Game Boy game! This is what the game might have been like if it had come out during the 8 bit era.

title: Gobs of Games
description: GOBS OF GAMES brings many childhood games to the Game Boy Color. The 16 different games are broken into four categories: Paper games, Peg games, Puzzle games, and Board games. The Paper games include Hangman, Dot Boxes, Triangle Boxes, Share, Color Snakes, and Tic-Tac-Toe. Peg Game is a series of boards in which the goal is to remove all of the pegs by jumping over them. Scramble and Move It are Puzzle games, and the only Board game is Checkers. All of the games can be played solo, but some can also played against another person via a link cable. Try to relive your younger days with GOBS OF GAMES.

title: God Destroyer
description:
You are god slayer lady named Venus who's mission is to slay gods for "purifying" the planet by exterminating all humans.
Collect all 15 bombs for the true ending!

title: God Destroyer 2
alternate_titles: God Destroyer v2
description:
A brand new game built from the ground up and took a month to create…

God destroyer 2! The angel slayer lady named Venus whose mission is to slay gods for "purifying" the planet by exterminating all humans is back!

The game features a Metroidvania experience with top down areas and shoot em up gameplay.

title: Godzilla The Series: Monster Wars
description: Aliens are creating mutants on Earth, and it is up to Godzilla to save the planet from the giant monsters in GODZILLA THE SERIES: MONSTER WARS. You take control of the giant lizard in 10 levels of action that take place in deserts, cities, and underwater. Free-scrolling technology gives you total control of Godzilla, and new cross-hairs improve the accuracy of Godzilla’s attacks that include fireball, tail whip, bite, claw, stomp, and flame breath. As an added bonus, all of the attacks can be linked together for unlimited combinations. And you are going to need those combinations to destroy the 16 types of enemies that Godzilla will face. Try to save the planet from giant monsters and aliens in GODZILLA THE SERIES: Monster Wars.

title: Godzilla: The Series
description: Giant monsters are attacking Earth, and Godzilla, a 200-foot tall, fire-breathing lizard, is the only thing that can save the world. Unfortunately, the military wants to destroy all giant creatures, good or bad. You take control of Godzilla as he travels through seven action-packed levels. In each one, Godzilla must work his way past the military to fight a giant monster. Luckily, Godzilla has fire breath that will destroy almost anything. While fighting through the levels, Godzilla will earn new attacks like the stomp, bite, and tail-whip. Will Godzilla be able to save the planet from the monster menace? Find out by playing GODZILLA: The Series.

title: Gold and Glory: The Road to El Dorado
description: After stowing away on Cortes's ship bound for the New World, Miguel and Tulio find themselves in a strange land with no food. However, they do find part of a map that might lead them to El Dorado, the lost city of gold. You take the role of either Miguel or Tulio as they search 20 levels of action that span swamps, rainforests, Spanish galleons, and even El Dorado for treasure and the other pieces of the map. Along the way, the heroes will have to fight bulls, native warriors, Spanish soldiers, wild boars, and rhinos, and they'll also have to brave the Circle of Fire. Luckily, the heroes are equipped with swords to dispatch any problems they might run into. If you play the game well, you just might get to ride Altivo, the horse. Help Miguel and Tulio find GOLD AND GLORY: The Road to El Dorado.

title: gold.
description: it's gold.

title: Golf Daisuki!
alternate_titles: I love golf! | ゴルフだいすき!
description: Power and atmosphere are powered up! Not only the shot screen, but also the flying ball scene and just before the cup-in are all progressing in 3D scene. Since data such as the undulations, conditions, and wind of the ground are prepared, you can devise a game strategy that is the same as real golf. When selecting a club, the short cursor displays how far you will fly. When playing a match, if the opponent's ball comes within 50 cm of the cup, you can judge the victory or you can gear cup yourself, so the game will develop smoothly. In online competition, you can have a hot fight against each other's clubs, and you can get a new club set depending on the number of points.

title: Golf Ou: The King of Golf
alternate_titles: ゴルフ王 | Golf king
description: There are 54 holes in 3 courses, Japan, USA and World. The world is made up of 9 difficult holes from Japan and USA, but the distance is getting longer and more difficult. Since the pin position changes from game to game, you can play with a fresh feeling no matter how many times you play. In addition, the course situation created by changes in wind direction and their combinations is infinite! There are three online matches, which are regular hole matches plus Dracon and Near Pin. Each course can save up to the best 5 scores, so you can always see the emotional record. In addition, you can print your scorecard on a pocket printer, so you can show off your hole-in-one or Albatross to your friends.

title: Gonta no Okiraku Daibouken
alternate_titles: Gonta's Great Adventure | ゴン太のおきらく大冒険
description: Familiar with pet food commercials, the dog Gonta has become a game! An adventure game where you can enjoy Gonta's easy everyday life. Players can become Gonta and enjoy the Gonta world. Many CM scenes also appeared in the game. BGM is all that I have heard once.

title: GoodLuck Baby
alternate_titles: GoodLuck Baby Jam
description:
Sell and stamp tickets, check documents. Work / desk job simulator with a papers please style game play. You make $100 for every customer you serve correctly.  Buy and collect items from the shop and decorate your rooms shelves.

Made in GB STUDIO in 3 months for the 2025 gameboy compo. (Game by me Kii)

title: Goraku Ou Tango!
alternate_titles: Language King  TANGO! | ～語楽王～TANGO!
description: A puzzle game where you go around 7 archaeological sites around the world, move letters such as "katakana" and "hiragana" to match the keywords, combine words, and solve the mystery. The seven locations in the world are the ruins of Japan, northern Syria, Greece / Rome, Scandinavia, Ireland, Maya Steka, and Mu. Five stages consisting of three questions are prepared for one stage, and 105 questions are prepared in all seven places. The player can move the disjointed letters up, down, left and right to create a word that suits the subject. The number of answers to clear one theme varies depending on the stage and is 3 to 11. There are also various help cards.

title: Gorf the Ghost Saves Halloween
description: You are Gorf the Ghost. It's Halloween but everyone is too scared to trick or treat because of an evil skeleton in the graveyard. Explore the town, help your friends, and save Halloween!

title: Goudall
description:
The evil wizard Walator has insidiously attacked the unsuspecting Goudall. He has cursed Goudall's magical power into diamonds that he hid in his underground kingdom. In order for Goudall to regain his magical power and defeat Walator, he will have to find all the diamonds. The journey will not be easy. The underground is full of Walator's evil monsters, and Goudall can only rely on his fast feet.

Help Goudall explore all 20 underground caves and collect all the diamonds. You must watch out for snakes, bats, hot lava, poisonous plants, giant monsters and many other traps in Waltor's underground world.

title: Grabber
description:
The object of the game is to "grab" the treasures, one at a time - in each "corner" of the two mazes - and store them in the "center" boxes. Passing over the "treasures" will "grab" them and entering the center boxes will "store" them.

The monsters are out to kill you. When he appears, he is the same color as you, and while this is the case, his touch kills. You can rectify this situation by passing over the "X". This will change your color and allow you to turn the collision disable, but this situation only lasts for a very short time, also remember you only have two "X's", use wisely!

title: Gran Duel: Shinki Dungeon no Hihou
alternate_titles: グランデュエル～深きダンジョンの秘宝～ | Grand Duel ~ The Hidden Treasure of the Deep Dungeon ~
description: The stage of the game is an island called "Tarian". In the dungeon, the main purpose is to collect cards and battle with rivals. There are more than 100 types of cards available. Furthermore, 8000 cards can be used by performing the work "synthesis" of combining cards. You can carry up to 50 cards, but if you can't carry them or want to replenish them, you'll have to go back to the ground and take an adventure at a facility in town. The shape of the dungeon changes each time you enter it, so you can try it as many times as you like.

title: Grand Theft Auto
alternate_titles: GTA
description:
Experience for yourself every classic car chase ever seen. Race at breakneck speed through an immense, living city out-running and out-witting rival gang members, mercenaries, hired killers and an entire police force.

Drive dozens of varied vehicles around three of America's toughest cities. Only the best will be able to tame the fastest cars. Only the smartest will know all the short-cuts and the whereabouts of the hottest wheels. Only the toughest will be able to take on the world and finish the job like a professional...

title: Grand Theft Auto 2
alternate_titles: GTA 2
description: Grand Theft Auto comes to Game Boy Color! Seven ruthless gangs are involved in a brutal power struggle. Make a name for yourself, but watch your back. Respect is earned, not given. Intelligent gang system - earn and maintain the respect of gangs to get the best jobs and special favors or play the gangs off against each other in turf wars. Completely open and non-linear gameplay frees you to carve your own way to the top. Fully reactive urban environment which responds to your every move.

title: Grandia: Parallel Trippers
alternate_titles: グランディア パラレルトリッパーズ
description: The main character, Yuhi, and his friends Mizuki and Shirou, were sent from school to another dimension in the wake of a certain incident. It was a girl named Sue who helped Yuhi, who had lost her mind after being separated from Mizuki and Shirou. Liete, the caretaker of the world who knows that Yuhi and others are human beings in another world, teaches that "keys" scattered all over the world are necessary to return to the original world. Yuhi embarks on a journey with his encouraging ally Justin Sue Fina to collect the "keys" and return to the original world with his friends. Why did Yuhi and his friends get lost in another dimension? "Grandia", synonymous with adventure, is now available on GBC! A full-scale RPG that follows the flow of SS and DC versions. Depending on the play, a completely different scenario will occur and the number of party members will increase. As with the Grandia series, IP (Initiative Point) gauges are used for battle. Place actions on the gauge for each character and fight using battle cards. Depending on the placement of the cards, defensive effects and combos of techniques may occur, requiring strategicity. There are many types of cards such as magic and techniques, and you can learn new techniques by synthesizing them. You can also play against friends and card trading using online battles.

title: Graveyard Oracle
description: A mysterious tent has appeared in the graveyard. A sign reads "ASK FORTUNE" or "FIX LUCK". Spirits inhabit an empty cloak. They have come to tell your fortune.

title: GraviCat
description:
GraviCat is a game about a gravity-defying cat. This cat finds itself lost in a realm where gravity is a suggestion.

This cat's having a bad day. He just wanted a nap, but instead, he got a one-way ticket to an anti-gravity adventure. Now, you've gotta help him escape this upside-down mess. Navigate tricky levels by switching gravity on the fly and collect shiny things.

title: Gravitorque
alternate_titles: Gravitorque (v1.0) (Homebrew)
description:
Gravitorque is a homebrew game for the Gameboy colour

You are an astronaut stranded on an unknown space station. Use your GRAVITATIONAL TORQUE MODIFIER to manipulate the direction of gravity. With this device you are able to walk on walls, ceilings and cross huge gaps by falling sideways.

title: Gravitorque DX
description:
You play as an astronaut who suffers a shipwreck and is now stranded in space. Use the Gravitational Torque Modifier to manipulate the direction of gravity and walk on walls and ceilings.

There is no jump button. Take on maze-like levels with a gravity-defying ability. Classic platformer logic is literally turned on its head, so you’ll have to adapt your spatial thinking to escape successfully.

title: Gremlins: Unleashed
description: In this game, the film's hero, Gizmo, attempts to find the gremlins and capture them all. In the meantime, the sinister Stripe and his army of 30 different gremlins decide to invade the town of Kingston Falls and try to transform Gizmo into a gremlin. The game can be played as either character. Gremlins: Unleashed! features 10 levels based in locations featured in the film, including Billy's house, the school laboratory, the department store, and the movie theater.

title: Grimace's Birthday
alternate_titles: McDonald's Grimace Birthday | grimacebday
description:
In an unexpected turn of events, McDonald's has started a new marketing campaign, announcing the return of their beloved McDonaldLand characters, like Grimace, Birdie the Early Bird, Hamburgular and the McNugget Buddies, as well as promoting a new ice cream shake "Grimace's Birthday". However, that wasn't the only way in which McDonald's is making said promotions.

McDonald's opened a new website titled "grimacesbirthday.com", and users are greeted with a surplus of ad-like images containing McDonald's marketing material, and the most interesting of all, is a free-to-play game in the website, appropriately titled "Grimace's Birthday". At first glance, and for those who have been in the internet for quite some time, the title might seem like your typical Java or Flash game running in the website, but the reality of it is entirely different.

"Grimace's Birthday" is actually an entirely new Game Boy Color ROM developed by Krool Toys, a new release for the system in 2023, more than 2 decades after the device has been out of stores.

Those interested in playing the game can do so directly through McDonald's website, but a dump of the game has also been making its rounds online in ROM format.

title: GRIMLORE
alternate_titles: Grimlore (Homebrew)
description:
Figure out who is worthy for a sacrifice during your tricks and treats!

The game randomly generates who is the criminal on every replay.

title: Ground Force Zero
description:
With all the ground forces, available to you, defeated, you have been ordered to make an air attack on the city. That city is New York. With your altitude dropping all the time your best tactic is to bomb the highest buildings by pressing the fire key. Any collision with a building, burning or solid will result in your fatality.

MAY THE FORCE OF TITAN BE WITH YOU.

title: Growth's Adventure
description:
Growth has found out some cheeky bugger has kidnapped Princess Fluffy-Butt IV and taken her to their evil flying fortress above Hooty-Tootie Volcano!

Now you must travel Soul Island collecting batteries to power your friends electrical Blimp so you can fly up there, kick some booty, and save the princess!

title: Guardian Frame Debrief
alternate_titles: Guardian Frame: Debrief!
description: Guardian Frame: Debrief! is a lighthearted, low-intensity dress-up game about two girls in love: a giant robot, and the engineer that pilots and maintains her.

title: Guido
description: Guido is a small ravenous Rabbit who's sole aim in life is to fill his little tummy full of the farmers best carrots. Can you help him in his ravenous rampage? One small tip - watch out for the bouncing balls. They're as crafty as that darn Rabbit.

title: Gun Law
description: Four months of bloody alien attacks have taken their toll - all the surviving inhabitants have fled and arson attacks have been made on your weapon stores. They destroyed what they could not carry away. You are left alone, armed with a single machine gun. You live on your nerves and let your trained instincts take over - prepare to shoot on sight. As you progress through the level of the enemy defenses the alien become more blood-thirsty and turn what were once your own rockets and grenades against you. Take cover behind the trees, houses and fences but don't stop for too long or you'll find yourself surrounded. The alien are ruthless and the fighting bloody but you must survive.

title: Gunship DX
description: Our nation is under attack by enemy forces and the defense can only succeed with the help of air ground support. The future of our nation depends on you! Fight your way through five missions to repel the attack and restore peace.

title: Gunslinger
description:
You take the part of Jesse James the deadly gunslinger, out to increase his cash in the bank, gained through his rewards from outlaws on the run. Wanted dead or alive, Jesse only takes people one way - dead!!

You start the game with three lives. Each life gives you a gun with 6 bullets, if you need to re-load your gun you must return to your saddle bag on your horse. The flashing arrows at the bottom left and right of the screen indicate where your next outlaw is hiding.

title: GuruGuru Garacters
alternate_titles: ぐるぐるガラクターズ | Round and round junk
description: An orthodox RPG in which the main character of an elementary school student fights while collecting unique junk monsters, going back and forth between two stages in the real world and a different world. If you bring junk in the real world to another world, it transforms into a reliable "monster" that helps the player (a round and round system). In a different world, there are battles with monsters, but if you talk well in a four-choice conversation, you can make friends. In online battles, you can fight with 1P, 2P, and a computer. You can work with your friends to kill your computer, or work with your computer to kill your friends.

title: Guruguru Town Hanamaru-Kun
alternate_titles: ぐるぐるタウンはなまるくん
description: GBC version of the picture book "Hanamaru-kun" for young children. Educational software that allows you to learn the knowledge you need in your daily life through games such as errands, hideouts, and shiritori. You can enjoy the story as if you were watching a TV program, and you can study without knowing it.

title: Gute Zeiten Schlechte Zeiten Quiz
alternate_titles: Good Times, Bad Times: The Quiz
description:
Good Times, Bad Times: The Quiz for GameBoy Color - The quiz about the series!

Features:

- Over 1000 questions about the series and stars
- Seven subject areas
- Approx. 3000 different answer options
- Single player mode against the clock

Which do you know best? Whether it's love, fate, trick or deception - seven subject areas with over 1000 questions ensure fast-paced guessing fun in Good Times, Bad Times: The Quiz for GameBoy Color. Think carefully about the answer, but also make sure that your fellow player doesn't snatch the point from under your nose in Good Times, Bad Times: The Quiz for GameBoy Color.

title: Gyouten Ningen Batseelor: Doctor Guy no Yabou
alternate_titles: 仰天人間 バトシーラー ～ドクトルガイの野望～ | Astonishing Human Bat Sealer ~ Doctor Guy's Ambition ~
description: Comic BomBom's popular manga game. It is also a TV anime. The game is a role-playing game linked to the story of a manga. The player controls the main characters Guts and Jeanne to fight Doctor Guy. You can collect stickers of various characters as the game progresses. The stickers collected in the game can be exchanged with friends by communication.

title: Halloween Racer
description: Halloween Racer is an racing game with a Halloween theme. It mostly reassembles a karting game, where you choose one of the different characters and race through each track of the game to win the Halloween trophy. To do so the player have to beat the competing monsters for each of the five tracks. On the road there is goodies to collect and traps to avoid to make it more challenging. Before going into the championship each track can be played in practise mode.

title: Halo: Combat Devolved
description: On November 15, 2001, Bungie released its legendary first-person shooter for the original xBox. This is a faithful demake for the Game Boy Color using GB Studio.

title: Hamster Club
alternate_titles: ハムスター倶楽部
description: A training simulation game that raises hamsters and aims to become a breeder master. Select one of the three animals, "Shigecchi", "Boo-chan", and "Endo-kun", and raise and breed them based on the funds you have. If you participate in various competitions (cups), you will compete for the hamster's ability and cuteness. Up to 4 hamsters can be kept in one cage at the same time. Of course, it is compatible with communication cables and can print cute hamsters.

title: Hamster Club 2
alternate_titles: ハムスター倶楽部 2
description: The second hamster breeding simulation game. In addition to the familiar "Shigecchi", cute new characters are appearing one after another. A new mini-game has been added to the new story, and it is full of fun and cuteness. Comes with a mascot doll as a first-time limited benefit.

title: Hamster Club: Awasete Chu
alternate_titles: ハムスター倶楽部 あわせてチュー | Hamster club: Together Chu
description: A cute puzzle game. Work with the cute hamsters to get rid of the falling blocks. There are two modes: "single mode" where you can see the ending according to the score when you select a support character and increase the score, and "2P battle mode" where you lose if the blocks are piled up first. The first privilege is an original key chain gift.

title: Hamster Club: Oshiema Chu
alternate_titles: ハムスター倶楽部 おしえまチュー
description: The fifth in the "Hamster Club" series. Aim for Dr. Hamster with quizzes and variety shows! Questions about various things about hamsters in a quiz format. You can get a mini-game by answering correctly and leveling up (1 to 6 steps). In addition, you can get rewards (24 kinds of 4-frame animation in total) by scoring the mini game! !! In "Hamster Shindan", you can diagnose which hamster character you own is close to which hamster character in "Hamster Club".

title: Hamster Monogatari GB + Magi Ham Mahou no Shoujo
alternate_titles: ハムスター物語GB+マジハームの魔法少女 | Hamster Story GB + Magical Girl of Magic Harm
description: You can enjoy the hamster breeding simulation game "Hamster Story GB" and the fantasy adventure game "Magical Girl of Magic Harm" with one cartridge. "Hamster Story GB" changes into various hamsters by feeding and playing with hamsters and communicating with them. You can use a communication cable to meet your friend's hamster, and if they are compatible, you can have a baby. "Magical Girl of Magic Harm" is an adventure game in which a girl who loves hamsters becomes a witch and goes to the hamster world by magically transforming into a hamster in order to save the crisis of the hamster world.

title: Hamster Paradise
alternate_titles: ハムスターパラダイス
description: "Hamster Paradise" where you can make a cute hamster a pet. Hamsters' behavior, personality, and behavior change depending on how they are raised and taken care of. When raised with love, hamsters perform tricks (such as ball riding) and perform various gestures. You can use the communication cable to meet your friend's hamster or race in a racing game. You can take a picture of a hamster's funny gesture and print it with a printer.

title: Hamster Paradise 2
alternate_titles: ハムスターパラダイス 2(ちゅー)
description: First of all, I got a hamster from Dr. Hamuzou of the ham center. Give the hamster you got a cute name. Basically care! If you grow up lovingly, your hamster will grow bigger and bigger. Grow carefully by feeding and taking a walk. If you take a walk with your hamster, there will be many events. You can get money by clearing the mini game. Use this money to buy food, toys, and birdhouses for your hamster. Hamsters can get married when they grow up. If you grow your hamster well, new species may be born. The game is more cute because it reacts more than a real hamster! ??

title: Hamster Paradise 3
alternate_titles: ハムスターパラダイス 3(ちゅりー)
