description: In this work, you can grow your favorite kind of hamster from Golden Hamster, Jungarian, and Roborovski. In addition to the mini rabbit that was popular in the previous work, a squirrel also appeared. There are also plenty of fun mini games to play with hamsters. In addition to familiar games such as ham wheels and ham catches, new games have been added, and there are more than dozens of them. The cage is also transformed into a two-story building. You can enjoy playing around by going up and down. Not only parks and shops, but also amusement parks and schools, where you can go out with hamsters has increased. You can now collect stickers that you can get at various places in the game, and exchange emails with your friends via infrared communication.

title: Hamster Paradise 4
alternate_titles: ハムスターパラダイス 4
description: The hamster paradise series is now even more cute! The types of hamsters that can be raised have increased to eight types: Golden, Jungarian, Roborovski, Blue Sapphire, White, Black, Panda, and Pudding! In addition, it has become possible to keep two hamsters at the same time. When you feed them, you can see cute gestures that the two animals share and eat. You can marry your own hamsters or play with your friend's hamsters using the communication function. The contents of the mini-game have been renewed, new walking places have been added, 16 new types of hamsters can be discovered, and you can meet the discovered hamsters at "Maison de Hamster".

title: Hamtaro: Ham-Hams Unite!
description: Hamtaro hops from your TV to your Game Boy Color for an adventure starring all the Ham-Hams from the hit animated series! See school yards, supermarkets, and other everyday places from the viewpoint of the pint-sized hamster. Help him round up his fellow Ham-Hams and meet back at the Clubhouse for a big surprise!

title: Hana Yori Dango: Another Love Story
alternate_titles: 花より男子 Another Love Story | Boys Over Flowers: Another Love Story
description: Tsukushi Makino, the main character of the general people, who entered the high school of Eitoku Gakuen of the super bourgeois school, which is dominated by the ultra-high-class boys' four-member group "F4", at the request of parents aiming for "Tama no Koshi", is just a sober school life. I was going to send it. However, my friend accidentally kicked F4 leader Tsukasa Domyoji, and the rugged Tsukasa cut a rebellion against F4, so it's hard! Tsukushi's school life will change completely. "Your guts, I'll rehash you. Declaration of war!" The game story is based on the original comic volume 12 (episode of the teen of Japan). An adventure game in which the player becomes the main character, Makino Tsukushi, and weaves romance and friendship without losing the various hardships that occur in school life. Depending on your choice, you can enjoy the original story of each member of F4 and Tsukushi's elementary school classmate Aoike, who are not told in the original story. Adopted a multi-ending that allows you to enjoy the ending with each character according to the flow of the scenario followed by the player. If you play the game, you can enjoy the further charm of the character. Feel free to enjoy the development along with the original story or enjoy your own love story!

title: Hanasaka Tenshi Tenten-Kun no Beat Breaker
alternate_titles: 花咲天使テンテンくんのビートブレイカー | Hanasaki Tenten-kun's beat breaker
description: Tenten-kun, who is very popular in Weekly Shonen Jump, will appear. It's exciting to think of a music puzzle like adding Pazuru Dama and Beatmania and dividing by two. Anyway, let's aim for a big chain by pressing the button at the right time according to the music.

title: Hands of Time
description: Hands of Time is an Action game, developed by Mirage and published by Titus Software, which was released in 2001.

title: Harbour Attack
description:
In Harbour Attack, you pilot a submarine through three stages to destroy an enemy cargo ship.

Stage 1: Side-view navigation from left to right, avoiding mines and nets while managing air supply and depth. Going too deep, running out of air, or hitting obstacles costs a life.

Stage 2: Another side-view stage where you surface to attack planes and ships, replenishing air while avoiding bombs, torpedoes, and depth charges. An octopus also appears on the C64 version.

Stage 3: First-person view of the enemy harbour, where you guide a torpedo toward a cargo ship’s target while dodging moving barges. You must destroy the ship before your air runs out to complete the mission.

title: Harley Davidson: Race Across America
description: Live the life of an easy rider in HARLEY DAVIDSON: Race Across America. There are four bikes to choose from, and they all of them have the classic Harley Davidson shape and sound. Each bike is rated in acceleration, top speed, and handling so you can pick one that fits your riding style. You can go for a high-speed, low-acceleration model, or if you prefer to burn rubber off of the line, you will want to choose a bike with monster acceleration. When you are ready to ride you will have the opportunity to race on four different tracks including the Arizona Desert, Deep South, Florida Everglades, and California Coast. On all of the tracks you will have to race from sunrise to sunset in order to emerge victorious. Get on your hog and cruise the good ol’ U.S. of A in HARLEY DAVIDSON: Race Across America.

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
description: Ignoring Dobbya the house-elf's grave warning that disaster will strike if he returns to Hogwarts, Harry embarks on his second year to find Dobby's predictions coming true! Harry soon finds himself entangled in a dark plot against his "Mudblood" classmates, as students keep turning up petrified! Could Draco Malfoya be to blame, or is something even more malevolent at work? With the help of returning friends Hermione, Ron, Hagrida and Hedwiga, players attend new classes to learn second-year spells that will aid them in a quest to uncover the true identity of the "Heir of Slytherin".

title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
alternate_titles: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
description: Unlike other game versions of the first Harry Potter book, the Game Boy Color rendition of Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone is a traditional roleplaying game, complete with NPCs to talk to and random beastie battles to challenge you. The game begins with the receipt of an acceptance letter into Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. From there, you (as Harry Potter, of course) will go shopping for your school supplies, catch the train on the 9 3/4 platform, take a boat ride, and finally arrive at your new home.

title: Harry Potter to Kenja no Ishi
alternate_titles: ハリーポッターと賢者の石 | Harry Potter & the Mystical Halo | Harry Potter 3
description:
Harry Potter & the Mystical Halo is a Bootleg/Shoot 'Em Up video game published by Vast Fame released on August 2nd, 2002 for the GB Color.

This is an unlicensed Chinese shoot 'em up known as "Harry Potter 3".

title: Harvest Moon 2 GBC
description:
Rebuild the farm of your grandfather and start raising cows, chickens and sheep. Keep them happy and they’ll make you rich! Discover the fantastic Harvest Moon world with cool friends ready to help you succeed in your mission.

- The awaited Harvest Moon sequel for GBC with even more fun!
- Choice of playing a boy or girl farmer
- Hours and hours of gameplay
- Hidden arcade games include Mole Bash and Cherry Cup Horse Race
- Special Game Link cable options allow trading between Harvest Moon 2 and Legend of the River King 2

title: Harvest Moon 3 GBC
genre: Construction and Management Simulation | Life Simulation
description:
The third entry in the down-home series of RPGs boasts a bevy of new options and features. You can play as a male or female farmer, get married, play with new pets and enjoy new minigames.

Essentially a farming role-playing game, Harvest Moon 3 requires you to clear a patch of land, till the soil, plant seeds and tend the new shoots. Take a twice-weekly ferry to the mainland (the island locale is new to this game) to purchase animals and other supplies.

Despite -- or perhaps because of -- the lack of swordplay, magic spells and other traditional RPG fare, the Harvest Moon series exerts its own unique charm that has won over thousands of would-be farmers worldwide.

title: Harvest Moon GB
country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: You have inherited the family ranch from an ancestor. With only a shed of rusted tools and a small amount of money, you must prove yourself worthy of owning the ranch by returning it to its former glory. To do this, you must till the soil and cultivate vegetables. When you have earned enough money, you can add chickens and livestock to help increase your profits. While you work, you will receive visits from the local townsfolk, who will ask for your help. You should always help them as much as possible, because they will be willing to return the favor later. Once you have built your ranch to a significant level, you can trade it with other farm masters via link cable. Try to restore the family ranch in HARVEST MOON.

title: Harvest Moon GBC
developer: Tose Co., Ltd. | 																Victor Interactive Software, Inc.
description: You have inherited the family ranch from an ancestor. With only a shed of rusted tools and a small amount of money, you must prove yourself worthy of owning the ranch by returning it to its former glory. To do this, you must till the soil and cultivate vegetables. When you have earned enough money, you can add chickens and livestock to help increase your profits. While you work, you will receive visits from the local townsfolk, who will ask for your help. You should always help them as much as possible, because they will be willing to return the favor later. Once you have built your ranch to a significant level, you can trade it with other farm masters via link cable. Try to restore the family ranch in HARVEST MOON.

title: Hatsune Miku Bomb Squad
alternate_titles: Hatsune_Miku_Bomb_Squad_v1-3
description:
Everyone knows that Hatsune Miku can do anything.

Virtual pop idol, racing team mascot, snow festival spokeswoman, boxing instructor... you name it, she's an expert. Now a member of the top secret Munitions Intervention Knowledge Unit (M.I.K.U.) she's ready to teach you the finer points of bomb defusal. 

Join Miku in solving 25 challenging puzzles while enjoying a bundle of chiptune Hatsune Miku song covers in this puzzle game exclusively for the Game Boy Color!

title: Hauntsfield
description:
Oh no!  Someone has stolen all the pumpkins from your farm, and the Hauntsfield festival is tomorrow!

You'll need assistance from the townsfolk to get the pumpkins back in time...

Hauntsfield is a short Halloween RPG for Game Boy!

title: He Fucked The Girl Out Of Me
description: This is is a semi-autobiographical narrative visual novel about trauma and sex work made for the gameboy. The author explains how sex work impacted her life and changed her perception of the world.

title: Hearts and Heroes
description:
Save your partner from the void, and other silly tings.

Hearts and Heroes is an adventure about love, doubt, and silly monsters.

You wake up in a strange world where your partner has been taken by The Void. To save them, you must journey through surreal levels, and face bosses that embody doubt, jealousy, anxiety, and past trauma... and a farmer and his beefcakes.

It is dialogue heavy, heartfelt, and a little silly. Each fight reminds you that love is stronger than fear.

title: Helichopper
description:
One fast moving, armed Helichopper. Unlimited supply of bombs. Mission: Rescue the Clones from the steamy, swarming Swamp.
On each screen three of Clones must be located and flown out - one at a time. To do this, land your chopper at the Electric Fence and when one of these little champs climbs aboard whisk him to the safety of the ledges (where he will disembark when the ledge is white).

title: Hell Breaker
description:
Every century since the dawn of man a battle has taken place between Heaven and Hell over the souls that get lost between the realms. Each side nominates an angel to fight and the winner collects these souls for their side. 

In this, our year 20XX, dark angel Lilith enters the puzzle arena to battle light angel Muriel for the title of Hell Breaker.

title: Hello Kitty Happy House
alternate_titles: ハローキティのハッピーハウス
description: The player is the spirit of an old old mansion that has lost happiness because humans have not lived for a long time. So let Hello Kitty live in the mansion, collect "Happy Points" with Kitty, and return the mansion to its old "Happy House"! By accumulating conversations with Kitty who is freely moving around in the Happy House, the content and reaction of the conversation will change. Many Kitty family and friends also appear in the game! You can play emails with your friends in the game! You can actually send and receive emails using the mobile adapter GB, and the person who receives the email can check what happened in the game. You can also send the items collected in the game to your friends!

title: Hello Kitty no Beads Koubou
alternate_titles: ハローキティのビーズ工房(ファクトリー) | Hello Kitty Beads Studio
description: Kitty got a mysterious bottle from her dad as a birthday present. Glittering in the bottle. A lot of beautiful beads are packed. When I open the lid of the bottle with my good friend Tiny Cham ... there are lots of beads later! "If you make accessories with this, it will be wonderful" Kitty's accessory making begins, the beginning ...

title: Hello Kitty no Magical Museum
description: Hello Kitty no Magical Museum is a Puzzle game, developed by Atelier Double and published by Imagineer, which was released in Japan in 1999.

title: Hello Kitty to Dear Daniel no Dream Adventure
alternate_titles: ハローキティとディアダニエルのドリームアドベンチャー | Hello Kitty and Dear Daniel's Dream Adventure
description: Kitty and Daniel have a London date together for the first time in a long time! It was a lot of fun, but Daniel has to go back to New York tomorrow. For Kitty, who feels lonely, Daniel presented her with a stuffed blue rabbit. However, one night, when Kitty wakes up with a noise, what a stuffed rabbit is running! Kitty chased a stuffed rabbit. When the stuffed rabbit stood in front of the mirror in the living room and cast a mysterious spell, the mirror glowed and the stuffed rabbit jumped into the mirror. Following the stuffed rabbit, Kitty jumped into the mirror ... This time, Kitty will take a big adventure in the fushigi world! A romantic Kitty and Daniel love story unfolds in a world where the past, present and future are mixed. If you change your costume during the game, you can power up Kitty's action. "Boss battle" appears at each turning point of the story! Compete in a game different from the action stage. There are lots of extra elements this time too!

title: Hello Kitty's Cube Frenzy
description: Hello Kitty comes to the Game Boy Color with HELLO KITTY'S CUBE FRENZY. The objective of each stage is simple: Kitty must collect all of the items scattered throughout each level. However, you can only tell Kitty to move left or right, and if you are not careful, Kitty will fall off the edge and say hello to the grim reaper. Luckily, blocks fall from the sky, which can be rotated and used to create staircases and bridges to the objects. However, placing three blocks with identical colors next to each other will make them disappear; this can both help and hurt. In addition to the block problems, Badz Maru, Hanamaru, and Pandaba will wander around and cause problems for Hello Kitty. Can you handle the pressure and collect all of the items in HELLO KITTY'S CUBE FRENZY?

title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
description:
Are you a true God?

You are Hercules, son of Zeus, and you must prove you are a true God to mortal eyes. Get ready for an extraordinary journey! This thrilling game, based on world-known TV series by Universal, mixes fast-paced action and adventure.

-Wide range of characters and adventures riddled with several missions and pitfalls.
-Link mode: play with your friends and exchange characters if you have Titus game Xena on Game Boy Color; Play as Xena in Hercules game and as Hercules in Xena game. You will access to hidden worlds.

title: Hero GP
description:
Hero GP is a 3D racing game which pays homage to the classic 3D retro racers of yesteryear. The aim of the game is simple: prove your worth as you compete in challenging races around the globe to become the ultimate racing champion.

That's it. Go play.

title: Hero Hero Kun
alternate_titles: へろへろくん
description: "Suya Suya" was the first friend of a player who had transferred to Ukiuki Town. However, there is something wrong around them playing with them. Everyone in Ukiuki Town has fallen asleep! that? Did you sleep too? The player is awakened by "Herohero-kun", but everyone else stays asleep. It seems that you have to go into your dreams to wake everyone up ... Kodansha's "Comic BomBom" and NHK Educational TV's popular "Herohero-kun" are now available! !! An orthodox RPG, but a "role-playing gag" game that mixes gag and laughter. The secret of popularity is the unique personality of the characters that appeared! You can enjoy a wider world of heroes, such as the appearance of characters recruited for readers in "Comic BomBom". The main character of the game can be selected from "boy" or "girl", and the gag changes depending on the selected main character. The main character can also communicate via infrared communication.

title: Heroes of Might and Magic
description: Travel to a world of wizards, knights, dragons, and minotaurs in HEROES OF MIGHT AND MAGIC. You can choose from four different heroes and take control of part of a map. The goal is to defeat the other three warlords and rule the entire map. In order to do this, you must travel throughout the land, finding new areas and new towns. If you can get a town to help you, you can recruit new warriors and uncover information to find artifacts that will increase your powers and abilities. When you encounter the enemy, the armies square off in tactical combat where you can try to cut down the opposition with ranged attacks or cause status problems with magic spells. Destroy the opposition and rule the world in HEROES OF MIGHT AND MAGIC.

title: Heroes of Might and Magic II
description: If you love role-playing games, you're sure to be jazzed about the fact that they've started releasing more of them for the Game Boy Color. Now you can take the power of the influential HEROES OF MIGHT AND MAGIC series with you wherever you go, challenging yourself with the intense action of this awesome sequel. Choose from a selection of unique hero types (including eight new ones) to take through this epic quest, gathering resources, creatures, and additional party members along the way. In addition to the new hero types, there are an amazing 30 total character classes for monsters those you control and those you fight against. The object is to gather enough material to create an entire army, taking your force into battle against those of enemy warlords. Dedicated fans of the series will definitely want to pick this one up as there is material that is exclusive to this GBC-only release. Don't have a GBC? Well, this is a perfect excuse to pick one up.

title: Hexcite: The Shapes of Victory
country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: The world's best strategy games have two things in common: they start with a deceptively simple board and the goal of taking territory from your opponents. Now HEXCITE brings a whole new shape to strategy games. In HEXCITE, 1 or 2 players battle to dominate the board with pieces of different shapes and sizes. Like any great strategy game, HEXCITE is simple to learn, but challenging to master. And every round is unpredictable until the last play. Who knows? HEXCITE could be the shape of things to come!

title: Hidden Gems
description:
Hidden Gems is a card game where you play against the AI and try to make the most points by fusing gem cards and playing them on a 4x4 board. 

The game has only three basic cards, but by fusing them and placing them strategically, there's a lot of depth to it.

title: High Noon
description: Shoot now! Ask questions later!! Cartoon quality animation brings back the days of the Wild West - with bandits, banks and burlesque girls. Rig Mortis the undertaker will attend to the corpses and leave main street clear for further mayhem (if he is home). As the tension builds up you need nerves of steel to match up to  the opposition and prove you're still the fastest gun in the West!

title: Hime’s Quest
description:
TAKE CONTROL AS CRUNCHYROLL-HIME TO SAVE THE ANIME CLUB FROM Y2K IN HER FIRST-EVER VIDEO GAME—FINALLY MAKING ITS WAY TO FANS THIS WINTER!
It’s 1999, and something electric is in the air. A malevolent force has crept into New Crunchy City, wreaking havoc on its technology, and tragically destroying the Anime Club’s precious DVD/VCR combo player. Now Crunchyroll-Hime must travel through the haunted forest, rescue her friends, and fight these sinister villains if she’s to save the NCC Anime Club. Can you root out the dastardly cretin brazen enough to ruin their meeting—all before time runs out?

title: Hime's Quest
description: It’s 1999, and something electric is in the air. A malevolent force has crept into New Crunchy City, wreaking havoc on its technology, and tragically destroying the Anime Club’s precious DVD/VCR combo player. Now Crunchyroll-Hime must travel through the haunted forest, rescue her friends, and fight these sinister villains if she’s to save the NCC Anime Club. Can you root out the dastardly cretin brazen enough to ruin their meeting—all before time runs out?

title: Hiryu no Ken Retsuden GB
alternate_titles: 飛龍の拳 烈伝GB | Hiryuu no Ken Retsuden GB | Hiryū no Ken Retsuden GB
description: Year 200X. Ryuhi, the folklore of "Hiryu no Ken," sensed that his master, Gensei, and the "red evil star" were approaching. Originally a clairvoyant, he foresaw that the once-sealed Daimajin would be resurrected when the evil star fell, and entrusted Ryuhi to prevent it. A man dressed in a crimson bodice that reappears in the shadow of a confrontation with the "Five Masters of the Dragon Fang" who are aiming to revive the Great Demon. The purpose of this man! ?? Can Ryuhi prevent the resurrection of the Great Demon! ?? And what is the true identity of Daimajin! ?? The game modes are "action mode" that follows the story, "one-player VS mode" that fights against 12 enemy characters and finally defeats the boss character, and "two-player VS mode" that allows you to play against each other using a communication cable. You can get the FC version "Hiryu no Ken III" for the first time only.

title: Hissatsu Pachinko Boy CR Monster House
alternate_titles: 必殺パチンコボーイ CRモンスターハウス | Deadly Pachinko Boy CR Monster House
description: The model includes the super popular "CR Monster House". Not only the LCD screen of the actual machine, but also the movement of the pachinko ball is realistically reproduced! There are 3 modes in total. In the "capture mode", you can set the cash rate and simulate the play at a pachinko parlor while checking the balance status, rotation speed, number of jackpots, number of reach, etc. "Tamare mode" is a mode that allows you to start digitally at any time. You can change the jackpot probability and enjoy the digital movement of the LCD screen. In the "Reach Catalog", you can see all the reach patterns of Monster House at any time.

title: Hit Man
description:
O.K. so you want to be the Hit Man, first you must see the boss and if he likes you he gives you a contract. It's not a nice job but the pay is good, what you got to do is find you man, rub him out and then disappear before the law arrives. Finding him could be a bit tricky but you've got contacts on the streets, he can't hide forever or can he. Don't foul up or the mob will retire you permanently!

NOTE. To use contracts move into one of the dark building squares, the two arrows appear will give general directions. Both the weapon you choose and the method of gateway have a bearing on the outcome and remember you must try to get as much money as possible, so don't select the helicopter each time.

title: Hole in One Golf
alternate_titles: Golf de Oha Suta
description: It's a quiet day on the links. You tee up your ball, and drive it 200 yards down the center of the fairway, leaving a 150-yard approach shot. After taking the approach shot, the ball stops rolling 3-feet from the pin. On the green, you sink the relatively easy putt, and you start your round with a birdie. While most golfers never have days like this, they can with HOLE IN ONE GOLF. Get out on three different courses and try to get the lowest score possible. However, the courses are located in rural areas, so you never know when birds, squirrels, or bears will come onto the course and mess with your shots. Try to play the round of your life with HOLE IN ONE GOLF.

title: Hollow Knight Fool's Song
description: An Unofficial free fan game of Team Cherry's Hollow Knight. A new game to experience starring the Lesser Known Hero, Tiso! An entry to the Retro Platform GameJam #3

title: Hollow Knight GB
description: An Unofficial free fan demake of the early beta build of Team Cherry's Hollow Knight. A new way to experience a masterpiece! Unofficially remade on the GameBoy.

title: Hollow Knight Silksong
alternate_titles: Hollow Knight - Silksong
description: An Unofficial free fan demake of the e3 demo of Team Cherry's Hollow Knight: Silk Song. A new way to experience another masterpiece! Unofficially remade on the GameBoy.

title: Hollywood Pinball
country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Hollywood Pinball is an Action game, developed by Tarantula Studios and published by Starfish, which was released in 1999.

title: Holy Magic Century
alternate_titles: Quest: Fantasy Challenge
description: The eponymous Game Boy version of "Quest 64", or in other regions called "Quest: Fantasy Challenge".

title: Hong Kong 97 Gameboy
alternate_titles: Hong Kong 97 GB
description:
Complete demake  of the SNES game for GAMEBOY. 

The year 1997 has arrived. A herd of fuckin' ugly reds. are rushing from the mainland. Crime rate skyrocketed! Hong Kong is ruined! Therefore, the Hong Kong government called Bruce Lee's relative "Chin" for the massacre of the Reds. Chin is a killer machine. Wipe out all 1.2 billion of the red communists! However, in mainland China there was a secret project in progress! A project to transform the deceased Tong Shau Ping into an ultimate weapon!

title: Honkaku Hanafuda GB
alternate_titles: 本格花札GB | Authentic Hanafuda GB
description: The content of the game includes 3 competitions, "Koikoi", "Oicho Kabu", and "Flower Matching". A gem of thinking that even Hanafuda enthusiasts will groan, such as abundant option settings and formidable opponents with full-scale thinking. "Winning mode" and "Free battle mode" are available. In "Winning Mode", 7 characters appear as opponents, and the competition can be played in the order of "Koikoi", "Flower Matching", and "Oicho Kabu", and the strength of the rivals will increase as they win. "Free battle mode" is ideal for training, as you can freely select your favorite competition and character.

title: Honkaku Shogi: Shogi Ou
alternate_titles: 本格将棋「将棋王」 | Honkaku Shougi: Shougi Ou | Honkaku Shōgi: Shōgi Ou
description: A true hit of shogi software is here! Achieves speed and strength with the Shogi Joseki algorithm. Communication battle between "human" and "human" is also possible. The tsume shogi is also enriched, and 50 questions full of variety are recorded.

title: Honkaku Taisen Shogi: Fu
alternate_titles: 本格対戦将棋 歩 | Honkaku Taisen Shougi Ayumu | Honkaku Taisen Shōgi Ayumu
description: This is the first shogi game supervised by Taku Morishita, who has always participated in A-class title battles, afflicted A-class players, and was nicknamed the "runner-up man." There are 3 COM levels according to the player's level. Even the beginner level did not suddenly make an unthinkable foolish move, and made everything from "a little weakness" to "demon strength". You can play against your friends using the communication cable. In addition, there are shogi classes and the next move. In the shogi class, there are more than 100 questions about tsume shogi, which is enough to enjoy for a long time.

title: Honkaku Yojin Uchi Mahjong: Mahjong Ou
alternate_titles: 本格四人打麻雀 麻雀王 | Authentic four-player mahjong mahjong king
description: Since the mode will be the ambition of playing mahjong "Mahjong King", the story mode "Training Journey" where you will travel all over Japan and practice, and "Free" where you can choose opponents and rules and enjoy mahjong freely. Two of "game".

title: Hoonigans (Game Boy Color)
description:
Hoonigans is a top-down racing game which pays homage to the classic retro racers of yesteryear. The aim of the game is simple: prove your worth as you tackle the game's diverse array of tracks and challenges, and earn medals to unlock a host of characters, tracks, vehicles, and more!

The game comprises twelve challenging tracks, three playable characters, and a huge array of vehicles.

That's it. Go play.

title: Hot Wheels: Stunt Track Driver
description: The little die-cast cars from Matchbox make their way to the Game Boy Color with HOT WHEELS STUNT TRACK DRIVER. You can choose from five different Hot Wheels cars, including Way 2 Fast, Tow Jam, Shadow Jet, Saltflat Racer and the Twin Mill each with unique strengths and weaknesses. After picking the right car, take it for a test drive on one of the six tracks in the Single Race mode. When you want some stiff competition, try to win successive races in the Tournament mode. And if your friends think they can drive better than you, make them prove it with the two-player link cable option. In all of the modes, the key to winning is to maximize your speed by pulling off big stunts. Find out if you have what it takes to become a Hot Wheels Driver in HOT WHEELS STUNT TRACK DRIVER.

title: HOTEL・S
description:
Nanami, who loves horror but doesn't believe in ghosts at all, is staying at a hotel with her friend Mao...

*This game is a visual novel horror game based on a true story based on the author's family experiences.

title: How a Body Sounds
description: The stones of the town resonate at the sound of a hollow hand. The Unmake is near, the fissures dilate. Quick, new chants are needed.

title: Hoyle Card Games
description: If you like to play cards, then you should get a copy of HOYLE CARD GAMES. There is a total of 14 different games to play including six variations of solitaire (Four Free, Golf Par 6 and Par 7, Klondike draw 1 and draw 3, and Pyramid), Crazy Eights, Cribbage, Gin, Go Fish, Hearts, Old Maid, Spades, and War. When you play, you can choose from 14 different personas like a balding professor, a crocodile, and a teddy bear. You can also play against a friend using the same system or via a link cable. Now you don't have to worry about finding a full deck of cards when you want to play, thanks to HOYLE CARD GAMES for the Game Boy Color.

title: Hoyle Casino
description: All of the excitement of beating the house in Las Vegas or Atlantic City can be put in the palm of your hand with HOYLE CASINO for the Game Boy Color. You can gamble your money away in seven different games: Blackjack, Video Poker, slots, Roulette, Craps, Pai Gow, and Poker. Learning how to play each game is easy, thanks to the tutorials included. All of the games are played just like they are in real life you get to see the dealer's hands as he deals the card, and you get to shake the dice in Craps. In most of the games, digitized voices call out the hands or the winning numbers. As an added bonus, you and a friend can link up to play any of the table games together. Now's your chance to try and break the bank in HOYLE CASINO.

title: Hugo
description: Meet Hugo. Hugo is a collector who decides to get local currency from every country. To do this, you have to travel to 9 different countries, but beware, because no one in those countries wants you to take their money. Help Hugo in this difficult mission.

title: Hugo - The Evil Mirror
description: The wicked witch Scylla wants to get rid of Hugo the troll once and for all. She has used her powers to trap Hugo in a magic mirror that she then cracked it into three pieces and magically scattered the fragments across the world. Scylla also once again kidnapped Hugo's wife, Hugolina. Hugo and Hugolina's three children, Rit, Rat, and Ruth, are the only ones who can free their parents. To break the witch's curse, each child must find a piece of the broken mirror. If the kids put the mirror together, Hugo is able to defeat Mirror Scylla and break the spell. After the fight Hugo gets out of the mirror, traps Scylla in it and smashes it into little pieces, and saves Hugolina.

title: Hugo 2 1/2
description: Hugo 2 1/2 is an Action game, developed by Bit Managers and published by Infogrames, which was released in Europe in 1999.

title: Hugo Black Diamond Fever
description: The evil Scylla is back and this time has found a way to make herself the most powerful witch of all time and take over the world. For this, she requires very rare black diamonds, which are to be found on the jungle island where the Kikurians live. She takes them all prisoner and forces them to work day and night in search of black diamonds. The elder King Kikurian asks Hugo the troll to liberate the slaves and stop Scylla's plot before it is too late. When Fernando arrives a letter from King Kikurian, Hugo reads it, but finds poor King Kikurian imprisoned in a cell and unable to help his people, and has absolutely no time to waste. Can Hugo free all the slaves and stop Scylla's plot?

title: Hungry Huey
alternate_titles: hungryhuey-demo-v01.gbc
description: Hungry Huey is a colorful mashup of Snake, Bejeweled, and Zoo Keeper. The goal is simple: chain as many slimes as you can to keep your hungry buddy Huey happy!  Combine jellies into mega-slimes to keep your space-friend Huey fed! The longer the slimes, the more points you get. But beware: if Huey's stomach is empty, it's game over!

title: Hungry in the Dungeon
description: A bite-sized Game Boy eat-em-up made in GB Studio. Escape the Tomb of Eetemhup in a first-person dungeon crawler style, but with fast paced action combat. 7 short but difficult levels in total. Lots of mysterious creatures to eat.

title: Hungry Knight
description:
Hungry Knight, a determined little adventurer with a big appetite. Fight your way through a strange wasteland, keep yourself fed every ten seconds, and accomplish a miracle. Others may perish at your hand, but such is the remorselessness of this world. 

A challenging action game. It's hard, but you can do it! Be brave.

title: Hunt The Gwumbus
description: The Gwumbus lives in a cave of twenty connected rooms.  There is little light. Rely on senses other than sight. Born of magma, the monster reeks of sulfur from two rooms away. Drafts foretell of pitfalls. Listen for hostile creatures.  Shoot the Gwumbus from an adjacent room. Missed shots can rebound and kill you.

title: Hunter in the Lost Forest
alternate_titles: Hunter in the Lost Forest (World) (En) (GB Compatible) (Aftermarket) (Unl)
description:
Advance through a total of 20 stages while defeating enemies.
The key to victory is to assess the actions of the enemies appearing from 4 directions!
Take aim and draw your bow while paying attention to obstacles such as trees and logs on the map.


When you defeat enemies on the map, there is a random chance that a heart will appear that will restore your health when touched.
Lucky if it comes out! Let's use it to survive.
Please note that if you take this heart, your score will decrease. It's up to you whether you want to increase your score or recover your HP!

title: Hunter X Hunter: Hunter no Keifu
alternate_titles: HUNTER×HUNTER ～ハンターの系譜～ | HUNTER x HUNTER ~ Hunter's Genealogy ~
description: Everything is a hunter legend that starts here. Aim to become a hunter by participating in the "Hunter Exam" that appeared in the Weekly Shonen Jump series "Hunter x Hunter". A character who has become a hunter can be selected as a master when creating a new character, and episodes of that technique and item can be reproduced and passed on to the next generation. By combining the items that appear in the game, more than 400 types of items will appear. It is also linked to the "Hunter x Hunter" card released by Bandai, and you can get various effects such as acquiring items by entering the 8-digit code printed on the card. The package includes 3 out of 6 original limited edition Carddass.

title: Hunter X Hunter: Kindan no Hihou
alternate_titles: HUNTER×HUNTER 禁断の秘宝 | HUNTER x HUNTER ~ Forbidden Hallows ~
description: On the way back to Whale Island after leaving the sky stadium, a storm hits the ship and the ship is in distress. After arriving at a mysterious island, Gon begins exploring the island in search of the missing Kirua. There are various archaeological sites on the island, full of dangerous beasts and traps! Can you really solve the mystery of this island and find the lost Kirua? The second GBC-only game, a completely original story. The stage is structured according to the atmosphere of the original manga. Whereas the previous work was a simulation, this time it is a side-scrolling type action game in which Gon and Kirua are very active. There are experience points and levels, so even formidable enemies can easily win if they challenge after raising the level! Recommended for those who are not good at action games!

title: Hype: The Time Quest
description: Hype: The Time Quest is an action and adventure game where you can interact with NPCs in fighting as well as in dialogue in search of information, goods, and services. You play has Hype, a medieval knight who happens to fall victim to the curse of Barnak. During this time, he is thrown into the past here he must find his way back. Will his future become worst from anything he does during this time in the past?

title: Ide Yosuke no Mahjong Kyoushitsu GB
alternate_titles: 井出洋介の麻雀教室GB | Yosuke Ide's Mahjong Class GB
description: Mahjong learning & actual battle with professional Yosuke Ide, who is familiar on TV, as a lecturer. Mahjong lessons are illustrated with illustrations that are difficult to understand just by explaining. It contains about 500 questions and a large amount of mahjong quizzes, and even if you can't answer correctly, you can follow up with kind and polite explanations. Even people who don't know mahjong are okay. From the name of the tile to the score calculation method, you can learn mahjong anytime, anywhere with this one.

title: In The Dark
description: In The Dark is a brain-teasing assembly of puzzles where there is but one goal - turn off all of the lights. Each light when turned on or off will flip the states of the ones around it. Featuring: - A Story Mode with 100 progressively harder curated puzzles. - With over 500 possible puzzle combinations, Random Mode offers countless hours of casual puzzling fun!

title: In The Dark 2
description:
A devastating virus threatens to cripple the Galactic Federations Chief Neural Core, threatening to put an end to intergalactic travel and turning a galaxy spanning empire into mere island settlements - disconnected and alone.

Ikalo Pann, Captain of the Starship Leviathan, must track down the source of this virus and bring the unknown terrorist before the Federation to answer for their crimes. An encrypted message sent by a dead man offers a single thread to unwind the mystery. Within are a set of galactic coordinates and a brief message: "Come find me, Pann..."

Join Ikalo as she solves hundreds of complex puzzles, explores planets for clues and uncovers a deep science fiction mystery.

title: Indiana Jones and the Infernal Machine
description: The Communists are trying to reassemble a machine that will open the door to a parallel universe. However, many of the key parts are missing. It is up to you as Indiana Jones to search the globe and recover the pieces before the Soviets do. You will have to run, jump, swim, and fight his way through 19 levels of action. Luckily, you can use a whip, pistol, machine gun, and grenades on the Soviet soldiers, spiders, scorpions, snakes, wolves, jaguars, sharks, jellyfish, and poisonous lice you encounter. After completing a level, you will be treated to a cinematic clip that will advance the plot and reveal the password you need to continue the game. The world will only be safe when the missing parts are recovered and the Communist threat is quelled in INDIANA JONES AND THE INFERNAL MACHINE.

title: Infinity
description:
An ancient, nameless evil stirs beneath the earth, twisting the land and its people alike with its corrupting force. Two rival nations careen toward war, as a shadowy figure arms them both with unholy weapons of immense power. And a disgraced knight is called upon to overcome the centuries-old pain that divides these peoples, his own grief, and malevolent forces fanning the flames of hate. This epic tale frames a roleplaying game with a unique tactical battle system, a detailed world with over 50 explorable areas and more than 100 items, and beautiful 8-bit graphics — all to immerse you into the world of Infinity!

Originally developed by Affinix Software from 1999 to 2001 towards the end of the Game Boy Color’s retail lifespan, the shift in the market towards the Game Boy Advance (released in 2001) resulted in publishing struggles for the game. As a result, the original Affinix team went their separate ways, leaving Infinity a what-if that was formally canceled in 2002. Yet, 15 years later, following repeated interest in what was seen as one of the last Game Boy Color games, an unfinished version of Infinity was released as a free ROM in 2016. 

Now, for the 20th anniversary of Infinity, we, Incube8 Games, have assembled a team consisting of both Affinix originals and fresh faces to finally complete Infinity and give it the physical cartridge release for the Game Boy Color that it always deserved! If you are interested in helping to finally make Infinity a reality, please subscribe to our newsletter to receive updates about the Kickstarter campaign and the project.

title: Inspector Gadget: Operation Madkactus
country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: The evil Dr. Claw is about to unleash the deadly MadKactus virus on the world, and it's up to Inspector Gadget to stop him. Since Gadget always needs a little help, his niece Penny and their dog Brain are at the ready to make their contribution. You, as the enigmatic Inspector, will have to work your way through 20 levels that span five different worlds. Luckily, many of your famous devices are available to help out including the helicopter, spring arms, rocket-powered roller skates, and hammer hat. If there is something that you can't do as Gadget, you can switch characters and use Penny or Brain to get past an obstacle or solve a puzzle. Gather up your go-go gadgets and get ready to save the world from Dr. Claw in INSPECTOR GADGET.

title: Inspector Waffles Early Days
alternate_titles: Inspector Waffles Early Days (v2) (World) (Aftermarket) (Goloso Games)
description: This time, follow Waffles in his first days as a Inspector and prove to everyone that you are more than just a rookie. Find clues, report to your partner and solve cases!

title: International Karate 2000
description: The classic karate fighter is back on the Game Boy Color, remade with the nostalgic gameplay that fans around the world will adore, and new playmodes to keep the action fresh and exciting. HIYAH!

title: International Rally
alternate_titles: Cross Country Racing (EU) | It's a World Rally
description: International Rally is a Racing game, developed by Konami Computer Entertainment Nagoya and published by Konami, which was released in 1999.

title: International Superstar Soccer 2000
description: Konami's premier soccer franchise, INTERNATIONAL SUPERSTAR SOCCER, has come to the Game Boy Color. You can choose your team from 36 international squads that include traditional powerhouses like Brazil and Italy, as well as some less-respected teams like the United States and Cameroon. After you select your team you will compete in pool play for the International Cup. If you are not ready for the international limelight, you can play and Exhibition game or participate in a League. During the game there are number of coaching options available, like the ability to pick your formations and match-ups. When you get a big winning streak going, you can keep track of your progress with a password. Now you can enjoy the world's most popular sport without getting dirty with INTERNATIONAL SUPERSTAR SOCCER.

title: International Superstar Soccer 99
description: So, you don't think realistic international soccer is possible on the Game Boy Color? Think again; INTERNATIONAL SUPERSTAR SOCCER 99 has all of the rules, physics, and intensity of the real thing. You can play as any of 32 worldwide squads, competing for the rights to the International Cup. Choose whether you want to play three, five, or seven-minute halves, and decide whether you want your overtime decisions to be made Golden Goal or Extended Time-style. The gameplay and decisions are so detailed, you can even select your starting lineup and reserve players, pick a formation, and set up your own strategies. You can engage in any number of exhibition games (alone or against a friend), but the real fun begins in International Cup mode, in which you claw your way up from a ranking of 32nd in the world. Beginners and seasoned veterans alike will get plenty of mileage out of the game, as there are three different difficulty settings to master.

title: International Track & Field
alternate_titles: Hyper Olympic Series - Track & Field GB
description: With International Track & Field it takes a little bit more to be a champion. Ten grueling decathalon events put your stamina and your will power to the test as you battle it out with athletes from around the world. Heart-pumping gameplay and vibrant graphics truly capture the pageantry of International competition. Be careful not to get too caught up in the global spotlight - or you may find yourself missing from the victory podium!

title: Invasion of the Geminorons
alternate_titles: Invasion of the Geminorons (World) (Aftermarket) (Unl)
description:
Invasion of the Geminorons is a sci-fi puzzle game for Game Boy Color.

Go head-to-head with a gauntlet of aliens from the planet Beta Geminorum B, in a battle for the future of humanity. Match gems to deal damage, recharge shields, and power special abilities, and defeat the alien fleet to save the Earth!

title: Iron Cor Stainless
description: How far are you willing to go for your nation? Follow Agent Seo as she learns who her true allies and foes are in the struggle for freedom.

title: Island Fever
description: The Island of Diego Garcia has long been kept secret by US and British Governments. As a new recruit stationed at Diego, It's up to you to explore and discover what has the government been hiding, and what is driving the Island's troops to insanity.

title: Itsudemo Pachinko GB: CR Monster House
alternate_titles: いつでもパチンコGB CRモンスターハウス | Pachinko GB CR Monster House at any time
description: The super popular pachinko machine "CR Monster House" is now available on GB! Faithfully reproduce from the movement of the ball to the reach action and the pattern of the jackpot. There are two modes in the game, "Story mode" where you play against monster characters such as the familiar witch Franken with quotas, and "Play mode" where you can find a strategy according to the platform, and the position and inclination of the nails are highlighted. There is also a function that you can check. It also has a backup function that allows you to save your money and progress, so you can easily play games while you are on the move or in a little spare time. This is the only way to play pachinko in GB!

title: Itty Bitty Adventures
description:
In Itty Bitty Adventures you play as Valiant Séance, a "small dog" looking for his lost mum. 

The game plays like a typical platformer for the most part. 

If Valiant collides with enemies turn based combat is initiated.

Valiant can level up and increase his ability to bark and bite enemies into submission.

There are 2 other playable characters that can be unlocked through exploring.

title: J.League Excite Stage GB
alternate_titles: J.LEAGUE エキサイトステージGB
description: A ported version of the soccer game that was a big hit with the Super Nintendo version. The appearance clubs are all 16 J1 teams at the time of 1999. There are a total of 256 players, 16 players per club. There are 4 modes. "Pre-season match" is a practice match with only one match. Let's get used to the operation here and challenge the J-League match. In the "J-League match", one team will be selected from all 16 teams, and 15 games and 2 championship games will be played on the 1st and 2nd stages. In "Communication Battle", you can enjoy a heated game of two-player battle. The match results are saved, and if you win, the number of spectators will gradually increase. In "Options", you can freely set the match time, stadium, rules, etc.

title: J.League Excite Stage Tactics
alternate_titles: Jリーグエキサイトステージ タクティクス
description: A full-scale simulation soccer game with J League (J1 and J2) + World Mode (Japan National Team). He becomes a manager when practicing, becomes a player during training and games, and sometimes becomes a manager. On the management side, you can not only get transfers and change directors, but you can also set admission fees. The official data of 16 teams for J1, 11 teams for J2, and 28 teams in total including the Japan national team are used. If you add 23 overseas countries and hidden teams, 52 teams will appear in the game. Up to 26 people can be registered for each team data. Player data is over 1300! The face of the edit player can also be created by the montage method. Of course, by using a communication cable, the trained teams can play against each other.

title: Jagainu-kun
alternate_titles: じゃがいぬくん | Dogtato
description: "Jagainu-kun" is a music picture book game (a heartwarming dance that enhances the sense of rhythm). Choose story mode when playing for the first time. As the story goes on, the dance begins with a certain trigger. There are choices in the middle of the story, and the dance songs and the characters you meet will change depending on how you proceed. At first, the purpose is to select various routes and collect characters and dances. When you finish the story, the result will be reflected and you can make your own picture book, you can read it in "picture book mode", and you can also enjoy dancing with the songs and characters collected on the way. Unlike traditional music games, there are no commands, so it's simple, easy to remember, and easy to get used to.

title: Jaguar Mishin Sashi Senyou Soft: Mario Family
alternate_titles: ジャガーミシン刺しゅう専用ソフト「ＭＡＲＩＯ　ＦＡＭＩＬＹ」
description:
Contains 32 patterns of Mario family cut embroidery data such as Mario, Yoshi, Princess Peach, Wario, and Goomba
Easily embroider with Game Boy Color! !!

title: Jankyuusei: Cosplay Paradise
alternate_titles: 雀級生 コスプレ★パラダイス
description: The main character is Tsumorou, a Gutara university student who is scheduled to graduate next spring. The major is the teacher's egg in the teaching process. The time for practical training is finally approaching for the protagonist who has been a student. However, I wanted to practice teaching differently from others, so I decided to go to two schools and do each for a week. How can we make this training fruitful ... So the hero wondered. I wanted to make a club by making the best use of mahjong, which I am good at, and build a relationship of trust with the students. If you can't get the trust in your area of ​​expertise, then the hero isn't a teacher. Will there be a demon or a snake? Okite-breaking educational training is about to begin! A dream mahjong battle with 12 characters, straddling the two worlds of the two major elf titles, "Classmate" and "Lower Classmate"! There are two game modes, a "free match mode" where you can enjoy mahjong in earnest with two or four players, and a "story mode" where you can make the other girl cosplay in various ways if you win the game. The cosplay screen scrolls all over! You can see the girl's slightly embarrassing facial expressions and gestures. If you clear "Story Mode", you can proceed to "Interleague Play" where you play mahjong with the characters of the two schools. Cosplay that cannot be seen in story mode is added.

title: Janosch: Das große Panama Spiel
alternate_titles: Janosch: Das grosse Panama-Spiel
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Jayro's GAME BOY™ Test Cartridge
description:
This is the world's first test cartridge for the Game Boy Color!

Nintendo made an official test cartridge for the original Game Boy, but let's face it... It sucks. The tests work, but they aren't geared to test the Game Boy Color's specific hardware.

This test cartridge has set out to fully replace Nintendo's official one.  This ROM was created using GB Studio v4!

title: Jeff Gordon XS Racing
description: You can experience the future of racing today with JEFF GORDON XS RACING. Choose from five different cars and race on seven different tracks. You can use the Time Trial mode to get the fastest lap time possible on an empty track. In the Championship mode, you will have to race through two seasons. The first season has you racing against five other cars, and you must finish in first place overall to gain access to the second season. In the second season you will face seven other competitors, including Jeff Gordon. Win the second season, and you can challenge Gordon to a one-on-one race on any track you choose. Should your friends want in on the action, they can join you via a link cable. Get behind the wheel of a futuristic racecar and take first place in JEFF GORDON XS RACING.

title: Jeremy McGrath Supercross 2000
description: Professional supercross racing comes to the Game Boy Color with JEREMY MCGRATH SUPERCROSS 2000. You can race with or against professional motocross riders like Jeremy McGrath, Travis Pastrana, Kevin Windham, Sebastian Tortelli, Jimmy Button, John Dowd, and Greg Albertyn. When you have selected the proper rider, you can race on any track in the Arcade mode. For a bigger challenge, work your way through the ranks to become champion in the 80cc, 125cc, and 150cc Seasons. In all of the races, you can gain an advantage by performing stunts to make power-ups appear, which you can collect to give you an advantage. Do you have what it takes to beat McGrath and the other professionals in JEREMY MCGRATH SUPERCROSS 2000?

title: Jet de Go!: Let's Go By Airliner
alternate_titles: JETでGO!
description: "JET de GO!", Which was popular in PS, is now available as GBC exclusive software. You can easily enjoy the actual aviation operations from takeoff, landing, and cruising. Weather changes such as rain and snow, and flights in the evening and midnight are also beautifully reproduced. Of course, you can take off and land at real airports (New Chitose Airport, Tokyo International Airport, Komatsu Airport, Nagoya Airport, Kansai International Airport, Matsuyama Airport, Hiroshima West Airport, Fukuoka Airport, Naha Airport) through the actual route. .. The initial appearances are three models, "J-31", "B767-300", and "B747-400D". As the game progresses, the aircraft becomes available.

title: Jeux Olympipiques DX
description: Play as Phrygidaire, the mascot of the Paparis 2024 Olympic Games, who must light the Olympic cauldron with the flame.

title: Jim Henson's Bear in the Big Blue House
description: Come spend a day of fun and discovery with Bear and all his pals as you play through delightful lessons like Pondball, Feathers, and Popcorn. The BIG BLUE HOUSE has never been this much fun!

title: Jim Henson's The Muppets
description: Dr. Bunsen Honeydew has developed a new time machine, so he invites all of the Muppets over to see the new invention. However, something goes awry and the Muppets are sent back in time. Fortunately, Kermit and Animal were running late and were not involved in the mishap. Now these two must travel back in time and rescue their friends. You will take control of Kermit and Animal as they travel through six different time periods that contain a total of 24 levels. Help Kermit defeat enemies with paper airplanes, and use his super jump to collect items. Animal will pound enemies into submission with drumsticks and will shake items loose with his stomp. Will the two heroes be able to save the gang? Find out by playing JIM HENSON'S MUPPETS.

title: Jimmy White's Cueball
alternate_titles: Jimmy White's Cue Ball
description: Jimmy White's Cueball is a pool game, developed by Vicarious Visions and published by Vatical Entertainment, which was released in Europe in 2000.

title: Jingles
description:
Jingles, the most revered cat in town had been out hunting all night. He was just settling down into his usual 14 hours of sleep, when all of a sudden he is rudely woken by the dreaded sound of the alarm clock.

It soon becomes clear that everything is not okay,  Jingles’ yarn balls appear to be missing. Has he carelessly misplaced his balls, or is there something bigger, more sinister going on? 

Can Jingles recover his yarn balls and solve this mystery, before it’s too late?

It’s up to you!

title: Jinsei Game Tomodachi Takusan Tsukurou yo!
alternate_titles: 人生ゲーム 友達たくさんつくろうよ! | Life game, Let's make a lot of friends!
description: Players create their own characters with montages (400,000 face patterns) and start with a baby. While growing "intellect," "physical strength," "sense," and "morality," clear life events such as going on to school, getting a job, and getting married, and aim to become a millionaire. Up to 50 characters created by the player can be registered and exchanged with a communication cable. In addition, you can enjoy "today's fortune-telling" and "compatibility fortune-telling" using the registered character data, and you can print it out with a pocket printer.

title: Jisedai Beegoma Battle Beyblade
alternate_titles: ベイブレード 次世代ベーゴマバトル | Beyblade Next Generation Beigoma Battle
description: An action RPG with a completely new type of beigoma called "Beyblade" as a motif. Beyblade contains spirits called "bits", each of which has its own attributes and is compatible with battles. In addition, some bits have special moves and combo moves, so you can enjoy the battle strategically.

title: Jissen ni Yakudatsu Tsumego
alternate_titles: Jissen ni Yakudatsu
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Jissen Yakudatsu Tsumego
description: A puzzle game where players solve life and death go problems.  It is solely go puzzles, there is no AI or board game aspect to it.

title: Joel's Bizarre PokéVenture
alternate_titles: Joel's Bizarre PokeVenture
description: In it, members of Vinesauce get kidnapped by an unknown person and turned into Pokémon. You play as Joel, and must find his Pokémon friends, collect them all and then get them turned back into humans, and find out who was responsible.

title: Jogger
description:
Guide your intrepid Jogger across the canal, across the four-lane motor-way, and across the river and finally through a gap in the fence.

Your Jogger might avoid the crocs in the canal and the barges; he might dodge the lorries and the cars on both sides of the motor-way; he might squeeze past the alligators and steam-ships in the river but will he get cut up by the menacing lawn-mowers on the motor-way central reservation?

The more Joggers that make it home the faster the arcade action becomes and the more lawn-mowers join in the action. When you've lost 3 Joggers it's time to get another team together.

title: Joryuu Janshi ni Chousen GB
alternate_titles: 女流雀士に挑戦GB～私達に挑戦してネ!～ | Challenge the female swordsman GB -Challenge us!-
description: A full-scale 4-player mahjong game in which 6 young female mahjong players appear in live action. Choose from 6 rooms (modes) with the name of the sparrow and play. "Yoko's room" where you can freely set rules, "Kaori's room" with old socks mahjong rules, Dobon, one shot, second-kill mahjong with horses "Sayaka's room", hell mahjong "Ayumi" "Room of No", "Room of Chisato", a series of mahjong in the Dongfeng War, and "Room of Yuri", a super-inflated mahjong with a high score if there are cracks and yakitori. Since the data such as the sparrow style, striking line, and personality of each sparrow is taken in detail, you can fully enjoy the game with the female sparrow who has each individuality. Even beginners can easily enjoy playing against young female Ryujakushi.

title: Judy's Adventure
description: You fall asleep one day at the base of a tree. When you wake up you notice that your key has been stolen! You must platform through various areas to get your house key.

title: Judy's Adventure DX
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: JumpStart: Dino Adventure Field Trip
description: JumpStart: Dino Adventure Field Trip is an Action game, developed by Digital Illusions and published by Knowledge Adventure Inc., which was released in 2001.

title: Jungle Trouble
description:
The purpose of the game is to get home as quickly as possible from the depths of the Jungle.

To achieve this goal you must first cross the river using the stepping stones to avoid the crocodile, and then carry your axe to the forest.

Here you must chop down the trees, but watch out for the monkeys who will snatch your axe.  When all the trees have been felled you must swing over the pit of fire and run home

title: Juukou Senki Bullet Battlers
alternate_titles: 銃鋼戦記バレットバトラー | Gun Steel Senki Barrett Butler
description: A role-playing game in which you control a huge armed warrior "Bullet Butler" and seek the legendary "Ultra-Ancient Butler" in a different world "Alha Raus". We will proceed with the "collecting" and "raising" games of butlers with their own characteristics. Butler has a variety of shapes and abilities such as human type, insect type, animal type, marine life type, fantasy monster type, and dinosaur type. You can also search for hidden "rare" butlers, exchange data, and play against each other. As Butler grows up, he will speak to the player.

title: K.O.: The Pro Boxing
alternate_titles: K.O.ザプロボクシング
description: Supervised by JBC (Japan Boxing Association). The boxing life is beautifully reproduced in the game. Steady practice is a training simulation, and the game is a real-time action that actually operates the trained boxer. You can create and select your favorite boxer, and there are countless boxer creation patterns such as height, class, and face. It's up to the player to take advantage of their abilities and to train to reinforce their weaknesses. Not only the basic movements of boxing, but also the special moves unique to the game are hidden.

title: Kaijin Zona
alternate_titles: 怪人ゾナー | Phantom Zona
description: A "riddle venture" game that combines an adventure game in which riddles and attractive (?) Characters appear. The main character is an elementary school student who likes riddles. One day, a letter "Nazoler Techo" arrived from the principal of Nanzo Elementary School. The letter said that he wanted him to transfer to Nanzo Elementary School and protect the school. Immediately transfer to another school, win the "Nazoler Battle" learned from the monster Zoner, and defeat the enemy. There are a total of 600 riddles you can play in the game! In addition, you can play "Nazolar Remote Control" where you can get a new riddle by decoding the received data when you send a signal with a TV or video remote control, and "Communication Nazoler Battle" where you play against your friends using a communication cable.

title: Kaitei Taisensou!! Treasure World
alternate_titles: 海底伝説 トレジャーワールド | Undersea Legend Treasure World
description: An adventure game where you travel around the world to find your friends and legendary treasures. You can enjoy the real thrill of the eternal theme "Treasure Hunt" that everyone is interested in. In order to break the seal of the ancient civilization, the main character becomes a treasure hunter looking for the ancient civilization that has sunk to the seabed due to crustal movement, and with the hint of the treasure called Great Treasure that sleeps in the seas around the world, the legendary treasure World Treasure Go on a voyage to look for it. Make full use of various items such as a variety of mini games and submarines to raise treasure.

title: Kakurenbo Battle Monster Tactics
alternate_titles: モンスタータクティクス
description: The monster hunting tournament, a specialty of the Kingdom of Iraldi, was held for the first time in five years. Of course, the main character Kevin aims only for the championship. The rules are simple! All you have to do is go through a pitch-black dungeon and defeat the monsters. However, in addition to seeing only a limited view in the dungeon, the attack is a turn system with a time limit. Therefore, the first step to victory is to devise a strategy by believing in your own intuition and as much time as you can. If you defeat a monster, you can get Montaku as proof. , You can take out a special ability called Montaku skill from Montaku, and you will power up by acquiring it. With infrared communication, you can compare your friends with Montak.

title: Kakutou Ryouri Densetsu Bistro Recipe: Food Battle version
alternate_titles: 格闘料理伝説ビストロレシピ 激闘★フードンバトル編 | Fighting Cuisine Legend Bistro Recipe Fierce Fight ★ Hoodon Battle Edition | Kakutou Ryouri Densetsu Bistro Recipe - Gekitou Foodon Battle Hen
description: The purpose is to rescue the father "Tsukiji" of the main character "Zen" who was kidnapped by the evil chef "Don Cook" and restore peace to the world. Zen can summon a monster called "Foodon" by combining a card called "Recipe Card" with the dish he cooked. Don Cook's minion "Pishocker", who blocks Zen's path, will be confronted using this Hoodon. Collect, grow, and fight in various genres of Japanese, Western, Chinese, and ethnic foods. If you can cook well using abundantly prepared ingredients, a delicious dish (strong foodon) will be completed. Communication battle is also possible.

title: Kakutou Ryouri Densetsu Bistro Recipe: Kettou Bistgarm Version
alternate_titles: 格闘料理伝説ビストロレシピ 決闘★ビストガルム編 | Fighting Cuisine Legend Bistro Recipe Duel ★ Bistgarm Edition | Kakutou Ryouri Densetsu Bistro Recipe - Kettou Bistgarm Hen
description: The sequel to "Fighting Cooking Legend Bistro Recipe Fierce Fighting ★ Food'n Battle Edition". The main character, Zen, can summon a monster called "Foodon" by matching a card called "Recipe Card" with the dish he cooked. Collect, grow and fight various genres of Hoodon! A "Topping Research Screen" that Petan advises has been added, so you can see the compatibility between Hoodon and topping items. 95 new Hoodons are participating! Four Hoodons standing at the top of each of Japanese, Western, Chinese, and Ethnic are set as rare Hoodons that you can get for the first time by entering the event password. Exchange and battle are possible using a communication cable.

title: Kandume Monsters Parfait
alternate_titles: カンヅメモンスター パフェ | Canned Monster Parfait
description: A new version of "Canning Monster", a training simulation game that grows and strengthens monsters born from canning. Communicate with monsters in "cultivation mode" and perform gem battles in "battle mode". In battle mode, you will fight 4 monsters. Battles use gems, which have various effects. When all league matches are won, the monster conveys love for the player. Of course, if you use a communication cable, you can play against your friends, and you can also make records and pictorial books of monsters. There is also a puzzle game "Crimp" that you will be addicted to!

title: Kanji Boy
alternate_titles: 漢字BOY
description: Difficulty can be set at a level based on the Kanji Kentei from 7 balls to 2nd grade. The flow of the game can be played according to tasks, characters can be introduced, and children and adults can enjoy learning. Various other mini games are also available. There are also introductions to the Kanji Kentei and mock exams, which support players. The player starts after selecting the stage to challenge (6 stages in total).

title: Kanji Boy 2
alternate_titles: 漢字BOY 2
description: Learning software supervised by the Japan Kanji Aptitude Testing Foundation. Learning software that is constructed based on questions that were actually asked in the past. This time, we have added "Children's Kanji Kentei Mode" and "Semi-Second Grade" for elementary school students and foreigners, and renewed a mini-game using kanji that can be played to take a break from the game. If you use a communication cable, you can play with your friends in the Kanji fast-press problem.

title: Kanji Boy 3
alternate_titles: 漢字BOY 3
description: The third installment of "Kanji BOY" that makes you smarter while playing games. The number of questions recorded is over 7,000! As you play, you will naturally acquire kanji. There are two game modes. There is a "existing question collection mode" where you can play the exams from the 2nd to 10th grades that have been asked in the past, and a "mini game mode" where you can get idioms about your body, health, animals, and living.

title: Kanji de Puzzle
alternate_titles: 漢字deパズル
description: You can enjoy the world of puzzle game magazines published in various ways on GB. Most of the kanji to be asked are 1006 kanji learned in the 1st to 6th grades of elementary school. Acquire perfect while playing antonyms, synonyms, stroke order, okurigana, homophones and idioms. There are four types of games: Kanji quiz "Spartan Z", Kanji crossword "Kankuro", "Kanji puzzle", and original puzzle "Elephant Dragon". It can also be used as a kanji learning tool for children from general education.

title: Karamuchou wa Oosawagi! Porinkiis to Okashina Nakamatachi
alternate_titles: カラムー町は大さわぎ!～ポリンキーズとおかしな仲間たち～ | Karamoo Town is a big rush! ~ Polinkies and strange friends ~
description: A sweets museum "Koikeya Memorial Hall" has been opened in "Karamoo Town"! Rare sweets from around the world are collected, but I haven't found the main sweets yet. At this rate, the museum will not be open! "Okay, then let's all go find it," said Polinkies and Grandma Hee! An action puzzle game using the characters of Koike-ya. You can play from your favorite world in all 5 worlds (20 stages each), and collect 3 keys in each stage to aim for the goal. Mini games are hidden in each world, so find them! There are also dedicated games that can only be played when played on GBC. You can print cute characters and collected sweets on stickers with a pocket printer along with the data.

title: Karan Koron Gakuen: Hanafuda - Mahjong
alternate_titles: 華蘭虎龍学園～花札/麻雀～ | Hualan Tiger Dragon Academy -Hanafuda / Mahjong- | GB Karan Koron Gakuen - Hanafuda Mahjong
description: The familiar classic game Hanafuda and Mahjong are coupled with GBC. A unique feature of handheld game consoles, you can easily enjoy Hanafuda and Mahjong anywhere. Let's enjoy the game with 16 cute Hanaran Toryu Gakuen girls who appear in the game. Hanafuda is based on the basic rule of "Koikoi", and there are three modes: "Tournament mode" where you can win out, "Dan certification mode" where you can be certified by winning, and "Competition mode" where you can play against your friends. Mahjong is a three-player mode with four players: "brute force mode" where you can play against all characters, "computer mode" where you can play a tournament-style battle, and "competition mode" where you can enjoy playing against friends.

title: Karate Joe
description: There's a new boss in town, and his gangs are taking over the city. He's got thugs on every corner waiting to take you out. But you're not a run-of-the-mill videogame character. You're Karate Joe, and you're going to fight your way through 18 levels to free the city in this side-scrolling action-adventure.

title: Karpe Diem: Pokemon Fishing Contest
alternate_titles: Karpe Diem - Pokemon Fishing Contest (birdup) (v1.0) | Karpe Diem - Pokemon Fishing Contest
description:
It's that time of year again... Karpe Diem!

The famous festival of the Joisey region brings travelers from far and wide to compete in a fishing competition overseen by the widely adored Mayor Slowpoke. Set out on an adventure to become the next Karpe Diem champion, face off against a worthy rival, meet helpful strangers, and solve thematic puzzles.

This fan-made Pokemon slice of life game strips out longtime series mechanics such as battling, badges, and evolutions to instead focus on things like kicking back, relaxing, and reeling in a whopper.

title: Kaseki Sousei Reborn II: Monster Digger
alternate_titles: 化石創世リボーン II ～モンスターディガー～ | Fossil Genesis Reborn II ~ Monster Digger ~
description: On that day, I set foot on "Hokora", which has long been said not to be entered. According to a strange doctor who lives in the town, a mysterious underground world inhabited by unknown creatures spreads out beyond the hole of "Hokora", and fossils with life are buried in it ...・. Apparently, the guy next door, who is always fighting, went looking for a legendary monster. "Let's lose! I'm going on an adventure with courage!" At that time, the doctor's words came to my mind. "Without the power of friendship, you can't know the world ..." The fossil excavation game is back! Collect the fossil fragments buried in the dungeon and revive the monsters on the Lab's Reborn Machine. Various monsters can be created depending on the attributes and combinations of fossils. Some monsters evolve when the parameters of a specific character exceed a certain value. Strategicity has increased due to the advantages and disadvantages of the character's orientation, the compatibility between attributes, and the character's "friendship parameter". You can exchange monsters with a communication cable, or use a pocket printer to seal monsters.

title: Katou Hifumi Kudan no Shogi Kyoushitsu
alternate_titles: 加藤一二三九段の将棋教室 | Katou Hifumi Kudan: Shougi Kyoushitsu | Katou Hifumi Kudan: Shōgi Kyoushitsu
description: There are 173 questions of tsume shogi, and a mode to challenge the problems created by "Hifumi Kato" Kudan for this game, so you can learn shogi in earnest.

title: Kawaii Pet Shop Monogatari
alternate_titles: かわいいペットショップ物語 | Cute pet shop story
description: A new sense RPG that raises pets while running a pet shop. The protagonist runs a pet shop on behalf of a sick grandmother and searches for a remedy for her. Pet shops can receive rewards if they receive requests from customers (want pets, deposit pets, pet medicine, etc.) and clear them by the deadline. Pets can be raised at the ranch in the pet shop, and the raised pets can participate in competitions (comparison of strength, foot race, etc.). Including the remedy for grandma, the medicine finds and formulates the ingredients by itself.

title: Kawaii Pet Shop Monogatari 2
alternate_titles: かわいいペットショップ物語 2 | Cute pet shop story 2
description: The second pet breeding RP game with very cute animals. The player manages the requests of customers who visit the pet shop well. Customers' requests include pet capture, custody, breeding, and drug preparation. The number of pets has increased from 38 in the previous work to 60. Lots of cute mammals to unusual reptiles. There are also 10 types of competitions such as disc catch competitions, gliding competitions, and diving competitions that test the abilities of the pets that have been raised. You can use the communication function to hold competitions and exchange pets.

title: Keep the Balance
description: Keep the balance! is a puzzle game, where you have to balance a big weighing scale. The longer it stays in balance the more point you gain. To do this, you have a catapult at your disposal, the objects you need to use to balance the scale are given to you by conveyor belt. One on the left and one on the right. But these objects differ in weight, so you must carefully choose the scales bucket you're going to put the objects in. To make things worse, all kinds of trouble appear on screen to make it just a little bit more challenging. Like crocodiles that eat object or jokers that throw around playing cards offsetting your carefully balance scale. The game stages 5 different game worlds each divided into 16 levels.

title: Keibajou he Gyoukou! Wide
alternate_titles: 競馬場へ行こう!ワイド | Let's go to the racetrack! Wide | Keibajou e Ikou! Wide
description: Recommended for horse racing beginners and young couples who go to the racetrack like a date! A tool that allows you to easily predict horse racing simply by entering the winning odds. If you anticipate the newly introduced wide betting ticket, the hit rate will increase further. No detailed information input. The only data required for forecasting is the winning odds displayed in newspapers and racetracks. If there is a horse that is pushed or you want to exclude from the forecast among the racehorses, you can set the evaluation and reflect it in the forecast. You can select the purchase tendency of betting tickets from the four patterns of "Random", "Solid favorite", "Aim for holes", and "Aim for large holes", and the expected results will change accordingly. Of course, it comes with a convenient help function that explains horse racing terms.

title: Keitai Denjuu Telefang: Power Version
alternate_titles: 携帯電獣テレファング パワーバージョン
description:
2020. One of the most popular games for children who had few places to play was to use their mobile phones to go to the electric beast world and make friends with them. Since I get a phone number from Denju as a proof of my friend, making friends with a stronger Denju has begun to become a new status. In order to make friends with stronger electric beasts, children enter the inner part of the electric beast world, but there are electric beasts that have not yet come into contact with humans in the inner part, and the electric beast that is the bodyguard of the children Children are enthusiastic about fighting! A new boy / girl called "Denju Tsukai" has appeared, and the Denju boom has reached its climax. The main character, Shigeki, lived a life unrelated to such an electric beast boom, but decided to go to the electric beast world with the appearance of one electric beast. A new sensation RPG that makes full use of the functions of mobile phones to clear the game by turning "Keitai Denju Telefang" serialized in Comic BomBom into a game. The main character is Shigeki, a boy who longs for "T. Fanger" who uses electric beasts (monsters). The purpose is to battle with Denju, get the phone number of Denju, make friends with many Denju, and complete the address book of Denju.
