description:
Deal with the strange and insane inhabitants of The Island as you explore a series of ruins that were discovered beneath the surface.

It’s your 13th birthday so the government says you’re old enough to die in a hole! (It’s all in the name of adventure, so it’s cool.)

Choose from 13 starters and dive into the depths of The Ruins, where every victory unlocks new opportunities. Defeat five critters to open the next door and claim loot, but you’ll face a tough choice: enhance your team or trade treasures for essential supplies. Progress through the site by defeating instructors to unlock more ANIMALs and resources for your expeditions. Adventure has never been so wild—or deadly!

title: Polar Peril
description: Polar Peril is a puzzle adventure game for the Gameboy. You must push, slide & dive your way through arctic mazes so you can mail a very important letter.

title: Polaris SnoCross
description: Get on a snowmobile and drive your way to victory with POLARIS SNOCROSS. Try to master 10 different courses that take you through ovals, twisting bobsled runs, and several treks through the wilderness. When you are ready for some competition, try to win the Tournament Cups, where you will have to take first place from two other racers. After winning, you will be able to upgrade your vehicle before moving on to the next race. With three different Cups to win, there is plenty of racing action. If you get tired of racing computer-controlled opponents, hook up a link cable to challenge your friends to a race. You will become the greatest snowmobiler of all time in POLARIS SNOCROSS.

title: Pong: The Next Level
description: PONG is the original videogame and PONG: The Next Level brings all of the action of the classic to the Game Boy Color. The game is an electronic version of table tennis (or Ping Pong, if you prefer). Players move a paddle up and down, trying to hit the ball past their opponent, and the first player to get 11 points wins. In addition to the classic Pong, there are three other tables to play on. On the Glacier level, two penguins waddle around between the paddles and affect the trajectory of the ball when it hits them. In the Soccer level, players must maneuver two paddles to try to put the ball into the opponent's net. Finally, the Jungle stage has two rollers in the middle that can change the ball's trajectory. Get all of the action of the first major videogame with PONG: The Next Level.

title: Pop Her Bubble
alternate_titles: Pop Her Bubble! Transpunk Mosh Cats
description: A bite-sized VN about holding onto friends in a lonely city

title: Pop'n Music GB
alternate_titles: ポップンミュージック GB
description: The songs included are popular songs from PS and DC's "Pop'n Music" 1st, 2nd, and 3rd. In addition, more than 20 songs are included with the addition of original songs! !! You can play in 2P using a communication cable, and you can continue to combo and attack your opponent. There are two modes, "ARCADE" mode where you can play songs selected from pop'n music so far, and "ORIGINAL" mode where you can play GB version original songs. In the "SURVIVAL" mode of "ARCADE", the gauge is set to full from the start of the game. However, the gauge is decreasing every time I make a mistake, so it's a thrilling experience!

title: Pop'n Music GB: Animation Melody
alternate_titles: ポップンミュージック GB アニメーションメロディー | pop'n music GB アニメーションメロディ
description: Covers popular anime theme songs from the 1960s to 1990s, and can be easily enjoyed anytime, anywhere. You can play 20 familiar songs such as "Sally the Witch", "Mazinger Z", "Galaxy Express 999", "Dragon Ball", and "Sailor Moon". If you get a high score, you can also see the special graphics of each anime character. Equipped with 7 modes: "Beginner", "Normal", "Excite", "Maniac", "Survival", "Free", and "Competition". You can play against your friends using the communication cable. The lyrics are displayed on the screen, so you can sing like karaoke! ??

title: Pop'n Music GB: Disney Tunes
alternate_titles: ポップンミュージック GB ディズニーチューンズ
description: Get a unique world view by tie-up with Disney, and it's just cute! This time, it is the easiest in the series so that it can be enjoyed by a wide range of age groups. You can enjoy the familiar songs of "It's a Small World" and "Electrical Parade" while watching cute anime. The surprisingly smooth animation is so wonderful that it makes me groan as "Disney". Not only Mickey and Minnie, but also Donald, Daisy, Goofy, Pluto, etc. will liven up the game with various costumes and splendid dances. * Playable only with this product.

title: Pop'n Pop
description: Its gameplay can be described as a hybrid of Puzzle Bobble ,Arkanoid and Space Invaders.[1] Rows of coloured balloons advance down the screen, and the player must shoot their own balloons at them. When three balloons of the same colour match up, they disappear.

title: Porkerion 4dventure
alternate_titles: Porkerion 4dventure Part 1
description:
After 2 years of development, the GAME BOY (color) ROM of Porkérion 4dventure is finally here, by HLMTZ-SICK LION, Creator of the Porkérion saga.

1000% GAME IN MEXICAN SPANISH.

title: Porklike: Wurst Comes to Worst
description:
A port of the wonderful Porklike, created by Krystian Majewski, to the original Game Boy!

Porklike is a classic, turn-based Roguelike with minimalist lo-fi aesthetic. Enter the tower of Wurstlord. Can you make it to the top and steal his legendary Kielbasa? 9 floors of dangerous traps and enemies await you. Only if you move carefully and master your character's abilities will you become the champion of Porklike.

title: Portal Runner
description: The characters from 3DO's popular ARMY MEN series have invaded the Game Boy Color! This time, you take control of Vikki Grimm as she battles the evil Brigitte Blue. Though you begin as a pint-sized plaything, you can eventually travel to worlds that are of an accommodating size over seven different locations. Each world contains numerous levels, resulting in 43 scenarios overall. Throughout your journey you'll come across swamps, dungeons, and even intergalactic spaceships. Each level progresses like typical a side-scrolling game, with plenty of action and adventure awaiting you. Some environments offer different weapons and enemies, and you'll even get the opportunity to commandeer a vehicle on some levels. For those with a penchant for exploration, there are even some hidden worlds to discover that offer even more amazing discoveries and challenges. Progress can be saved using a password system based on which levels have already been conquered. PORTAL RUNNER is a graphically impressive game for a portable system and it promises hours of gameplay, harrowing challenges, and an exciting story to follow.

title: Postie
description:
The annual postman competition takes place at the Castle of Ribe. A race to the top of the castles highest tower shall decide who is the fastest mail deliverer and is allowed to call himself postie of the year.

Developer: invertedHat

title: Postman Pat's Trail Game
alternate_titles: Postman Pat's Trail Game (World) (Aftermarket) (Unl)
description:
Tracking game for 4 to 6 year olds. 
Here is a delightfully simple yet fascinating game, based on the ever-popular BBC-TV character, that will help to encourage the development of your child's problem-solving skills, sense of direction and manual coordination, while keeping him or her thoroughly absorbed and entertained.

The wizardry of modern computer technology transports your child to the colorful world of Greendale where he/she will help Postman Pat track down friends and animals from the village who need his assistance. Follow the trail left by Mrs Hubbard's bicycle, Peter Fogg's tractor or Sam Waldron's van, or the footprints of Postman Pat's cat Jess or George Lancaster's bull. But watch out carefully, because bumping into things loses points!

Original version:  Longman Software - Zx-Spectrum, 1984.

title: Powa!
alternate_titles: POWA! (World) (En) (GB Compatible) (Aftermarket) (Unl)
description:
Powa! is a newly developed action platformer in a similar vein as other genre classics of the handheld, like Kirby's Dreamland and Trip World.

The gameplay is decidedly kept simple and makes Powa! easy to pick it up, but challenging to conquer. A good variety of level themes and obstacles, with an ever-increasing difficulty curve keep the experience thoroughly engaging and fresh!

title: Power Pro Kun Pocket
alternate_titles: パワプロクンポケット
description: A power pro world developed by friends full of individuality. Gather a lot of friends to form a strong team and aim for Koshien! If you can become a professional, you can enjoy online competition with the team at that time! The player made with this can be used in the NINTENDO 64 version of "Jikkyou Powerful Professional Baseball 6".

title: Power Pro Kun Pocket 2
alternate_titles: パワプロクンポケット 2
description: The protagonist, who was nominated as a draft by the weak small team "Drill Mogler's" in the B-class, grows through various experiences when he was in the fourth year of college. Characteristic characters such as Dr. Daijove and new character helper foreigner Domio will liven up the story. It became difficult to make all-A super players as before, and it became closer to more realistic player training. Raised athletes can be re-raised again by sending or receiving them to friends in "reincarnation mode". In addition, five various mini-games are inserted in the story of success mode, so you can enjoy it beyond the framework of sports games.

title: Power Quest
description:
The gameplay of Power Quest is a mixture of two genres: RPG and fighting game similar to Hissatsu Doujou Yaburi, Tenkaichi Bushi Keru Naguru and Metal & Lace: Battle of the Robo Babes. You venture around the town in which you live on an overworld map where you can go to different locations. Once you arrive at a location, a character appears on the screen with some dialogue. More often than not this dialog involves the character challenging you to a fight. After you are challenged by a character, the game switches to a one-on-one fighting game engine. This is the RPG's battle system which differs from the usual turn-based battle engine's of the genre.
You can buy new parts for your Model which is how you gain experience throughout the game. You progress through the game by challenging a certain amount of people before the next event is triggered. Then special events pop up throughout the game after this number is met which usually involve a tournament or beating some strong boss-type character.

title: Power Rangers: Time Force
description: As time is being torn apart by evil forces, there is only one force powerful enough to stop it: the Power Rangers! In POWER RANGERS TIME FORCE for the Game Boy Color, you take the role of the color-coordinated heroes and fight the good fight. The game plays out in 2D battles and side-scrolling action in two different ways: you will be forced to battle enemies in human form, and you'll also have to band together and become a Megazord to take down the most powerful bosses. Each character offers several different attributes and statistics, so choosing the right Ranger is critical. There are 15 levels in all, each coming with a different theme. You'll take the Power Rangers everywhere from pyramids to space environments as you fight to save the world. POWER RANGERS TIME FORCE is a great adventure across time and space, and it's sure to please fans of both side-scrolling games and the numerous incarnations of the television show.

title: Power Spike Pro Beach Volleyball
alternate_titles: Beach'n Ball
description: Put on some sunscreen and head to the sand for action in POWER SPIKE PRO BEACH VOLLEYBALL. Play as 20 different pros, including beach legend Gabrielle Reece. In addition to the professional competition, you can also experience playing in: Osaka, Rio de Janeiro, New York, Los Angeles, and other exotic locales. Play a Single Match to get some quick action, or try to win it all in the Championship mode. Remember, advancing through the Championship mode will teach you how to perform super moves that can give you a big advantage. If your friends give you a hard time about your style of play, kick sand in their faces with the Two-Player mode. If you think you have what it takes to spike your way to king of the beach, play POWER SPIKE PRO BEACH VOLLEYBALL.

title: Powerball
description:
So you think you can play ball games? Powerball is designed to prove you wrong. Collect the golden chalices by bouncing over them. On the way you have to negotiate a fiendishly constructed maze-background full of meanies, spiky plants and the not-so-occasional missile. Since each chalice earns you more points then the last, the problem naturally gets much harder the further you go.

Move across the screen, left to right, jumping on or over, the various obstacles in your way. It helps if you work out first which are harmless, because those that won't will burst your bubble. Literally.

title: PowerBall: Monster's Quest
description: Once upon a time there was a humble young man and a princess who fell in love. They wanted to marry but the King did not accept this union. So he cast a spell on the young man which transformed him into a monster. The poor princess was confined in the castle to arrange a marriage of convenience with a prince of great wealth. The only option for the young monster to get his princess back is to defeat the King by playing PowerBall and prove his worth. Will love triumph over the King's evil plans?

title: Poyon no Dungeon Room
alternate_titles: ポヨンのダンジョンルーム MOZ WORLD | Poyon's Dungeon Room MOZ WORLD | Daikaijuu Monogatari - Poyon no Dungeon Room
description: Daikaiju Monogatari, a game featuring Poyon, a character who is very popular with MOZ cards. "Digging low pre" that digs the soil and pushes through the dungeon buried in the soil. There is a "room" in the dungeon, which also includes an adventure element to talk with various people in it and solve the mystery. Summoned beasts also appear in the dungeon, and become friends by winning the battle. With communication cable support, you can give items, copy summoned beasts, and play online battles.

title: Poyon no Dungeon Room 2
alternate_titles: 大貝獣物語 ポヨンのダンジョンルーム 2 | Daikaiju Monogatari Poyon's Dungeon Room 2
description: Items are buried in the soil! Power up by digging yourself and going ahead and finding items. By picking up and using the "stones" that have fallen in the dungeon, the parameters will increase. There are many types of stones, such as "fire" and "water", which are attribute parameters, in addition to stones that increase the basic parameters "attack power" and "defense power", so you can use the stones to grow your own poyon. Yeah. If you use a communication cable, you can also play against "Mini Mecha Poyon" and "Dungeon Battle".

title: Pretty Princess' Castle Escape
description: The Princess has to escape from the Royal Castle killing Aznar clones, Captain Zurrapa and other deadly enemies avoiding spikes everywhere! Help her get her crown back!

title: Prima Materia
description:
Prima Materia is a puzzle-platformer which takes place in the 17th century castle of an alchemist.

Gold Edition (Batch 4) consists of the game cartridge, manual, and a homemade print of an original artwork based on an alchemic etching.

title: Prince Naseem Boxing
description:
Fight one-off bouts, compete in tournaments or become a career boxer and slug it out for the World Title Belt. Lightning play speed allows you to dodge, block, weave and hit back at a blistering pace.

With 16 world champion boxers to compete against and four modes of play this game offers the most complete boxing experience on Game Boy Color.

title: Prince of Persia
description: The Grand Visir Jaffar seizes control of the throne while the Sultan is away. At the same time, a young prince from a far away land falls in love with the Princess, causing him to become Jaffar's enemy. Jaffar kidnaps the prince throwing him into the darkest part of the dungeon. The Princess now has one hour to make a choice: marry the evil Jaffar or die. Take the role of the young prince as he tries to escape from the dungeon. Each of the 12 game levels is a puzzle, and you have exactly 60 minutes to get through all of the levels. There are guards throughout the dungeon who are trying to stop you, but you can pick up a sword and use it to dispatch the guards. Break out of the dungeon and save the woman you love in PRINCE OF PERSIA.

title: Princess Gardening
alternate_titles: プリンセスガーデニング
description: Let's grow legendary flowers for our beloved 8! The story takes place in a garden at the foot of a mountain. Princess Saiko's goal is to use a magic jar to collect many legendary and mysterious flowers that are said to make wishes come true. Will she be able to make her beloved 8-chan's wish come true?

title: Princess Poffin and the Spider Invasion
description: The moth kingdom has been covered in spiderwebs! It's up to Poffin to find the spider responsible, and restore her kingdom to its former web-free glory!

title: Pro Darts
description: PRO DARTS brings the greatest of all British pub games to the Game Boy Color. You can play as eight different characters (two have to be unlocked), each with unique ratings in strength, nerve, and accuracy. Once you have selected your character, use the Practice mode to learn the rules of the six different games Cricket, 301, 301 Double Out, Around the World, 501, and 501 Double Out. When you are ready for some competition, you can challenge the computer to a game on three different difficulty settings. If your friends want to get in on some of the action, you can challenge them to a game without having to use a link cable. No matter how you play, you must aim the dart and use a power meter to send it flying. Play PRO DARTS, and get all of the darts action you could ever want.

title: Pro Mahjong Kiwame GB2
alternate_titles: プロ麻雀 極GB 2 | Professional Mahjong Pole GB 2
description: A reliable and proven 4-player mahjong male "Professional Mahjong Goku" is now available in Game Boy Color. The screen is now color-enabled, making it easier to see and more beautiful and luxurious. All hits (except communication games) can be auto-saved and the game can always be interrupted. There are two modes: "Juban Game Mode" where you can enjoy free games with bonus functions, beginners, and easy games for practice, "Title Battle Mode" where you can enjoy gambling rules, competition rules, and hidden title battles, and "Goku GB II" where you can enjoy quizzes. In addition to "mode", various game modes such as "material room mode" and "communication game mode" are available.

title: Pro Mahjong Tsuwamono GB
alternate_titles: プロ麻雀「兵」GB | Professional Mahjong "Soldier" GB
description: The professional mahjong "Soldier" series has been upgraded by new members and appeared in Game Boy Color. Equipped with a suspend function, you can enjoy the continuation anytime, anywhere. In addition, software for pocket printers that shows the certificate and report card when you win the championship with a print sticker. Since the data such as the striking lines, personality, and sparrow style of 16 professional sparrows are well taken in, you can fully enjoy the game with professional sparrows who have their own individuality.

title: Pro Mahjong Tsuwamono GB2
alternate_titles: プロ麻雀「兵」GB 2 | Professional Mahjong "Soldier" GB 2
description: The professional mahjong "Soldier" series is a full-fledged four-player mahjong that breaks the conventional wisdom. The soldiers who won numerous titles such as the master, the throne, and the phoenix are now available in live action! By transplanting to the highest peak artificial intelligence and capturing live action, you can fully enjoy playing with professionals at home or outside. "Free game mode" where you decide the face from 16 professional sparrows and play, "Title battle mode" where you participate in 6 "Soldier" original tournaments and conquer all titles, Female Ryujaku at the beginner level NO. You can enjoy playing mahjong in your favorite game mode from "Instruction Mode" where you can receive mahjong instruction from 1 Shimizu Pro and Ando Pro who is a master of 28th and 29th term at intermediate level.

title: Pro Pool
description: Exciting billiards action comes to the Game Boy Color with PRO POOL. Play a match against the computer or a friend, or play the Single-Player Speed Match and try to clear all of the balls off of the table as quickly as possible. In Hustle mode, you take the role of a pool hustler, traveling from bar to bar placing bets on games. Ultimately, you want to win enough money to buy your own bar. In all of these modes, six different games can be played: 8 Ball, 9 Ball, 6 Ball, 3 Ball, straight pool, and speed pool. And the competition will never get stale thanks to the 64 different computer opponents to play. Plus, an outstanding physics engine makes this the most realistic pool game available for the Game Boy Color. Try to become a great hustler with PRO POOL.

title: Project S-11
description: When a vicious crew of aliens decides to hone in on Earth and do some damage, you're the planet's only hope for salvation. You'd better be in top form as you command a killer spacecraft out into orbit in hopes of rescuing humanity from unthinkable misery. Each of the eight stages in PROJECT S-11 poses unique challenges, and each setting is more harrowing than the last. Although you're going it alone in this one, there are four different types of power-ups hidden throughout the game to give the boost you'll need to survive and wipe out the terrifying extra-terrestrials. You'll benefit from a complete statistical readout that adorns the right side of your screen, keeping you abreast of all necessary information: your score, your ship's armor level, and the number of bombs you have stored up for combat. The game's fast-paced action looks excellent in full color, and the intensity of it will have you breaking a sweat before you're through the first level. Those aliens had better look out with you at the controls, Earth stands a fighting chance.

title: Proof of Destruction
description:
You play across an interconnecting grid of wire, along which your P.O.D (what else?) may be moved. The aliens arrive (usually) from the top and descend rapidly in orderly fashion, intent on causing P.O.D actual physical pain. You can't move over the damage until it heals (A few second), but the Bad Guys can move!

Each level is timed (20 sec) as shown on the screen and to win through all you have to do is stay in one piece. Should you succeed a bonus extra life (every second level + 1 life - max. no.3) You will need them all! Firing will often be a problem because if the machine overheats, you can't shoot!

title: Puchi Carat
description:
A mix between classic "Walls" and "Bubbles" puzzles games
12 characters to challenge
12 gems to win
Intense competitions
4 amazing game modes

The general objective of Puchi Carat is to destroy gem-like blocks using a ball and paddle. Gems "fall in" from the top of the play area one line at a time and are connected to each other either horizontally or vertically. Hitting a gem with the ball will destroy it, and if the destroyed gem causes other gems to no longer be connected to the top of the play area, they fall off, scoring bonus points. Destroying a special flashing gem also destroys all regular gems of the same color in the playfield. There are also metallic blocks that take more than one hit to destroy.

The player controls a paddle at the bottom of the playfield, which can move left and right to bounce the ball back upward. Unlike in most other Breakout-style games, missing the ball does not cost a life or end the game, but rather adds more lines of gems to the top of the playfield. Gem lines will advance on their own after a certain amount of time, as well as when the playfield is cleared entirely or drops below a certain number of gems. If the gems advance across the line at the bottom of the playfield where the paddle resides, the player loses and the game is over.

The arcade version of Puchi Carat features three main gameplay modes: A single-player mode where the goal is to clear a certain number of gem lines, a story mode in which the player challenges each character in a head-to-head battle (where dropped gems are added to the opponent's playfield from the bottom), and a two-player versus mode following the same rules as the story mode. Each of the single-player modes offers three levels of difficulty. Various ports of the game offer additional gameplay modes (such as time-attack mode), more difficulty levels, and expanded storylines for each character.

title: Pumpkin Jack and the Witch's Curse
description: The witch has stolen your soul and placed it in three unholy candles! Make your way to the end of the stage to retrieve a candle, but then hurry back to the pumpkin patch at the start of the level, because the witch will chase you when you pick up the candle!

title: Pumuckls Abenteuer bei den Piraten
description:
Pumuckls Abenteuer bei den Piraten is an action/adventure game developed by NEON Software and published by Acclaim Entertainment for the Game Boy Color platform.

Pumuckls Abenteuer bei den Piraten was only released in Germany and stars a popular cartoon character, Pumuckl.

title: Pumuckls Abenteuer im Geisterschloss
alternate_titles: Pumuckl's Abenteuer im Geisterschloss
description:
Pumuckls Abenteuer im Geisterschloss is an action game developed by NEON Software and published by Acclaim Entertainment for the Game Boy Color platform.

Pumuckls Abenteuer im Geisterschloss was only released in Germany and is based off of a cartoon series titled Pumuckls Abenteuer. both the game and TV show star the main character Pumuckl.

title: Punch-It
description: The stadium is full, the television viewers can't wait for the fight at home, in which you can now be the hero who lasts the longest in the ring. Show that you haven't practiced in vain. Try again and again and get the highest score.

title: Purple Turtles
description: Turtle Bobbing is a sport which can only be carried out with the very rare Purple Turtle. The fabled Purple Turtles rise and fall as the whim takes them and due to their passive nature and unusual buoyancy they can be used as stepping stones. A game for the young at heart and for people who have tired of alien bashing.

title: Puyo Puyo Gaiden: Puyo Wars
alternate_titles: ぷよぷよ外伝～ぷよウォーズ～
description: In the past, "Puyo" coexisted with humans on the planet Guy Earth. One scholar devised a weapon with overwhelming destructive power from the special energy contained in "Puyo", and the life of the star was endangered. The gods of the planet erased the existence and memory of "Puyo" and protected the stars. Over time, humankind eventually discovered a plate with an unseen creature (Puyo) in the depths of a huge underground ruin. Scientists have succeeded in creating "Puyo" based on the information on this plate. "Puyo" was welcomed as a pet. At one point, a doctor was looking for "Puyo" with his invention "Puyo Radar" in his hand, and found a strange capsule. A boy about 3-4 years old was sleeping in the capsule ...

title: PUZZLE BOBBLE 4
description: You'll be Forever Bursting Bubbles! Puzzle Bobble 4 is bursting onto the scene with more advanced gameplay, and tons of new features. It's a challenge for the whole family!

title: Puzzle de Shoubuyo! Wootama-chan
alternate_titles: ウータマちゃん パズルデショーブヨ!
description: Do you know Utama-chan? Utama-chan is Toei Animation's own character. A puzzle game in which pieces that appear in the field are rotated and moved, and pieces of the same type are collected in four squares and erased. You can enjoy tricks such as "Matome Teget", which erases a lot at once, and "Okkakerensa", which attaches pieces of the same type to pieces that are disappearing. A simple but profound puzzle game where you can create your own tricks by moving and arranging pieces. Equipped with various ways to play, such as a two-player battle and a quiz mode that automatically creates problems.

title: Puzzle Master
description: The Goblin King has corrupted the elements and is flooding the world, and it's up to you to save it. Groups of four elements fire, water, stone, and wood fall from the sky. You must position the elements in such a way that three of the same type touch each other, and are thus eliminated. However, there are some complicating factors: monsters will appear on the play field and will throw pollution blocks that cannot be removed. Further, each round has some tasks which range from watering a flowerpot to triggering a drawbridge that will eliminate several rows which need to be completed.

title: Puzzled
description: Do you love puzzles? Well, you're about to put your commitment to the test, as you try your hand at more than 150 different brain-bending challenges. It seems that a maniacal scientist has transported you to a distant dimension. The only way to return to your rightful place is to solve dozens and dozens of puzzles--each of which will get you one step closer to escaping imprisonment and saving the world. Each unique mindbender uses tiles with varied symbols, charging you with the task of eliminating them, rearranging them, or otherwise manipulating them. The color graphics and cool sound effects only add to the charm of this great blend of puzzles and plot. Because PUZZLED has so many different challenges, the game takes hours to tackle, and the replay value is high. If you think you've got what it takes to crack a mountain of crazy puzzles and save the world, then you're just the hero the planet has been waiting for.

title: Q*bert
description: The arcade hit Q*BERT comes to the Game Boy Color. The player takes control of an orange creature that hops around a course built of blocks. The goal is to change all of the blocks to the appropriate color by hopping on them. As the game progresses, blocks will require multiple jumps. Complicating the process, a snake that wants to destroy you hops around the course, and there are two balls that go down parts of the course undoing all of your work. There are more than 40 levels to complete with several that are larger than one screen. Since all of the action in the game moves in diagonals, there are two different control schemes to maximize your fun. If you remember playing Q*BERT at the arcade, you will enjoy being able to play it in the palm of your hand.

title: Qix Adventure
description: Can you trap the elusive line of energy that's bouncing all around? Based on the coin-operated classic, QIX, this GBC sequel to the puzzle-based original offers similar gaming styles and a few welcome updates. In this take, you'll use a cursor to draw boxes on the screen, avoiding the Qix. If you can draw a compete box without the Qix touching its perimeter, that area of the screen will disappear and get you one step closer to advancing. Adding an element of story, QIX ADVENTURE casts you in the role of Speedy, a treasure hunter who's traveled to a mysterious island. Each level that you pass will help you in your quest to rid the island of all its strange creatures. Easy to learn but extremely difficult to master, QIX ADVENTURE is addicting fun for puzzle lovers and other gamers. Are you quick enough for Qix? Find out alone or against a friend.

title: Quartet
description: Quartet is a simple but addictive puzzle game where you assemble pieces into faces and score points. Don't be too slow, or you will lose! This is the Game Boy version of the original Quartet game by Photon Storm.

title: Queen Fighter 2000
alternate_titles: Queen of Fighting 2000 | 女王格鬥2000
description: Queen Fighter 2000, also known as Gals Fighters and Queen of Fighting 2000 (女王格鬥2000), is an unlicensed Game Boy Color game produced in 2000 by Vast Fame. It's an all-female fighting game based on SNK's Gals' Fighters title for the Neo Geo Pocket Color and is Vast Fame's first "original" fighter (their previous one, Super Fighters S, is a hack of an official The King of Fighters game.)

title: Quest 2 - The Ancient Temples
alternate_titles: Quest 2 - SAGE '23 Demo
description:
Quest 2 - The Ancient Temples is a role-playing game for the Game Boy Color, and is the 2nd Quest game.

Taking place directly after the events of Quest - The Adventure for the 6 Stones in the year of 2036, the Wooden Knight and his friends, Alex and Brian, discover that the six legendary stones have to be recharged due to not being used in a very long time. This takes them to a region of Light Island called the Solar Region, where they have to find six ancient temples that can bring back the power of the stones. Along the way, they meet new friends and new foes, as well as beings that were around during the time of the Hero of the Past.

title: Quest for Camelot
alternate_titles: Warner Bros. Quest for Camelot
description: King Arthur has lost his legendary sword, Excalibur. Now the evil Sir Ruber is out to claim Camelot. Since the King is unable to fight, he trusts a young girl named Kayley to fight for him and save his Kingdom. You take the role of Kayley as you explore nine worlds and a total of 60 areas in search of Excalibur. Along the way, you will have to learn how to use several devices including a slingshot, snorkel, and grappling hook to perform tasks and solve puzzles. Naturally, Sir Ruber has henchmen out to stop you, but use your sword to dispatch them. As the game progresses, you will learn a powerful spin-attack as well as dart- and lunge-attacks. Will Kayley be able to save Camelot? Will finding Excalibur be enough to help King Arthur? Find the answers to these questions by playing QUEST FOR CAMELOT.

title: Quest: Brian's Journey
alternate_titles: Elemental Tale - Jack no Daibouken: Daimaou no Gyakushuu
description: Brian lives in a peaceful and quiet town where nothing ever happens, which is the way everyone likes it. Suddenly, hordes of evildoers overrun the town and start wreaking havoc in this once-sleepy community. The town is counting on Brian to go on a quest to restore peace and harmony. You take control of the unlikely hero and set out on the adventure of a lifetime. While traveling, you will discover something more nefarious is happening, and you'll have your hands full of monsters and enemies. Throughout your journey you will have to battle these monsters and enemies in turn-based combat with a twist. The twist is that you can move between turns to dodge attacks, and you can also combine spells and attacks to create special moves. Help Brian save his town, and maybe even the world, in QUEST RPG: Brian's Journey.

title: Quest: Fantasy Challenge
alternate_titles: Holy Magic Century
description: As you're leaving a party at the castle, you're suddenly attacked by a swarm of evil monsters. Now you must fight your way through the monsters to get home. In each of the 20 levels, you must collect gems and open chests that are scattered throughout. However, there are a large number of enemies on your tail including Hellhounds, Apophis, Bumbershoot, Rocky, Skeletons, and Scorpions. Luckily, you have a magic wand that will destroy them, but there's a catch it must recharge between shots. There are also a multitude of power-ups like Fresh Bread, Mint Leaves, Honey Leaves, Dew Drops, Spirit Light, Healing Potion, Heroes Drink and the Dragon's Potion that will help you along the way. Try to collect all of the items and get home safely in QUEST FANTASY CHALLENGE.

title: Qui Qui
alternate_titles: QuiQui
description: A game in which a cute character (Kuikyu) evolves into an amazing monster. Aim for the strongest galaxy in the incandescent surprise battle "Guluxy One". In battle, you can teleport to quickly approach, transform into flames and burn the forest, shed enemies with the tsunami, and fight with many special abilities. You can also remodel the planet with your friends to train Kikui.

title: qulqy
description:
Game Boy Color and Pocket/Classic demake/remake of Janusz Lewandowski's 1995 game "Kulki" for Windows 3.1.

Connect five or more balls in the row, horizontally, vertically  or diagonally. Select a ball, then an empty space, to move that ball.

    Game starts with five random balls.
    If the move did not removed any balls, three new random balls will be added to the board.
    If the move did removed some balls, the score is increased. No new balls are added.
    Game ends if there are no more possible moves.

title: R-Type DX
description:
The World Government needs your help.

A deep-space probe has uncovered the Bydo Empire's secret plans to mount an attack on Earth. A full-scale assault force would be detected by the Empire's long-range scanners, and any hope of surprise would be lost. Our only chance is for a single pilot in a lone R-Type fighter to penetrate the Bydo defense system and destroy the evil Empire before it can launch its attack.

• It's five games in one! R-Type I and II for Game Boy pocket, R-Type I and II color-enhanced for Game Boy Color, and the all-new R-Type DX for the Game Boy Color.
• Tear through Bydo defenses as you blast enemies with your Fire Chain, Super Laser, and Bubble Beam.
• Take the fight to a fevered pitch with two pulse-pounding Rapid Fire modes on your Game Boy Color system.

title: R.I.P. The Game
description:
The 20 Chalices of Truth were stolen from your King. He has commanded you to retrieve them from the Crypts of Darkness. Once all 20 are assembled and returned to their rightful owner all evil will be banished from your Kingdom forever.

Deep inside the bowels of the caverns are blood thirsty creatures that delight in tormenting any soul foolish enough to venture therein. You are armed with the Staff of Light given to you by the Elders.

You alone can save your country from eternal darkness.

title: Race Time
description:
Race Time is a fun racing game in which you can take control of one of four cars in a fast paced race to the finish.
In Race Time you play on one of 6 tracks with any one of 10 cars and can play each of these with 4 different skill levels. Single race

Race one of 6 tracks against 3 other (AI) opponents
Aim: get the quickest time

title: Racin' Ratz
description: A variety of little animals take center stage in this racing challenge that takes you through some unlikely environments. Trek through the living room, Grandma's house, a bedroom, and the garage in your quest for glorious victory. There are 25 missions in all, and the action is spread over 10 huge levels. You choose to play as Chris (a cat) or Betty (a little bird), and then take your character through a slew of puzzles, avoiding hazards and collecting power-ups. Finding the appropriate items will allow you to jump across furniture, shrink your car, or even climb over your obstacles. Smart strategy and quick reflexes will help you unlock an extremely trying boss level where you'll take on either a cat or bird in a head-to-head duel. Sometimes the best things come in small packages, and that's certainly the case in this small-scale racing challenge for the Game Boy Color.

title: Radikal Bikers
description: Radikal Bikers is a racing game, developed by Bit Managers and published by Infogrames, which was cancelled before it was released.

title: Raffles
description: Raffles, leaving a lively champagne party at his London hotel, sets out at night to rob five nearby mansions. Avoiding police patrols, he breaks into the first house, carefully searches for the jewel-filled safe, and dodges security guards. After planting dynamite and blowing open the safe, he grabs the loot and escapes to his car. He returns to The Savoy Hotel to stash his stolen goods before heading out to rob the remaining mansions. It promises to be a busy, risky night for the daring thief.

title: Rainbow Islands
description: This is a port of the original Arcade game of the same name and was released only in Europe in 2001.

title: Rampage 2: Universal Tour
description: Giant monsters are attacking the world's cities and you just happen to be one of the monsters. You can choose from six different beasts, including a gorilla, wolf, rat, lizard, lobster, and rhino. Each character has unique strengths and weaknesses, plus a unique special attack. Earn points by demolishing all of the buildings, downing helicopters, destroying tanks, and eating the helpless citizens. When you are hit by the human defenses, you lose power from your life meter. As luck would have it, health power-ups are located in each level, including a special food for each character that boosts their abilities. There are 100 cities to destroy, along with a Two-Player option that allows a friend to join the destructive action. Send the human race back to the Stone Age with RAMPAGE 2: Universal Tour.

title: Rampage: World Tour
description: Purebred destruction is the name of the game in RAMPAGE WORLD TOUR. Choose one of three different monsters (each a gargantuan tower of rage), and then join your counterparts as you wreak holy terror on city after city. You'll stomp buildings, crush cars, and even take down innocent pedestrians in your strides to do as much damage as possible. Parents can rest assured: although the game's focus is on tearing apart the scenery, there's little of the blood and gore that pervades many video games these days. There are more than 130 stages to romp through in this tribute to silver screen terrors, and each level presents all-new challenges and more difficult gameplay. If you're familiar with the RAMPAGE series, you'll love the inclusion of three new monsters to take the place of the familiar faces from the original game. The play is faithful to previous titles in the RAMPAGE series, but improved graphics and controls make for the most exhilarating entry to date. Devastation has never been so fun!

title: Rampart
description: Rampart is a game combining strategy and artillery action. Build your castle from Tetris-style pieces, place your cannons, bombard the enemy, try to repair, do it all over again. The original arcade release has a single-player and a two-player mode; later revisions incorporate three-player gameplay.

title: Rat Splat!
alternate_titles: Rat Splat
description:
In the sewers the rats have been multiplying for years and so a rat cull has been organized. You have been chosen to carry out this gruesome task. You will have to kill the rats by hitting them with your "ACME Patent Rat Killing Hammer". You will only be able to hit a rat when it is directly beneath the hammer, so fast reactions are essential. Unfortunately in the sewers lives an aggressive monster which has sentimental feelings towards the rats and will get very angry if you hurt his furry friends. By pressing a key you can swap the hammer for an aerosol can, this will allow you to kill the monster. The cheese is used as bait to attract the rats and must be protected. If you kill a rat when it has begun eating some cheese then the cheese will be saved. Your aim is to kill 16 rats but if you take too long the smell of the cheese will overpower you . You will die if you are touched by the monster, overpowered by the smell or if all cheese is eaten.
Good luck!

title: Rats!
alternate_titles: Reservoir Rat
description: A variety of little animals take center stage in this racing challenge that takes you through some unlikely environments. Trek through the living room, Grandma's house, a bedroom, and the garage in your quest for glorious victory. There are 25 missions in all, and the action is spread over 10 huge levels. You choose to play as Chris (a cat) or Betty (a little bird), and then take your character through a slew of puzzles, avoiding hazards and collecting power-ups. Finding the appropriate items will allow you to jump across furniture, shrink your car, or even climb over your obstacles. Smart strategy and quick reflexes will help you unlock an extremely trying boss level where you'll take on either a cat or bird in a head-to-head duel. Sometimes the best things come in small packages, and that's certainly the case in this small-scale racing challenge for the Game Boy Color.

title: RAVEN-STAR
alternate_titles: raven star
description:
A tiny Game Boy Color game about finding a place where you belong.

You are a raven born without wings. Cast out of your village, you must find a way to return home. Run and jump around The Ravine on your journey to find the legendary Wishing Star.

title: Raven's Core
description:
“There’s a peace that can only be found on the other side of war.” - King Arthur

So when the alien invaders known as RAVEN entered Terran space, it was time to act.

Armed with the most advanced spaceship ever built, you stand between Earth and the RAVEN onslaught.

Do you have what it takes to attack RAVEN on its own turf, destroy its central core, and bring peace to the Earth - and the galaxy?

title: Rayman
description: Rayman is side-scrolling platformer starring the titular Rayman, a big-nosed chap with no arms or legs. Rayman can jump and use his hair to hover for a short period of time. He can also attack by throwing his fists, or winding up his fists for a more powerful punch. He can occasionally find special power ups that grant him unlimited flying power, giving him the ability to navigate through tricky mazes.

title: Rayman 2
alternate_titles: Rayman 2: The Great Escape
description: Rayman 2 (GBC) is an adaptation of Rayman 2: The Great Escape that was released for the Game Boy Color. Despite the fact that Rayman 2 was a big hit, this game is rarely known about, even to Rayman audiences. It was released under the title Rayman 2: Forever in Europe with slightly different box art. The title screen of this game says Rayman 2: The Great Escape even though the box and the audiences regard it as Rayman 2 (GBC).

title: Razor: Freestyle Scooter
description: If they're so cool in real life, can you even imagine what they can do in a video game? The popular razor scooters now have their own GBC title, and it's one intense ride. Choose your rig from a variety of available scooters, and then head out to rescue your friends from the clutches an evil robot named Norton. Your style and skills are the only things that can save the day, so get moving! There are 10 cool characters to play as each with unique abilities and shortcomings and 45 cool maneuvers to pull off. Packed with awesome graphics and realistic action, RAZOR FREESTYLE SCOOTER challenges you to grind ledges, jump barrels, and perform tricks like no-footers, tailwhips, and supermen. Each level is loaded with difficult obstacles and hidden bonuses, and the controls are refreshingly simple to learn. If you're looking for a great take on this popular new sport, you've found it. Play alone or take on a friend.

title: RC-Shuriken
alternate_titles: Remote Control Shuriken
description:
RC-Shuriken is boss rush style homebrew for the Game Boy Color.

Developer: Health Potion Studios

title: Ready 2 Rumble Boxing
description: Boxing action comes to the Game Boy Color with READY 2 RUMBLE BOXING. Choose from 10 fighters including Afro Thunder, Lulu Valentine, and "Big" Willie Johnson, each with their own abilities and styles. Play the Arcade mode to get in some quick action, and when you are ready for a challenge, try to win eight matches and become the best in the world in the Championship mode. In both modes, legendary ring announcer Michael Buffer intros each fighter, which includes full-motion video sequences that are based on the console introductions. As an added bonus, the cartridge rumbles so it feels like you are taking every punch yourself. Step into the ring and fight with READY 2 RUMBLE BOXING.

title: Real Pro Yakyuu!: Central League Version
alternate_titles: リアルプロ野球 セリーグ編 | Real Pro Yakyuu! - Central League Hen
description: With the permission of the Nippon Professional Baseball Organization, all professional baseball players can be registered and participated, and the individuality of each player (running ability, striking ability, defensive ability, pitcher ability) can be accurately entered based on the actual data up to the previous year. .. Trading is possible regardless of the manager, coach, or player, and if you have both SE and PA products, you can exchange players from both leagues. Story mode starts with your favorite team selection. Choose from open battles or pennant races. Beginners start from the open game and practice the game, and in the pennant race, they compete for 30 games a year while accumulating various data such as training points, trade points, reduction / recovery of pitcher's stamina value every time the game is digested.

title: Real Pro Yakyuu!: Pacific League Version
alternate_titles: リアルプロ野球 パリーグ編 | Real Pro Yakyuu! - Pacific League Hen
description: With the permission of the Nippon Professional Baseball Organization, all professional baseball players can be registered and participated, and the individuality of each player (running ability, striking ability, defensive ability, pitcher ability) can be accurately entered based on the actual data up to the previous year. .. Trading is possible regardless of the manager, coach, or player, and if you have both SE and PA products, you can exchange players from both leagues. Story mode starts with your favorite team selection. Choose from open battles or pennant races. Beginners start from the open game and practice the game, and in the pennant race, they compete for 30 games a year while accumulating various data such as training points, trade points, reduction / recovery of pitcher's stamina value every time the game is digested.

title: Remi's Pizzaria
description: Remi's Pizzaria is a short fan-made game about a famous cooking-loving Rat! Memorize the client's order!!

title: Remote Control Shuriken
description: Defeat 3 bosses by switching between controlling your movement and the movement of your shuriken.

title: Repair-chan no Shuuri Daisakusen
alternate_titles: Repair-chan's Repair Mission
description:
Outbreaks of computer machine failures all over the world! The Game Impact Lab Repair Department is busy with repair requests from all over the world! Mascot character Repair-chan has embarked on a major operation!

Game mode:-

* Story mode

A mode in which you can enjoy the story of Repair-chan running around the world. There are 7 normal stages in one area, and if you clear it, there will be a bonus stage at the end.

* Challenge mode

A mode where you can enjoy only the bonus stage. Clear if you take all the hearts in time. If you can't get it in time, the game is over. If you can clear all the stages, finally...

title: Repugnant Bounty
description:
One million years ago a certain star was at the climax of its life. The radiation produced by the star changed the people who relied on it...finding a new place to call home was their only option. One thousand ships left in search of new worlds...but none returned.

The people who remained on the planet changed more and more as their environment became hostile. They even became nearly immortal...Despite that, an unforeseen threat wiped them all out.

All except...one.

Rosemarie, an alien from the planet Nimola seeks genocide on the evil monsters who killed her mother and people. Can you find and terminate all 28 threats?

Discover new upgrades to reach new areas and kill all the shadow monsters in this compact adventure.

title: Rescue Heroes: Fire Frenzy
description: If you have a little one who is ready to start playing videogames, then you should give RESCUE HEROES: Fire Frenzy a try. There are five mini-games to play; some are versions of classic kid's games, but with a fire theme. One is simple game MEMORY where players must match pictures of animals to rescue them from a fire, while another is similar to SIMON where players must memorize and repeat color combinations. Some of the other games are more action oriented and will challenge anyone's skill. For example, one game calls for the player to ride a jet ski to rescue people stuck on the other side of a river and drop buckets of water from a helicopter. If you have a Game Boy printer, the medals and awards earned can be printed. Now you can help a young gamer get started with RESCUE HEROES: Fire Frenzy.

title: Reservoir Rat (PAL)
description: Your girlfriend just happens to be the daughter of the head of the MOB. Marlon - The Godfather - Mozzarella has dispatched his henchmen to kidnap his Loretta back... It's now time to put on your shades, pick up your weapon and go get your girl back. Reservoir Rat is a platform/puzzle/shoot-em-up with 5 worlds and 17 levels per world.

title: Resident Evil
alternate_titles: Resident Evil (Prototype)
description: Following the success of the original PlayStation edition of Resident Evil in 1996, Capcom expanded the game in a number of ports - one of those planned was for the GameBoy Color. In 1999, HotGen Studios, Ltd., a company in the United Kingdom, was selected by Capcom to port the game. The game was never released.

title: Resident Evil Gaiden
alternate_titles: Biohazard Gaiden
description: Experience a brand new chapter in Cpacom's classic horror survival series: Resident Evil. Now a desperate fight for survival takes place aboard a luxury cruise-liner overflowing with a host of deadly zombies. There is no escape. As S.T.A.R.S. operative Barry Burton, it's up to you to save Leon Kennedy, rescue a young survivor named Lucia and disable a deadly Bio-Organic Weapon. With countless traps to avoid, rooms to explore, puzzles to solve and mysteries to uncover, each lurking horror survived will take you closer to the source of the Resident Evil. Survival is your only option.

title: Resident Evil: Grim Beginnings
description: Welcome to Resident Evil: Grim Beginnings - an unfinished, yet fully playable, solo developed, Game Boy demake of the original Resident Evil.

title: Retro Surf
description:
Welcome to Retro Surf! An exclusive event from the RETROlympics! In this game you will participate in a surfing competition divided into three sessions! In each session you will have three waves to achieve your best score! The best grade from each session will be added together to determine your final result!

Your final score will determine your medal in this RETROlympics event!

title: Return of the Ninja
description:
What your enemy fears the most is something it cannot see: You!

A mysterious army has attacked the land of Koga and stolen an ancient and sacred scroll. As a highly trained ninja, it's up to you to find out who is behind the trouble and recover Koga's precious treasure. To accomplish this, you'll need to recover six secret ninja tools hidden from the invaders. The enemy army may outnumber you a thousand to one, but you are a master of stealth-- and every military leader knows that a blind enemy is a vanquished foe.

-Play as a male or female ninja character.
-Collect six special ninja tools.
-Earn ninja trading cards by completing levels
-Trade ninja trading cards with other Return of the Ninja game owners.

title: Return of the Ninja [Limited Run]
description:
Return of the Ninja on physical cartridge for the Game Boy Color. Region free. Includes an instruction booklet.

Return of the Ninja is a follow up to the 90’s classic Shadow of the Ninja. You must take on the descendants of the ninja clan Iga. They’ve stolen a secret scroll and intend to use it to bring war upon the earth. Use ancient ninja techniques and tools to fight the clan and return the scroll to its rightful owners. Originally released in ‘01 on Gameboy Color, you can play as Tsukikage or Saiyuri in this stealthy platformer by Natsume.

title: Revelations: The Demon Slayer
description: A mystical force known as Gaia permeates every aspect of the planet. Those who are aware of the force can manipulate it to do their bidding. While most use Gaia for good, there are those who would use it for evil. You take the role of El, who must journey around the world in hopes of stopping those who want to use Gaia for evil. Along the way, you will encounter new friends that will aid you in the quest. Ultimately, you will encounter monsters, and if you're lucky, you'll be able to convince the monsters to join you. When a monster has joined the party, it can be summoned to help in battle. While the monster will not gain experience, it can be combined with other creatures to create a more powerful monster. Try to keep Gaia pure and evil free in REVELATIONS: The Demon Slayer.

title: Rezal
alternate_titles: Rezal (Only For GBC)
description:
A puzzle game made in 12 days.

Throw a ball of energy at an object and swap places with it.

26 levels

Everything was made from scratch for the game jam.

title: Rhino Rumble
country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: It's amazing what some animals will do just to get a drink of water. Take Rocky the Rhino, for instance: Positively parched (he ate way too many peppers at a local jungle party), the little fellow is willing to traverse 19 enormous levels in the hope of quenching his mighty thirst. Help the adorable Rocky get through seven unique worlds, fending off all who would stand in his way. Many of the jungle's inhabitants are convinced that Rocky will drink up the water supply, you see, so they're all working against you from the outset. Make your way through forests and caves, using unique artillery like fireball breath and belly jumps to squelch the attempts of your foes and get to the magical spring. In addition to your weaponry, you'll have the assistance of various boats, planes, trampolines, and wagons to reach the end of each level.

title: Rig Attack
description: Your mission is fly a helicopter from the Heli-pad on an Oil Rig and patrol the surrounding oil fields. If you are unable to re-fuel, you will crash into the sea. To re-fuel (fuel and bombs) you land on any of the Heli-pads where an attendant will fill you up before take off. At any time in the game an enemy submarine can appear firing deadly torpedoes. To safeguard your rig you must fly over the submarine and drop your bombs, avoiding his missiles.

title: Rip-Tide Racer
description: Rip-Tide Racer is a Racing game, developed and published by Cryo Interactive, which was released in Europe in 2000.

title: Road Champs: BXS Stunt Biking
description: Stunt biking makes an appearance on the Game Boy Color with ROAD CHAMPS BXS STUNT BIKING. When you start the game, you will have to progress through a 26-stage Training mode that teaches you how to perform all 50 moves in the game. After getting through training, you will be able take on a Single-Run, Career, or Tournament. The Single-Run mode allows you to work one course and master stringing tricks together, while Career mode has you compete in competitions to move from the amateur ranks to the world of the professionals. You can also compete in the Tournament mode to become the world champion. There are total of 64 unique levels spread throughout the game do you have what it takes to master ROAD CHAMPS BXS STUNT BIKING?

title: Road Rash
description: Jump on a motorcycle and beat up the competition in ROAD RASH. You must race 15 other competitors to the finish line, but there's a catch: your opponents are equipped with weapons including chains, clubs, and pipes, and they have no problems using them on you when you get too close. Luckily, you can kick to get rid of these guys, or you just might be able to catch one and steal his weapon. Keep in mind, though, that the cops are patrolling and will not hesitate to pull you over. By placing in the top three of any race, you will be awarded some cash to spend on new bike parts or a whole new motorcycle. If your friends want to join the brutal action, they can with the Link Cable mode. Are you tough enough to take out the competition in ROAD RASH?

title: Roadsters
description: You get into a race with your buddies...in the middle of traffic. In order to win, you must pass your friends and get past all of the other cars on the road. This is the racing action and excitement of ROADSTERS for the Game Boy Color. You can choose from three different drivers that have unique attributes, and go find some action on any of the 12 tracks. To win a race, you must weave through traffic and pass the seven cars that are the competition. After each race, you are awarded cash to repair and upgrade your vehicle. Thanks to a revolutionary game engine, the action is the fastest possible on the Game Boy Color. ROADSTERS puts the thrills and dangers of road racing into the palm of your hand.

title: Robin Hood
description: Robin Hood is a action game in the style of The Legend of Zelda. You control Robin Hood from a top-down perspective. You'll have to explore, fight enemies, solve puzzles and acquire items to progress in the game. You can shoot enemies with arrows or hit them with a staff or sword. The game's targeting system allows the player to lock onto a target while walking in other directions. Acquired items can be bought and sold and NPC characters can be spoken with for hints and plot progression. The game features fifteen levels.

title: Robin to the Rescue
description: Guide Robin to the heroic journey through Nottingham Castle, to rescue Maid Marion from the evil Sheriff. You will encounter many hazards, as you scale the castle walls and climb the battlements. Extra guards have been posted, and Robin must collect the keys along the way, to save Marion from a mysterious fate.

title: RoboCop
description: Step into the shoes of the half-man, half-human hybrid known as Robocop. Your mission is to uncover a sinister plot involving OCP, local gangsters dealing a deadly new synthetic drug and a powerful cyborg known only as MIND. As the police force's last hope, you must capture, destroy, or arrest hostile characters in a desperate search for clues and evidence. Protect the innocent using six different weapons, various power-ups, and Robocop's multitarget locking system.

title: Robopon: Sun Version
description: Robopon are robotic creatures that inhabit the planet alongside humans. They can be captured and trained to battle other Robopon. You have just inherited Robopon Dispatching Company from your grandfather, but the business is failing. To start earning a profit, you must become the greatest Robopon master in the world. To do this, you must travel the globe, battling other Robopon masters and collecting the 150 species of Robopon. As Robopon battle, they gain experience and evolve into more powerful types. The cartridge also has an infrared sensor that will allow new attributes to be unlocked by shooting remote control beams into it. An internal clock is built in and will notify you of time-sensitive events. Try to catch them all in ROBOPON: Sun Version

title: Robot Ponkottsu Sun Version
alternate_titles: Robopon Sun Version
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Robot Ponkottsu: Comic Bom Bom Special Version
alternate_titles: ロボットポンコッツ コミックボンボンスペシャルバージョン
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Robot Ponkottsu: Moon Version
alternate_titles: ロボットポンコッツ 月バージョン
description: "Robopon Sun Version" and "Robopon Star Version" have been upgraded! Of course, the device using the TV and video remote control is still alive! Depending on the type of remote control, there are 6 types of events to be held this time. A variety of attractions such as "fighting ground" and "playground" are also available.

title: Robot Ponkottsu: Star Version
alternate_titles: Robopon Star Version
description: Within Robopon Sun, Star, and Moon versions, the player assumes the role of a child named Cody, whose grandpa is retiring and gives him the family business, a Robopon Dispatching Company. Cody travels around Porombo Island collecting Robopon and battling against the "Legend 7", the top-ranked Robopon collectors on the island. Each time Cody successfully beats one of the Legend 7, he takes his or her place in the ranking system.

title: Robot Wars: Metal Mayhem
description:
Robot Wars: Metal Mayhem is the first video game based on the British game show Robot Wars. It was released exclusively for Game Boy Color on 7 December 2000.[1] It was the first of four games based on the show, with the first three selling over 250,000 copies.[2] The game was based on the third series of the show, and competitors such as its champion Chaos 2 feature in the game.

In the game, a competitor robot from the series, or a robot created by the player, is entered into combat against a robot controlled by the game. A bout finishes when one robot's health bar is fully depleted. In the Tournament Mode, the first robot to win two bouts advances. The game features the arena obstacles and House Robots of the series, and in other modes, a selection of mini-games based on the show's side events.

title: Rockets Vs Cars
description:
The spinoff the and 2nd game I've been working on play as 4 characters.

 Zippy,  Potar, Cella, Spirit boy

title: Rockman
description: Its the 1890's and diamond mining fever has struck Africa. Young men travel from all over the world to make their fortunes and return home rich to marry their sweethearts. One such adventurer is Ricky Rockman from England. A strong young man with the true pioneering spirit aiming to collect as many diamonds as possible and return to Great Britain rich and famous. To achieve this, he will not only need to be strong and brave miner but also keep his wits about him, as there are many baddies about, trying to stop him and steal his diamonds!

title: Rockman 8
alternate_titles: Rockman 8: Metal Heroes | ロックマン8 メタルヒーローズ
description:
Rockman 8: Metal Heroes (ロックマン8 メタルヒーローズ) is a recoloured Game Boy Color version of the bootleg Mega Man game of the same name for the Game Boy, created by Makon Soft in 1999.

There are five Robot Masters, marked on the level select screen as Frost Man, Clown Man, Tengu Man, Grenade Man, and Rock Man. However, on the screen afterwards, the name and sprites don't match, along with some typos (i.e. Grenade Man on the Robot Master select screen is called "Tengv Man" on the following screen with a sprite of Spark Man) As well as this, the actual boss in every level isn't a Robot Master at all, varying between a car, a flying dreidel and a penguin.

title: Rockman X2 SOUL ERASER
alternate_titles: ロックマンX2 ソウルイレイザー
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Rockman X4
alternate_titles: Megaman X4
description:
Rockman X4 is a bootleg game from Makon Soft. It is a roughly colourised version of another Makon bootleg called Rockman 8: Metal Heroes, which is itself a bootleg Game Boy version of Mega Man 8.

Rockman X4 was made by Makon Soft in 2000 and is pretty much exactly like Rockman 8 with an attempt at colorization, but it has different intro pictures (This time showing scenes from Rockman X4) and a different stage select screen. Also, it doesn't show you a Rockman World 3 boss when you select a boss. Instead, it shows the boss' mugshot.

title: Rocky Mountain: Trophy Hunter
description: If you've got a keen eye and a quick trigger finger, you might just have what it takes to become the next great hunter. Using a wide array of weaponry that ranges from rifles to bows to muzzleloaders, you'll search all sorts of scenery in pursuit of your prey. Journeying through the treacherous mountains of Colorado, deep into the expanses of Montana, and through the deserts of New Mexico, you'll have to keep your eyes peeled if you want to get the jump on these wily critters. There are plenty of animals out there, but each has realistic movements and behavior to evade your efforts. The big game creatures at large include deer, bighorn sheep, elk, and bears. Of course, you'll have access to the requisite calls, attractants, and cover scents, but don't expect any of these intelligent beasts to fall right into your traps. You'll have to use your brains, reflexes, instinct, and some basic perseverance to help bag you a trophy kill. In ROCKY MOUNTAIN TROPHY HUNTER, you won't have to worry about strapping a dead animal to your car roof!

title: ROGUECRAFT GB
alternate_titles: Roguecraft GB (World) (Aftermarket) (Unl)
description:
The deeper dungeons of Mordecoom await...

For time immemorial, legend has told of a dark, deadly dungeon containing unimaginable horrors and riches beyond belief. Enough riches and magic to make you a king... or more...

Through many trials and perils, you are now standing at the entrance of a dark and mystical dungeon far from where you started. You, Zendar — a fighter, a mage, or uh, a rogue — are ready to defeat the monsters and gather the riches waiting below.

You just need to take a leak first...

title: Rokumon Tengai Mon Colle Knight GB
alternate_titles: 六門天外モンコレナイトGB | Mon Colle Knights
description: "Rokumon Tengai Mon Colle Knight", which is familiar on TV and cards, is now available as GBC exclusive game software. A lineup of familiar characters on TV! The player becomes Monto-kun, a warrior of justice, and adventures in the Rokumon world to collect Monmon items. Join forces with monsters and fight to protect the Rokumon world from the magical hands of the collection. During your journey, discover monsters with a chitin detector and join many monsters. In battle, you can get unique effects by combining monsters. It's also fun to challenge in various combinations and discover powerful attacks and defenses. Combining monsters and monsters, it's a combo battle!

title: Roland Garros French Open
alternate_titles: Roland Garros 2000
description:
Roland Garros French Open is the only appearance of the franchise on the Game Boy Color. Less of a serious simulation of tennis than other versions, the handheld edition features cartoony 2D graphics and outrageous court locations.

All-in-all, the game includes eight different players and twelve different tournaments. Only five players and four tournaments can be selected from the start, the others are unlocked by winning events. The starting tournaments are realistic grand slam events: the Roland Garros French Open (the only one with a license), the English Open (i.e. Wimbledon), the US Championship and the Australian Cup, on clay, grass or turf. Winning them unlocks the more unusual locations: from street and beach tournaments to far-out events in the Antarctic or on the moon.

All events are single elimination, starting at the quarter finals. Matches follow original rules, and are seen from a standard perspective behind the controlled player. All characters (players, officials and fans) are drawn in a cartoony style with oversized heads. The controls allow for a variety of moves including backhand and forehand shots, volleys and lobs.

title: Ronaldo V-Soccer
alternate_titles: Ronaldo V-Football
description: Based on the European hit, RONALDO-V FOOTBALL, this game is the pinnacle of soccer experiences for the Game Boy Color. Endorsed by international legend, Ronaldo Luis Nazario de Lima, RONALDO V-SOCCER brings Brazilian soccer traditions to the rest of the world. Boasting more than 100 real teams from around the globe, the game is set to an awesome Samba soundtrack and graced by colorful graphics. See how you fare over the course of an entire tournament in the comprehensive Simulation mode, or enjoy the rush of jumping right into things in Arcade mode. Either way, you're in for a highly realistic soccer experience with motion-capture animation and lifelike game physics. You can set up the rules and conditions any way you'd like, and you'll even have the ability to tailor your strategy to your opponent's style pulling from a complete playbook. Play alone, or compete against a friend.

title: Rope & Bombs
description: Rope & Bombs is a puzzle game where pieces of rope and bombs fall from above. The player tries to connect the rope as much as possible. Every once in a while, a fire appears. The fire burns any rope connected to it. The goal is to burn as much rope as possible, as when the rope reaches the top of the screen, the game is over. Any bombs touched by fire will (you guessed it) explode, destroying any rope near it.

title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths & Legends
country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Aliens have lived among mankind for centuries. However, man has known them as vampires, banshees, werewolves, and other mythical creatures. It is up to Global Alliance agent Nick Logan to stop these aliens from hunting humans and send them back to their home planets. Take control of Logan as he travels through 10 levels of action, spanning five exotic locations. In each level, Nick must master new technology to capture the aliens. If an alien tries to make a run for it, Logan can chase after it in a variety of vehicles, including a truck and a Humvee. In all of this action, he must avoid harming innocent human bystanders, who are unaware of the alien presence. Help Logan keep the aliens from feeding on humans in ROSWELL CONSPIRACIES: Aliens, Myths, & Legends.

title: Rox
description: Bunches of dice are falling from the sky, and it's up to you to arrange them the right way! In the grand tradition of puzzle classics like TETRIS and DR. MARIO comes this white-knuckle test of your reflexes. Replacing the usual bunch of plummeting shapes with six-sided dice, ROX adds an element of dominoes into the mix. Your real moment-to-moment challenge is to match one die with another, using the pair to eliminate the dice that lie in between the two.

title: Rox: 6 = Six
alternate_titles: Rox

MARIO comes this white-knuckle test of your reflexes. Replacing the usual bunch of plummeting shapes with six-sided dice, ROX adds an element of dominoes into the mix.
