title: RPG Tsukuru GB
alternate_titles: RPGツクールGB | RPG Maker GB
description: "RPG Maker GB" is perfect for you, who are in trouble because of the overflow of ideas for making games. With GB, you can easily make an RPG anytime, anywhere. I want to make an RPG, but it must be difficult to make ... Many people think that. Let's use "RPG Maker GB" for such people! Haz that you can see that it is very easy to make. Not only the main character and monster graphics, but also magic effects, castles, town graphics, and everything else you need for an RPG is available. You don't have to know the program. Even beginners can easily create RPGs by simply combining event commands prepared in advance. You are already a member of the game creators.

title: Rubber Duckie: Bathtime Fun
description:
You are Rubber Duckie. Fight filth, robot ducks, parrots, and pizza rat, among others. All leading to your ultimate showdown with Dirty Beard The Pirate on the mysterious Pirate Island!

Splish-splash your way through five worlds of this charming, quack-tastic adventure!

title: Ruby & Rusty Save the Crows
alternate_titles: Ruby and Rusty Save the Crows
description:
One Halloween, Ma and Pa put a goofy witch costume on the scarecrow. Unfortunately, that turned the scarecrow into an evil monster who took the job of scaring crows way too far.
Ruby and Rusty are two vegetables that grew into children and they’ve been friends with the crows for a long time. They’re not going to let the scarecrow get away with it! So they decided to go around the farm and find all the crows to make them feel better. And hopefully defeat the evil scarecrow at the same time, or at least give it its old clothes back.

title: Rulent Tower
description: Rulent Tower is a place filled with fandom favorite furries seen through a porn parody lens. With the tone of late 90's late-night cable skin flicks, take the role of Kyanal, Space Vixen, as she moves in her new residence recommended by her friend Rennommons. Getting the idea? Serving more like "stunt doubles" that sometimes even lead parallel lives (although sometimes it's just method acting) but in a sillier and sexier universe.

title: Runie Story
alternate_titles: RunieStory (2024) (World) (GB Compatible) (Aftermarket) (Unl)
description: Befriend locals, romance a girl, or even go on an adventure for money for gifts! An action RPG inspired by Stardew Valley and Rune Factory where you befriend or romance townsfolk or go explore dungeons. There is a lot of things to do such as farming, cooking and hunting! The main goal is to get married and get to know everyone the exploring dungeons.

title: Rusty Flesh
description:
Rusty Flesh is a sci-fi horror puzzle platformer for the Game Boy Color where you switch gravity instead of jumping (guess you could call it a VVVVVV-like!). Explore the different areas of a derelict spaceship putting together all the pieces of its lovecraftian mystery, and enjoy its retro-futuristic aesthetics.

In the near future, Earth has become a wasteland, unfit for any kind of life. Nations fell, and big tech corporations seized power. They had been getting ready for this. They built massive spaceships where a few chosen ones would travel for hundreds of years, looking for a new home. The Grampus was one of those ships... but something went wrong.

title: Saban's Power Rangers: Lightspeed Rescue
description: The Power Rangers have decided to take a more active role in their hometown of Mariner Bay. They have redesigned their Zords into rescue vehicles including a helicopter, ambulance, and fire truck providing the city with a powerful response team. Choose your character from among all five Rangers, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. The spandex-clad heroes must travel through 20 levels in an attempt to save people from fires, floods and other natural disasters. Every Power Ranger must search through the levels for all of the tools needed to make the rescue, as well as find the proper path around the destruction. However, the evil Diabolico dispatches his henchmen to block the Power Rangers at every turn while they also must contend with Mother Nature. Take control of the Rangers and save the day in POWER RANGERS LIGHT SPEED RESCUE.

title: Saboteur!
description:
Saboteur is a martial arts arcade adventure with 118 different screens, which was originally designed to run on computers with at least 48k of RAM. So to fit it into the C16's much smaller memory we have had to make a number of cuts (for example, you cannot kill the guard dogs). This version occupies almost every single byte available on the C16 - we are sorry for the cut, but we believe you will still find it very enjoyable to play.

The NEAR DISPLAY shows nearby objects that you can pick-up or use. If you press SELECT when an object is shown in the NEAR DISPLAY it gets swapped with your HELD DISPLAY. The only exception to this is the computer terminals, which you may USE to pause the game.

At the start of the game the ENERGY counter shows your energy level. This will go down when you get shot, when you fight, when you fall or get bitten, but it will go up if you stand still. If you run out of energy you die.

Your mission is to find the disk with the secret data and swap it with the bomb to escape in the helicopter before everything blows up.

title: Sabrina the Animated Series: Spooked!
description: Sssomebody ssstop him! The comic book hero brought to life in inimitable fashion by Jim Carrey now has his very own handheld game on the Game Boy Color. The well being of Stanley's beloved Tina is at stake, and he's going to have to transform himself into the Mask in order to protect her. More than 20 bizarre enemies are out to stir up trouble in this bizarre epic such as motorcycle gangs, crocodile men, and others. Make your way through nine levels of excitement, using oddball weaponry like a giant boxing glove and a hunk of cheese to fend off your rivals and return Tina safely home. In addition to the standard gameplay, there are several hidden stages to uncover, most of which can be accesses by seeking out secret objects. Whether you're a fan of the comic book, the movie, or neither, you'll have your hands full with the crazy action of THE MASK.

title: Sabrina the Animated Series: Zapped
country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Sabrina has messed up again: she has turned all of the kids into animals. Now, she must travel through town and change the kids back. In order to turn the kids back, she must hit them and then use her magic on them. There are a number of power-ups available to help Sabrina on her quest, including quadruple jumps, a butt stomp, and warping abilities. She can also collect five stars that will allow her to change the kids back without having to stun them first. However, there are areas in each stage that Sabrina cannot reach. So she must find Salem, who can crawl through small spaces and use his tail to knock over blocks to clear a path for Sabrina. Getting through a level will require planning and skill, so put on your thinking cap. Help Sabrina return her classmates to normal in SABRINA THE ANIMATED SERIES: Zapped!

title: Sabrina the Animated Series: Zapped! (ModRetro Classics Collection)
description: A re-release of the fast-paced platformer from the developer of Shantae, based on the cartoon series, where you switch between Sabrina and Salem to reverse a magical mishap.

title: Saint Seiya - El Regreso del Fenix
description:
Los caballeros siempre aparecen cuando el mal intente dañar al mundo, los caballeros del zodiaco llegan a la GameBoy Color en este fan made realizado con mucho cariño para todos los fans.

Revivan tu infancia imaginando como hubiera sido tener un título como este en su época.

Revive la historia de los Caballeros del zodiaco por más de 10 niveles que cuentan el arco de los Black Saints.
Secretos y coleccionables.
4 personajes jugables
PixelArt para ilustrar la historia
Música basada en el Anime.

title: Sakata Goro Kudan no Renju Kyoushitsu
alternate_titles: 坂田吾朗九段の連珠教室
description: Supervised by Goro Sakata, Vice President of Nippon Renjusha. It is a competition that defines the rules of "renju" and "gomoku". You can also enjoy the Renju puzzle "Goal is 5" created by Mr. Sakata!

title: Sakura Taisen GB
alternate_titles: Sakura Taisen GB: Geki Hanagumi Nyuutai! | サクラ大戦 GB ～檄・花組入隊!～ | Sakura Wars GB ~ Enlistment in the Hanagumi! ~
description: A player who will experience input to the flower troupe as an apprentice member of the Imperial Flower Troupe. During the limited period of one month, they will be trained by Sakura Yasumirera members to improve their abilities and foster love and friendship while living with them. There is an adventure part where you can interact with unique characters and a simulation part where you fight against enemies to protect the Imperial City. Of course, "LIPS", which selects options within the time limit that can be said to be a feature of the series, is also alive and well. Mini-games related to the event will appear, and if you clear the mini-game in the main story, you can enjoy the mini-game at any time. Works with Pocket Sakura.

title: Sakura Taisen GB: Geki Hanagumi Nyuutai! (Pocket Sakura Bundle)
alternate_titles: Sakura Wars GB: Go Forth, Young Cadet! (Pocket Sakura Bundle) | Sakura Wars GB: Geki Hanagumi Nyuutai! (Pocket Sakura Bundle)
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Sakura Taisen GB2
alternate_titles: サクラ大戦 GB 2 ～サンダーボルト作戦～ | Sakura Wars GB 2 ~ Operation Thunderbolt ~
description: "Sakura Wars" is back in GAME BOY! This time dramatic RPG! Orihime and Reni join the six members of the flower troupe that appeared in the previous work. Along with the familiar flower troupes, the player himself becomes the main character as a member of the Imperial City Flower Troupe and fights to collect the three types of genie treasures in Mikasa. "Mitsutake Kai" on which players and flower troupe members board can be customized. Create "Mitsutake Kai" that suits each individuality!

title: Sam Mallard: The Case of the Missing Swan
description:
Sam Mallard – The Case of the Missing Swan is a short and simple point-and-click inspired adventure game for the Game Boy.

The clock had turned midnight and I was just about to leave my office when there was a knock on my door.

It was a Mr. Swan, owner of the Swanline shipping company. He explained that his wife was missing and the police had told him that, unless they can prove outright that there was an involuntary disappearance, they just file paperwork.

He said he'd pay me a grand upfront if I could find his wife by morning, no question asked.

That may be a suspiciously large reward for a simple missing person case, but I haven't had that many jobs lately and my wallet is getting thin...

...so who am I to ask questions?

title: Samurai Kid
alternate_titles: サムライキッド
description: Stage clear type action puzzle game. The purpose is for the player to become Prince Homuramaru of the land of human beings, board the ten great youkai castles, and defeat the youkai who threaten people. Go through each stage where various gimmicks are prepared, solving the mystery while defeating the Zako youkai. Clear the stage by defeating the boss youkai that appears at the end of the stage. You can reach the ending by clearing all stages. There are three types of Homuramaru weapons: "Gourd", "Katana", and "Ougi". Each weapon has various characteristics, so if you use it properly, you may get unexpected effects. An involuntarily addictive game with a perfect response.

title: San Francisco Rush 2049
description: The arcade hit SAN FRANCISCO RUSH 2049 has come to the Game Boy Color. You can choose from five different cars, each with different attributes. Once you have the right car for your driving style, head to the track and enter the Circuit Mode to race on all 10 tracks. While racing, you will have to collect power-up icons located throughout each track to boost your speed. In addition, each track has shortcuts that will cut your time down considerably. When you win a race in Circuit Mode, the track becomes available in the Time Trial mode, where you race against the clock on an empty track. No matter how you race, all of the tracks are set in the streets of San Francisco in the year 2049. Try to become the best and unlock hidden tracks in SAN FRANCISCO RUSH 2049.

title: San Goku Shi Game Boy Han 2
alternate_titles: 三國志 ゲームボーイ版 2 | Romance of the Three Kingdoms Gameboy Version 2
description: That masterpiece "Sangokushi II" is now available in Game Boy Color! !! A magnificent drama of the men who are revived now. A fierce diplomatic battle with a breathtaking warrior's plan, and a brave single combat flash on the battlefield. Introduced unique strategy elements such as ambush poison and tiger wolf. A diplomatic element introduced in reinforcements and joint operations. Wars that are reminiscent of actual battles, such as single combat and ambush. A multi-scenario consisting of 6 scenarios. 350 unique characters.

title: Sanrio Time Net: Kako
alternate_titles: サンリオタイムネット 過去編
description: In the world of "time net", time was flowing correctly as "past", "present" and "future" thanks to the "pillar of time" that controls time. However, somebody's work broke the "pillar of time" into pieces. From that time on, the world of "Time Net" became strange and split into two parts, "past" and "future". Only pure creatures who can understand the words of the inhabitants of "Timenet" who can live in another world can save the world of "Timenet" which is divided into two worlds, the flow of time stops, and then disappears. It was the hero and his rivals who lived in the modern world that the arrow of Shirahane was. An RPG that can be enjoyed by children and adults with full-scale scenarios and systems. More than 60 popular Sanrio characters will appear, and more than 160 newly drawn Sanrio monsters will appear. Sanrio monsters can be raised and grown. You can exchange monsters, money, and information with your friends using a communication cable. You can print out the monster you got and make an original picture book. There is a different version of "Future Edition", and there are differences in scenarios and monsters that appear.

title: Sanrio Time Net: Mirai
alternate_titles: サンリオタイムネット 未来編

There is a "past edition" with different versions, and there are differences in scenarios and monsters that appear.

title: Santa Claus Junior
description: Santa Claus Junior is a platform game for the Gameboy Color. It features a little boy called Nick whose job is to find all presents Santa Claus lost when the evil witch caught him. So, he must defeat the witch and free Santa Claus so that Christmas can commence as usually.

title: Santa Claus Workshop
description:
In this Game Boy Color game, you play as an elf working in Santa Claus’s workshop during the most chaotic time of the year: the countdown to Christmas. Toy orders keep coming nonstop, and your mission is to prepare them correctly before time runs out, moving through the workshop, assembling toys, and delivering them ready to be wrapped.

Each level is a race against the clock, where you must optimize your movements. As you progress, orders become more complex and the workshop grows increasingly dangerous.

- Holes in the floor that force you to carefully plan your steps or go around them to avoid wasting time.
- Icy tiles that make you slide uncontrollably across the floor.
- The Grinch, who appears in certain levels to sabotage the workshop, trying to break toys and spread chaos.

If you manage to keep the workshop under control, Santa Claus will be able to deliver all the presents on time. But if you fail… Christmas itself could be in serious danger.

A perfect Christmas adventure to play under the tree!

title: Santa Gift Master
description: Christmas time is so magical... but Santa Claus is in big trouble! All the presents have fallen off the sleigh and now Santa needs to get them to the right places.

title: Sapphire & Shiny Kidnap the Crows
description: Sapphire & Shiny Kidnap the Crows is a Halloween-Themed ROM Hack of Ruby & Rusty Save the Crows. Everything has been reversed. Now the main characters are evil - and your job is to help them!

title: Sapphire Hotel - The Little Tales of
description:
The Hotel is now open!

Explore every room interacting with all whom stays. Unveil the mystery of who stole the cat’s-eye Sapphire. In this unique story driven blue world!

title: Satellitey's Adventure - Smickeonn: The Game 3
description: While He Cleaned SatellitOBob's Garage, Satellitey Found Something Interesting - A Water Spraying Machine That SatellitOBob Used It 21 Years Ago To Clean His Water Park From Blue, Watery Creatures Called "Bubblums" That Invaded And Tried To Destroy The Water Park. Then, Something Strange Happened When SatellitOBob And Satellitey Heard A Loud Noise... THE BUBBLUMS RETURNED AND INVADED AGAIN! Now, It's Satellitey's Turn To Clean The Water Park From The Bubblums With SatellitOBob's Help, And Also, Save The Moon From The Mighty King KamiKami Who Plans To Destroy It.

title: Scooby-Doo! Classic Creep Capers
description: Jinkies! Join up with the entire gang of meddling kids (Shaggy, Scooby, Fred, Daphne, and Velma) as you try to crack three separate mysteries each based on classic episodes of the beloved cartoon program. Taking the TV episodes "What a Night for a Knight," "That's Snow Ghost," and "A Tiki Scare is No Fair," the game runs the three stories together with a unifying plotline. You play as Shaggy, trudging through haunted forests, creepy basements, and abandoned buildings with your trusty pal, Scoob. Rather than having a "death" meter, as in most games of its kind, SCOOBY-DOO: Classic Creep Capers has a courage meter Scoob and Shag flee the scene if they get too scared. There are plenty of clues hidden throughout the game's expansive levels, but if you're not careful the bad guys might get to you before you can solve the mysteries. While the game certainly offers something for nostalgic fans of the series, it's a hilarious, original take that will keep gamers challenged as well.

title: Scrabble
description:
What do you say? It’s Scrabble, right? True, but not as we know it. Ubi Soft has finally reproduced one of the world’s most popular board games for the handheld gaming community. Yes, this is Scrabble for Game Boy Color. 

Visually, there’s really not much to say about this Game Boy Color version. The game consists of a series of white tiles each with their own letter and value. Is that enough for you? Oh yes. You know Scrabble. Seven random letters, make a word out of 'em, score points. Fall out with opponent optional. 

Seven lettered tiles it is then, with which you must formulate the highest scoring word possible. Clearly, letters such as Q, X and Z have a greater value, but the number of legitimate words that use these letters is limited. Once you’ve chosen your word, you must place it on a board in a horizontal or vertical fashion. Certain spaces on the board contain score boosters that will increase the value of your chosen word. Triple Word Score is particularly useful. Your letter supply will then be replenished and you must repeat the process once your opponent has placed his word on the board. At the end of the game, when the supply of tiles is exhausted, the highest scoring player wins. 

So there you have it. It’s Scrabble on a handheld, and it’s brilliant.

title: SD Hiryu no Ken EX
alternate_titles: SD飛龍の拳EX
description: A total of 19 unique fighters collide! Authentic techniques such as exhilarating special moves, ultimate big moves, and secrets explode! A super-real fighting game in which Hiryu no Ken's original system, SD (Super Defense) and ST (Super Technique) are completely ported.

title: Sea Change
description: A shallow adventure of exploring and matching fish for your alien overlords

title: Seal Dreamer
description: SEAL DREAMER is a retro handheld 2D platformer where you, as Dreame, must fight the "Nightmarees" with Sleep Sparkles, and find each kid's lost plush - and bring it to them so they can sleep well.

title: Seal Game 2: Seal Kid
alternate_titles: Seal Kid
description: Play as the Seal Kid and go up, jump on (or avoid) the Springy Polars and reach to your goal; a nice and tasty Grilled Cheeso Burger!

title: Seal Save
description: The one and lovely princess has been taken by some kind of Dark Magic, and it is up to you, Mint - a young seal, to save her!

title: Seipoi Densetsu
alternate_titles: 聖牌伝説 | Holy tile legend | Sei hai Densetsu
description: The strength of mahjong determines its social status. This is the kingdom of Jammar. One day, the demon is resurrected because the king mistakenly unravels the holy tile that the demon is sealed. It is said that Ikoro, the son of a brave man who is proud of the kingdom's best sparrow power and has contained monsters in tiles, will defeat the Demon King. In this way, a long journey to exterminate the Demon King of Ikoro, who only knows Reach, has begun. While fighting against enemies on 50 stages, the purpose is to acquire special power with sparrow power, defeat the enemies in line, and defeat the Demon King. Unlike a normal game, the game ends when the given conditions are cleared.

title: Self Simulated
alternate_titles: Self-Simulated (World) (Modretro Chromatic) (Aftermarket) (Unl)
description:
You were in a severe accident. Fortunately, your entire mind, including all your memories, were mapped and saved before the incident. This data, essentially you, has now been transferred into a humanoid robotic body, which you control.

However, the memories of exactly what happened and why the accident occurred are locked behind a code. M.A.C.R.I.S. cannot access these memories, and you cannot recall the code yourself.

To unlock this information, you must synchronize fully with your new robotic body. This synchronization happens automatically as you progress through and complete various stages.

title: Seme COM Dungeon: Drururuaga
alternate_titles: ～攻めCOMダンジョン～ドルルルアーガ | ～ Offensive COM Dungeon ～ Druaga
description: Set in the world 100 years after the story of the masterpiece "Tower of Druaga", a summoning action RPG in which Prince Gills of the Vivarium Kingdom stands up to save his country invaded by another country. Players and enemies have their own dungeon, fight with weapons and monsters, and attack each other to steal the source of power "Jewel". Monsters and items obtained during the game are transformed into "spell cards" and possessed, and sometimes summoned and used. Spell cards can be played against or exchanged with friends by using a communication cable. Can a new hero save the world's crisis?

title: Senkai Ibunroku Juntei Taisen
alternate_titles: 仙界異聞録 準提大戦～TVアニメーション「仙界伝封神演義」より～ | Senkai Ibunroku Semi-Promotion War: From the TV animation
description: The story is a completely original story that begins with the final scene of the original climax "Senkai Taisen". After a fierce battle, Taiko's fateful rival Wen Zhong threw himself off the cliff. However, at that moment, they are sent to another world by an unknown force. What is the fate of waiting for them in this world? Equipped with an "active turn system" in which the order of actions is determined by the speed of the character among the enemies and allies. It is necessary to always be aware of the character to act next. Many events such as "Takarakai", a weapon that is indispensable for "Hoshin Engi", have also appeared. Content that is irresistible for Hoshin Engi fans.

title: Sergio Kidd
description:
A legend says that a long time ago the inhabitants of a town met in the square to buy and exchange food.

Until one day they named a King. Which did not take long to impose taxes. The inhabitants rebelled and went to the castle. The Wizard Merlin, the King's right hand, used his magic to turn them all into obedient monsters. Plants, mushrooms... and thus create an army for the King.

Since then, no one else has tried it. Who can enter the castle and kill the King? Everyone in the town was wondering. Then, a brave young man named... Sergio Kidd appeared.

title: Sesame Street Sports
description: Good sportsmanship is the name of the game in this delightful series of sporting events. All of your favorite SESAME STREET characters are the competitors in these original contests, and winning (for once) is not the most important thing. Take the adorable athletes through six big time sporting events: Guide Grover through a unicycle race, lead Elmo into a roller skating contest, and push Ernie past the rapids in his own bathtub. Big Bird is along to conduct all of the post-game interviews, putting the emphasis of the events squarely on fun and fair play rather than heated competition. The game's controls are easy top learn allowing little gamers to get the hang of things quickly and an in-game tutorial teaches the ins and outs of each wacky sport. The excellent graphics and familiar faces make the game look and feel just like an episode of the classic kids' show. Hand-held sports have never been so fun!

title: Sesame Street: Elmo's 123s
description: Get ready to come and play and learn in SESAME STREET: Elmo's 123s for the Game Boy Color. Preschoolers love Elmo it's a simple fact of life and your kids or siblings will have a fun time here while they learn their numbers. There are four basic math concepts to be enjoyed: addition, subtraction, counting, and number pattern recognition. Elmo is the official welcoming committee to visitors from the Planet Zap, and he needs help counting all the stars so his visiting outerspace pals will turn the Sesame Street lights back on. Four cheerful and challenging games await: "How Many Stars," "Beam That Number," "Adding Countdown," and "Take It Away." In "Stars." you'll count how many stars that a speeding spaceship has left in its wake; "Beam" has you beam a spotlight over three patterns. Correctly match the patterns to the number in the lower right hand of the screen and watch rockets blast into space. "Countdown" has you flying with your jetpack and solving three addition equations, and "Take It Away" is similar, only learning subtraction is the goal. SESAME STREET: Elmo's 123s from NewKidCo will keep you entertained while you master your numbers.

title: Sesame Street: Elmo's ABCs
description: Sesame Street: Elmo's ABCs is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Bonsai Entertainment Corp. and published by NewKidCo, which was released in 1999.

title: Sesame Street: The Adventures of Elmo in Grouchland
alternate_titles: Sesame Street: Elmo in Grouchland
description: Sesame Street: The Adventures of Elmo in Grouchland is an Action game, developed by Bonsai Entertainment Corp. and published by NewKidCo, which was released in 1999.

title: Sgt. Rock: On the Frontline
alternate_titles: Front Line: The Next Mission
description: The American way is no laughing matter, and Sgt. Rock is here to prove it to naysayers the world over. Help the leathery veteran make it all the way to enemy camp, then obliterate it in order to save the day and preserve U.S. ideals. Based on the arcade game FRONT LINE, this Game Boy Color update on the title features Sgt. Rock, a D.C. Comics hero. You must guide the war hero over rivers and through the woods, taking out enemy troops and tanks. The obstacles are bountiful, as you'll come up against heavy opposition at every turn. If you stumble upon an opposing tank, feel free to hop in just remember that even tanks can be destroyed if riddled with enough grenades. Featuring a solid, straightforward premise, and intense, combat-based action, SGT. ROCK: On the Front Line is sure to appeal to gamers, appreciators of war, comic book fans, and wait, that covers everybody.

title: Shadowgate Classic
description: A council of 12 sorcerers ensured peace in Kal Torin. One member of the council began to practice the black arts and spread destruction throughout the land; he became know as the Warlock Lord. Fortunately, the others were able to defeat the Warlock Lord and imprison him beneath Shadowgate Castle. Now, he has escaped from his prison and rules Shadowgate Castle. Furthermore, he is threatening to summon the Behemoth, a creature so powerful it could destroy the world. As the last member of the forgotten royal family, you are the only one who can stop the Warlock Lord and save Kal Torin. The trek through Shadowgate castle will not be easy, and will require strength of mind and body. Will you be able to stop the Warlock Lord in SHADOWGATE CLASSIC?

title: Shaman Dojo
description:
Welcome to the world of Shaman Dojo!

Catch 'em all but Spirits! A casual game where you can catch spirits or stroll around and talk to the townsfolk. There is a lot of dialogue choices and a lot of time based events depending on the time of day in-game!

title: Shaman King: Chou Senjiryakketsu - Funbari Version
alternate_titles: シャーマンキング 超・占事略決 ふんばり編
description: The game completely reproduces the rules of the trading card game "Super Conquest"! Even trading card fans can enjoy it. Of course, you can also use the communication cable to play against each other and exchange cards. In "Funbari", Asakura Haha is the main character, and in "Melamera", Tao Ren, the enemy of the leaves, is the main character. Also, the types and appearance rates of the cards that appear in each game are different. Full of fun unique to Game Boy, such as visualization of battle and spirit summoning scenes!

title: Shaman King: Chou Senjiryakketsu - Meramera Version
alternate_titles: シャーマンキング 超・占事略決 メラメラ編
description: The game completely reproduces the rules of the trading card game "Super Conquest"! Even trading card fans can enjoy it. Of course, you can also use the communication cable to play against each other and exchange cards. In "Funbari", Asakura Haha is the main character, and in "Melamera", Tao Ren, the enemy of the leaves, is the main character. Also, the types and appearance rates of the cards that appear in each game are different. Full of fun unique to Game Boy, such as visualizing battle and spirit summoning scenes!

title: Shamus
description: Shamus has tracked Shadow to his lair. Preparing for a long fight, Shamus charges his blaster and gets a reading from his sensors, telling him that there are 128 rooms to explore before he gets to Shadow. Take control of Shamus as you hunt down Shadow and try to put an end to his diabolical deeds. Unfortunately, there are droids and drones that will do whatever they can to stop you. You'll come across a total of seven different androids with different abilities and skills. Luckily, you can fire your blaster in eight different directions to eliminate the bad guys while avoiding enemy fire. During the adventure, you will find keys to unlock new levels, extra lives, and mysterious question marks that contain extra lives, points, or Shadow himself. If you are good enough, you will be able to unlock several bonus levels. Work your way through the hideout to a final battle with Shadow in SHAMUS.

title: Shanghai Pocket
description: Shanghai has been a popular PC game for quite some time. Now the game has come to the Game Boy Color with SHANGHAI POCKET. The game has a Mah-Jongg tile set arranged in an organized pile. The player must remove matching pairs of tiles, but only if the two can be moved freely. Removing all of the tiles or getting to a point when no moves are available will end the game. In addition to the standard Single-Player mode, there are two different Two-Player modes. In one, the players are given the same set of tiles and whoever clears all of them first is declared the winner. The other Two-Player game, removing certain combinations of tiles will cause new tiles to be dumped onto your opponent's pile. Try to become a master with SHANGHAI POCKET.

title: Shantae
description:
Shantae is a 2002 Game Boy Color video game developed by WayForward Technologies and released by Capcom USA in the USA on June 4, 2002.

Genie-girl Shantae is the self-appointed guardian of a small fishing village, Scuttle Town. Living life in a lighthouse rather than a bottle, she's constantly on the lookout for danger. When the nefarious lady-pirate, Risky Boots catches wind of the treasure that was recently unearthed in the village, she launches an attack. To get Scuttle out of trouble, it's up to Shantae to prove that she's the rightful 'Guardian Genie' to the best of her dancing, buying and hair-whipping abilities. Now crack that whip!

* Play on the Game Boy Advance system for enhanced color and to unlock hidden secrets!
* Over 50 Locations and Mini-Games!
* Learn 'Dance Magic' to transform Shantae and learn new attacks!

title: Shantae [Limited Run Collector's Edition]
description: Follow the adventures of the eponymous half-genie Shantae, who must travel across Sequin Land, the setting of the series, to foil the domination plans of the evil lady pirate Risky Boots.

title: Shantae [Limited Run Games]
description:
Shantae on playable physical cartridge for the Game Boy Color. This is an open pre-order for a limited time.

This comes packaged in a standard Game Boy sized box with beautiful rainbow foil stamping on the side. The cartridge is functional on Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, and any other hardware that supports Game Boy Color games.
Includes a full color manual.


Follow the adventures of the eponymous half-genie Shantae, who must travel across Sequin Land, the setting of the series, to foil the domination plans of the evil lady pirate Risky Boots.

title: Shark Attack
description:
The seas of the world are no longer safe! Giant, man eating sharks now rule the waves, and the only hope left is for fearless divers to brave the rigors of the undersea world and destroy the shark menace. Not only will kill you have to brave the sharks, but also vicious and hungry squid, electric eels, and octopi.

Sharks threaten bathers across 12 seas, please clear all 12 locations. Good luck!

title: Shaun Palmer's Pro Snowboarder
description: What TONY HAWK'S PRO SKATER did for skateboarding, SHAUN PALMER'S PRO SNOWBOARDER will do the same for snowboarding. Take your shot at building a pro legacy with the help of the legendary snowboarder Shaun Palmer. Four real-world boarding locales will challenge you to the max, and there are 16 total courses to learn and master. The object of the game is to make your way up the ladder of all-pro snowboarders, earning higher rankings as you learn new tricks. Many snowboarding games emphasize speed and racing, but SHAUN PALMER'S PRO SNOWBOARDER is mostly about the tricks. With literally dozens of awesome maneuvers to try out, the game ensures that things will never get dull. The game's graphics rival those of full-sized consoles, and there's a kicking soundtrack to keep your adrenaline pumping. If you have a craving for extreme sports, this is the perfect way to get your fix without breaking a leg in the process.

title: Sheep Split
description:
You’ve always dreamed of becoming a rancher and living among animals. Yesterday, you finally landed a job at a ranch near your hometown, and today is your very first day.

But disaster strikes — you slip and accidentally open both the blue and red sheep pens! Now the sheep are running wild, and if the owner finds out… you don’t even want to imagine what’ll happen. You have until 13:00 to fix this mess before the owner gets back from town. Right now, it’s… WHAT?! 12:57!!! That’s only three minutes to round them all up!

Face the sheep stampede and herd them into their correct pens. Pick them up, throw them to the sides, and pray for your soul. And whatever you do… watch out for the disguised wolves!

title: Shera's Music Party
description: Shera's Music Party is a rhythm music video games inspired by games like "Guitar Hero" or "Rock Band". The player controls a piano with which he has to hit the keys just at the moment when the notes (or other elements) reach the corresponding key zone. You are accompanied by a kitty of your choice which will cheer up if you have a good rhythm or will lose concentration if you fail.

title: Shin Megami Tensei Trading Card: Card Summoner
alternate_titles: 真・女神転生トレーディングカード カードサマナー
description: An authentic card game full of "tutorials" where you can learn the rules according to the scenario so that even first-time players can enjoy it immediately while retaining the fun of the original card version "Shin Megami Tensei Trading Card". There are more than 480 types of cards, including devil cards and item cards! Many characters such as humans and demons fight against players by mastering their unique decks. A hot battle is developed by the biggest feature of card summoner, "Devil union". If you win the rookie competition in story mode, you will be able to use the communication cable to perform communication battles and card trades with the two rules of "Standard" and "Highlander".

title: Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Children - Aka no Sho
alternate_titles: 真・女神転生デビルチルドレン 赤の書 | Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Children - Red Book
description: The main character, "Kai Mirai," is suddenly handed a devilizer at school and is attacked by an enemy devil who is chasing it. He succeeds in summoning the Gryphon veil using the Devilizer and driving away the enemy, but he is robbed of the jewel that is his mother's keepsake. The mysterious boy "Takajo Zet" who was there takes him to the demon world using the jewel of his mother's keepsake, and is asked by the king of the demon world to defeat "another Devil Children" who destroys the world. .. The player becomes the main character and develops an adventure. The hero calls the devil who became a demon (Nakama) by various encounters and fights against the enemy. Incidents, mysteries, encounters that block the player's path ... What is the fate of the hero? ??

title: Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Children - Kuro no Sho
alternate_titles: 真・女神転生デビルチルドレン 黒の書 | Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Children - Black Book
description: One day when a devilizer was sent to the main character "Kai Setsuna", he was attacked by Jack Frost with his younger brother "Nagahisa". Setsuna uses a devilizer to summon Cerberus's cool and escapes the crisis, but her younger brother "Nagahisa" is taken away by the demon world. A mysterious boy "Takajo Zet" who suddenly appeared in front of the moment taught him that he had to explore all the worlds of the demon world in order to rescue Nagahisa, and he left for the demon world. The player becomes the main character and develops an adventure. The hero calls the devil who became a demon (Nakama) by various encounters and fights against the enemy. Incidents, mysteries, encounters that block the player's path ... What is the fate of the hero? ??

title: Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Children - Shiro no Sho
alternate_titles: 真・女神転生デビルチルドレン 白の書 | Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Children - White Book
description: With the arrival of a new era by Ragnarok, the demon world and the heavenly world are changing into new forms in the future. The power of devils and angels is instilled in human children by the forces of the heavenly world trying to reshape the world as they wish and the forces of the demon world that oppose it. Humans and devils, humans and angels. Two babies born in the same hospital on the same day, each with two powers, grew up to be two boys attending the same elementary school in Harajuku, Tokyo, ten years later while fostering friendship with each other. Masaki Kuzuha, who has free thinking and vigorous curiosity, and Takaharu Ojo, who is honest and quiet, lived happily every day while acknowledging each other. Without knowing that a harsh fate awaits after that ... Full of fun and interesting gimmicks, just like the world view of Debitil World! Continuing from the previous work of the adventure in "Makai", this time the adventure has spread to "Tenkai", and the scenario is even more intense. More than 330 kinds of characters, such as the familiar Cu Chulainn and the new Frost character, have appeared! Since both the black coalescence system (such as a coalescence accident) and the red coalescence system (same race coalescence) are possible in the "White Book", you can choose which coalescing to perform. If infrared rays are transmitted to the infrared receiver of the GBC main body by transmitting infrared rays such as a home TV remote controller during coalescence, the coalescence can be affected in some way. * Infrared communication is GBC only.

title: ShinoBeetle
description: Set in a post-nuclear world where the earth inhabitants are mutated bugs, you must clean up the world from the Toxic Mold, what remains of the old world, that infest the lands and transform the bugs in brainless deadly creatures. With your ninja-bug skills you will have to restore balance to the world!

title: Shogi 2
alternate_titles: 将棋 2
description: Completely renewed GB software "Shogi" for the first time in about 10 years! Achieves faster thinking and smoother movement. The modes are "game mode" where you can enjoy the main shogi according to the strength of the shogi from level 1 to 5, "mystery shogi" where you can play without seeing the opponent's piece, and all the kneading from 3 to 19 tsume shogi. There are 60 titles, "Tsume Shogi Mode".

title: Shogi 3
alternate_titles: 将棋 3
description: The third in the "Shogi" series! There are 5 levels, and you can enjoy it according to the ability of the player. Central Rook and Third File Rook have been added to the main tactics up to the previous work, Static Rook and Fourth File Rook. It's a routine full of humanity, with quick stabs, long thoughts like a professional shogi player, and a variety of changes, sometimes with poker and tesuji changes. Since the game record remains until the end, you can freely return or proceed.

title: Shoot-Out!
alternate_titles: Shoot-Out! In Colour
description:
You're a wandering lawman on the trail of an outlaw gang. Beat them in a test of reflexes and bring peace to the Wild West!

• 5 breathtaking locations

• 5 colorful outlaws to duel

• a shocking ending for anyone with the grit to defeat the final stage

title: Shrek: Fairy Tale Freakdown
description: The wackiest computer-animated film of all time has its own classic hand-held game! Boasting fast-paced thrills and the most hilarious characters ever portrayed in a video game, SHREK: Fairy Tales Freakdown turns the story of the movie into a fighting game that players of all ages will love. Taking six familiar faces from the popular film, Fairy Tales Freakdown pits the unlikely combatants in a series of battles against one another each fight taking place in a classic SHREK environment. Solid gameplay will earn you the right to play as one of three locked characters, and each brawler is characterized by a unique (and highly comical) fighting style. The mostly non-violent fighting closely mirrors the humor of the film, resulting in some truly memorable melees. Using animations that are straight from the film, the game delivers the look and feel that made SHREK so successful. Play alone or take on a friend in this lighthearted, tournament-style fighting game.

title: Shrine Rally
description: Team up with your student activist friend and a local shrine to fight against the gentrification on your campus or learn about your family’s past in a slight-of-life gameboy adventure “Shrine Rally”.

title: Silent Hill 2: 20th Anniversary Demake
alternate_titles: Silent Hill 2 | Silent Hill 2 Demake
genre:
This is a Gameboy Color Demake of the PlayStation 2 game, Silent Hill 2, where you join James Sunderland, who enters the town after receiving a letter written by his deceased wife, saying she is waiting for him in their "special place" in Silent Hill. Joined by Maria who resembles her except for a more provocative outfit and personality, he searches for her and discovers the truth about her death. Additional material in re-releases and ports included Born from a Wish, a sub-scenario which focuses on Maria before she and James meet.

This ROM is "as is" not finished, but that said you can go through the whole game. There are times when limitations of the software may force a player to NOT FIGHT but run past certain nurses in dark silent hill and if you go to the room where the videotape is the door might not let you in but entering a nearby door then returning will fix it. Still has all the endings including the dog ending, The board  and gun are the only real weapons coded in that is as far as I got.

++++ and one more thing in the bathroom at the beginning of the game if you go left through the wall then up you will find a warp zone with the theme of laura playing...
