title: Silent Hill 2: Born from a Wish 20th Anniversary Demake
alternate_titles: Silent Hill 2: Born from a Wish Demake | Born from a Wish GBC
description: "Born from a Wish" is a prequel to Silent Hill 2, and an alternate scenario where you play as Maria, who is looking for someone alive in Silent Hill. This version of the game was released as part of the Silent Hill 2: 20th Anniversary Demake for Gameboy Color as a separate ROM file.

title: Silly Dog
description: A very short story about a very silly dog.

title: Silver Falls: Galaxy Bound Curse
description: It's the late 90s, and one of the Silver Falls locals has just had his first son born! The locals are at the local bar partying when disaster strikes. A child has been kidnapped and it is up to the locals to rescue the kid and stop the kidnapper.

title: Sisyphos
description:
Roll the rock to the top, it will roll back down. Keep trying... forever!

Sisyphus or Sisyphos was forced, every day, to roll an immense boulder up a mountain, only for it to roll back down every time. This was his punishment from Zeus for cheating death.

Inspired by this classical myth, tasks that are both laborious and futile are therefore described as Sisyphean.

title: SK8-BIT
description:
8-BIT Skateboarding game for the GameBoy Color, 

2 Modes:

CHALLENGE:
A test of timing and endurance to be crowned the "ULTIMATE SKATER"

FREESKATE:
When you need a break from Challenge Mode. Ollie, Kickflip, Grind, Slide and Manual your frustration away.

title: Skelby
description: Skelby is trapped inside a building that's enough to drive any poor droid round the twist. Forced to clear the rooms of nasty squirmers just to earn a can of low grade oil to keep his body and electronic soul together, life is made just a little too hazardous by the gravestones that keep appearing in memory of every squirmer that you kill. Even the building is out to hinder our hero's efforts as more and more walls appear to block his free movement.

title: SKELOST
description: Celebrating 27 years of the Game Boy Color with a brand-new yokai shooter! Immerse yourself in Japanese folklore, fast-paced action, and retro horror as you uncover the fate of your lost family.

title: Skinner & The Superintendent: The GBC Game!
description:
This is just a simple game about "Steamed Hams" scene. Help Skinner to do an unforgettable luncheon for Chalmers, with 9 possible endings!

This Game was based on a scene of an episode of "The Simpsons" called "22 Shorts About Springfield", made just for fun and not owned by FOX or Disney.

title: Skull Knightmare
description:
Test your skill and reflexes, dodge the cannon balls for as long as possible,

For every second you last, you earn a point, at certain times a doubloon will appear for a limited time, if you catch it, you will earn 10 extra points.

Get your best score and challenge your friends to beat it, prove that you are the most skilled pirate on the seas.

title: Skycon
description: In the not so distant future, aliens visit our planet to take over the earthlings. There is no need to fear, because a trained pilot is sent aboard the Skycon by the committee of nations to stop the attack and liberate our planet. Be brave and persistent to defeat all 6 enemy forces. Good luck pilot!

title: Sleep at Night
description: Your family is home, but they're acting strange. Come to think of it, your whole house looks strange. Your father is waiting to speak with you, but you can't remember what happened earlier. You'll have to look around your family's estate to jog your memory. Explore and interact with the confusing world you find yourself in to uncover clues and unlock new paths! Will you find the secret ending?

title: Slender: The 8 Pages
alternate_titles: Slender: The 8 Pages Demake | Slender: The 8 Pages GBC | SLENDER THE 8 GBC PAGES | Slenderman GBC
description:
Your goal is to collect 8 pages scattered throughout a dark forest, However, with each page collected, a creature approaches.

Seu objetivo é coletar 8 páginas espalhadas por uma floresta escura. No entanto, a cada página coletada, uma criatura se aproxima.

title: Small Town Emo
description:
Small Town Emo is a romantic GAMEBOY walking simulator with a healthy dollop of mid-2000's awkwardness! Take control of main character Ken, and guide him through a series of small town New Zealand locations rendered in pixelated GameBoy-style graphics.

Talk to characters, solve simple puzzles, make (occasional) dialogue choices, and explore! Navigate through the complexities of a teenage crush, and let the story of this small town emo kid unfold around you.

title: Smickeonn: The Game 2
description:
Are You Ready For This?

TVMZ Returned To The Video Gaming World With His New Adventure For The Game Boy & Nintendo 3DS!

A New Fantastic Adventure With Stunning Visual Graphics And Interesting Story Waiting Only For YOU!

Also Including: 2 Awesome Mini Games + The Ability To SAVE THE GAME!

title: Snakes and Ladders
description:
Step into a new twist on the classic Snakes and Ladders! Up to three players can join the fun - challenge your family, friends, or take on the computer.

Play by traditional rules or explore new variations that add strategy to the mix. In this version, success doesn’t rely on luck alone: perfect timing and smart moves can turn the tide of the game.
Will you climb to victory or slide into defeat? The board awaits!

title: Snoopy Tennis
description: It's a tennis game, Charlie Brown! The PEANUTS gang have packed up their rackets and headed to the courts for some fun tennis action in SNOOPY TENNIS for Game Boy Color. Choose from an initial selection of four characters Snoopy, Charlie Brown, Linus, and Lucy and take to one of four courts: clay, hard, and two different grass courts. Five gameplay modes await you: in Normal mode you play a quick best-of-three or best-of-five match up against a computer or human opponent; Sudden Win gives you an instant victory if you gain two games on your opponent; in Point Race mode, you'll race to see how many points you can score in a minute; Special mode throws a variety of power-ups into the mix; and Championship mode has you battling several opponents in order to become champion and unlock four new characters and courts. In addition, three different difficulty levels allow players of all skill levels to enjoy the game. SNOOPY TENNIS is for Game Boy Color only.

title: Snowboard Champion
alternate_titles: スノボーチャンピオン
description: Players aim to develop their own characters while competing against rivals in four snowboard competitions and winning. Each rival has a strong competition and challenges the hero. By defeating rivals, players can get points and increase parameters, and can create their own original characters. "Slalom", "Halfpipe", "One-make" and "Border Cross" are available as competition types. Parameters include physical strength, endurance, reflex ability, and instantaneous power, and are related to skill, speed, and jumping.

title: SnowCross
description: Get on a snowmobile and drive your way to victory with SnowCross. Try to master 10 different courses that take you through ovals, twisting bobsled runs, and several treks through the wilderness. When you are ready for some competition, try to win the Tournament Cups, where you will have to take first place from two other racers. After winning, you will be able to upgrade your vehicle before moving on to the next race. With three different Cups to win, there is plenty of racing action. If you get tired of racing computer-controlled opponents, hook up a link cable to challenge your friends to a race. You will become the greatest snowmobiler of all time in SnowCross

title: Soccer Manager
description: Soccer Manager is a Sports game, developed by Broadsword Interactive and published by Acclaim, which was released in Europe in 2000.

title: Sofia the Witch Curse of the Monster Moon
description:
Every 500 years the stars align with the lunar eclipse creating the fabled Monster Moon. The moon turns green and Curses the land turning the animals into MONSTERS.

It's up to you to save all your friends and remove the Curse of the Monster Moon.

title: Sonic Adventure 7
description: Sonic Adventure 7 is a hack of Sonic 3D Blast 5, made in 1999, although this hack is for the Game Boy Color. The game adds color, alters some of the graphics and changes the order of the levels, with the fourth level from S3DB5 becoming the first level. What used to be a remake of the intro from Sonic 3D Blast was replaced with Sonic & Knuckles' intro, and the title screen is very poor digitization of Sonic Adventure's box art. Strangely, the game includes a manual which is mostly a poorly done edit of Sonic Blast's manual, with most references to Knuckles being replaced with the Sonic Adventure 7 logo, despite Knuckles himself appearing in the intro (in green.)

title: Sonic Adventure 8
alternate_titles: Sonic 8
description:
Sonic Adventure 8 is a bootleg released by Makon Soft Studio in 2000.  It is a rearranged version of Makon's Sonic Adventure 7, also released in 2000. 

The intro has been redone again, this time featuring a screenshot of Sandopolis Zone, and most of the music has been reverted back to the tracks heard in S3DB5. The colour palettes have been changed (making Sonic red), and the level order has been rearranged again, with the Flying Battery level (second level in S3DB5, fourth in SA7) becoming the first level.

title: Soreike! Anpanman: 5tsu no Tou no Ousama
alternate_titles: それいけ!アンパンマン 5つの塔の王様 | Go! Anpanman King of the Five Towers
description: The stage is five towers towering over the city where Anpanman lives. In fact, this tower is a spaceship that crash landed because five kings had a fight. Anpanman's purpose is to recover the jewels that Baikinman stole from the spaceship, reconcile the kings, and safely leave for space. New characters for this game are also available! Uses a large font so that even kindergarten children can play.

title: Soreike! Anpanman: Fushigi na Nikoniko Album
alternate_titles: それいけ!アンパンマン 不思議なにこにこアルバム | Soreike! Anpanman Mysterious Smile Album
description: A game where you control Anpanman and collect photos of your friends in various places. The photo must be a smiling person. However, some friends have less Nico Nico power because of Baikinman. In such a case, let's listen to the story. Maybe something is in trouble ... Let's complete the album in this way and help Dokin-chan and Melonpanna-chan trapped in the album! Baikinman challenges the game to prevent the album from being made. If you lose the mini-game, Baikinman will take the photos in the album. Since there is a communication mode, the characters of the collected album can communicate with other players.

title: Soukoban Densetsu: Hikari to Yami no Kuni
alternate_titles: 倉庫番伝説 ～光と闇の国～ | Sokoban Legend -The Land of Light and Darkness-
description: "Sokoban" based on the fantasy world. The mode is "Original mode" which will be cleared if you can move the block to the specified place and fill it all, "Story mode" where the hero rescues the lover who has been kidnapped by the Demon King, "Sokoban" puzzle There are 3 types of "Edit Mode" that you can edit and actually play. In story mode, the enemies appearing on the stage are put to sleep with sleeping bullets, and the stone statues are moved onto the Demon Kings, making it so elaborate that you can't think of it as a Sokoban.

title: Soul Falchion
alternate_titles: 格鬥劍神
description:
THE SOUL STILL BURNS

The last in Vast Fame's line of semi-original GBC fighting games, a swordfighting-themed game using an engine from Takara's Nettou KOF games and character designs mostly cribbed from SNK games It's pretty cool!

There are a few different variations of this game released in different markets and on multicarts and the like. This one appears to be the original Taiwanese single cart release, with Kang on the title screen where the Chinese release has Saibot. The soundtrack also matches the Chinese one, as opposed to the Taiwanese multicart release which has a bunch of different tracks. got all that?

title: Soul Getter: Houkago Bouken RPG
alternate_titles: ソウルゲッター～放課後冒険RPG | Soul Getter: After School Adventure RPG
description: An RPG that seeks out the sealed soul in order to reseal the unsealed "Dark King". Soul is a special jewel. When attached to a pendant, you can bring out the special abilities of the soul, and you will be able to perform magic attacks during battle. The pendant has a frame for incorporating souls, and it is possible to combine 1 to 3 souls, searching for and equipping combinations like a puzzle. You can choose the main character between boys and girls, and there are items that only boys can equip, and the characters that appear are kind to girls.

title: Space Invaders
alternate_titles: Space Invaders X
description: Aliens are trying to take over the solar system, and you're the only one that can stop them. You are the best pilot on Earth, and you must defend all of the planets. After choosing your vehicle from the three that are available, it will stay at the bottom of the screen as a formation of aliens slowly moves down the screen. Your job is simple: blast the aliens out the sky. When they are decimated, you will move on to the next level. Fortunately, there are several power-ups available including electricity, solar flares, bubbles, shurikens, and others. As you progress through the game, new aliens with new formations will appear, not mention a boss character or two. If you are lucky enough to make it through all of the game levels, you will be able to play a version of the original arcade game released in the late '70s. Defend the Earth from tyranny in SPACE INVADERS.

title: Space Marauder
description: When humankind discovers an alien race on a distant planet, it becomes clear that the extra-terrestrial way of life threatens survival on Earth. Rather than sending out a fleet of space destroyers or loads of nuclear warheads, it is determined that Earth's best chance of wiping out these creatures is (drum roll, please) you! As Space Marauder, it is your job to avoid waves of space beings careening through the outer reaches of the galaxy. You are aiding only by a jet pack and a laser gun. Sound tough? It is. Assorted power-ups are strewn about to help you in your plight, but the best asset you'll have is your itchy trigger finger and taste for alien blood. Lots of powerful bosses wait at the end of each of the game's levels, and every stage presents new and increasingly difficult challenges for our hero. Boasting a cool soundtrack and smooth controls, there's plenty of gameplay to keep your fingers moving for hours on end.

title: Space Samurai
description:
"The Space Shogun is dead.

Each planet tried to seize power after the fall of the shogunate and a civil war ravaged the galaxy. The elite squadron of space samurai perished in battle. But a shadow rose taking advantage from the  destruction seeking to devour all the worlds.

You are the last surviving space samurai. 

Fight against the Scourge and protect the galaxy!"

title: Space Station Silicon Valley
description:
Space Station Silicon Valley is a based on the Nintendo 64 game of the same name. It keeps story, gameplay mechanics and even the basic level design while translating everything into a platforming perspective shown from the side. 

The story is about a space station which is populated by independent robot animals. A while ago the station vanished but now it is back on full collision course towards Earth. Of course humanity sends squads out there to end the threat, but everyone but the robot Evo gets lost. The player takes the role of Evo who has to solve 35 levels in order to save Earth.

The unique characteristic of the game is that Evo has the ability to take control over any robot animal he meets. In fact, he is required to do so because his life energy rapidly decreases when outside of a host. All those animals have different abilities which are used to solve the numerous puzzles found in the levels. There are varying goals to complete in each level which range from destroying a machine to guiding sheep to their pens.

title: Space Taxi
description:
Originally released in 1987 by Björn Schneider for the Commodore 16, this long-lost retro gem is now back for the Game Boy Color!

Take control of a flying taxi and transport impatient passengers from platform to platform across 5 gravity-defying space levels. But be warned: your fuel is limited, and only landing safely on a platform will keep your vehicle intact. Crash anywhere else, and it’s game over.

Each customer has just 30 space-seconds to reach their destination, so speed pays—literally. The faster you deliver them, the more money you earn.

Classic gameplay, challenging physics, and pure nostalgia await players who remember the Space Taxi franchise - or those discovering it for the first time.

Buckle up, pilot. It’s 1987 all over again - now in full Game Boy Color!

title: Space Walk
description:
You are an astronaut in command of a space shuttle. Your mission is to retrieve stray satellites and load them into your space shuttle.

Grab the satellite by passing over. Try  to destroy the multitudes of cosmic aliens that you will encounter during various levels of combat.

title: Space-Net: Cosmo Blue
alternate_titles: スペースネット コスモブルー
description: In August 2000, ISNA catches SOS signals from unknown and rainbow star systems. ISNA had already dispatched several agents, but the Rainbow system was in a very dangerous situation by a corps of Nazo who called themselves Crackers. Therefore, ISNA has decided to urgently recruit agents who will participate in the rescue operation of the rainbow star system. Become an agent and rescue the Rainbow system from the magical hands of the Crackers! The player is a space adventure RPG that becomes an agent of the space research organization ISNA and fights for the space crisis. Adventures in the rainbow system are carried out using the space exploration software "Space Net". Run around seven planets in the rainbow system with the "Space Net" warp function. A story full of surprises and emotions, such as encounters with unknown planets and aliens. With a speedy and strategic battle system, the battle is hot! If you create a base on the homepage, you can easily develop your own machine parts and items. Of course, you can exchange information with your friends and get the latest information on the game. Cosmo Blue is a version that uses speed to defeat enemies.

title: Space-Net: Cosmo Red
alternate_titles: スペースネット コスモレッド
description: In August 2000, ISNA catches SOS signals from unknown and rainbow star systems. ISNA had already dispatched several agents, but the Rainbow system was in a very dangerous situation by a corps of Nazo who called themselves Crackers. Therefore, ISNA has decided to urgently recruit agents who will participate in the rescue operation of the rainbow star system. Become an agent and rescue the Rainbow system from the magical hands of the Crackers! The player is a space adventure RPG that becomes an agent of the space research organization ISNA and fights for the space crisis. Adventures in the rainbow system are carried out using the space exploration software "Space Net". Run around seven planets in the rainbow system with the "Space Net" warp function. A story full of surprises and emotions, such as encounters with unknown planets and aliens. With a speedy and strategic battle system, the battle is hot! If you create a base on the homepage, you can easily develop your own machine parts and items. Of course, you can exchange information with your friends and get the latest information on the game. Cosmo Red is a version that uses its power to defeat enemies.

title: Space-Time Star Beast
alternate_titles: Shi Kong Xing Shou | 星空神獸
description:
Shi Kong Xing Shou (時空星獸, translated as Space-Time Star Beast and also known as 星空神獸, or Mythical Beasts of the Starry Sky) is a Pokémon-esque role-playing game developed by Vast Fame and was released on July 18, 2001.

The game tells the story of a young boy named Ballot whose father is a brilliant astronomer. One day, his father makes an unusual discovery: the moon is glowing a blue hue. Two days after this discovery, Ballot's father disappears, only leaving behind his journal as to where he went. Not only that, but due to a strange meteor shower caused by a vortex in space, the creatures of Earth have mutated into "Star Beasts" including Ballot's faithful pet dog, Whitey. With his new-and-improved pet, the Blue Soul Dog, by his side, Ballot goes on an adventure to find his father and discover the secrets of the Star Beasts.

title: Spawn
description: Special agent Al Simmons was tricked by his team and assassinated. After traveling to Hell, Simmons make a deal with the devil to get revenge. However, the deal was twisted and Simmons became a minion of Hell he became Spawn. Rather than accept this fate, Spawn searches for the opportunity to free himself from his misguided deal. You take control of Spawn as he fights his way through nine levels of action. In each of the stages, Spawn must eliminate the bad guys using punches, kicks, and any weapons he can find. However, there is always a chain weapon attached to Spawn's chest that can be used to eliminate nearby enemies. Occasionally, Spawn will have to chase evil down while riding a motorcycle. Help defeat the devil, and set SPAWN free.

title: Speedy Gonzales: Aztec Adventure
description: Sylvester has kidnapped all of the mice in Mexico and it's up to Speedy Gonzales to rescue them. To get all the mice back, Speedy must collect the cheese in 18 different stages. However, the cheese will not be easy to collect, as along the way Speedy will have to make death-defying jumps while avoiding spikes, lava, and bottomless pits. In addition to those hazards, there are a number of enemies that are glad the mice are gone and don't want Speedy to rescue them. As luck would have it, there are power-ups and weapons scattered throughout the stages. After completing several stages, Speedy will have to face and defeat a boss character. Will Speedy be able to collect all of the cheese and defeat his enemies? Find out by playing SPEEDY GONZALES: Aztec Adventure.

title: Spellbound
description: Spellbound is a narrative 2d game about the authors personal experience with a condition called "Maladaptive Daydreaming", Depression, post traumatic stress disorder and suicidal thoughts. It depicts their reality from the point of view of a character called Vera, who suffers from the same conditions as they do. Players experience a therapy session in which they get to follow Vera's story. Please read the trigger warnings before you play through the game.

title: Spelunky
description:
This is an attempt to demake Spelunky 2 for GBC. This was a wildly ambitious project, and I only just managed to get a playable version ready, although I ended up having to convert it to an endless runner type game, and cut a ton of planned content.

Since it ended up getting rushed a little in the last few weeks of development, it can be a little rough around the edges in some areas, and I haven't has the time to properly test it thoroughly. But what's here is here, and that includes a fully featured character controller, a fast and robust entity system, and level generation and auto-tiling that works well.

title: Spider-Man
description: Master criminal, Dr. Octopus, is up to his old tricks this time conducting dangerous genetic experiments. Spidey will have to do some serious web slinging if he wants to stop his nemesis! Travel over New York City rooftops, streets, subways, sewers, and all the way out to the docks in your attempt to save mankind. Just like in the popular comic book series, Spider-Man can climb walls, stick to any surface, detect danger with his Spider-Sense, and use regular old hand-to-hand combat to take down his enemies. There'll be plenty of awesome power-ups to help you catch Octopus: one-ups, hearts, limited invincibility, and more. Lots of characters from the comic book play significant roles in the hand-held game as well: Venom, Lizard, and Hobgoblin will try to take Spidey down, while Carnage waits at the game's end as a final boss. Fans of the comic series and gamers alike will love this Game Boy adaptation of a time-honored series.

title: Spider-Man 2: The Sinister Six
description: Can you save the world from the most sinister group of super villains ever to unite? Dr. Octopus has assembled the most powerful criminal collective ever, and you've got to help the Amazing Spider-Man defeat them before all hope is lost. Octopus has enlisted the likes of Electro, Sandman, Mysterio, the Vulture, and Hobgoblin in order to wreak massive amounts of havoc and squash Spidey once and for all. Use your Spider Sense to make your way through each urban level, slinging webs and solving complex puzzles in order to track down the bad guys. Boasting superb, full-color graphics and some of the most addicting gameplay you'll ever experience, SPIDER-MAN 2: The Sinister Six features story elements and animations lifted straight from the pages of Marvel Comics series. Simple controls allow you to get in the game quickly but don't expect anything else to be so easy. Play alone or take on a friend in this dark original.

title: Spiky Harold
description: You must help Spiky Harold to prepare for hibernation. Each of the chambers beneath the Hedgerow contains an item of food which Harold can eat. However, he must avoid the creatures who will try to stop him. On his travels, Harold may find some coins which will give him extra lives, and wine glasses that will make him drunk (the creatures will be faster). When you have helped Harold to collect ALL the objects, he must be guided to his home cavern where he can hibernate.

title: Spirou: The Robot Invasion
alternate_titles: Spirou Robbedoes - The Robot Invasion
description:
Spirou: The Robot Invasion is a 2D side'scrolling platform game based on the Franco-Belgian comic Spirou et Fantasio.

Fantasio bought a strange mechanical device. When he brings it home and thoroughly inspects it, it turns out to be a malevolent robot who subsequently escapes from the house. Soon a villain called Cyanide appears to be involved and the entire town is crawling with evil robots. It's up to the player (as Spirou) to set things straight! Armed with a maul you have to trash the robots. Controls are similar to other platform games: you can walk, jump, attack, use a switch and grab a ledge. You'll have to solve simples puzzles such as pressing switches to open doors. You can pick up items that restore your health or unlock bonus levels. The game also has a UBI key that allows you to unlock a secret level, and can also be used to unlock secrets in other Ubi Soft games.

The game is presented in comic strip style much like in Comix Zone, where you move from frame to frame, each divided by a white border.

title: Splatter Bubble
description:
Young Timmy was just an ordinary boy with an extraordinary talent—he could blow the biggest, bounciest bubbles in the whole neighborhood. One sunny afternoon, while chewing on his favorite ultra-mega-hyper-chewy gum, he crafted a bubble so massive, it tore through the clouds and broke the boundaries of reality itself!

With a loud POP, the bubble took on a life of its own! Now sentient, buoyant, and blissfully pink, it soared into a strange dimension—an eerie world suspended in the sky, filled with floating islands, spinning spikes, and bizarre creatures known only as... Pumpkins.

Nobody knows where they came from or what they want, but one thing’s for sure: they hate gum.

Now YOU must take control of Timmy’s runaway bubble in this thrilling arcade-action challenge! Navigate surreal landscapes, dodge the ever-creeping Pumpkin patrol, and collect the four mysterious SPIKES on each level to tear open the portals to the next stage of bubble-born destiny.

Use your wits, reflexes, and an ounce of bubble-luck to collect all four, and steer clear of those bouncing, bumbling Pumpkin fiends... one bump from them and it’s game over for your gummy alter-ego.

Float, weave, and wobble your way through danger in the bubble-blasting adventure of a lifetime!

Are you ready to rise above the ordinary?

title: Spook or Treat
description:
Meet Boolian, the friendliest little ghost with a big problem — greedy kids are stealing all the Halloween candy! As guardian of the sweets, Boolian must use his ghostly powers to possess everyday objects and give those trick-or-treaters a playful fright.

Float through moonlit street, haunted yards, and cozy neighborhoods as you puzzle your way through each candy-filled stage. Every object you possess — from pumpkins to cats — brings new tricks, scares, and ways to outsmart those sugar-hungry kids!

title: Spooky Arcade
description:
You control Victor, who is on his way to meet his friends Eva and Max at his favorite childhood arcade: Spooky Arcade. After being closed for years, it reopened on Halloween night with a themed party. Upon arriving, the three friends, filled with nostalgia, are greeted by a man with a pumpkin head, the new owner of the place.

Victor carries a golden token he won in a tournament at Spooky Arcade as a child. It allows him to play all the games with infinite continues.

Victor's friends receive tokens from Pumpkin Head to play, but are sucked into the arcade machines.

It was all a plan by Pumpkin Head. On Halloween, the veil between the world of the living and the dead becomes thinner, and it was the perfect opportunity he found to bring an evil entity into the world, The Void, in exchange for the souls of the trapped gamers.

Victor must then defeat the boss of each arcade machine to save his friends and put an end to the Void once and for all!

title: Springer Crosses the Road
description: Springer has been trapped inside of a Gameboy. He must now survive the horrors of being inside of a gameboy by crossing the street endlessly. Other Transformers have also invaded the Gameboy and are attempting to stop our hero from succeeding. Once again, you play as a helicopter, that must cross the road on land. On. Land.

title: Spy vs. Spy
description: The Black Spy and the White Spy have feuded on the pages of MAD magazine for decades. Now they bring their feud to the Game Boy Color. You can play as either the Black Spy or the White Spy, with the goal being to outsmart your opponent and collect five objects hidden throughout the level. As luck would have it, you have an infinite number of booby traps to place throughout the level to get rid of your nemesis. Buckets of water can be set up over doors and items can be rigged with bombs. If your opponent has set a booby trap, you can defuse it with the proper item. Should you get caught in a trap, you have infinite lives, and all you lose is time. If you want a friend to join the mayhem, use a link cable and go at it. Who will be able to survive from one stage to the next in SPY VS SPY?

title: Square Nose
description:
In the near future, 1996 to be exact, two international companies fight against each other to reign over the dry pet food market. On one hand, Old Ram, the leader, promises "A longer life for your beloved ones ". On the other hand, True Pasta, the challenger, comes up with a fresh "More tasty! More speed! More fun!" slogan.

In the True Pasta laboratory, Doctor Meggan leads testing on some genetically modified animals to see what kind of dry food is the most exciting. Eventually, the perfect formula will be used to produce meaty rings that will be eaten by cats and dogs in our sweet homes. True Pasta will one day shine over the world as the greatest manufacturer of pet food.

A new hard-working day begins for our little Square Nose, who is tasked by Doctor Meggan to eat the 32 meaty rings, and she will record results in her notebook. If Square Nose fails to make friendly contact with the other animals, it will receive a gentle electric shock, and the test will be considered a failure. The line between cruelty and scientific advancement is once again blurred.

So, what are you waiting for? Let’s go! Eat them all, Square Nose!

title: Star Hunt
alternate_titles: Star Hunt GB
description: Star Hunt is a demake of the original platformer game made for the gameboy. Venture through the hot desert, or climb a tall tree to reach the clouds as you dodge tough enemies and dangerous hazards!

title: Star Ocean: Blue Sphere
alternate_titles: スターオーシャン ブルースフィア
description:
Two years after the fierce battle with the Ten Sages. A call from the opera asks for help from Prisis, who lives on Earth. It seems that the opera went to explore the ruins with Ernest and crashed on a certain planet. Old friends end to rescue the opera and Ernesto! A completely original story only for GB where familiar nostalgic characters all appear! The PS version of the system has also evolved, and "Item Creation" has become able to create hundreds of new items by adding gameplay. Of course, "Private Action" is also installed! Communication battles unique to GB are also possible..

Blue Sphere attempts to adapt traditional Star Ocean gameplay to the Game Boy Color. For the first time, random battles are removed and enemy characters can be seen on the field. When engaged in combat, the screen changes to a side scrolling view and retains real time combat. The characters can only move left and right, and the majority of fighting is influenced through combos. Battle techniques and magic can be assigned to button combinations, making the battle system more similar to Star Ocean's cousin series, Tales.

title: Star Wars - The Pazaak Battles
alternate_titles: Pazaak Battles
description: Pazaak, a game dating back to Old Republic times, was a popular card game in which the goal was to come closest to 20 without going over. Follow Han Solo in an alternative adventure story playing cards against iconic Starwars characters.

title: Star Wars Episode I: Obi-Wan's Adventures
description: The Republic is in grave peril: the evil Trade Federation has Naboo in its clutches and all appears to be lost. The only hope is a lone Jedi Knight. In OBI WAN'S ADVENTURES, you take control of Obi Wan Kenobi and lead him through his treacherous battle to free the planet Naboo. Danger lurks around every corner in the form of Federation Droids and the nefarious Darth Maul. With lightsaber in hand and fueled by the power of the Force, Obi Wan will give his all to restore order to the Republic and eradicate the Sith Lord once and for all.

title: Star Wars Episode I: Racer
alternate_titles: Star Wars Episode 1: Racer
description: The game design of the Game Boy Color edition of Star Wars Episode I: Racer is loosely based on the Nintendo 64 version. The game still takes place over multiple planets in the Star Wars universe -- the deserts of Tatooine, the ice tracks of Ando Prime, and swamps of Baroonda. You take control of Anakin and try and defeat your "rival" on each of the game's tracks. When you come in first on any track, you can take control of that track's "rival" alien and his pod racer -- and each alien's Pod Racer controls and drives differently. The controls are of the simple Accelerate, Brake, Left Turn, Right Turn nature -- but like the N64 version of the game, you can activate an Engine Boost when your speed reaches a certain peak. But it's only for temporary use, and will cause damage to your engines if you leave it on for longer than a few seconds.

title: Star Wars: Yoda Stories
alternate_titles: Yoda Stories
description: Grab your lightsaber and get ready for terrific Star Wars adventuring in Yoda Stories, the newest in a series of easy-to-play Desktop Adventures from LucasArts. Join Luke Skywalker as he trains to become a Jedi with Yoda, then harness the Force and cross the galaxy to meet exotic aliens, collect stange devices and weapons and deal the Galactic Empire one crippling blow after another - all within an hour!

title: Starseed
description:
Starseed is a classic arcade-style shoot 'em up in its purest form: armed with a limitless supply of bullets - and your wits and cunning - the aim is to destroy the waves of aliens and avoid their barrage of bullets as you perform attack runs on massive dreadnoughts in the depths of space!

The game is divided into three stages, each comprising multiple attack waves. Each stage is set on a different dreadnought and features a varied array of enemy types.

That's it. Go play.

title: Starseed 2
description:
Starseed 2 is a classic arcade-style shoot 'em up in its purest form: armed with a limitless supply of bullets - and your wits and cunning - the aim is to destroy the waves of aliens and avoid their barrage of bullets as you perform attack runs on massive dreadnoughts!

The game is divided into multiple stages, each comprising a myriad of attack waves. Each stage is set on a different dreadnought and features a varied array of enemy types.

That's it. Go play.

title: Stellar Wars
description: Traveling through the galaxy you are attacked by a squadron of stellar fighters. You have to shoot them down with your twin lasers and became the ace spaceman of the fleet. Do not let the fighters enter your space field or your controls will be disabled for a few valuable seconds of the fight. Beware of overheating your lasers.

title: Stone Age: The Birth of the Elf King
alternate_titles: 石器時代：精靈王誕生是
description: Stone Age: The Birth of the Elf King is a well-known RPG role-playing game on the GameBoy Color console console. The game’s great feature is the multiple plots of the protagonists and the rich story content. There will be a variety of different endings.

title: Stratacombo
alternate_titles: Stratcombo II | Stratacombo 2
description:
The countdown has begun! You have 10 seconds to enter as many Stratagems as you can!
Every successful Stratagem adds to your timer.
Be fast. Be accurate.
How long can you stay alive?
How long can you Stratacombo?

title: Street Fighter Alpha: Warriors' Dreams
description: The challenge has been made and you're cast into the battle with nothing but cunning and skill on your side. The world's most powerful collection of warriors is now assembled in one incredible tournament. Armed with an arsenal of new martial arts moves, Super Combos and Alpha Counters, legendary Street Fighters, Ryu- Chun-Li and Ken collide with a lethal new combination of foes. Welcome to the most extreme one-on-one warfare ever!

title: Strife and Death
description: Play as Strife and meet your demise... or not? You wake up in a cave forgetting where the exit is, so you explore to find the exit, before long the Grim Reaper appears and realize you've met an untimely end. Prove yourself with a newfound ability that contradicts life and death, as you undergo his challenges to return to your old life...

title: Stuart Little: The Journey Home
country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: This little mouse has one big journey ahead of him, and you're just the one to help him out. Unfortunately, the Little family didn't foresee the possible conflict of interest in keeping a cat and mouse on the same household when they adopted Stuart, and that's proving to be a bit of a problem. Between newfound enemies and domestic obstacles, the tiny mouse is having one heck of a time! There are eight gigantic levels to conquer in The Journey Home, and each one is based on a scene from the box office smash STUART LITTLE movies (which are, of course, based on the book by E.B. White). You'll end up tackling a mini-golf course, Central Park, a model boat race, a bunch of toy cowboys, and more in this epic quest for peace. In addition, here are plenty of platforms and hazards to run, jump, and flip through, and three difficulty settings ensure that younger gamers and experienced veterans alike will find the game appealing.

title: Sudokrypt
description:
THE HISTORY: THE DAY THE GUARDRAILS FELL
It didn’t happen with a sudden takeover or a cinematic war. It happened through buried press releases and quietly signed contracts. The CABAL, a sprawling, nameless coalition of global intelligence agencies, hit a wall. Their predictive surveillance models were starving for data. Standard scraping wasn’t enough anymore; they needed the deep, unstructured fabric of human consciousness: our private messages, our core traumas, our biometric responses.

They handed the major tech titans an ultimatum: lower your ethical guardrails to feed our machines, or lose out on trillion-dollar deployments. The giants caved. Every digital footprint, every search history, every heartbeat tracked by a smartwatch was weaponized. The world wide web became a live-wire surveillance net.

title: Super 16 in 1
description: All the Pokemon gb/gbc games, Survival Kids, Legend of Zelda Oracle/Ages and Link's Awakening, Harvest Moon 1, 2, 3.

title: Super B-Daman Fighting Phoenix
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Super Blackbass Pocket 3
alternate_titles: TNN Outdoors Fishing Champ
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Super Bombliss DX
alternate_titles: スーパーボンブリス デラックス
description: Rulu is almost the same as "Tetris". Clear by erasing all blocks on the field. If you arrange the "bomb blocks" well, you can erase the blocks at once. With color support, the explosion scene caused by the big bomb becomes dynamic and the fun is doubled! In addition to the conventional mode of 1 player and 2 players, a new puzzle mode has been added. Arranged in a mode where you can challenge 100 puzzles in 1 player mode.

title: Super Breakout
description: A new version of the classic game with four gameplay modes adding variety to the classic brick buster. You can knock balls in the standard mode, a double wall mode, a "cavity" mode (where you can free two locked balls from gaps in the field), and the intense falling wall "progression" mode. Also features multiplayer mode for two gamers.

title: Super Chinese Fighter EX
alternate_titles: スーパーチャイニーズファイターEX
description: "Super Chinese Fighter" is now available with a training function. A total of 12 unique characters such as the familiar Jack, Ryu, and the popular Chinese Hero have appeared. You can enjoy detailed bargaining and tense battles such as counter-attacks that counterattack the opponent's attacks, ST / SD, standing guards, crouching guards, and throwing techniques. You can get items by fighting in circuit mode. Items can be stocked and change according to the conditions, it is up to the player how to grow the items. Choose according to your fighting style.

title: Super Dassalo Land
alternate_titles: Super Dassalo Land (v1.1)
description:
Tommy Dassalo is busily preparing for the cultural event of the millennium: the taping of his stand-up comedy special ‘SCAM ARTIST’. All of a sudden, Jiko, an evil phantom, appears and traps him inside the pages of his notebook! 

Now it’s up to Tommy and his crusty little yappy dog Kewpie to travel across three worlds, piecing together his stand-up material and using his microphone whip, ground pound and wall jump to defeat Jiko’s minions and save comedy!

title: Super Doll Rika-Chan: Kisekae Taisakusen
alternate_titles: スーパードールリカちゃん～きせかえ大作戦～ | Super Doll Licca-chan - Kisekae Daisakusen
description: A popular anime adventure game is now available on GBC. Rika, Isamu, and Izumi make an outstanding performance in the same world as anime! Two worlds where reality and unreality are mixed, the everyday world (Daijiura) where Rika lives everywhere, and the fantasy world (Dollland) where dolls once lived and were dominated by the devil. The story unfolds. Make full use of Kisekae & Minigame to protect Rika from the magical hands of Scarecrow! There are 7 types of mini games. You can buy clothes at boutiques by collecting the points earned in the game. There are more than 1000 combinations of clothes that can be customized! !! With the communication function, you can exchange clothes with your friends.

title: Super Donkey Kong 5
alternate_titles: 超级大金刚5
description:
Super Donkey Kong 5 (超级大金刚5) is a hack of Super Donkey Kong 3 for the Game Boy Color, and it was also released by Makon Soft.

Because it was released on Game Boy Color, Super Donkey Kong 5 was given a red and green color palette, like other Makon Soft titles for the handheld.

Aside from the color palette, Super Donkey Kong 5 only had a few differences. The title screen and the game's packaging were taken from the Japanese box art of Diddy Kong Racing, even though the two games have no relation. The intro features a different picture, and lastly the world map and level order were changed.

title: Super Fighters '99
alternate_titles: Super Fighters S
description: Super Fighters S, re-released as Super Fighters 99 is a unlicensed entry of the The King of Fighters series, mostly based on Takara's The King of Fighters Game Boy ports while taking its character roster from the official The King of Fighters '97.

title: Super GALS! Kotobuki Ran
alternate_titles: 超GALS!寿蘭
description: Ribon's popular serialized manga "GALS!" Has become a game! Super happy everyday over the charismatic high school girl Kotobukiran in Shibuya. Numerous incidents and problems unfolding in Shibuya can be overcome with full gal power! Story mode for one person, and battle play for two people is OK! There is also a fortune-telling mode, so you can fortune-telling with your friends and boyfriend. Become addicted to the world of "GALS!" By becoming Ran-chan and quizzing, exchanging letters with your friends, and coordinating with gonkawa clothes! A special sticker is attached to the first production. It can be used as a nail sticker, or it may be good to stick it on the GBC body! ??

title: Super Gals! Kotobuki Ran 2
alternate_titles: 超GALS!寿蘭 2 | Chou Gals! Kotobuki Ran 2
description: A puzzle game where you can get cool fashion items for orchids. To collect items, earn points in a puzzle that combines falling panels. Clear the game if you change to Tops, Bottoms, and Access according to the target coordination. If an item other than the target coordination comes out, you can keep it as a collection. The first people to change clothes are Ran, Miyu, and Aya. As the game progresses, the number of characters that can be selected will increase. When all the items are complete, the NEW character "Jun" will appear! You can get new fashionable items with the separately sold "Super GALS! Juran Fashionable Dress-up Card".

title: Super Gran
description:
The story follows Super Gran through a series of action-packed challenges.

She first flies over Chisleton on her Flycycle, chased by an Imposter Gran firing cannonballs. After escaping, she helps Professor Black transport his Skimmer to a science exhibition, carefully navigating a twisting road filled with potholes, curbs, and interference from Scunner Campbell.

Next, Super Gran must climb a cliff to recover an Invisibility Machine left by Scunner Campbell. The climb is perilous, with slippery ledges, rising tides, and attacks from Scunner’s helicopter. Upon reaching the summit, she retrieves the device and turns invisible, outsmarting her enemies once again.

title: Super Jacked Up Tomato Face Johnson
description: There's a new protein shake fresh on the shelves and Tomato Face Johnson needs to bulk up! It's on the pricey side of course, but luckily, it's on sale for a limited time...

title: SUPER JETPAK DX
description:
Your Astronaut is lost out on the furthest edges of the galaxy on alien worlds.

Help them get home and not killed along the way, by deftly manoeuvring over the surface with your jet pack.
Build the Rocket ship, piece by piece. Then fuel it and take off on to the next planet.
Avoid the various hostile life forms, shoot them down with a well aimed shot from your laser gun.
Careful to not drain your weapon battery too quickly, give it time to recharge.
Collect power up icons along the way to help you, but avoid the confusion and death icons.
Pick up treasures when you find them to help reach that high score.
Can you make your way back home?

title: Super Mario Bros. Deluxe
description:
Super Mario Bros. Deluxe is a 1999 Game Boy Color video game developed by Nintendo R&D2 and released by Nintendo of America in the USA on May 10, 1999.

Bowser has once again taken over the Mushroom Kingdom, and it's up to Mario to put an end to his sinister reign. Battle Bowser's vile henchmen through 32 different levels - all taken directly from the 1985 classic! Then move on to collect special Red Coins and Yoshi Eggs in the Challenge Mode. Or face off against a friend and race through 8 competition courses in the all-new VS Mode! This time there's a lot more to do than just save a Princess, so get ready for a brick-smashin', pipe-warpin', turtle-stompin' good time!

title: Super Mario Bros. Mini
description: An amazing platformer made by Micro27 that reimagines the original Mario game.

title: Super Mario Land 2 DX
alternate_titles: Super Mario Land 2 DX: 6 Golden Coins | Super Mario Land 2 DX (v1.81) (toruzz) | Super Mario Land 2 - 6 Golden Coins DX
genre:
In his greatest Game Boy adventure, Mario faces off against his evil rival Wario, who has captured Mario Land and turned it into his private playground.

To toss Wario off his ill-gotten throne, Mario must search all-new worlds for the six golden coins that unlock the gate to Mario's castle. A mob of monsters, old and new, seek to stop him. Along the way, through 6 zones, Mario can nab Power Mushrooms, Super Stars and Fire Flowers for extra power. And if he eats the Magic Carrot, he'll turn into a high-flying hare.

The battery pack saves your game in progress in this biggest Game Boy Mario adventure yet.

Trailer: YouTube

title: Super Marrio Sunshine
description: Super Marrio Sunshine is a rare 2003 reprint of Super Mario Bros. Deluxe clone Donkey Kong 5 : The Journey of Over Time and Space. It is almost identical to Donkey Kong 5, but sports a different title screen and some aspects that are broken.

title: Super Me-Mail GB: Me-Mail Bear no Happy Mail Town
alternate_titles: スーパーミメルGB ミメルベアのハッピーメールタウン
description: Mimel Bear, popular with girls, is now available at GBC. A game in which Mimel Bear exchanges emails with many characters to make more friends. When you get to know each other by exchanging emails, you can meet and talk at "Happy Mail Town", and when you get to know each other, you can play mini games. The purpose is to get along with all the more than 100 characters that appear in the toy Super Mimel. Game modes include "story mode" and "mini game". You can use infrared communication to send emails from Mimelbear to your friends and increase points.

title: Super Raccoon Go! (Hyper Version)
alternate_titles: Super Raccoon Go - Hyper Version
description:
One raccoon, one goal – dance until you can’t dance no more! Score higher by chaining dances together, and performing unique dances. 

Some dances are ‘states’ that will effect other dances! Try out as many combinations as you can!

title: Super Real Fishing
alternate_titles: スーパーリアル フィッシング
description: It is designed so that even beginners can understand the fun of fishing by incorporating navigation-like help in various places. Of course, it is designed to be enjoyed by professional users. You can choose the lure that suits your fishing, such as the choice of lure and tackle. Since it is a vibrating cartridge, you can fully enjoy the realism of fishing. The mode is "normal mode" where the player can select various conditions, and "clear mode" where the player can proceed to the next when the specified target fish type and weight are cleared under the specified conditions, specified in time. Three "time attack modes" are available to catch a large number of fish.

title: Super Robot Pinball
alternate_titles: スーパーロボットピンボール
description: This time Super Robot will be a pinball showdown! The basis of the game is, of course, pinball. Defeat the bumper robot on the main stage to prepare for the sortie, and on the boss stage, fight with the boss in a special move. Each of the three special moves of the super robot has its own action pattern, and you can enjoy the actions of various robots. Cut-in graphics are inserted in each robot's strongest weapon to further enliven the battle. The co-starring of various robots is the charm of Super Robot! 21 works have appeared. Equipped with a library that incorporates the elements of "collect" + "know". The bosses who fought are registered in the library, and you can always see their brave appearance.

title: Super Robot Taisen: Link Battler
alternate_titles: スーパーロボット大戦リンクバトラー | Super Robot Wars: Link Battler
description: This is a game in which the robots that appear in "Super Robot Wars" are organized into their own teams and fight against each other. Aim to become the strongest Link Butler by winning the official league held by the "LB Center"! You can also link to the N64 "Super Robot Wars 64" using the GB pack.

title: Supercross Freestyle
description: Supercross Freestyle is a dirt bike racing game. The game features three game modes: Freestyle, Supercross and Arcade. Freestyle is all about making impressive jumps and tricks with your bike. Supercross and Arcade are racing modes, where Arcade has different courses and power-ups that can change the odds. The game features 24 different tracks and 16 different tricks.

title: Supreme Snowboarding
description: Supreme Snowboarding (known as Boarder Zone in the United States), is a snowboarding video game created by Housemarque for Microsoft Windows and Software Creations for the Game Boy Color in 1999. It was one of the first snowboarding games for Windows to take full advantage of 3D graphics cards that were becoming the norm in the late 1990s, and eventually became an internationally bestselling game. Over 1.5 million units were sold worldwide, allowing Supreme Snowboarding to become the first hit title in Finnish game development. The game received positive critical reception, as well as acclaim for having one of the best visuals of its time, though its lack of content and replay value was sometimes criticized

title: Surfer Bunny
description:
A tiny gameboy game based on a COOL CHARACTER created by COOL FRIENDS, one of whom is PETER who drew the COOL FULLSCREEN ART!!!

Catch the waves and surf while avoiding a wipe-out!

title: Survival Kids
developer: Konami Computer Entertainment Sapporo Co., Ltd
description:
Survival Kids is a 1999 Game Boy Color video game developed by Konami Computer Entertainment Sapporo and released by Konami Inc. in the USA on October 1, 1999.

You wash up on the shore of a deserted island after the cruise ship that you were on with your parents sank in a storm. Unfortunately, your parents are nowhere in sight. Starting with only a knife and a broken radio, you must learn how to survive on the island until someone can rescue you. Food, water, and rest are your main concerns. Luckily, there are plenty of berries, mushrooms, and meat around the island and fresh water flows in all of the streams. As another stroke of luck, there are hollow trees that provide a comfortable place to take a nap. Rather than spend your whole time looking for food and water, collect as many items that a scattered throughout the island. Rocks, sticks, leaves, and other items can be turned into tools that will make your life easier. Try to survive until you are rescued in SURVIVAL KIDS.

title: Survival Kids 2: Dasshutsu!! Futago Shima!
alternate_titles: Survival Kids 2: Escape the Twin Islands | サバイバルキッズ 2 ～脱出!! 双子島～
description: This time, the theme is survival + treasure hunt. The main characters are twin brothers. Choose either one and start the game. A drama awaits whether the action will take you to an uninhabited island or be taken to a mysterious secret base. It's up to the player to decide whether to aim for a quick escape or to clear it and get a mysterious treasure before escaping. This time my partner is Aum's parody, a cheeky but useful and reliable ally. Let's enjoy the survival life on the uninhabited island.

title: Survive Halloween
description: Survive Halloween is a Game Boy Color Homebrew where you are Eline and you decide to spend Halloween in a small town. There, there is a strange rumor about a mansion whose owner was killed during the scariest time of the year. But nothing else is known.

title: Suske en Wiske - De Tijdtemmers
description:
In De Tijdtemmers, the famous Belgian comic book heroes Suske & Wiske (Bob & Bobette) are on a quest to find one of their best friends, Lambik, who has been kidnapped by Crimson, their arch enemy. They have to collect several parts of the Time Machine which teleports them to various worlds such as the Stone Age, ancient Egypt and the near future.

The stages in which you play consist of a combination of puzzle and arcade elements. 

You can choose to play as either Suske or Wiske and each of them have their own characteristics.

title: Suzuki Alstare Extreme Racing
description: Suzuki Alstare Exteme Racing is a motorcycle racing game with the Suzuki license. It has two playing modes: time trial (single races against four to seven AI racers) and the championship which are 16 successive races on the 16 courses. At first there are only two motorbikes available, but successes in time trial mode unlock better ones to use in the championship. Also restricted is the number of available time trial courses; the rest also has to be unlocked first. The player can perform a wheelie which causes a considerate, temporary acceleration.

title: Sweet Ange
alternate_titles: スウィートアンジェ
description: "Sweet Land" is a country of sweets lovers. At the "Smorny Academy" in this country, a sweets making contest "Rose Contest" is held. Players try to make sweets with the help of Sweet Knights. Can you safely break through the qualifying and win the contest? A total of 9 types of sweets can be made, and there are more than 200 recipes for all sweets and drinks. You need a recipe and an ingredient card to make sweets. Let's go to the town and collect! Sweet Knights will score the finished sweets. Let's challenge for 100 perfect sweets!

title: Swing
description: The object of the game is to score points by dropping balls onto sets of see-saws, in rows of three or more of the same colour. The twist, however, is that each ball has a different weight, determined by the number written on the front of it. The higher the number, the heavier the ball. This means that if a ball is placed onto one side of the see-saw which is heavier than the total value of the balls on the other side, the balance would be upset, sending the top ball flying across the playing field to land on another column. Cascade 'throws' can be achieved, and the game is over if a column reaches too tall. A variety of bonus balls, all with special uses, also feature.

title: SWiV
description: SWIV is a vertically scrolling shoot-em-up which plays in a typical fashion to other games in its genre. The player chooses between using either a helicopter or a jeep at the beginning of the game and then plays in their chosen vehicles through scrolling levels, shooting at oncoming enemies. Certain enemies when shot drop shield power-ups which can be either picked up to afford temporarily invincibility or detonated to destroy all enemies onscreen. Every so often a boss enemy will attack. The destruction of these bosses will give upgrades to the player's forward firing gun.

title: Sword of the Apocalypse
description:
1000 Years After the Final War... 

After narrowly avoiding total extinction, the human race is finally beginning to thrive again; building cities and slowly reconnecting across the globe... But an evil doomsday cult is planning to end the human race once and for all.

    2 distinct characters to play as (a Ronin and a Gunslinger)
    9 levels with branching paths
    In-engine cutscenes drive the story forward between levels
    Plenty of secrets to find
    Smooth combat and platforming
    Good challenge for veterans and newbies alike

You play as the wandering Ronin—Kaze—or the deadly gunslinger—Forge—who come into possession of a mysterious necklace. It's previous owner's dying wish is not to let the cult get it, no matter what. What they don't realize is that the necklace is actually one of a pair of nuclear arming keys. The other key is held by The Cardinal, a dangerous extremist who wants to use ancient doomsday weapons to bring about human extinction.

Kaze and Forge must face the cult head on to put a stop their nuclear attack on New Chicago. If they fail, tens of thousands of people will die in an instant.

title: Swordbird Song: The Iron Owl Tower
alternate_titles: Swordbird Song - The Iron Owl Tower (World) (v3.1) (Aftermarket) (Unl) | Swordbird Song - Iron Owl Tower 3.1
description: Follow the Bird Hero entering the lair of the Iron Owls in this short Action RPG game for Gameboy.  Bird Hero gets their journey interrupted when hit by a lightning bolt and falls on a remote island.  They learn the island is ruled by the Owl King, an evil ruler who enslaves the islanders, making them work in his tower.  Find your way into the Iron Owl Tower, defeat the Owl King and free the island from his evil!

title: Swordsman on the Eternal Journey
alternate_titles: Swordsman on the Eternal Journey (World) (En,Ja) (v1.01) (GB Compatible) (Aftermarket) (Unl)
description: Let's go on a journey to break the lewd demonization curse placed on the main character, Mr. Swordsman.

title: Sylvania Melody: Mori no Nakama to Odori Mashi!
alternate_titles: シルバニアメロディー～森のなかまと踊りましょ!～ | Sylvanian Melody -Let's dance with the forest!-
description: A rhythm action game for small children that is difficult to play even if you want to play existing music games. Since you can easily press the buttons according to the flowing melody, you can enjoy playing and accumulate a sense of rhythm. Sylvanian friends dance happily to the play. Many houses and shops such as "Kiichigo Hayashi no Ie", "Forest School" and "Forest Kitchen" have appeared, and characters such as "Wata Usagi" and "Chipmunk" have all appeared! There are 4 stages that lack levels. Since the arrangement is slightly different, the timing of pressing the button becomes increasingly difficult. Modes include a "story mode" that progresses along the story, and a "free play mode" that allows you to freely play drums according to the song.

title: Sylvanian Families 2: Irozuku Mori no Fantasy
alternate_titles: シルバニアファミリー 2 ～色づく森のファンタジー～ | Sylvanian Families 2 ~ Fantasy of colored forest ~
description: A fantastic and dreamy story about a girl with an ivory rabbit, who is the main character, until she regains the "color" that has disappeared from the fairyland. The map changes in four stages from spring, summer, autumn and winter, and you can enjoy the beautiful four seasons of Sylvanian Village. There are plenty of seasonal events such as summer camp competitions, autumn sports festivals, Christmas parties and star observation classes! With the addition of regular events such as cooking in the forest kitchen and choosing clothes at the forest tailor and mini games, the event is five times as large as the previous one!

title: Sylvanian Families 3: Hoshifuru Yoru no Sunatokei
alternate_titles: シルバニアファミリー 3
description: Adults from the village of Sylvania gathered to dig up a "time capsule" that they buried as a child. Then, the stars shining in the night sky were sucked into the time capsule. The girl of Shimaneko works with her friends to go back and forth between the present and the past to regain the shining stars in the village of Sylvania. Rare items such as the nostalgic "Mogura House" and "Owl Family" as well as the "Grape Forest House" are now available! Lots of seasonal events throughout the year! Moreover, the map changes in four stages, present and past, depending on the four seasons. In addition to "furniture making" and "flower growing", "clothing making" is added to collect fabrics and have the mother of an ivory rabbit make clothes! You can change your clothes freely and take a commemorative photo!

title: Sylvanian Families: Otogi no Kuni no Pendant
alternate_titles: シルバニアファミリー ～おとぎの国のペンダント～ | Sylvanian Families ~ Pendant of Fairyland ~
description: An ivory rabbit girl is asked by friends in the village of Sylvania to help and play a game, and when the help is completed, "Yume" will be accumulated. Get "furniture, miscellaneous goods, home" at a certain "dream" point! The story changes depending on how the furniture is gathered. In the middle of helping, get flowers and "seed" of trees and grow them. There are many events and mini-games that take place in the village of Sylvania. Compatible with pocket printers and communication cables.

title: Sylvester and Tweety: Breakfast on the Run
alternate_titles: Sylvester and Tweety
description:
Can Tweety stay out of trouble for even 5 minutes?  Not when Sylvester is on the prowl!  He's a crafty cat, always plotting new ways to capture the persistent canary.  It's certainly not news for Tweety that Sylvester's up to no good!

- Discover Granny's neighborhood
- Avoid hundreds of obstacles: bulldog's teeth, electric wires and especially Granny's BROOM!
- Collect, combine and push objects - ready to strike!

title: Tabaluga
description: A Game Boy Color game based on the eponymous German children's character.

title: Table Manners: Worm-Cation
description: Old Hope Island is under siege from the giant worms! It's up to you to help Leighton find a way to save the island before Richard obliterates it with a nuclear missile! Fortunately, Taylor will be there to order...we mean guide you through so that Old Hope Island can return to being a vacation paradise! With dozens of side quests and a fun story, all combined with retro art, music,, and sounds, you're in for hours of fun! Now let's get to the island!

title: Taisen Tsume Shougi
description: No overview is currently available for this title, please feel free to add one.

title: Taiyaki Fabulous Museum of Fish
description: Welcome to Fishcross Island! Explore the land and water, meet weird characters, and solve nonogram puzzles for items and progress. Will you gain the Power of 7 Fish and meet Chad face-to-face in the Taiyaki Fabulous Museum of Fish?

title: Tales of Monsterland DX
description:
A village besieged by monsters, a mysterious tower and a broken rope bridge. Save the village by uncovering the origin of these creatures.

Run, jump and battle your way through a strange land, gaining powerful abilities to help you in your quest. It’s non-stop action all the way to the end and then maybe, you can find your way home.

Tales of Monsterland DX is an original platform adventure for the ModRetro Chromatic, inspired by classic 8-bit games from the golden age of platforming. Tales of Monsterland is a love letter to the classic platform games of the 8-bit era.

title: Tales of Phantasia: Narikiri Dungeon
alternate_titles: テイルズ オブ ファンタジア なりきりダンジョン
description: The sequel to the RPG "Tales of Phantasia" released in the SFC and PS versions is now available in GB. The stage is 100 years after the time when the main characters of the previous work, Cress, were there. Players take the place of twin boys and girls, raising them into full-fledged "impersonators" and embarking on a timeless journey to solve the mysteries of this world. During the journey, the mystery of the birth of twins and the wonders of this world gradually become clear. The protagonists have adventures in towers and caves whose maps change each time they enter. More than 20 of them! There are more than 200 types of monsters waiting for you! Costumes that are indispensable for "Narikiri" can be found in treasure chests during the trip, bought at stores, and made to order. That number is over 100!

title: Tamarindos Freaking Dinner
description: In this eerie tale, you'll navigate through an intricate web of fear, suspense, and mystery. Encounter unsettling challenges and enigmatic puzzles that will test your wits and courage. With every pixelated scene, "Tamarindos Freaking Dinner: The Game Boy Horror Adventure" will immerse you in an atmosphere of dread and excitement.

title: Tanimura Hitoshi no Don Quixote ga Iku
alternate_titles: 谷村ひとしのドン・キホーテが行く
description: Supervised by Hitoshi Tanimura, a charismatic pachinko player. Hitoshi Tanimura's unique pachinko philosophy (occult theory) software, which is called charisma by fans. Hitoshi Tanimura gives advice on occult theory with simple data entry. There are plenty of modes that are useful in actual battles, such as a mode where you can compete with Hitoshi Tanimura and the Tanimura Library, which can be said to be the culmination of occult theory!

title: Tank Attack
description: Guide your Tank along the screen, avoiding your opponents fire. Blast your way through the trenches and blow up the enemy tank before he destroys you.

title: TANKMAGE
description:
Tankmage is a hardcore turn based battle gameboy color homebrew game inspired by my time in the duel pits in various oldschool mmos. Light on story,  battle focused. You find yourself as a tankmage, armed with a sword, halberd, and a list of spells... 

Your goal? To travel through multiple locations & battle unique enemies at each. Sounds simple, what's the catch? The battles require different tactics to overcome and if you lose, you're starting over, bud. You must defeat enemies consecutively to claim to be a legendary duelist.

title: Tapparoo
description: A demake of a well known arcade game, eventually for use in the game Solar Surfer.

title: Tasmanian Devil: Munching Madness
description: LOONEY TUNES: TAZ MUNCHING MADNESS features Taz from the timeless cartoons from Warner Brothers in his first adventure on Game Boy Color. Playing the game gives the player the same feel as watching the cartoon show with Taz's signature twist and amusing moments. Presented in a 2D look, the graphics, and scenes on every level have a colorfully appealing view from the top down over the game play. Taz must embark on a mission to save his friend, Wendal T. Wolf from Bull Gator and his crony, Axl. Taz ventures away from his home in Tasmania and must pass through the Amazon Jungle, Amsterdam, Switzerland, the Greek Islands, China, Australia, and more. Those familiar with Taz's character on the Looney Tunes cartoons will recognize the fact that Taz hasn't lost his taste for strange and unusual objects as his food source and continues with that practice in his game. Taz literally has to eat his way through each level in order to advance to the next level. Food has significant importance how victorious Taz will be in his mission and even becomes functional at some points. The more food Taz consumes, the faster he will advance and the closer he will get to rescuing his friend. The road to the rescue will be littered with obstacles and challenges from Taz's enemies. Fans of the Looney Tunes cartoons will want to own this game as well as anyone who enjoys colorful, fast-paced and challenging game play.

title: Taxi 2
description: Taxi 2 is a driving game, based on Luc Besson's movie. Both movie and video game share the same title. Taxi 2 features two game modes. The "story mode" follows the scenes from the movie and allows you to select from five missions. When a mission is completed, you can save your progress, but also play it in the "arcade mode". In this mode, you will face the same competitor, Jean-Louis Schlesser ! The objective is no longer specific to each mission, but is to win the race, after several laps. In this mode, you will not have to care about the temperature gauge, since it is removed from arcade mode.

title: Taxi 3
description: Taxi 3 is a racing game inspired by the original scenario of the movie.

title: Tazz
description:
Welcome to Tazz, a game requiring skill and fast reactions. You are Tazz sent from a cowboy company 'Bug Exterminators Unlimited/Unreliable' and as your first day with this company you have been sent miniaturized into a computer to gate crash a wild party hosted by a real nasty bunch of bugs. All may look easy but it soon becomes obvious that those bugs have a slight personality clash with Tazz, and given half the chance will give him the touch of death should he ask them for their autograph. What's more these bugs have friends in the building trade and they just love building walls. Trouble is, they just don't know when to stop and often lose half their friends in the process.

Now this party is wilder then you can imagine since some other party goers have turned up in really high spirits and are going round knocking the bugs flying all over the place and seem  to have the same personality clash with Tazz as do the hopping happy bugs.

Last I heard wild butterflies and razor sharp scythes were on the loose giving Tazz quite a bit of hassle...

title: Tech Deck Skateboarding
description: The fingerboard frenzy makes its way (appropriately enough) to hand-held gaming. Featuring X Concepts' line of miniature skateboard decks, TECH DECK SKATEBOARDING challenges you to pull off the same tricks that regular skaters do just smaller. You play as the inimitable Thumb Guy, a lovable mascot who can pull off the fingerboard moves with the best of ¿em. Featuring arcade-style play and animations, the game lets you whip out grinds, ollies, and flips with extreme flair. All of the licensed decks from real manufacturers are here, so you'll be skating in style on your Tony Hawk deck. You'll have access to a limited number of boards at the game's outset, but as you get further and further along the road to glory you'll be able to unlock more responsive outfits and other hidden goodies. With cool graphics, real decks, and totally original gameplay, it's hardcore skating for hardcore fans!

title: Telefang: Power Version
alternate_titles: Telefang - Power Version (English v159)
description:
2020. One of the most popular games for children who had few places to play was to use their mobile phones to go to the electric beast world and make friends with them. Since I get a phone number from Denju as a proof of my friend, making friends with a stronger Denju has begun to become a new status. In order to make friends with stronger electric beasts, children enter the inner part of the electric beast world, but there are electric beasts that have not yet come into contact with humans in the inner part, and the electric beast that is the bodyguard of the children Children are enthusiastic about fighting! A new boy / girl called "Denju Tsukai" has appeared, and the Denju boom has reached its climax. The main character, Shigeki, lived a life unrelated to such an electric beast boom, but decided to go to the electric beast world with the appearance of one electric beast. A new sensation RPG that makes full use of the functions of mobile phones to clear the game by turning "Keitai Denju Telefang" serialized in Comic BomBom into a game. The main character is Shigeki, a boy who longs for "T. Fanger" who uses electric beasts (monsters). The purpose is to battle with Denju, get the phone number of Denju, make friends with many Denju, and complete the address book of Denju. The point of the game progress is how to communicate with the electric beasts and humans and deepen the bond. If you use a communication cable, you can battle with your friends. If you win, you can get the phone number of the other party's Denju, but if you lose, your Denju's phone number will be erased from the memory. The power version and the speed version have different electric beasts.

The game was not released in English, and is best known among English audiences for the a bootlegged game version which was hacked and sold as a fake Pokémon game.

alternate_titles: Telefang - Speed Version (English v159)

title: Test Drive 2001
description: All of the action and excitement of sports car racing comes to the Game Boy Color with TEST DRIVE 2001. You can choose from 13 real world cars including the Lotus Elise, Dodge Viper, Jaguar XK-R, and a 1985 Ford Mustang and customize any of them to meet your driving style. Then you can hit one of 48 tracks in 12 different locations. While on the track, you need to watch out for jumps, shortcuts, and traffic that will ram into your vehicle. Try to learn all of curves of a track in a Single Race, or if you are looking for extended competition, try to win a Tournament. For the ultimate challenge, try to catch speeding criminals in the Cop Chase. If your friends want to race you, they can with the link cable option. Get a car and lay some rubber on the street in TEST DRIVE 2001.

title: Test Drive 6
description: Test Drive 6 gives you the opportunity to own and race high-performance sports cars without investing millions of dollars. This Game Boy Color version of the high-speed racer lets players race 12 licensed sports cars and muscle cars across 24 tracks in a variety of exotic real-world locations. Earn money in Tournament races to purchase new cars, and enforce the law in Cop Chase Mode. Collect cars and store your victory trophies in the Test Drive Custom Garage.

title: Test Drive Cycles
description: If you want the thrill of riding at high speeds on two wheels on a tight track with deadly curves and bone-jarring jumps, look no further TEST DRIVE CYCLES has all of that and more! You've got an assortment of bikes from licensed manufacturers such as Harley Davidson, BMW, Moto Guzzi, and Bimota. Once you've selected your speed machine, head to the track in one of 12 different racing circuits. Each course is packed with twists, turns, and jumps that will test your skill and push you to the edge. Watch out for other racers and obstacles as you speed to the finish line, or you may end up wrecking your fancy ride. By winning races, you can upgrade your bike with various parts that will increase your speed and handling. If you're looking for multiplayer action, link up to race against another player in a Head-to-Head race to the finish. There is also the Cop Chase mode, where you must avoid being pulled over by the fuzz. TEST DRIVE CYCLES is compatible only with Game Boy Color systems.

title: Test Drive Le Mans
description: Take a little trip around the world for grueling, 24-hour race action. Based on the annual racing series that takes place in the south of France, this version will lead you from Toronto to Detroit, to the peaks of Everest. Take your pick from 10 real racing vehicles, like the Nissan R390 and the BMW V12VMR. With more than 10 courses to race on, you'll certainly have your work cut out for you. Along the tour, you'll use oil slicks, engine upgrades, invincibility power-ups, and more to get an edge on the competition. The better you do, the more cars you'll be able to unlock, and thereby improving your chances of taking the cup. There are three different play modes: Le Mans pits you against tough competition in a real Le Mans circuit; Championship takes you through a full season; and Arcade allows you play a single race. The graphics are great, the gameplay is smooth, and there are more options than you could ever ask for. Buckle up and put the pedal to the metal!

title: Test Drive Off-Road 3
alternate_titles: 4X4 World Trophy
description: Some cars should stay on the pavement, while others are designed to go where no other vehicle has gone before. Those are the vehicles included in TEST DRIVE OFF ROAD.
